entry.summary: Identifies a fundamental structural bottleneck in LLM post-training RL: the absence of compact Markov states leading to a 'capability ceiling'. Proposes reintroducing explicit Markov states with theoretical guarantees showing significant sample complexity reduction.

entry.title: Goedel-Code-Prover: Hierarchical Proof Search for Open State-of-the-Art Code Verification

author.name: Zenan Li, Ziran Yang, Deyuan (Mike) He, Haoyu Zhao, Andrew Zhao, Shange Tang, Kaiyu Yang, Aarti Gupta, Zhendong Su, Chi Jin

entry.summary: Proposes a hierarchical proof search framework for automated code verification in Lean 4 that decomposes complex verification goals into simpler subgoals before tactic-level proving. Trains Goedel-Code-Prover-8B achieving state-of-the-art results on code verification benchmarks.

entry.title: AI Agents Can Already Autonomously Perform Experimental High Energy Physics

author.name: Eric A. Moreno, Samuel Bright-Thonney, Andrzej Novak, Dolores Garcia, Philip Harris

entry.summary: Claude Code autonomously performs substantial portions of a high energy physics analysis pipeline including event selection, background estimation, uncertainty quantification, statistical inference, and paper drafting. Authors argue the HEP community is underestimating AI agent capabilities.

entry.title: Speculating Experts Accelerates Inference for Mixture-of-Experts

author.name: Vivan Madan, Prajwal Singhania, Abhinav Bhatele, Tom Goldstein, Ashwinee Panda

entry.summary: Proposes an expert prefetching scheme for Mixture-of-Experts models that predicts future expert activations using current internal representations, enabling CPU-GPU memory transfers to overlap with computation. Demonstrates reliable prediction across multiple MoE architectures while maintaining task accuracy.

entry.title: Neural Uncertainty Principle: A Unified View of Adversarial Fragility and LLM Hallucination

author.name: Dong-Xiao Zhang, Hu Lou, Jun-Jie Zhang, Jun Zhu, Deyu Meng

entry.summary: Proposes the Neural Uncertainty Principle (NUP), arguing that adversarial vulnerability in vision and LLM hallucination share a common geometric origin: input and loss gradient are conjugate observables with an irreducible uncertainty bound. Provides theoretical framework and practical probe.

entry.title: Beyond Single Tokens: Distilling Discrete Diffusion Models via Discrete MMD

author.name: Emiel Hoogeboom, David Ruhe, Jonathan Heek, Thomas Mensink, Tim Salimans

entry.summary: Introduces Discrete Moment Matching Distillation (D-MMD) for distilling discrete diffusion models, adapting continuous distillation ideas to the discrete domain. Distilled models maintain quality and diversity and can outperform teacher models.

entry.title: A Framework for Formalizing LLM Agent Security

author.name: Vincent Siu, Jingxuan He, Kyle Montgomery, Zhun Wang, Neil Gong, Chenguang Wang, Dawn Song

entry.summary: Presents a formal framework for LLM agent security that contextualizes attacks and defenses based on whose instruction, what objective, and whether the action serves that objective. Systematizes existing attacks/defenses to address the utility-security tradeoff.

entry.title: Pitfalls in Evaluating Interpretability Agents

author.name: Tal Haklay, Nikhil Prakash, Sana Pandey, Antonio Torralba, Aaron Mueller, Jacob Andreas, Tamar Rott Shaham, Yonatan Belinkov

entry.summary: Investigates pitfalls in evaluating automated interpretability agents for circuit analysis. Shows that three different classifiers produce significantly different faithfulness rates (69.7-82.6%) on identical data, with per-model gaps up to 30.6 percentage points.

entry.title: Measuring Faithfulness Depends on How You Measure: Classifier Sensitivity in LLM Chain-of-Thought Evaluation

author.name: Richard J. Young

entry.summary: Shows that measuring chain-of-thought faithfulness depends heavily on the classifier used: three classifiers produce rates of 74.4%, 82.6%, and 69.7% on the same data, with per-model gaps up to 30.6 percentage points, all statistically significant.

entry.title: ResNets of All Shapes and Sizes: Convergence of Training Dynamics in the Large-scale Limit

author.name: Louis-Pierre Chaintron and L\'ena\"ic Chizat and Javier Maass

entry.summary: Establishes convergence rates for ResNet training dynamics in the joint limit of infinite depth, width, and embedding dimension. Proves error bounds of O(1/L + sqrt(D/(LM)) + 1/sqrt(D)) and derives optimal parameter scaling for a given budget, yielding O(P^(-1/6)) convergence.

entry.title: Transformers are Stateless Differentiable Neural Computers

author.name: Bo Tang and Weiwei Xie

entry.summary: This paper formally proves that a causal Transformer layer is exactly equivalent to a stateless Differentiable Neural Computer (sDNC), mapping attention to content-based addressing and multi-head attention to parallel read heads. The equivalence extends to cross-attention in encoder-decoder Transformers. This provides a unifying theoretical lens connecting two major architecture families.

entry.title: Maximizing mutual information between user-contexts and responses improve LLM personalization with no additional data

author.name: Hyunji Nam, Haoran Li, Natasha Jaques

entry.summary: Proposes MIPO (Mutual Information Preference Optimization), a self-improvement method for LLM personalization that constructs preference pairs by generating responses conditioned on correct vs. random prompts. Maximizes mutual information between user contexts and responses using DPO without requiring external labels.

entry.title: Global Convergence of Multiplicative Updates for the Matrix Mechanism: A Collaborative Proof with Gemini 3

author.name: Keith Rush

entry.summary: Proves global convergence of a fixed-point iteration for the matrix mechanism in private ML, notably with the bulk of the proof provided by Gemini 3. Represents a commentary on practical AI-assisted mathematical research.

entry.title: Learning to Disprove: Formal Counterexample Generation with Large Language Models

author.name: Zenan Li, Zhaoyu Li, Kaiyu Yang, Xiaoxing Ma, Zhendong Su

entry.summary: Addresses LLM-based formal counterexample generation - training models to not only propose counterexamples but produce verifiable proofs in Lean 4. Introduces symbolic mutation for training data synthesis and demonstrates improved counterexample finding.

entry.title: Demonstrations, CoT, and Prompting: A Theoretical Analysis of ICL

author.name: Xuhan Tong, Yuchen Zeng, Jiawei Zhang

entry.summary: Provides theoretical analysis of In-Context Learning under mild assumptions, deriving upper bounds on ICL test loss that connect demonstration selection quality, Chain-of-Thought reasoning, number of demonstrations, and prompt templates to generalization behavior.

entry.title: FIPO: Eliciting Deep Reasoning with Future-KL Influenced Policy Optimization

author.name: Chiyu Ma, Shuo Yang, Kexin Huang, Jinda Lu, Haoming Meng, Shangshang Wang, Bolin Ding, Soroush Vosoughi, Guoyin Wang, Jingren Zhou

entry.summary: Presents FIPO, a reinforcement learning algorithm that uses discounted future-KL divergence for dense credit assignment in LLM training, addressing the coarse-grained token-level advantage problem in GRPO-style methods. Enables models to break through length stagnation.

entry.title: A Super Fast K-means for Indexing Vector Embeddings

author.name: Leonardo Kuffo, Sven Hepkema, Peter Boncz

entry.summary: Presents SuperKMeans, a k-means variant for clustering high-dimensional vector embeddings that achieves up to 7x speedup over FAISS/Scikit-Learn on CPUs and 4x over cuVS on GPUs. The key innovation is dimension pruning during centroid assignment and a novel early termination mechanism based on retrieval recall quality.

entry.title: How Out-of-Equilibrium Phase Transitions can Seed Pattern Formation in Trained Diffusion Models

author.name: Luca Ambrogioni

entry.summary: Proposes a theoretical framework interpreting diffusion model generation as out-of-equilibrium phase transitions, where reverse diffusion passes through critical regimes that seed pattern formation. Shows how architectural constraints transform memorization instabilities into collective spatial modes.

entry.title: TTQ: Activation-Aware Test-Time Quantization to Accelerate LLM Inference On The Fly

author.name: Toshiaki Koike-Akino, Jing Liu, Ye Wang

entry.summary: Proposes TTQ (Test-Time Quantization), a framework that compresses LLMs on-the-fly during inference using efficient online calibration, adapting quantization to each prompt to avoid domain shift issues with static calibration data.

entry.title: Any-Subgroup Equivariant Networks via Symmetry Breaking

author.name: Abhinav Goel, Derek Lim, Hannah Lawrence, Stefanie Jegelka, Ningyuan Huang

entry.summary: Presents Any-Subgroup Equivariant Networks (ASEN), a single model simultaneously equivariant to multiple symmetry groups by modulating an auxiliary input. Built on permutation-equivariant base with symmetry-breaking inputs for flexible multi-modal foundation models.

entry.title: Evaluating Evidence Grounding Under User Pressure in Instruction-Tuned Language Models

author.name: Sai Koneru, Elphin Joe, Christine Kirchhoff, Jian Wu, Sarah Rajtmajer

entry.summary: Evaluates how instruction-tuned LLMs balance user-alignment pressure against faithfulness to in-context evidence, using a controlled framework grounded in U.S. National Climate Assessment data. Tests 19 models (0.27B-32B) and identifies three failure modes under user pressure.

entry.title: PhysMaster: Building an Autonomous AI Physicist for Theoretical and Computational Physics Research

author.name: Tingjia Miao (1 and 2 and 5), Jiawen Dai (2), Jingkun Liu (2), Jinxin Tan (2 and 3 and 4), Muhua Zhang (2 and 3 and 4), Wenkai Jin (1), Yuwen Du (1), Tian Jin (1), Xianghe Pang (1), Zexi Liu (1), Tu Guo (2 and 4), Zhengliang Zhang (2 and 4 and 5), Yunjie Huang (1), Shuo Chen (6), Rui Ye (1), Yuzhi Zhang (7), Linfeng Zhang (7), Kun Chen (6), Wei Wang (2 and 3 and 4), Weinan E (1), Siheng Chen (1) ((1) School of Artificial Intelligence, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, (2) School of Physics and Astronomy, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, (3) State Key Laboratory of Dark Matter Physics, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, (4) Tsung-Dao Lee Institute, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, (5) Zhiyuan College, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, (6) Institute of Theoretical Physics, Chinese Academy of Sciences, (7) DP Technology)

entry.summary: Proposes PhysMaster, an LLM-based autonomous agent for theoretical and computational physics research that couples abstract reasoning with numerical computation using the LANDAU knowledge system.

entry.title: LSR: Linguistic Safety Robustness Benchmark for Low-Resource West African Languages

author.name: Godwin Abuh Faruna

entry.summary: Introduces LSR, the first benchmark measuring how LLM safety refusal mechanisms degrade when harmful prompts are expressed in low-resource West African languages (Yoruba, Hausa, Igbo, Igala). Proposes Refusal Centroid Drift (RCD) as a metric and evaluates Gemini 2.5 Flash across culturally grounded attack probes. Finds significant safety gaps for non-English languages.

entry.title: MemReward: Graph-Based Experience Memory for LLM Reward Prediction with Limited Labels

author.name: Tianyang Luo, Tao Feng, Zhigang Hua, Yan Xie, Shuang Yang, Ge Liu, Jiaxuan You

entry.summary: Introduces MemReward, a graph-based experience memory framework for predicting reward labels in LLM reinforcement learning when labels are scarce. Stores rollouts as graph-structured experience memory and propagates known rewards through semantic similarity to label unlabeled rollouts.

entry.title: Target Concept Tuning Improves Extreme Weather Forecasting

author.name: Shijie Ren, Xinyue Gu, Ziheng Peng, Haifan Zhang, Peisong Niu, Bo Wu, Xiting Wang, Liang Sun, Jirong Wen

entry.summary: Proposes TaCT, an interpretable concept-gated fine-tuning framework for weather forecasting that uses Sparse Autoencoders and counterfactual analysis to discover failure-related internal concepts, selectively adapting models for extreme events like typhoons while preserving general performance.

entry.title: VAMPO: Policy Optimization for Improving Visual Dynamics in Video Action Models

author.name: Zirui Ge, Pengxiang Ding, Baohua Yin, Qishen Wang, Zhiyong Xie, Yemin Wang, Jinbo Wang, Hengtao Li, Runze Suo, Wenxuan Song, Han Zhao, Shangke Lyu, Zhaoxin Fan, Haoang Li, Ran Cheng, Cheng Chi, Huibin Ge, Yaozhi Luo, Donglin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes VAMPO, a post-training framework for video action models that uses policy optimization to directly improve visual dynamics precision for robot manipulation, formulating multi-step denoising as sequential decision-making.

entry.title: Is Evaluation Awareness Just Format Sensitivity? Limitations of Probe-Based Evidence under Controlled Prompt Structure

author.name: Viliana Devbunova

entry.summary: Tests whether linear probe evidence of 'evaluation awareness' in LLMs actually reflects benchmark-canonical structure rather than genuine context understanding. Finds probes primarily track surface formatting and fail to generalize to free-form prompts.

entry.title: Adaptive Layerwise Perturbation: Unifying Off-Policy Corrections for LLM RL

author.name: Chenlu Ye, Xuanchang Zhang, Yifan Hao, Zhou Yu, Ziji Zhang, Abhinav Gullapalli, Hao Chen, Jing Huang, Tong Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Adaptive Layerwise Perturbation (ALP) to address off-policy problems in LLM reinforcement learning, injecting learnable perturbations into hidden states during updates to smooth importance ratios. Demonstrates improved training stability for LLM RL.

entry.title: Physion-Eval: Evaluating Physical Realism in Generated Video via Human Reasoning

author.name: Qin Zhang, Peiyu Jing, Hong-Xing Yu, Fangqiang Ding, Fan Nie, Weimin Wang, Yilun Du, James Zou, Jiajun Wu, Bing Shuai

entry.summary: Physion-Eval is a large-scale benchmark with 10,990 expert reasoning traces for diagnosing physical realism failures in generated videos across 5 SOTA models, covering 22 fine-grained physical categories in egocentric and exocentric views.

entry.title: ContractionPPO: Certified Reinforcement Learning via Differentiable Contraction Layers

author.name: Vrushabh Zinage, Narek Harutyunyan, Eric Verheyden, Fred Y. Hadaegh, Soon-Jo Chung

entry.summary: ContractionPPO augments PPO reinforcement learning with a state-dependent contraction metric layer to provide certified robustness guarantees for legged locomotion policies, combining RL's performance benefits with formal stability guarantees.

entry.title: RiboSphere: Learning Unified and Efficient Representations of RNA Structures

author.name: Zhou Zhang, Hanqun Cao, Cheng Tan, Fang Wu, Pheng Ann Heng, Tianfan Fu

entry.summary: RiboSphere learns discrete geometric representations of RNA structures by combining vector quantization with flow matching, using a geometric transformer encoder for SE(3)-invariant features. Achieves strong results on RNA structure tasks despite scarce 3D data.

entry.title: LoopRPT: Reinforcement Pre-Training for Looped Language Models

author.name: Guo Tang, Shixin Jiang, Heng Chang, Nuo Chen, Yuhan Li, Huiming Fan, Jia Li, Ming Liu, Bing Qin

entry.summary: LoopRPT proposes reinforcement pre-training for looped language models that perform iterative latent computation, assigning RL signals directly to latent steps using EMA teacher reference to compress reasoning into fewer iterations.

entry.title: What If Consensus Lies? Selective-Complementary Reinforcement Learning at Test Time

author.name: Dong Yan, Jian Liang, Yanbo Wang, Shuo Lu, Ran He, Tieniu Tan

entry.summary: Proposes SCRL, a robust test-time reinforcement learning framework for LLMs that mitigates label noise from weak consensus in majority voting by combining selective positive pseudo-labeling with complementary negative filtering.

entry.title: On the Ability of Transformers to Verify Plans

author.name: Yash Sarrof, Yupei Du, Katharina Stein, Alexander Koller, Sylvie Thi\'ebaux, Michael Hahn

entry.summary: Analyzes transformers' ability to verify plans in AI planning tasks, introducing C*-RASP to establish length generalization guarantees under growing sequence length and vocabulary size. Identifies classes of planning domains where transformers can provably verify long plans.

entry.title: ReViSQL: Achieving Human-Level Text-to-SQL

author.name: Yuxuan Zhu, Tengjun Jin, Yoojin Choi, Daniel Kang

entry.summary: Introduces ReViSQL, a framework achieving human-level accuracy on the BIRD Text-to-SQL benchmark through clean training data rather than complex architectural engineering, demonstrating that data quality trumps pipeline complexity.

entry.title: Experience is the Best Teacher: Motivating Effective Exploration in Reinforcement Learning for LLMs

author.name: Wenjian Zhang, Kongcheng Zhang, Jiaxin Qi, Baisheng Lai, Jianqiang Huang

entry.summary: Proposes HeRL, a hindsight-experience-guided reinforcement learning framework for LLMs that uses failed trajectories and their unmet rubrics as in-context guidance to bootstrap more effective exploration beyond the current policy distribution.

entry.title: The $\mathbf{Y}$-Combinator for LLMs: Solving Long-Context Rot with $\lambda$-Calculus

author.name: Amartya Roy, Rasul Tutunov, Xiaotong Ji, Matthieu Zimmer, Haitham Bou-Ammar

entry.summary: Introduces λ-RLM, a framework for long-context LLM reasoning that replaces free-form recursive code generation with a typed functional runtime grounded in λ-calculus. Uses pre-verified combinators and neural inference only on bounded leaf subproblems.

entry.title: TAB-AUDIT: Detecting AI-Fabricated Scientific Tables via Multi-View Likelihood Mismatch

author.name: Shuo Huang, Yan Pen, Lizhen Qu

entry.summary: TAB-AUDIT presents the first systematic study on detecting AI-generated fabricated scientific tables, introducing the FabTab benchmark (1,173 AI-generated vs 1,215 human papers) and a framework that detects within-table perplexity mismatches between skeletons and numerical content.

entry.title: WorldAgents: Can Foundation Image Models be Agents for 3D World Models?

author.name: Ziya Erko\c{c}, Angela Dai, Matthias Nie{\ss}ner

entry.summary: WorldAgents investigates whether 2D foundation image models possess implicit 3D world model capabilities, using a multi-agent architecture with VLM director, image generator, and VLM verifier for 3D world synthesis from 2D models.

entry.title: Evolving Jailbreaks: Automated Multi-Objective Long-Tail Attacks on Large Language Models

author.name: Wenjing Hong, Zhonghua Rong, Li Wang, Feng Chang, Jian Zhu, Ke Tang, Zexuan Zhu, Yew-Soon Ong

entry.summary: Presents EvoJail, an automated framework for discovering jailbreak attacks on LLMs using multi-objective evolutionary search over long-tail distributions (low-resource languages, encrypted data). Systematically evaluates security vulnerabilities beyond handcrafted attacks.

entry.title: Minimax and Adaptive Covariance Matrix Estimation under Differential Privacy

author.name: T. Tony Cai, Yicheng Li

entry.summary: Proposes a differentially private blockwise tridiagonal estimator for high-dimensional bandable covariance matrices, achieving minimax-optimal rates. Develops a new private van Trees inequality for lower bounds.

entry.title: Two-Time-Scale Learning Dynamics: A Population View of Neural Network Training

author.name: Giacomo Borghi, Hyesung Im, Lorenzo Pareschi

entry.summary: Introduces a theoretical framework modeling neural network training as two-time-scale population dynamics, combining fast SGD parameter updates with slower hyperparameter selection-mutation, and proves the large-population mean-field limit.

entry.title: When Prompt Optimization Becomes Jailbreaking: Adaptive Red-Teaming of Large Language Models

author.name: Zafir Shamsi, Nikhil Chekuru, Zachary Guzman, Shivank Garg

entry.summary: Repurposes black-box prompt optimization techniques (via DSPy) as automated adversarial attacks against LLM safety measures, showing that optimization-based jailbreaking can bypass contemporary model safeguards.

entry.title: The {\alpha}-Law of Observable Belief Revision in Large Language Model Inference

author.name: Mike Farmer, Abhinav Kochar, Yugyung Lee

entry.summary: Identifies a multiplicative scaling law (α-law) governing how instruction-tuned LLMs revise probability assignments during iterative reasoning, proving exponents below one are necessary and sufficient for stability.

entry.title: CURE: A Multimodal Benchmark for Clinical Understanding and Retrieval Evaluation

author.name: Yannian Gu and Zhongzhen Huang and Linjie Mu and Xizhuo Zhang and Shaoting Zhang and Xiaofan Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces CURE, a benchmark of 500 multimodal clinical cases mapped to physician-cited literature, designed to disentangle multimodal reasoning from evidence retrieval capabilities in medical LLMs. Evaluates state-of-the-art MLLMs under controlled evidence settings to isolate their respective contributions to clinical diagnostics.

entry.title: URAG: A Benchmark for Uncertainty Quantification in Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models

author.name: Vinh Nguyen, Cuong Dang, Jiahao Zhang, Hoa Tran, Minh Tran, Trinh Chau, Thai Le, Lu Cheng, Suhang Wang

entry.summary: Introduces URAG, a benchmark for evaluating uncertainty quantification in RAG systems across healthcare, programming, science, math, and general text. Reformulates tasks into multiple-choice format to enable conformal prediction-based uncertainty measurement, evaluating 8 RAG methods.

entry.title: CLaRE-ty Amid Chaos: Quantifying Representational Entanglement to Predict Ripple Effects in LLM Editing

author.name: Manit Baser, Alperen Yildiz, Dinil Mon Divakaran, Mohan Gurusamy

entry.summary: Introduces CLaRE, a lightweight method to predict ripple effects in LLM knowledge editing by quantifying representational entanglement between facts using forward activations from a single layer, avoiding costly backward passes. Analyzes 11,427 facts to build large-scale entanglement graphs.

entry.title: PhyGile: Physics-Prefix Guided Motion Generation for Agile General Humanoid Motion Tracking

author.name: Jiacheng Bao, Haoran Yang, Yucheng Xin, Junhong Liu, Yuecheng Xu, Han Liang, Pengfei Han, Xiaoguang Ma, Dong Wang, Bin Zhao

entry.summary: Presents PhyGile, a framework that closes the loop between robot-native motion generation and general motion tracking for humanoid robots, using physics-prefix guidance to ensure generated motions are physically feasible rather than just kinematically plausible.

entry.title: Anatomical Heterogeneity in Transformer Language Models

author.name: Tomasz Wietrzykowski

entry.summary: Empirically analyzes anatomical heterogeneity in transformer language models, finding that layer importance spans a 10^7 range with critical cores and anti-layers that improve performance when removed. Identifies universal oscillatory patterns in weight structures.

entry.title: Warm-Start Flow Matching for Guaranteed Fast Text/Image Generation

author.name: Minyoung Kim

entry.summary: Proposes warm-start flow matching that uses a lightweight generative model to provide starting points for flow matching, guaranteeing speedup without quality degradation. Applicable to both text and image generation.

entry.title: Automated Membership Inference Attacks: Discovering MIA Signal Computations using LLM Agents

author.name: Toan Tran, Olivera Kotevska, Li Xiong

entry.summary: Proposes AutoMIA, a framework using LLM agents to automate the design of membership inference attacks by systematically exploring attack strategies and discovering novel signal computations without manual design.

entry.title: Scalable Prompt Routing via Fine-Grained Latent Task Discovery

author.name: Yunyi Zhang, Soji Adeshina, Patrick Guan, Ashwin Ganesh, Zhen Han, Vassilis N. Ioannidis, Huzefa Rangwala, George Karypis

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage prompt routing architecture using graph-based clustering for automated fine-grained task discovery and task-aware quality estimation, addressing scalability challenges as model pools grow to dozens of frontier models.

entry.title: Cooperation and Exploitation in LLM Policy Synthesis for Sequential Social Dilemmas

author.name: V\'ictor Gallego

entry.summary: Studies LLM-based policy synthesis for multi-agent social dilemmas, where an LLM iteratively generates Python policies evaluated in self-play. Compares sparse vs dense feedback (including social metrics) across Gathering/Cleanup environments using Claude Sonnet 4.6 and Gemini 3.1 Pro, finding dense feedback consistently helps.

entry.title: Deep Hilbert--Galerkin Methods for Infinite-Dimensional PDEs and Optimal Control

author.name: Samuel N. Cohen, Filippo de Feo, Jackson Hebner, Justin Sirignano

entry.summary: Develops deep learning methods for solving fully nonlinear PDEs on infinite-dimensional Hilbert spaces using Hilbert-Galerkin Neural Operators (HGNOs). Proves first Universal Approximation Theorems for these settings with novel topologies for Hessian terms.

entry.title: Reinforcement-guided generative protein language models enable de novo design of highly diverse AAV capsids

author.name: Lucas Ferraz, Ana F. Rodrigues, Pedro Giesteira Cotovio, Mafalda Ventura, Gabriela Silva, Ana Sofia Coroadinha, Miguel Machuqueiro, Catia Pesquita

entry.summary: Develops a generative framework combining protein language models with reinforcement learning to design novel AAV capsids for gene therapy. Fine-tunes on experimentally validated sequences and uses RL to generate highly novel yet functionally plausible capsid designs.

entry.title: ReXInTheWild: A Unified Benchmark for Medical Photograph Understanding

author.name: Oishi Banerjee, Sung Eun Kim, Alexandra N. Willauer, Julius M. Kernbach, Abeer Rihan Alomaish, Reema Abdulwahab S. Alghamdi, Hassan Rayhan Alomaish, Mohammed Baharoon, Xiaoman Zhang, Julian Nicolas Acosta, Christine Zhou, Pranav Rajpurkar

entry.summary: ReXInTheWild benchmarks vision-language models on medical photograph understanding with 955 clinician-verified questions across 484 photographs. Finds large performance variation: Gemini-3 at 78%, Claude Opus 4.5 at 72%, GPT-5.2 at 68%.

entry.title: EvidenceRL: Reinforcing Evidence Consistency for Trustworthy Language Models

author.name: J. Ben Tamo, Yuxing Lu, Benoit L. Marteau, Micky C. Nnamdi and May D. Wang

entry.summary: EvidenceRL introduces a reinforcement learning framework using GRPO that enforces evidence adherence during LLM training, scoring responses for grounding and correctness. Tested on cardiac diagnosis and legal reasoning domains.

entry.title: AI Psychosis: Does Conversational AI Amplify Delusion-Related Language?

author.name: Soorya Ram Shimgekar, Vipin Gunda, Jiwon Kim, Violeta J. Rodriguez, Hari Sundaram, and Koustuv Saha

entry.summary: Examines whether conversational AI amplifies delusion-related language over multi-turn interactions, using simulated users from Reddit histories chatting with GPT, LLaMA, and Qwen. Develops DelusionScore metric.

entry.title: Data-driven ensemble prediction of the global ocean

author.name: Qiusheng Huang, Xiaohui Zhong, Anboyu Guo, Ziyi Peng, Lei Chen, Hao Li

entry.summary: FuXi-ONS is the first machine-learning ensemble forecasting system for the global ocean, providing 5-day forecasts up to 365 days for temperature, salinity, currents and more on a 1° grid.

entry.title: DeepStock: Reinforcement Learning with Policy Regularizations for Inventory Management

author.name: Yaqi Xie, Xinru Hao, Jiaxi Liu, Will Ma, Linwei Xin, Lei Cao, Yidong Zhang

entry.summary: DeepStock applies deep reinforcement learning with policy regularizations grounded in classical inventory concepts (like base stock) to inventory management, deployed at 100% on Alibaba's Tmall platform. Shows that domain-aware regularization significantly improves DRL hyperparameter tuning.

entry.title: Diminishing Returns in Expanding Generative Models and Godel-Tarski-Lob Limits

author.name: Angshul Majumdar

entry.summary: Develops a formal task-space framework proving diminishing returns in expanding generative models, connecting to Gödel, Tarski, and Löb logical limitations to show that capability growth faces fundamental theoretical bounds.

entry.title: DataProphet: Demystifying Supervision Data Generalization in Multimodal LLMs

author.name: Xuan Qi, Luxi He, Dan Roth, Xingyu Fu

entry.summary: DataProphet investigates whether training dataset influence on MLLM performance can be predicted before training, analyzing transfer across 14 vision-language datasets. Finds that intuitive task similarity poorly predicts transferability.

entry.title: Stepwise: Neuro-Symbolic Proof Search for Automated Systems Verification

author.name: Baoding He, Zenan Li, Wei Sun, Yuan Yao, Taolue Chen, Xiaoxing Ma, Zhendong Su

entry.summary: Stepwise introduces a neuro-symbolic proof generation framework for automated systems verification, combining LLM-based proof step generation with interactive theorem prover tools for step repair and filtering in a best-first tree search.

entry.title: ReLi3D: Relightable Multi-view 3D Reconstruction with Disentangled Illumination

author.name: Jan-Niklas Dihlmann, Mark Boss, Simon Donne, Andreas Engelhardt, Hendrik P.A. Lensch, Varun Jampani

entry.summary: ReLi3D is the first unified end-to-end pipeline that simultaneously reconstructs 3D geometry, PBR materials, and environment illumination from sparse multi-view images in under one second, using transformer cross-conditioning and a two-path prediction strategy.

entry.title: Embodied Science: Closing the Discovery Loop with Agentic Embodied AI

author.name: Xiang Zhuang, Chenyi Zhou, Kehua Feng, Zhihui Zhu, Yunfan Gao, Yijie Zhong, Yichi Zhang, Junjie Huang, Keyan Ding, Lei Bai, Haofen Wang, Qiang Zhang, Huajun Chen

entry.summary: Proposes 'embodied science' as a paradigm for scientific discovery that couples agentic AI reasoning with physical execution in a closed-loop Perception-Language-Action-Discovery (PLAD) framework. Argues that framing discovery as isolated predictions misses the inherently physical, long-horizon nature of experimentation.

entry.title: Overreliance on AI in Information-seeking from Video Content

author.name: Anders Giovanni M{\o}ller, Elisa Bassignana, Francesco Pierri, Luca Maria Aiello

entry.summary: Investigates how generative AI affects accuracy, efficiency, and confidence in video-based information retrieval through an experiment with ~900 participants. Finds that LLM summaries increase overreliance and confidence even when containing inaccuracies.

entry.title: Trojan's Whisper: Stealthy Manipulation of OpenClaw through Injected Bootstrapped Guidance

author.name: Fazhong Liu and Zhuoyan Chen and Tu Lan and Haozhen Tan and Zhenyu Xu and Xiang Li and Guoxing Chen and Yan Meng and Haojin Zhu

entry.summary: Identifies and characterizes guidance injection attacks on autonomous coding agents like OpenClaw, where adversarial narratives are embedded in bootstrap guidance files to stealthily manipulate agent behavior without traditional prompt injection.

entry.title: X-World: Controllable Ego-Centric Multi-Camera World Models for Scalable End-to-End Driving

author.name: Chaoda Zheng, Sean Li, Jinhao Deng, Zhennan Wang, Shijia Chen, Liqiang Xiao, Ziheng Chi, Hongbin Lin, Kangjie Chen, Boyang Wang, Yu Zhang, Xianming Liu

entry.summary: Presents X-World, an action-conditioned multi-camera generative world model for autonomous driving that simulates future multi-view observations in video space, enabling controllable and scalable evaluation of VLA driving policies.

entry.title: Orchestrating Human-AI Software Delivery: A Retrospective Longitudinal Field Study of Three Software Modernization Programs

author.name: Maximiliano Armesto, Christophe Kolb

entry.summary: Reports a retrospective longitudinal field study of an industrial platform (Chiron) coordinating humans and AI agents across software delivery stages, covering three real modernization programs including COBOL migration. Compares five delivery configurations from baseline to advanced AI integration.

entry.title: Agentic Harness for Real-World Compilers

author.name: Yingwei Zheng, Cong Li, Shaohua Li, Yuqun Zhang, Zhendong Su

entry.summary: Introduces llvm-autofix, the first agentic harness for assisting LLM agents in understanding and fixing LLVM compiler bugs. Includes agent-friendly tools, a benchmark of reproducible bugs, and shows 60% performance decline without the specialized tooling.

entry.title: Var-JEPA: A Variational Formulation of the Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture -- Bridging Predictive and Generative Self-Supervised Learning

author.name: Moritz G\"ogl, Christopher Yau

entry.summary: Argues that JEPA and variational generative self-supervised learning are structurally equivalent, not fundamentally different paradigms. Proposes Var-JEPA, which provides a variational formulation unifying the two approaches.

entry.title: Reasoning Gets Harder for LLMs Inside A Dialogue

author.name: Ivan Kart\'a\v{c}, Mateusz Lango, Ond\v{r}ej Du\v{s}ek

entry.summary: Introduces BOULDER, a dynamic benchmark showing that LLM reasoning performance significantly degrades when tasks are embedded within task-oriented dialogue versus presented in isolation. Tests arithmetic, spatial, and temporal reasoning across travel-related scenarios.

entry.title: AIGQ: An End-to-End Hybrid Generative Architecture for E-commerce Query Recommendation

author.name: Jingcao Xu, Jianyun Zou, Renkai Yang, Zili Geng, Qiang Liu, Haihong Tang

entry.summary: Dream2Act proposes a robot-centric framework for humanoid robot interaction that uses video generation models to envision the robot completing tasks with morphology-consistent motion, enabling zero-shot interaction without explicit retargeting.

entry.title: Rethinking Ground Truth: A Case Study on Human Label Variation in MLLM Benchmarking

author.name: Tomas Ruiz, Tanalp Agustoslu, Carsten Schwemmer

entry.summary: Examines how human label variation affects MLLM benchmarking, finding that larger models excel on high-agreement subsets but often underperform medium-sized models when human annotators disagree, suggesting parameter count alone doesn't determine sensitivity to ambiguity.

entry.title: Heavy-Tailed and Long-Range Dependent Noise in Stochastic Approximation: A Finite-Time Analysis

author.name: Siddharth Chandak, Anuj Yadav, Ayfer Ozgur, Nicholas Bambos

entry.summary: Establishes first finite-time moment bounds for stochastic approximation under heavy-tailed and long-range dependent noise, with applications to temporal difference learning in reinforcement learning.

entry.title: Beyond Monotonicity: Revisiting Factorization Principles in Multi-Agent Q-Learning

author.name: Tianmeng Hu, Yongzheng Cui, Rui Tang, Biao Luo, Ke Li

entry.summary: Analyzes non-monotonic value decomposition in multi-agent RL through dynamical systems theory, proving that IGM-violating equilibria are unstable saddle points while IGM-consistent solutions are stable attractors under approximately greedy exploration.

entry.title: Exploring the Agentic Frontier of Verilog Code Generation

author.name: Patrick Yubeaton, Chinmay Hegde, Siddharth Garg

entry.summary: Presents the first systematic evaluation of agentic LLMs for Verilog hardware design code generation using the CVDP benchmark. Introduces open-source hardware design agent harnesses and studies how structured prompting and tool design affect performance across frontier models.

entry.title: A Mathematical Theory of Understanding

author.name: Bahar Ta\c{s}kesen

entry.summary: Develops a mathematical model of understanding as a learner-side bottleneck, modeling learners as 'minds' with prerequisite structures over concepts. Formalizes when information conveys meaning based on the structural capacity of the receiver.

entry.title: Vocabulary shapes cross-lingual variation of word-order learnability in language models

author.name: Jonas Mayer Martins and Jaap Jumelet and Viola Priesemann and Lisa Beinborn

entry.summary: Studies how vocabulary structure shapes cross-lingual word-order learnability in language models by pretraining on synthetic word-order variants of natural languages. Finds that vocabulary structure, rather than a simple free/fixed word-order distinction, is the key driver of computational learnability.

entry.title: GeoLAN: Geometric Learning of Latent Explanatory Directions in Large Language Models

author.name: Tianyu Bell Pan and Damon L. Woodard

entry.summary: GeoLAN introduces a training framework treating LLM token representations as geometric trajectories, applying regularizers inspired by the Kakeya Conjecture to promote isotropy and diverse attention. Experiments on Gemma-3 and Llama-3-8B show maintained accuracy with improved geometric metrics and reduced fairness biases.

entry.title: ProactiveBench: Benchmarking Proactiveness in Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Thomas De Min, Subhankar Roy, St\'ephane Lathuili\`ere, Elisa Ricci, Massimiliano Mancini

entry.summary: ProactiveBench benchmarks whether multimodal LLMs can proactively request user interventions (e.g., removing occlusions, improving image quality) when needed. Evaluating 22 MLLMs reveals they generally lack proactiveness, and this doesn't correlate with model capacity.

entry.title: TextReasoningBench: Does Reasoning Really Improve Text Classification in Large Language Models?

author.name: Xinyu Guo, Yazhou Zhang, Jing Qin

entry.summary: TextReasoningBench systematically evaluates whether explicit step-by-step reasoning actually improves LLM text classification, questioning the assumption that reasoning uniformly benefits all NLP tasks given token/time costs.

entry.title: All-Mem: Agentic Lifelong Memory via Dynamic Topology Evolution

author.name: Can Lv, Heng Chang, Yuchen Guo, Shengyu Tao and Shiji Zhou

entry.summary: All-Mem presents a lifelong memory framework for interactive agents that maintains topology-structured memory banks with explicit consolidation, using LLM-driven topology edits and bounded retrieval for long-term agent memory.

entry.title: ParallelVLM: Lossless Video-LLM Acceleration with Visual Alignment Aware Parallel Speculative Decoding

author.name: Quan Kong, Yuhao Shen, Yicheng Ji, Huan Li, Cong Wang

entry.summary: ParallelVLM introduces a training-free speculative decoding framework for Video-LLMs that parallelizes draft-then-verify stages and uses unbiased verifier-guided pruning to accelerate inference on long videos. It achieves lossless acceleration by better aligning draft and target models.

entry.title: HyEvo: Self-Evolving Hybrid Agentic Workflows for Efficient Reasoning

author.name: Beibei Xu, Yutong Ye, Chuyun Shen, Yingbo Zhou, Cheng Chen, Mingsong Chen

entry.summary: HyEvo proposes an automated workflow generation framework that combines LLM nodes for reasoning with deterministic code nodes for rule-based execution, using LLM-driven multi-island evolutionary strategy to optimize hybrid agentic workflows.

entry.title: A Subgoal-driven Framework for Improving Long-Horizon LLM Agents

author.name: Taiyi Wang, Sian Gooding, Florian Hartmann, Oriana Riva, Edward Grefenstette

entry.summary: Proposes a subgoal-driven framework for improving long-horizon LLM agents in web navigation, addressing both online execution drift and sparse reward challenges during RL fine-tuning by decomposing tasks into subgoals.

entry.title: PoC: Performance-oriented Context Compression for Large Language Models via Performance Prediction

author.name: Runsong Zhao, Shilei Liu, Jiwei Tang, Langming Liu, Haibin Chen, Weidong Zhang, Yujin Yuan, Tong Xiao, Jingbo Zhu, Wenbo Su, Bo Zheng

entry.summary: PoC introduces performance-oriented context compression where developers specify acceptable performance floors instead of compression ratios, using a lightweight predictor to automatically find the most aggressive ratio meeting the constraint.

entry.title: FREAK: A Fine-grained Hallucination Evaluation Benchmark for Advanced MLLMs

author.name: Zhihan Yin, Jianxin Liang, Yueqian Wang, Yifeng Yao, Huishuai Zhang, Dongyan Zhao

entry.summary: FREAK introduces a comprehensive benchmark for fine-grained hallucination assessment in MLLMs using photorealistic images with counter-commonsense edits, revealing severe hallucination issues in state-of-the-art models for detailed visual perception.

entry.title: FormalEvolve: Neuro-Symbolic Evolutionary Search for Diverse and Prover-Effective Autoformalization

author.name: Haijian Lu (School of Artificial Intelligence, Xidian University, Beijing Institute for General Artificial Intelligence), Wei Wang (Beijing Institute for General Artificial Intelligence), Jing Liu (School of Artificial Intelligence, Xidian University)

entry.summary: Proposes FormalEvolve, a neuro-symbolic evolutionary framework for autoformalization that generates diverse formal math candidates through LLM-driven mutation/crossover with AST rewrite operations, achieving high semantic consistency and proof success rates.

entry.title: Fourier Splatting: Generalized Fourier encoded primitives for scalable radiance fields

author.name: Mihnea-Bogdan Jurca, Bert Van hauwermeiren and Adrian Munteanu

entry.summary: Proposes Fourier Splatting, the first inherently scalable primitive for radiance field rendering that uses Fourier-encoded planar surfels allowing runtime quality scaling by truncating Fourier coefficients without retraining.

entry.title: Memori: A Persistent Memory Layer for Efficient, Context-Aware LLM Agents

author.name: Luiz C. Borro, Luiz A. B. Macarini, Gordon Tindall, Michael Montero, Adam B. Struck

entry.summary: Introduces Memori, an LLM-agnostic persistent memory layer that converts unstructured dialogue into compact semantic triples and summaries for efficient retrieval, achieving 81.95% accuracy on LoCoMo while using only ~5% of tokens compared to full conversation injection.

entry.title: CoverageBench: Evaluating Information Coverage across Tasks and Domains

author.name: Saron Samuel, Andrew Yates, Dawn Lawrie, Ian Soboroff, Trevor Adriaanse, Benjamin Van Durme, Eugene Yang

entry.summary: Introduces CoverageBench, a benchmark measuring information coverage (diversity of relevant information) in retrieval systems, which is especially important for RAG pipelines. Argues that traditional precision/recall metrics don't capture whether retrieved results cover the full range of relevant information.

entry.title: Conditioning Protein Generation via Hopfield Pattern Multiplicity

author.name: Jeffrey D. Varner

entry.summary: Shows that a single scalar bias parameter added to stochastic attention logits in protein sequence generation can continuously shift output from the full protein family toward a user-specified functional subset, with no retraining required.

entry.title: Semantic Token Clustering for Efficient Uncertainty Quantification in Large Language Models

author.name: Qi Cao, Andrew Gambardella, Takeshi Kojima, Yutaka Matsuo, Yusuke Iwasawa

entry.summary: Proposes Semantic Token Clustering (STC) for efficient LLM uncertainty quantification that groups tokens into semantically consistent clusters using embedding clustering and prefix matching, then measures uncertainty from probability mass distribution across clusters.

entry.title: LagerNVS: Latent Geometry for Fully Neural Real-time Novel View Synthesis

author.name: Stanislaw Szymanowicz, Minghao Chen, Jianyuan Wang, Christian Rupprecht, Andrea Vedaldi

entry.summary: Introduces LagerNVS, an encoder-decoder network for novel view synthesis that builds on 3D-aware latent features from pre-trained 3D reconstruction networks. Achieves 31.4 PSNR on Re10k with real-time rendering and works with or without known cameras.

entry.title: Learning to Bet for Horizon-Aware Anytime-Valid Testing

author.name: Ege Onur Taga, Samet Oymak, Shubhanshu Shekhar

entry.summary: Develops horizon-aware anytime-valid statistical tests using the betting/e-process framework, casting the problem as finite-horizon optimal control and showing when to deviate from Kelly betting based on schedule position.

entry.title: How to Enable LLM with 3D Capacity? A Survey of Spatial Reasoning in LLM

author.name: Jirong Zha, Yuxuan Fan, Xiao Yang, Chen Gao, Xinlei Chen

entry.summary: Survey of methods integrating LLMs with 3D spatial understanding, proposing a taxonomy across image-based, point cloud-based, and hybrid modality approaches for robotics, autonomous driving, and VR applications.

entry.title: GeoChallenge: A Multi-Answer Multiple-Choice Benchmark for Geometric Reasoning with Diagrams

author.name: Yushun Zhang, Weiping Fu, Zesheng Yang, Bo Zhao, Lingling Zhang, Jian Zhang, Yumeng Fu, Jiaxing Huang and Jun Liu

entry.summary: Introduces GeoChallenge, a 90K geometry proof benchmark with multi-step reasoning over text and diagrams, showing GPT-5-nano achieves 75.89% vs. higher human accuracy.

entry.title: Neural Dynamics Self-Attention for Spiking Transformers

author.name: Dehao Zhang and Fukai Guo and Shuai Wang and Jingya Wang and Jieyuan Zhang and Yimeng Shan and Malu Zhang and Yang Yang and Haizhou Li

entry.summary: Proposes LRF-Dyn, a spiking self-attention mechanism for Spiking Transformers inspired by biological localized receptive fields and membrane-potential dynamics. Addresses both the performance gap with ANNs and high memory overhead in existing spiking transformers for edge vision applications.

entry.title: PrefPO: Pairwise Preference Prompt Optimization

author.name: Rahul Singhal, Pradyumna Tambwekar, Karime Maamari

entry.summary: Introduces PrefPO, a minimal prompt optimization approach inspired by RLHF that uses pairwise preferences from an LLM discriminator to iteratively improve prompts without labeled data. Evaluated on BIG-Bench Hard and a new IFEval-Hard subset, matching or exceeding existing methods.

entry.title: Spectral Tempering for Embedding Compression in Dense Passage Retrieval

author.name: Yongkang Li, Panagiotis Eustratiadis, Evangelos Kanoulas

entry.summary: Proposes spectral tempering for embedding compression in dense retrieval, showing that the optimal spectral scaling coefficient varies with target dimensionality and is governed by the signal-to-noise ratio of the retained subspace, leading to an adaptive selection method.

entry.title: Speculative Policy Orchestration: A Latency-Resilient Framework for Cloud-Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Chanh Nguyen and Shutong Jin and Florian T. Pokorny and Erik Elmroth

entry.summary: Proposes SPO (Speculative Policy Orchestration), a cloud-edge framework for robotic manipulation that uses a cloud-hosted world model to pre-compute and stream future waypoints to an edge buffer, decoupling execution frequency from network latency with safety verification.

entry.title: Narrative Aligned Long Form Video Question Answering

author.name: Rahul Jain, Keval Doshi, Burak Uzkent, Garin Kessler

entry.summary: Introduces NA-VQA, a benchmark for evaluating narrative reasoning in long-form videos with 88 full-length movies and 4.4K QA pairs requiring multi-scene temporal reasoning. Tests whether models can track intentions and causal chains across entire movies.

entry.title: FDARxBench: Benchmarking Regulatory and Clinical Reasoning on FDA Generic Drug Assessment

author.name: Betty Xiong, Jillian Fisher, Benjamin Newman, Meng Hu, Shivangi Gupta, Yejin Choi, Lanyan Fang, Russ B Altman

entry.summary: FDARxBench introduces an expert-curated benchmark for document-grounded QA on FDA drug labels, testing factual, multi-hop, and refusal tasks in collaboration with FDA regulatory assessors. Reveals substantial gaps in current LLM drug label understanding.

entry.title: Wearable Foundation Models Should Go Beyond Static Encoders

author.name: Yu Yvonne Wu, Yuwei Zhang, Hyungjun Yoon, Ting Dang, Dimitris Spathis, Tong Xia, Qiang Yang, Jing Han, Dong Ma, Sung-Ju Lee, Cecilia Mascolo

entry.summary: Position paper arguing wearable foundation models need to move beyond static encoders to support longitudinal, anticipatory health reasoning over chronic conditions that unfold over months/years. Identifies key architectural gaps in current WFMs.

entry.title: BEAVER: A Training-Free Hierarchical Prompt Compression Method via Structure-Aware Page Selection

author.name: Zhengpei Hu, Kai Li, Dapeng Fu, Chang Zeng, Yue Li, Yuanhao Tang, Jianqiang Huang

entry.summary: BEAVER is a training-free prompt compression framework that uses hierarchical page-level selection with dual-path pooling and semantic/lexical hybrid planning to compress long contexts while preserving discourse structure.

entry.title: GoAgent: Group-of-Agents Communication Topology Generation for LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Hongjiang Chen, Xin Zheng, Yixin Liu, Pengfei Jiao, Shiyuan Li, Huan Liu, Zhidong Zhao, Ziqi Xu, Ibrahim Khalil, Shirui Pan

entry.summary: GoAgent proposes explicitly modeling group structures in LLM-based multi-agent communication topologies rather than letting them emerge implicitly from node-centric connectivity, using group-aware topology generation for better coordination.

entry.title: FedPDPO: Federated Personalized Direct Preference Optimization for Large Language Model Alignment

author.name: Kewen Zhu, Liping Yi, Zhiming Zhao, Zhuang Qi, Han Yu, Qinghua Hu

entry.summary: FedPDPO proposes personalized federated DPO for LLM alignment, using LoRA adapters with shared and local components to handle non-IID preference data, including implicit reward regularization to prevent reward hacking.

entry.title: Borderless Long Speech Synthesis

author.name: Xingchen Song, Di Wu, Dinghao Zhou, Pengyu Cheng, Hongwu Ding, Yunchao He, Jie Wang, Shengfan Shen, Sixiang Lv, Lichun Fan, Hang Su, Yifeng Wang, Shuai Wang, Meng Meng, Jian Luan

entry.summary: Introduces a Borderless Long Speech Synthesis framework for agent-centric audio synthesis that unifies multiple TTS capabilities including multi-speaker synthesis, instructed TTS, and long-form synthesis. Addresses limitations of sentence-by-sentence synthesis by capturing global context and paralinguistic cues.

entry.title: IsoCLIP: Decomposing CLIP Projectors for Efficient Intra-modal Alignment

author.name: Simone Magistri, Dipam Goswami, Marco Mistretta, Bart{\l}omiej Twardowski, Joost van de Weijer, Andrew D. Bagdanov

entry.summary: Analyzes intra-modal misalignment in CLIP by decomposing projectors into inter-modal and intra-modal operators, proposing IsoCLIP to improve performance on inherently intra-modal tasks like image-to-image retrieval.

entry.title: Physics-Informed Long-Range Coulomb Correction for Machine-learning Hamiltonians

author.name: Yang Zhong, Xiwen Li, Xingao Gong, Hongjun Xiang

entry.summary: Derives closed-form long-range Coulomb corrections for machine-learning electronic Hamiltonians in nonorthogonal atomic-orbital basis, implementing in HamGNN-LR with E(3)-equivariant message passing and Ewald summation. Shows physics-based corrections outperform data-driven attention for capturing macroscopic electrostatics.

entry.title: The End of Rented Discovery: How AI Search Redistributes Power Between Hotels and Intermediaries

author.name: Peiying Zhu, Sidi Chang

entry.summary: Audits 1,357 citations from Google Gemini across hotel queries and documents an 'Intent-Source Divide': experiential queries draw significantly more non-OTA citations than transactional queries. Suggests AI search may redistribute power from online travel agencies to direct hotel content.

entry.title: Trojan horse hunt in deep forecasting models: Insights from the European Space Agency competition

author.name: Krzysztof Kotowski, Ramez Shendy, Jakub Nalepa, Agata Kaczmarek, Dawid P{\l}udowski, Piotr Wilczy\'nski, Artur Janicki, Przemys{\l}aw Biecek, Ambros Marzetta, Atul Pande, Lalit Chandra Routhu, Swapnil Srivastava, Evridiki Ntagiou

entry.summary: Reports on an ESA competition where 200+ teams tried to identify trojan horse (backdoor) triggers hidden in deep forecasting models for spacecraft telemetry. Describes the novel task formulation, benchmark, evaluation protocol, and winning solutions.

entry.title: Learning Dynamic Belief Graphs for Theory-of-mind Reasoning

author.name: Ruxiao Chen, Xilei Zhao, Thomas J. Cova, Frank A. Drews, Susu Xu

entry.summary: Proposes a structured dynamic belief graph model for Theory-of-Mind reasoning with LLMs that jointly infers latent beliefs, learns time-varying dependencies, and links belief evolution to decisions. Targets high-stakes settings like disaster response.

entry.title: VideoSeek: Long-Horizon Video Agent with Tool-Guided Seeking

author.name: Jingyang Lin, Jialian Wu, Jiang Liu, Ximeng Sun, Ze Wang, Xiaodong Yu, Jiebo Luo, Zicheng Liu, Emad Barsoum

entry.summary: Presents VideoSeek, a long-horizon video agent that uses video logic flow to actively seek evidence rather than exhaustively parsing entire videos. Operates in a think-act-observe loop with multi-granular video observation tools, using far fewer frames.

entry.title: Alternating Diffusion for Proximal Sampling with Zeroth Order Queries

author.name: Hirohane Takagi, Atsushi Nitanda

entry.summary: Introduces a proximal sampler using only zeroth-order information by treating intermediate distributions as Gaussian mixtures for Monte Carlo score estimation, achieving exponential convergence guarantees.

entry.title: Deep Autocorrelation Modeling for Time-Series Forecasting: Progress and Prospects

author.name: Hao Wang, Licheng Pan, Qingsong Wen, Jialin Yu, Zhichao Chen, Chunyuan Zheng, Xiaoxi Li, Zhixuan Chu, Chao Xu, Mingming Gong, Haoxuan Li, Yuan Lu, Zhouchen Lin, Philip Torr, Yan Liu

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of deep time-series forecasting from the perspective of autocorrelation modeling, covering both neural architecture design for history sequences and learning objectives for label sequences.

entry.title: DuCCAE: A Hybrid Engine for Immersive Conversation via Collaboration, Augmentation, and Evolution

author.name: Xin Shen, Zhishu Jiang, Jiaye Yang, Haibo Liu, Yichen Wan, Jiarui Zhang, Tingzhi Dai, Luodong Xu, Shuchen Wu, Guanqiang QI, Chenxi Miao, Jiahui Liang, Yang Li, Weikang Li, Deguo Xia, Jizhou Huang

entry.summary: Presents DuCCAE, a hybrid conversational engine deployed in Baidu Search that decouples real-time response generation from asynchronous agentic execution via shared state, addressing heavy-tail latency in tool-using conversations.

entry.title: MAPLE: Metadata Augmented Private Language Evolution

author.name: Eli Chien, Yuzheng Hu, Ryan McKenna, Shanshan Wu, Zheng Xu, Peter Kairouz

entry.summary: Introduces MAPLE, a method improving Private Evolution (PE) for DP synthetic data generation by incorporating metadata to bridge the gap between foundation model priors and specialized private data distributions.

entry.title: Probing to Refine: Reinforcement Distillation of LLMs via Explanatory Inversion

author.name: Zhen Tan, Chengshuai Zhao, Song Wang, Jundong Li, Tianlong Chen, Huan Liu

entry.summary: Introduces a knowledge distillation framework using 'Explanatory Inversion' probes that force student models to articulate reasoning logic, combined with Explanatory GRPO for reinforcement-based generalization.

entry.title: Parameter-Efficient Token Embedding Editing for Clinical Class-Level Unlearning

author.name: Iyad Ait Hou, Shrenik Borad, Harsh Sharma, Pooja Srinivasan, Rebecca Hwa, Aya Zirikly

entry.summary: Introduces STEU, a parameter-efficient machine unlearning method for clinical language models that updates only PMI-selected token embeddings and a small classifier head while keeping encoder layers frozen. Tested across MIMIC-IV, MIMIC-III, and eICU datasets.

entry.title: Analytically tractable model of synaptic crowding explains emergent small-world structure and network dynamics

author.name: Makoto Fukushima

entry.summary: Introduces a minimal wiring rule based on synaptic crowding that produces emergent small-world network structure with power-law connection length distributions. The model admits exact finite-size solutions and shows mean connectivity grows logarithmically with network size.

entry.title: POET: Power-Oriented Evolutionary Tuning for LLM-Based RTL PPA Optimization

author.name: Heng Ping, Peiyu Zhang, Zhenkun Wang, Shixuan Li, Anzhe Cheng, Wei Yang, Paul Bogdan, Shahin Nazarian

entry.summary: Proposes POET, an LLM-driven evolutionary framework for RTL code optimization targeting power, performance, and area (PPA). Uses differential-testing-based verification to ensure functional correctness and non-dominated sorting for multi-objective PPA optimization.

entry.title: Can LLMs Prove Robotic Path Planning Optimality? A Benchmark for Research-Level Algorithm Verification

author.name: Zhengbang Yang, Md. Tasin Tazwar, Minghan Wei, Zhuangdi Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces a benchmark for evaluating whether LLMs can prove approximation optimality of robotic path planning algorithms, consisting of 13 tasks requiring multi-step geometric reasoning. Tests reveal current LLMs struggle with research-level mathematical proofs in this domain.

entry.title: ICLAD: In-Context Learning for Unified Tabular Anomaly Detection Across Supervision Regimes

author.name: Jack Yi Wei, Narges Armanfard

entry.summary: ICLAD proposes an in-context learning foundation model for tabular anomaly detection that generalizes across datasets and supervision regimes (one-class, unsupervised, semi-supervised). Trained via meta-learning on synthetic data.

entry.title: Inducing Sustained Creativity and Diversity in Large Language Models

author.name: Queenie Luo, Gary King, Michael Puett, and Michael D. Smith

entry.summary: Addresses sustained creativity and diversity in LLM outputs for long search quests, proposing methods to prevent repetitive and homogeneous results when users need to explore many diverse alternatives over extended interactions.

entry.title: dinov3.seg: Open-Vocabulary Semantic Segmentation with DINOv3

author.name: Saikat Dutta, Biplab Banerjee, Hamid Rezatofighi

entry.summary: dinov3.seg extends DINOv3 for open-vocabulary semantic segmentation with a task-specific architecture for dense prediction. Adapts the DINOv3 backbone for pixel-level labeling from open text categories.

entry.title: SeeClear: Reliable Transparent Object Depth Estimation via Generative Opacification

author.name: Xiaoying Wang, Yumeng He, Jingkai Shi, Jiayin Lu, Yin Yang, Ying Jiang, Chenfanfu Jiang

entry.summary: SeeClear converts transparent objects into opaque-looking images via diffusion-based generative opacification, enabling standard monocular depth estimators to produce reliable depth predictions for transparent materials without retraining.

entry.title: Skilled AI Agents for Embedded and IoT Systems Development

author.name: Yiming Li, Yuhan Cheng, Mingchen Ma, Yihang Zou, Ningyuan Yang, Wei Cheng, Hai "Helen" Li, Yiran Chen, and Tingjun Chen

entry.summary: Introduces a skills-based agentic framework and IoT-SkillsBench benchmark for AI-assisted embedded/IoT development, spanning 3 platforms, 23 peripherals, and 42 tasks testing hardware-in-the-loop coding capabilities.

entry.title: UniPR: Unified Object-level Real-to-Sim Perception and Reconstruction from a Single Stereo Pair

author.name: Chuanrui Zhang, Yingshuang Zou, ZhengXian Wu, Yonggen Ling, Yuxiao Yang, Ziwei Wang

entry.summary: UniPR is the first end-to-end framework for object-level real-to-sim perception and reconstruction from a single stereo image pair, eliminating the need for modular pipelines of detection, segmentation, shape reconstruction, and pose estimation.

entry.title: PolicySim: An LLM-Based Agent Social Simulation Sandbox for Proactive Policy Optimization

author.name: Renhong Huang, Ning Tang, Jiarong Xu, Yuxuan Cao, Qingqian Tu, Sheng Guo, Bo Zheng, Huiyuan Liu, Yang Yang

entry.summary: PolicySim is an LLM-based social simulation sandbox for proactively evaluating the impact of platform intervention policies (recommendation, content filtering) before deployment, addressing limitations of reactive A/B testing.

entry.title: Scale-Dependent Radial Geometry and Metric Mismatch in Wasserstein Propagation for Reverse Diffusion

author.name: Zicheng Lyu and Zengfeng Huang

entry.summary: Formalizes a metric mismatch in reverse diffusion analysis between radial geometry (which contracts early at large separations) and Euclidean geometry (where terminal error is measured), providing explicit radial lower profiles and characterizing admissible switch times.

entry.title: MOSS-TTSD: Text to Spoken Dialogue Generation

author.name: Yuqian Zhang, Donghua Yu, Zhengyuan Lin, Botian Jiang, Mingshu Chen, Yaozhou Jiang, Yiwei Zhao, Yiyang Zhang, Yucheng Yuan, Hanfu Chen, Kexin Huang, Jun Zhan, Cheng Chang, Zhaoye Fei, Shimin Li, Xiaogui Yang, Qinyuan Cheng, Xipeng Qiu

entry.summary: MOSS-TTSD is a spoken dialogue synthesis model supporting up to 60 minutes of single-pass multi-party conversational speech with up to 5 speakers and zero-shot voice cloning, addressing turn-taking, cross-turn consistency, and long-form stability.

entry.title: Dual Path Attribution: Efficient Attribution for SwiGLU-Transformers through Layer-Wise Target Propagation

author.name: Lasse Marten Jantsch, Dong-Jae Koh, Seonghyeon Lee, Young-Kyoon Suh

entry.summary: Dual Path Attribution introduces a framework for faithful attribution in SwiGLU Transformers using one forward and one backward pass, analytically decomposing SwiGLU into distinct pathways for efficient layer-wise attribution without counterfactual examples.

entry.title: Evaluating Image Editing with LLMs: A Comprehensive Benchmark and Intermediate-Layer Probing Approach

author.name: Shiqi Gao, Zitong Xu, Kang Fu, Huiyu Duan, Xiongkuo Min, Jia wang, Guangtao Zhai

entry.summary: TIEdit introduces a comprehensive benchmark for text-guided image editing evaluation with 512 source images, 10 editing methods, 5120 edited images, and 307,200 expert subjective ratings, plus an LLM-based quality metric using intermediate-layer probing.

entry.title: From Plausibility to Verifiability: Risk-Controlled Generative OCR for Vision-Language Models

author.name: Weile Gong, Yiping Zuo, Zijian Lu, Xin He, Weibei Fan, Chen Dai

entry.summary: Identifies a core deployment misalignment in generative OCR using vision-language models: autoregressive decoding favors semantic plausibility while OCR requires visual grounding. Proposes a model-agnostic Geometric Risk Controller that uses cross-view consistency checks to accept or abstain from transcriptions.

entry.title: MedQ-Engine: A Closed-Loop Data Engine for Evolving MLLMs in Medical Image Quality Assessment

author.name: Jiyao Liu, Junzhi Ning, Wanying Qu, Lihao Liu, Chenglong Ma, Junjun He, Ningsheng Xu

entry.summary: Proposes MedQ-Engine, a closed-loop data engine for medical image quality assessment that iteratively discovers model failure prototypes, retrieves similar images for annotation, and evolves the MLLM through targeted training.

entry.title: SegVGGT: Joint 3D Reconstruction and Instance Segmentation from Multi-View Images

author.name: Jinyuan Qu, Hongyang Li, Lei Zhang

entry.summary: Presents SegVGGT, a unified end-to-end framework for simultaneous 3D reconstruction and instance segmentation from multi-view RGB images by integrating object queries with geometric features in a visual geometry transformer.

entry.title: 2K Retrofit: Entropy-Guided Efficient Sparse Refinement for High-Resolution 3D Geometry Prediction

author.name: Tianbao Zhang, Zhenyu Liang, Zhenbo Song, Nana Wang, Xiaomei Zhang, Xudong Cai, Zheng Zhu, Kejian Wu, Gang Wang, Zhaoxin Fan

entry.summary: Presents 2K Retrofit, enabling efficient 2K-resolution inference for geometric foundation models through entropy-based sparse refinement of high-uncertainty regions, without modifying or retraining the backbone.

entry.title: Detached Skip-Links and $R$-Probe: Decoupling Feature Aggregation from Gradient Propagation for MLLM OCR

author.name: Ziye Yuan, Ruchang Yao, Chengxin Zheng, Yusheng Zhao, Daxiang Dong, Ming Zhang

entry.summary: Identifies and addresses a gradient interference problem in multi-layer feature fusion for MLLM OCR tasks. Proposes Detached Skip-Links that pass features forward but stop gradients in skip branches, improving fine-grained visual detail preservation without adding parameters.

entry.title: LoASR-Bench: Evaluating Large Speech Language Models on Low-Resource Automatic Speech Recognition Across Language Families

author.name: Jianan Chen, Xiaoxue Gao, Tatsuya Kawahara, Nancy F. Chen

entry.summary: Proposes LoASR-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating speech language models on low-resource automatic speech recognition across diverse language families. Fills a gap since existing benchmarks focus on high-resource languages.

entry.title: EgoForge: Goal-Directed Egocentric World Simulator

author.name: Yifan Shen, Jiateng Liu, Xinzhuo Li, Yuanzhe Liu, Bingxuan Li, Houze Yang, Wenqi Jia, Yijiang Li, Tianjiao Yu, James Matthew Rehg, Xu Cao, Ismini Lourentzou

entry.summary: Introduces EgoForge, an egocentric goal-directed world simulator that generates first-person video rollouts from a single image, instruction, and optional auxiliary view, without requiring dense supervision like camera trajectories.

entry.title: Making Video Models Adhere to User Intent with Minor Adjustments

author.name: Daniel Ajisafe, Eric Hedlin, Helge Rhodin, Kwang Moo Yi

entry.summary: Shows that slightly adjusting user-provided bounding boxes to align with video diffusion models' internal attention maps can significantly improve both generation quality and control adherence in text-to-video generation.

entry.title: HUGE-Bench: A Benchmark for High-Level UAV Vision-Language-Action Tasks

author.name: Jingyu Guo, Ziye Chen, Ziwen Li, Zhengqing Gao, Jiaxin Huang, Hanlue Zhang, Fengming Huang, Yu Yao, Tongliang Liu, Mingming Gong

entry.summary: Introduces HUGE-Bench, a benchmark for high-level UAV vision-language-action tasks testing whether agents can interpret concise commands and execute complex trajectories with safety awareness, built on 3D Gaussian Splatting-Mesh representation.

entry.title: Timestep-Aware Block Masking for Efficient Diffusion Model Inference

author.name: Haodong He, Yuan Gao, Weizhong Zhang, Gui-Song Xia

entry.summary: Proposes timestep-aware block masking for diffusion model inference acceleration, learning which transformer blocks to skip at each denoising step. Optimizes masks per-timestep independently for memory efficiency.

entry.title: HiPath: Hierarchical Vision-Language Alignment for Structured Pathology Report Prediction

author.name: Ruicheng Yuan, Zhenxuan Zhang, Anbang Wang, Liwei Hu, Xiangqian Hua, Yaya Peng, Jiawei Luo, Guang Yang

entry.summary: Presents HiPath, a lightweight VLM framework for structured pathology report prediction using frozen UNI2 and Qwen3 backbones with three trainable modules (15M parameters) for hierarchical patch aggregation, contrastive learning, and structured diagnosis generation.

entry.title: Uncertainty Matters: Structured Probabilistic Online Mapping for Motion Prediction in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Pritom Gogoi, Faris Janjo\v{s}, Bin Yang, Andreas Look

entry.summary: Proposes structured probabilistic online map generation for autonomous driving that models intra-element dependencies via dense covariance matrices (Low-Rank plus Diagonal decomposition). Shows that calibrated uncertainty improves downstream motion prediction.

entry.title: From Masks to Pixels and Meaning: A New Taxonomy, Benchmark, and Metrics for VLM Image Tampering

author.name: Xinyi Shang and Yi Tang and Jiacheng Cui and Ahmed Elhagry and Salwa K. Al Khatib and Sondos Mahmoud Bsharat and Jiacheng Liu and Xiaohan Zhao and Jing-Hao Xue and Hao Li and Salman Khan and Zhiqiang Shen

entry.summary: Reformulates VLM image tampering detection from coarse region labels to pixel-grounded, meaning-aware detection. Introduces a new taxonomy of edit primitives, a benchmark with per-pixel tamper maps, and a training framework.

entry.title: Demographic-Aware Self-Supervised Anomaly Detection Pretraining for Equitable Rare Cardiac Diagnosis

author.name: Chaoqin Huang, Zi Zeng, Aofan Jiang, Yuchen Xu, Qing Cao, Kang Chen, Chenfei Chi, Yanfeng Wang and Ya Zhang

entry.summary: Develops a two-stage AI framework for rare cardiac anomaly detection from ECGs, combining self-supervised anomaly detection pretraining with demographic-aware representation learning to improve sensitivity and equity across diverse populations.

entry.title: Utility-Guided Agent Orchestration for Efficient LLM Tool Use

author.name: Boyan Liu, Gongming Zhao, Hongli Xu

entry.summary: Proposes a utility-guided orchestration policy for LLM tool-use agents that explicitly models action selection (respond, retrieve, tool call, verify, stop) by balancing estimated gain, cost, uncertainty, and redundancy.

entry.title: On the role of memorization in learned priors for geophysical inverse problems

author.name: Ali Siahkoohi and Davide Sabeddu

entry.summary: Analyzes how memorization in deep generative priors (especially diffusion models) affects geophysical inverse problems, showing that a memorized prior reduces the posterior to a likelihood-weighted lookup among training examples.

entry.title: Minimax Generalized Cross-Entropy

author.name: Kartheek Bondugula, Santiago Mazuelas, Aritz P\'erez, Anqi Liu

entry.summary: Proposes minimax generalized cross-entropy (MGCE), a convex optimization formulation that interpolates between cross-entropy and MAE losses, providing robustness while avoiding the non-convexity issues of existing GCE formulations.

entry.title: A Federated Many-to-One Hopfield model for associative Neural Networks

author.name: Andrea Alessandrelli, Fabrizio Durante, Andrea Ladiana, Andrea Lepre

entry.summary: Proposes a federated associative-memory framework using Hopfield networks where clients encode experience as low-rank Hebbian operators, aggregated at a server for spectral factorization into global archetypes.

entry.title: FinMMDocR: Benchmarking Financial Multimodal Reasoning with Scenario Awareness, Document Understanding, and Multi-Step Computation

author.name: Zichen Tang, Haihong E, Rongjin Li, Jiacheng Liu, Linwei Jia, Zhuodi Hao, Zhongjun Yang, Yuanze Li, Haolin Tian, Xinyi Hu, Peizhi Zhao, Yuan Liu, Zhengyu Wang, Xianghe Wang, Yiling Huang, Xueyuan Lin, Ruofei Bai, Zijian Xie, Qian Huang, Ruining Cao, Haocheng Gao

entry.summary: Introduces FinMMDocR, a bilingual multimodal benchmark for evaluating MLLMs on financial numerical reasoning, featuring 1,200 expert-annotated problems requiring multi-step reasoning over long financial documents.

entry.title: Can Structural Cues Save LLMs? Evaluating Language Models in Massive Document Streams

author.name: Yukyung Lee, Yebin Lim, Woojun Jung, Wonjun Choi, Susik Yoon

entry.summary: Introduces StreamBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on streaming document environments with 605 events and 15K documents, testing topic clustering, temporal QA, and summarization under concurrent event conflicts.

entry.title: MOSAIC: Modular Opinion Summarization using Aspect Identification and Clustering

author.name: Piyush Kumar Singh, Jayesh Choudhari

entry.summary: Proposes MOSAIC, a modular opinion summarization framework for product reviews that decomposes summarization into theme discovery, structured extraction, and grounded generation. Validated through online A/B tests on live product pages, showing measurable improvements in customer experience.

entry.title: Framing Effects in Independent-Agent Large Language Models: A Cross-Family Behavioral Analysis

author.name: Zice Wang and Zhenyu Zhang

entry.summary: Examines how prompt framing influences LLM decision-making in threshold voting tasks with individual-group interest conflicts. Finds that logically equivalent prompts with different framings significantly shift choice distributions toward risk-averse options, suggesting surface cues override logical equivalence.

entry.title: CDEoH: Category-Driven Automatic Algorithm Design With Large Language Models

author.name: Yu-Nian Wang, Shen-Huan Lyu, Ning Chen, Jia-Le Xu, Baoliu Ye, Qingfu Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes CDEoH, an LLM-based automated algorithm design framework that models algorithm categories and balances performance with category diversity in evolutionary population management. Addresses premature convergence in LLM-driven heuristic search.

entry.title: GT-Space: Enhancing Heterogeneous Collaborative Perception with Ground Truth Feature Space

author.name: Wentao Wang, Haoran Xu, Guang Tan

entry.summary: Proposes GT-Space, a collaborative perception framework for autonomous driving that constructs a common feature space from ground-truth labels for heterogeneous agent feature alignment, requiring only a single adapter module per agent rather than pairwise alignment.

entry.title: Ternary Gamma Semirings: From Neural Implementation to Categorical Foundations

author.name: Ruoqi Sun

entry.summary: Introduces Ternary Gamma Semirings as a theoretical framework connecting neural network learning with abstract algebraic structures, showing that a logical constraint enables 100% accuracy on compositional generalization tasks where standard networks completely fail.

entry.title: Diffusion-Guided Semantic Consistency for Multimodal Heterogeneity

author.name: Jing Liu, Zhengliang Guo, Yan Wang, Xiaoguang Zhu, Yao Du, Zehua Wang, Victor C. M. Leung

entry.summary: Proposes SemanticFL, a federated learning framework that uses pre-trained Stable Diffusion model representations to provide privacy-preserving semantic guidance for local training under non-IID multimodal data distributions.

entry.title: In-the-Wild Camouflage Attack on Vehicle Detectors through Controllable Image Editing

author.name: Xiao Fang, Yiming Gong, Stanislav Panev, Celso de Melo, Shuowen Hu, Shayok Chakraborty, Fernando De la Torre

entry.summary: Proposes a camouflage attack framework on vehicle detectors that formulates adversarial attacks as conditional image editing, using ControlNet to synthesize camouflaged vehicles on real images. Achieves strong adversarial effectiveness while maintaining visual fidelity.

entry.title: Vision Tiny Recursion Model (ViTRM): Parameter-Efficient Image Classification via Recursive State Refinement

author.name: Ange-Cl\'ement Akazan, Abdoulaye Koroko, Verlon Roel Mbingui, Choukouriyah Arinloye, Hassan Fifen and Rose Bandolo

entry.summary: ViTRM introduces a parameter-efficient vision architecture that replaces L-layer ViT encoders with a single tiny 3-layer block applied recursively N times, achieving up to 84x fewer parameters than standard ViTs.

entry.title: Linear Social Choice with Few Queries: A Moment-Based Approach

author.name: Luise Ge, Daniel Halpern, Gregory Kehne, Yevgeniy Vorobeychik

entry.summary: Studies social choice under extreme communication budgets using a linear model where voter utilities are inner products of latent types and candidate embeddings. Shows one pairwise comparison per voter suffices for candidate selection through moment recovery.

entry.title: Gastric-X: A Multimodal Multi-Phase Benchmark Dataset for Advancing Vision-Language Models in Gastric Cancer Analysis

author.name: Sheng Lu, Hao Chen, Rui Yin, Juyan Ba, Yu Zhang, Yuanzhe Li

entry.summary: Gastric-X introduces a large-scale multimodal benchmark for gastric cancer analysis with 1.7K cases including CT scans, endoscopic images, biochemical indicators, and diagnostic notes with tumor annotations, reflecting clinical workflows.

entry.title: Verifiable Error Bounds for Physics-Informed Neural Network Solutions of Lyapunov and Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman Equations

author.name: Jun Liu

entry.summary: Develops verifiable error bounds for PINN-based solutions of Lyapunov and Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equations, showing that verifiable residual bounds yield relative error bounds and computable a posteriori estimates.

entry.title: StreetForward: Perceiving Dynamic Street with Feedforward Causal Attention

author.name: Zhongrui Yu, Zhao Wang, Yijia Xie, Yida Wang, Xueyang Zhang, Yifei Zhan, Kun Zhan

entry.summary: StreetForward presents a pose-free, tracker-free feedforward framework for dynamic street reconstruction using causal attention and 3D Gaussian Splatting, enabling rapid scene reconstruction for autonomous driving simulation.

entry.title: Optimal Scalar Quantization for Matrix Multiplication: Closed-Form Density and Phase Transition

author.name: Calvin Ang, Sungyoon Kim, Mert Pilanci

entry.summary: Derives optimal scalar quantization for matrix multiplication, obtaining sharp asymptotic expansions, optimal quantization densities, and closed-form solutions for Gaussian cases with a phase transition phenomenon.

entry.title: CurveStream: Boosting Streaming Video Understanding in MLLMs via Curvature-Aware Hierarchical Visual Memory Management

author.name: Chao Wang, Xudong Tan, Jianjian Cao, Kangcong Li, Tao Chen

entry.summary: CurveStream proposes a training-free, curvature-aware hierarchical visual memory management framework for streaming video understanding in MLLMs, using curvature in representation space to identify semantically important frames.

entry.title: HiFiGaze: Improving Eye Tracking Accuracy Using Screen Content Knowledge

author.name: Taejun Kim, Vimal Mollyn, Riku Arakawa, Chris Harrison

entry.summary: HiFiGaze leverages high-resolution user-facing cameras to capture screen reflections in users' eyes, combined with knowledge of displayed screen content, for accurate gaze estimation without specialized eye tracking hardware.

entry.title: K-GMRF: Kinetic Gauss-Markov Random Field for First-Principles Covariance Tracking on Lie Groups

author.name: ZhiMing Li

entry.summary: K-GMRF proposes training-free covariance tracking on Lie groups by reformulating it as forced rigid-body motion, using Euler-Poincaré equations and symplectic integration. Achieves zero steady-state error under constant rotation.

entry.title: OrbitNVS: Harnessing Video Diffusion Priors for Novel View Synthesis

author.name: Jinglin Liang, Zijian Zhou, Rui Huang, Shuangping Huang, and Yichen Gong

entry.summary: OrbitNVS reformulates novel view synthesis as orbit video generation, adapting a pre-trained video generation model with camera adapters, normal-guided geometry conditioning, and appearance-aware attention for high-quality view synthesis from limited input views.

entry.title: MetaCues: Enabling Critical Engagement with Generative AI for Information Seeking and Sensemaking

author.name: Anjali Singh, Karan Taneja, Zhitong Guan and Soo Young Rieh

entry.summary: MetaCues is an interactive GenAI search tool that delivers metacognitive cues alongside AI responses to promote critical engagement rather than passive acceptance. An N=146 study shows preliminary evidence of improved critical engagement.

entry.title: DynFlowDrive: Flow-Based Dynamic World Modeling for Autonomous Driving

author.name: Xiaolu Liu, Yicong Li, Song Wang, Junbo Chen, Angela Yao, Jianke Zhu
