entry.summary: DynFlowDrive proposes a latent world model for autonomous driving that uses rectified flow to model scene state transitions under different driving actions, enabling progressive future state prediction with stability-aware multi-mode trajectory planning.

entry.title: Adapting a Pre-trained Single-Cell Foundation Model to Spatial Gene Expression Generation from Histology Images

author.name: Donghai Fang, Yongheng Li, Zhen Wang, Yuansong Zeng, Wenwen Min

entry.summary: Adapts single-cell foundation models to predict spatial gene expression from histology images by bridging the modality gap through cross-modal alignment, leveraging pre-trained gene-gene dependency knowledge that histology alone cannot capture.

entry.title: Enhancing Alignment for Unified Multimodal Models via Semantically-Grounded Supervision

author.name: Jiyeong Kim, Yerim So, Hyesong Choi, Uiwon Hwang, Dongbo Min

entry.summary: Presents SeGroS, a fine-tuning framework for Unified Multimodal Models that resolves granularity mismatch between text and visual supervision through visual grounding maps, semantic visual hints, and corrupted input reconstruction.

entry.title: FoleyDirector: Fine-Grained Temporal Steering for Video-to-Audio Generation via Structured Scripts

author.name: You Li, Dewei Zhou, Fan Ma, Fu Li, Dongliang He, Yi Yang

entry.summary: Proposes FoleyDirector for precise temporal control in video-to-audio generation using Structured Temporal Scripts and DiT-based architecture, enabling fine-grained multi-event audio synthesis even with insufficient visual cues.

entry.title: On the Dynamics & Transferability of Latent Generalization during Memorization

author.name: Simran Ketha and Venkatakrishnan Ramaswamy

entry.summary: Studies the dynamics and transferability of latent generalization abilities in deep networks during memorization of corrupted labels, showing that internal representations retain better generalization than model outputs suggest.

entry.title: TAPAS: Efficient Two-Server Asymmetric Private Aggregation Beyond Prio(+)

author.name: Harish Karthikeyan and Antigoni Polychroniadou

entry.summary: Presents TAPAS, a two-server privacy-preserving aggregation protocol that achieves asymmetric costs, communication independent of input dimension, no trusted setup, and client-side efficiency improvements over Prio.

entry.title: When Contextual Inference Fails: Cancelability in Interactive Instruction Following

author.name: Natalia Bila, Kata Nasz\'adi, Alexandra Mayn, Christof Monz

entry.summary: Introduces BWIM, a benchmark for contextual meaning construction in collaborative block-building, finding that LLMs can detect speaker unreliability in explicit ratings but fail to adjust behavior accordingly, revealing a judgment-action dissociation.

entry.title: RouterKGQA: Specialized--General Model Routing for Constraint-Aware Knowledge Graph Question Answering

author.name: Bo Yuan, Hexuan Deng, Xuebo Liu, Min Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes RouterKGQA, a framework that routes between specialized small models and general large models for knowledge graph question answering. The specialized model generates reasoning paths while the general model performs KG-guided repair only when needed, reducing cost.

entry.title: An Agentic Multi-Agent Architecture for Cybersecurity Risk Management

author.name: Ravish Gupta (1), Saket Kumar (2), Shreeya Sharma (3), Maulik Dang (4), Abhishek Aggarwal (4) ((1) BigCommerce, (2) University at Buffalo, The State University of New York, Buffalo, NY, USA, (3) Microsoft, (4) Amazon)

entry.summary: Built a six-agent AI system for cybersecurity risk assessment aligned with NIST CSF framework. Tested on a 15-person healthcare company and compared against three CISSP practitioners, claiming comparable quality at dramatically lower cost.

entry.title: IndoorR2X: Indoor Robot-to-Everything Coordination with LLM-Driven Planning

author.name: Fan Yang, Soumya Teotia, Shaunak A. Mehta, Prajit KrisshnaKumar, Quanting Xie, Jun Liu, Yueqi Song, Li Wenkai, Atsunori Moteki, Kanji Uchino, Yonatan Bisk

entry.summary: Introduces IndoorR2X, the first benchmark for LLM-driven multi-robot task planning with Robot-to-Everything communication in indoor environments. Integrates mobile robot and IoT sensor observations for global semantic state construction.

entry.title: Improving Image-to-Image Translation via a Rectified Flow Reformulation

author.name: Satoshi Iizuka, Shun Okamoto, Kazuhiro Fukui

entry.summary: Proposes I2I-RFR, a plug-in method that recasts image-to-image regression networks as continuous-time rectified flow transport models. Adds noise-corrupted targets at input and enables ODE-based progressive refinement at inference without changing the base architecture.

entry.title: MME-CoF-Pro: Evaluating Reasoning Coherence in Video Generative Models with Text and Visual Hints

author.name: Yu Qi, Xinyi Xu, Ziyu Guo, Siyuan Ma, Renrui Zhang, Xinyan Chen, Ruichuan An, Ruofan Xing, Jiayi Zhang, Haojie Huang, Pheng-Ann Heng, Jonathan Tremblay, Lawson L.S. Wong

entry.summary: Proposes MME-CoF-Pro, a benchmark for evaluating reasoning coherence in video generative models across 303 samples and 16 categories. Introduces a Reasoning Score for process-level evaluation and three settings (no hint, text hint, visual hint).

entry.title: Graph-Informed Adversarial Modeling: Infimal Subadditivity of Interpolative Divergences

author.name: Panagiota Birmpa (1 and 2) and Eric Joseph Hall (1 and 2) ((1) Heriot--Watt University, (2) Maxwell Institute for Mathematical Sciences)

entry.summary: Proves infimal subadditivity for interpolative divergences on Bayesian networks, providing theoretical justification for replacing monolithic GAN discriminators with localized family-level discriminators aligned to the graph structure.

entry.title: Legged Autonomous Surface Science In Analogue Environments (LASSIE): Making Every Robotic Step Count in Planetary Exploration

author.name: Cristina G. Wilson, Marion Nachon, Shipeng Liu, John G. Ruck, J. Diego Caporale, Benjamin E. McKeeby, Yifeng Zhang, Jordan M. Bretzfelder, John Bush, Alivia M. Eng, Ethan Fulcher, Emmy B. Hughes, Ian C. Rankin, Jelis J. Sostre Cort\'es, Sophie Silver, Michael R. Zanetti, Ryan C. Ewing, Kenton R. Fisher, Douglas J. Jerolmack, Daniel E. Koditschek, Frances Rivera-Hern\'andez, Thomas F. Shipley, and Feifei Qian

entry.summary: LASSIE presents legged robots for planetary surface exploration that use direct surface interactions for terrain characterization and human-inspired data acquisition algorithms for adaptive scientific exploration, validated in planetary analog environments.

entry.title: ATHENA: Adaptive Test-Time Steering for Improving Count Fidelity in Diffusion Models

author.name: Mohammad Shahab Sepehri, Asal Mehradfar, Berk Tinaz, Salman Avestimehr, Mahdi Soltanolkotabi

entry.summary: ATHENA is a model-agnostic, test-time framework for improving object count fidelity in diffusion models without retraining, using intermediate representations during sampling to estimate counts and apply corrections early in denoising.

entry.title: FlashCap: Millisecond-Accurate Human Motion Capture via Flashing LEDs and Event-Based Vision

author.name: Zekai Wu, Shuqi Fan, Mengyin Liu, Yuhua Luo, Xincheng Lin, Ming Yan, Junhao Wu, Xiuhong Lin, Yuexin Ma, Chenglu Wen, Lan Xu, Siqi Shen, Cheng Wang

entry.summary: FlashCap introduces a flashing LED-based motion capture system for millisecond-precise timing using event cameras, along with FlashMotion dataset comprising event, RGB, LiDAR, and IMU modalities for high-temporal-resolution motion analysis.

entry.title: Failure Modes for Deep Learning-Based Online Mapping: How to Measure and Address Them

author.name: Michael Hubbertz, Qi Han, Tobias Meisen

entry.summary: Proposes a framework to identify failure modes in deep learning-based online mapping for autonomous driving by disentangling memorization of input features from overfitting to known map geometries, using Fréchet distance-based metrics.

entry.title: SIMPLER: Efficient Foundation Model Adaptation via Similarity-Guided Layer Pruning for Earth Observation

author.name: V\'ictor Barreiro, Johannes Jakubik, Francisco Arg\"uello, Dora B. Heras

entry.summary: Introduces SIMPLER, a pre-fine-tuning layer pruning method for Earth Observation foundation models that computes layer-wise representation similarity on unlabeled data to identify redundant layers before adaptation, reducing both training and inference costs.

entry.title: SAGE: Sustainable Agent-Guided Expert-tuning for Culturally Attuned Translation in Low-Resource Southeast Asia

author.name: Zhixiang Lu, Chong Zhang, Yulong Li, Angelos Stefanidis, Anh Nguyen, Imran Razzak, Jionglong Su, Zhengyong Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces SAGE, an energy-aware translation framework for low-resource Southeast Asian languages that uses an RL agent to select high-quality training data instead of training on massive noisy corpora, reducing carbon footprint while improving translation quality.

entry.title: Not an Obstacle for Dog, but a Hazard for Human: A Co-Ego Navigation System for Guide Dog Robots

author.name: Ruiping Liu, Jingqi Zhang, Junwei Zheng, Yufan Chen, Peter Seungjune Lee, Di Wen, Kunyu Peng, Jiaming Zhang, Kailun Yang, Katja Mombaur, Rainer Stiefelhagen

entry.summary: Presents a co-egocentric navigation system for robotic guide dogs that addresses 'viewpoint asymmetry'—obstacles safe for the robot at ground level but dangerous at human height (e.g., bent branches). Integrates robot-centric and user-centric perspectives.

entry.title: ReManNet: A Riemannian Manifold Network for Monocular 3D Lane Detection

author.name: Chengzhi Hong, Bijun Li

entry.summary: ReManNet proposes a Riemannian manifold approach for monocular 3D lane detection, treating the road as a smooth 2D manifold with lanes as embedded submanifolds, providing geometric-topological coupling that improves the ill-posed 2D-to-3D lifting.

entry.title: Semantic Delta: An Interpretable Signal Differentiating Human and LLMs Dialogue

author.name: Riccardo Scantamburlo, Mauro Mezzanzana, Giacomo Buonanno, Francesco Bertolotti

entry.summary: Introduces 'semantic delta' - the difference between two most dominant semantic category intensities - as a lightweight interpretable metric for distinguishing human-written from LLM-generated dialogue, finding LLMs show stronger thematic concentration.

entry.title: Deterministic Mode Proposals: An Efficient Alternative to Generative Sampling for Ambiguous Segmentation

author.name: Sebastian Gerard and Josephine Sullivan

entry.summary: Proposes mode proposal models as a deterministic alternative to generative sampling for ambiguous segmentation, producing a fixed-size set of likely segmentations in a single forward pass with confidence scores.

entry.title: Near-Equivalent Q-learning Policies for Dynamic Treatment Regimes

author.name: Sophia Yazzourh and Erica E.M. Moodie

entry.summary: Extends Q-learning for dynamic treatment regimes to identify near-equivalent treatment policies using a worst-value tolerance criterion, revealing meaningful clinical alternatives beyond a single optimal policy.

entry.title: Scalable Learning of Multivariate Distributions via Coresets

author.name: Zeyu Ding and Katja Ickstadt and Nadja Klein and Alexander Munteanu and Simon Omlor

entry.summary: Develops the first coreset construction for multivariate conditional transformation models (MCTMs), achieving substantial data reduction while maintaining log-likelihood within (1±ε) multiplicative error bounds.

entry.title: MAFA: A Multi-Agent Framework for Enterprise-Scale Annotation with Configurable Task Adaptation

author.name: Mahmood Hegazy, Aaron Rodrigues, Azzam Naeem

entry.summary: Presents MAFA, a production-deployed multi-agent annotation framework at JP Morgan Chase that eliminated a 1M utterance backlog while achieving 86% agreement with human annotators through configurable task adaptation.

entry.title: From Comprehension to Reasoning: A Hierarchical Benchmark for Automated Financial Research Reporting

author.name: Yiyun Zhu, Yidong Jiang, Ziwen Xu, Yinsheng Yao, Dawei Cheng, Jinru Ding, Yejie Zheng and Jie Xu

entry.summary: Introduces FinReasoning, a hierarchical benchmark for evaluating LLMs on financial research report generation, testing comprehension through multi-step reasoning over real financial data.

entry.title: Significance-Gain Pair Encoding for LLMs: A Statistical Alternative to Frequency-Based Subword Merging

author.name: Azam Nouri

entry.summary: Introduces Significance-Gain BPE, a drop-in alternative to standard BPE tokenization that selects merges based on a z-statistic cohesion measure combined with compression gain, rather than raw pair frequency.

entry.title: HypeLoRA: Hyper-Network-Generated LoRA Adapters for Calibrated Language Model Fine-Tuning

author.name: Bartosz Trojan and Filip G\k{e}bala

entry.summary: Investigates calibration dynamics of LoRA fine-tuning and proposes HypeLoRA, where a shared hyper-network generates LoRA adapter matrices to induce structural coupling across layers. Experiments on GLUE benchmark with RoBERTa show calibration parity with full fine-tuning.

entry.title: VERDICT: Verifiable Evolving Reasoning with Directive-Informed Collegial Teams for Legal Judgment Prediction

author.name: Hui Liao, Chuan Qin, Yongwen Ren, Hao Li, Zhenya Huang, Yanyong Zhang, Chao Wang

entry.summary: Proposes VERDICT, a multi-agent framework for legal judgment prediction that simulates a virtual collegial panel with specialized agents for fact structuring, legal retrieval, opinion drafting, and supervisory verification in a traceable draft-verify-revise workflow.

entry.title: Towards Solving Polynomial-Objective Integer Programming with Hypergraph Neural Networks

author.name: Minshuo Li, Yaoxin Wu, Pavel Troubil, Yingqian Zhang, Wim P.M. Nuijten

entry.summary: Proposes a hypergraph neural network approach for polynomial-objective integer programming, capturing high-degree variable interactions through hypergraph representations and integrating convolutions between variables, high-degree terms, and constraints.

entry.title: DAPA: Distribution Aware Piecewise Activation Functions for On-Device Transformer Inference and Training

author.name: Maoyang Xiang, Bo Wang

entry.summary: Proposes DAPA, a distribution-aware piecewise activation function for Transformers that allocates finer approximation segments to high-probability regions of pre-activation data, designed for efficient on-device inference and training.

entry.title: AURORA: Adaptive Unified Representation for Robust Ultrasound Analysis

author.name: Ufaq Khan, L. D. M. S. Sai Teja, Ayuba Shakiru, Mai A. Shaaban, Yutong Xie, Muhammad Bilal, and Muhammad Haris Khan

entry.summary: Proposes AURORA, a unified multi-task framework for ultrasound image analysis using Qwen3-VL transformer encoder, handling segmentation, detection, classification, and landmark regression across diverse organs and datasets through shared representation.

entry.title: TuLaBM: Tumor-Biased Latent Bridge Matching for Contrast-Enhanced MRI Synthesis

author.name: Atharva Rege, Adinath Madhavrao Dukre, Numan Balci, Dwarikanath Mahapatra, Imran Razzak

entry.summary: Proposes TuLaBM for synthesizing contrast-enhanced MRI from non-contrast MRI using Brownian bridge transport in latent space with tumor-biased weighting, avoiding GBCAs while preserving critical tumor contrast patterns.

entry.title: Optimizing Resource-Constrained Non-Pharmaceutical Interventions for Multi-Cluster Outbreak Control Using Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Xueqiao Peng, Andrew Perrault

entry.summary: Proposes a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework for allocating limited NPI resources (testing, quarantine) across multiple asynchronous disease outbreak clusters, formulated as a constrained restless multi-armed bandit problem.

entry.title: A Closed-Form CLF-CBF Controller for Whole-Body Continuum Soft Robot Collision Avoidance

author.name: Kiwan Wong, Maximillian St\"olzle, Wei Xiao, Daniela Rus

entry.summary: Presents a closed-form CLF-CBF controller for real-time 3D obstacle avoidance in soft continuum manipulators without online optimization, analytically embedding safety constraints into the control input for guaranteed stability and safety.

entry.title: When both Grounding and not Grounding are Bad -- A Partially Grounded Encoding of Planning into SAT (Extended Version)

author.name: Jo\~ao Filipe and Gregor Behnke

entry.summary: Explores a middle ground between fully lifted and fully grounded planning by introducing SAT encodings that keep actions lifted while partially grounding predicates. Achieves linear scaling with plan length instead of quadratic, outperforming state-of-the-art on hard-to-ground domains.

entry.title: TrustFlow: Topic-Aware Vector Reputation Propagation for Multi-Agent Ecosystems

author.name: Volodymyr Seliuchenko

entry.summary: TrustFlow introduces a multi-dimensional reputation propagation algorithm for multi-agent systems, using topic-gated transfer operators on interaction graphs with convergence guarantees via contraction mapping theorem. It resists sybil attacks and reputation laundering with minimal precision impact.

entry.title: Instruction-Free Tuning of Large Vision Language Models for Medical Instruction Following

author.name: Myeongkyun Kang, Soopil Kim, Xiaoxiao Li, Sang Hyun Park

entry.summary: Proposes instruction-free tuning for medical vision-language models that replaces curated instruction datasets with image-description pairs and momentum proxy instructions. Addresses the challenge of creating medical instruction datasets requiring expert knowledge.

entry.title: Zero Shot Deformation Reconstruction for Soft Robots Using a Flexible Sensor Array and Cage Based 3D Gaussian Modeling

author.name: Linrui Shou, Zilang Chen, Wenjia Xu, Yiyue Luo, Tingyu Cheng

entry.summary: Presents a zero-shot deformation reconstruction framework for soft robots using flexible piezoresistive sensors and cage-based 3D Gaussian deformation modeling, requiring no visual supervision or object-specific retraining at inference.

entry.title: Scalable Cross-Facility Federated Learning for Scientific Foundation Models on Multiple Supercomputers

author.name: Yijiang Li, Zilinghan Li, Kyle Chard, Ian Foster, Todd Munson, Ravi Madduri, Kibaek Kim

entry.summary: Presents a cross-facility federated learning framework for training scientific models across heterogeneous HPC environments, built on APPFL with Globus Compute orchestration for multiple supercomputers.

entry.title: Efficiency Follows Global-Local Decoupling

author.name: Zhenyu Yang, Gensheng Pei, Tao Chen, Yichao Zhou, Tianfei Zhou, Yazhou Yao, Fumin Shen

entry.summary: ConvNeur introduces a two-branch architecture decoupling global reasoning (via neural memory) from local representation, using learned gates for interaction. Achieves subquadratic scaling while retaining local inductive priors.

entry.title: MagicSeg: Open-World Segmentation Pretraining via Counterfactural Diffusion-Based Auto-Generation

author.name: Kaixin Cai, Pengzhen Ren, Jianhua Han, Yi Zhu, Hang Xu, Jianzhuang Liu, Xiaodan Liang

entry.summary: MagicSeg uses diffusion models to automatically generate training datasets for open-world semantic segmentation, including counterfactual negative samples alongside positive examples, reducing reliance on expensive pixel annotations.

entry.title: OmniDiT: Extending Diffusion Transformer to Omni-VTON Framework

author.name: Weixuan Zeng, Pengcheng Wei, Huaiqing Wang, Boheng Zhang, Jia Sun, Dewen Fan, Lin HE, Long Chen, Qianqian Gan, Fan Yang, Tingting Gao

entry.summary: OmniDiT proposes a unified virtual try-on/try-off framework based on Diffusion Transformers with a large dataset (380k pairs), adaptive position encoding, and a self-evolving data curation pipeline for high-quality garment-model pairing.

entry.title: Semantic Audio-Visual Navigation in Continuous Environments

author.name: Yichen Zeng, Hebaixu Wang, Meng Liu, Yu Zhou, Chen Gao, Kehan Chen, Gongping Huang

entry.summary: SAVN-CE introduces continuous-environment semantic audio-visual navigation where agents move freely in 3D with coherent audio-visual streams and targets may go silent. MAGNet, a multimodal transformer, uses a semantic-aware memory bank for persistent goal tracking.

entry.title: Morphology-Consistent Humanoid Interaction through Robot-Centric Video Synthesis

author.name: Weisheng Xu, Jian Li, Yi Gu, Bin Yang, Haodong Chen, Shuyi Lin, Mingqian Zhou, Jing Tan, Qiwei Wu, Xiangrui Jiang, Taowen Wang, Jiawen Wen, Qiwei Liang, Jiaxi Zhang, Renjing Xu

entry.summary: AIGQ proposes the first end-to-end generative framework for e-commerce query recommendation on Taobao, using interest-aware list-level supervised fine-tuning, offline RL for list-level optimization, and a hybrid architecture for deployment.

entry.title: FedRG: Unleashing the Representation Geometry for Federated Learning with Noisy Clients

author.name: Tian Wen and Zhiqin Yang and Yonggang Zhang and Xuefeng Jiang and Hao Peng and Yuwei Wang and Bo Han

entry.summary: FedRG proposes using representation geometry rather than scalar loss values for identifying noisy labels in federated learning, creating label-agnostic spherical representations via self-supervision and using von Mises-Fisher distributions for noise detection.

entry.title: Neither Here Nor There: Cross-Lingual Representation Dynamics of Code-Mixed Text in Multilingual Encoders

author.name: Debajyoti Mazumder, Divyansh Pathak, Prashant Kodali, Jasabanta Patro

entry.summary: Probes how multilingual encoders represent code-mixed Hindi-English text, finding that code-mixed inputs remain loosely connected to either constituent language and that continued pre-training on code-mixed data doesn't significantly improve alignment.

entry.title: Controllable Text-to-Motion Generation via Modular Body-Part Phase Control

author.name: Minyue Dai, Ke Fan, Anyi Rao, Jingbo Wang, Bo Dai

entry.summary: Proposes Modular Body-Part Phase Control for text-to-motion generation, using sinusoidal phase signals to enable structured editing of specific body parts while maintaining overall motion coherence. The plug-and-play framework uses a scalar-based phase interface rather than high-dimensional joint constraints.

entry.title: NASimJax: GPU-Accelerated Policy Learning Framework for Penetration Testing

author.name: Raphael Simon and Jos\'e Carrasquel and Wim Mees and Pieter Libin

entry.summary: Presents NASimJax, a JAX-based reimplementation of the Network Attack Simulator achieving 100x speedup over the original, enabling RL training for penetration testing on larger and more realistic network scenarios.

entry.title: Graph2TS: Structure-Controlled Time Series Generation via Quantile-Graph VAEs

author.name: Shaoshuai Du, Joze M. Rozanec, Andy Pimentel, Ana-Lucia Varbanescu

entry.summary: Proposes Graph2TS for structure-controlled time series generation using quantile-graph VAEs that separate structural backbone from stochastic residual dynamics, with structure represented as quantile-based transition graphs.

entry.title: MedSPOT: A Workflow-Aware Sequential Grounding Benchmark for Clinical GUI

author.name: Rozain Shakeel, Abdul Rahman Mohammad Ali, Muneeb Mushtaq, Tausifa Jan Saleem, and Tajamul Ashraf

entry.summary: Introduces MedSPOT, a workflow-aware sequential grounding benchmark for clinical GUI environments with 216 task-driven videos and 597 annotated keyframes, testing whether MLLMs can perform procedural spatial reasoning in medical software.

entry.title: ODySSeI: An Open-Source End-to-End Framework for Automated Detection, Segmentation, and Severity Estimation of Lesions in Invasive Coronary Angiography Images

author.name: Anand Choudhary, Xiaowu Sun, Thabo Mahendiran, Ortal Senouf, Denise Auberson, Bernard De Bruyne, Stephane Fournier, Olivier Muller, Emmanuel Abb\'e, Pascal Frossard, Dorina Thanou

entry.summary: Introduces ODySSeI, an open-source end-to-end framework for automated detection, segmentation, and severity estimation of lesions in invasive coronary angiography images. Tested on 2149 patients across three continents with a novel Pyramidal Augmentation Scheme.

entry.title: An Empirical Study of SFT-DPO Interaction and Parameterization in Small Language Models

author.name: Yuming Feng and Christy Yang

entry.summary: Systematically compares SFT-only, DPO-only, and staged SFT→DPO training alongside full fine-tuning vs LoRA on GPT-2-scale models. Finds that parameterization (FFT vs LoRA) dominates over training recipe choice (SFT vs DPO) at small scale.

entry.title: Spectral Alignment in Forward-Backward Representations via Temporal Abstraction

author.name: Seyed Mahdi B. Azad, Jasper Hoffmann, Iman Nematollahi, Hao Zhu, Abhinav Valada, Joschka Boedecker

entry.summary: Analyzes temporal abstraction as a mechanism to address spectral mismatch between continuous environment dynamics and low-rank forward-backward representations. Shows temporal abstraction acts as a low-pass filter that reduces effective rank of the successor representation.

entry.title: Adaptive Greedy Frame Selection for Long Video Understanding

author.name: Yuning Huang and Fengqing Zhu

entry.summary: Proposes a question-adaptive greedy frame selection method for long-video VLM question answering that jointly optimizes query relevance (SigLIP) and semantic representativeness (DINOv2) under a fixed frame budget.

entry.title: CoVR-R:Reason-Aware Composed Video Retrieval

author.name: Omkar Thawakar, Dmitry Demidov, Vaishnav Potlapalli, Sai Prasanna Teja Reddy Bogireddy, Viswanatha Reddy Gajjala, Alaa Mostafa Lasheen, Rao Muhammad Anwer, Fahad Khan

entry.summary: Introduces a reasoning-first, zero-shot approach to Composed Video Retrieval (CoVR) that uses large multimodal models to infer causal and temporal consequences of edits. Also proposes CoVR-Reason benchmark with structured reasoning annotations.

entry.title: Subspace Projection Methods for Fast Spectral Embeddings of Evolving Graphs

author.name: Mohammad Eini, Abdullah Karaaslanli, Vassilis Kalantzis, Panagiotis A. Traganitis

entry.summary: Presents a Rayleigh-Ritz projection framework for efficiently updating eigenvectors of adjacency/Laplacian matrices as graphs evolve dynamically, avoiding full recomputation.

entry.title: Efficient Label Refinement for Face Parsing Under Extreme Poses Using 3D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Ankit Gahlawat, Anirban Mukherjee, Dinesh Babu Jayagopi

entry.summary: Uses 3D Gaussian Splatting to refine face parsing labels under extreme poses by jointly fitting RGB and segmentation 3DGS models, enforcing multiview consistency for generating pose-diverse training data.

entry.title: Full-Stack Domain Enhancement for Combustion LLMs: Construction and Optimization

author.name: Quanjia Xiao, Weimin Ouyang, Zonglin Yang, Tianhao Wu, Qingguo Zhou, Runze Mao, Zhi X. Chen

entry.summary: Proposes the first full-stack domain-enhanced LLM workflow for combustion science, integrating automated corpus construction, incremental pre-training, instruction fine-tuning, and verifiable reward RL to ensure physical law adherence.

entry.title: Improving Automatic Summarization of Radiology Reports through Mid-Training of Large Language Models

author.name: Mengxian Lyu, Cheng Peng, Ziyi Chen, Mengyuan Zhang, Jieting Li Lu, Yonghui Wu

entry.summary: Proposes a mid-training adaptation strategy for LLMs applied to radiology report summarization, showing that clinical-domain pre-training followed by subdomain-specific mid-training improves performance over standard pre-training and fine-tuning approaches. Uses GatorTron models and evaluates on OpenI and MIMIC-CXR benchmarks.

entry.title: LLM-MRD: LLM-Guided Multi-View Reasoning Distillation for Fake News Detection

author.name: Weilin Zhou, Shanwen Tan, Enhao Gu, Yurong Qian

entry.summary: Proposes LLM-MRD, a teacher-student framework for multimodal fake news detection that distills multi-view reasoning from an LLM teacher into a smaller student model, covering textual, visual, and cross-modal perspectives to reduce inference costs while maintaining detection quality.

entry.title: Agreement Between Large Language Models, Human Reviewers, and Authors in Evaluating STROBE Checklists for Observational Studies in Rheumatology

author.name: Emre Bilgin, Ebru Ozturk, Meera Shah, Lisa Traboco, Rebecca Everitt, Ai Lyn Tan, Marwan Bukhari, Vincenzo Venerito, Latika Gupta

entry.summary: Compares STROBE checklist assessments from LLMs (ChatGPT-5.2, Gemini-3Pro), human reviewers, and original authors across 17 rheumatology articles. Evaluates inter-rater reliability using Gwet's Agreement Coefficient across methodological rigor and presentation domains.

entry.title: DPxFin: Adaptive Differential Privacy for Anti-Money Laundering Detection via Reputation-Weighted Federated Learning

author.name: Renuga Kanagavelu, Manjil Nepal, Ning Peiyan, Cai Kangning, Xu Jiming, Fei Gao, Yong Liu, Goh Siow Mong Rick and Qingsong Wei

entry.summary: Proposes DPxFin, a federated learning framework for anti-money laundering that integrates reputation-guided adaptive differential privacy, dynamically assigning noise levels to client updates based on alignment between local and global models.

entry.title: MSNet and LS-Net: Scalable Multi-Scale Multi-Representation Networks for Time Series Classification

author.name: Celal Alag\"oz, Mehmet Kurnaz, Farhan Aadil

entry.summary: Proposes MSNet and LS-Net, scalable multi-scale convolutional architectures for univariate time series classification that systematically integrate multi-representation inputs. Evaluated across 142 benchmark datasets under a unified protocol.

entry.title: SOFTMAP: Sim2Real Soft Robot Forward Modeling via Topological Mesh Alignment and Physics Prior

author.name: Ziyong Ma, Uksang Yoo, Jonathan Francis, Weiming Zhi, Jeffrey Ichnowski, Jean Oh

entry.summary: Presents SOFTMAP, a sim-to-real framework for real-time 3D forward modeling of tendon-actuated soft finger manipulators, combining ARAP-based topological alignment, simulation pretraining, and real-world fine-tuning for accurate deformation prediction.

entry.title: Beyond the Desk: Barriers and Future Opportunities for AI to Assist Scientists in Embodied Physical Tasks

author.name: Irene Hou, Alexander Qin, Lauren Cheng, Philip J. Guo

entry.summary: First study examining how scientific practitioners use AI for embodied physical tasks (lab/fieldwork). Identifies three barriers: high-stakes experimental risks, constrained environments, and inability to match human tacit knowledge.

entry.title: Recognising BSL Fingerspelling in Continuous Signing Sequences

author.name: Alyssa Chan, Taein Kwon and Andrew Zisserman

entry.summary: Introduces FS23K, a large-scale BSL fingerspelling dataset, and proposes a recognition model accounting for bi-manual interactions and mouthing cues. Halves the character error rate compared to prior state of the art.

entry.title: MoCA3D: Monocular 3D Bounding Box Prediction in the Image Plane

author.name: Changwoo Jeon, Rishi Upadhyay and Achuta Kadambi

entry.summary: MoCA3D predicts projected 3D bounding box corners and per-corner depths from monocular images without camera intrinsics, using dense corner heatmaps and depth maps. Introduces Pixel-Aligned Geometry metric for evaluation.

entry.title: PowerLens: Taming LLM Agents for Safe and Personalized Mobile Power Management

author.name: Xingyu Feng, Chang Sun, Yuzhu Wang, Zhangbing Zhou, Chengwen Luo, Zhuangzhuang Chen, Xiaomin Ouyang, and Huanqi Yang

entry.summary: PowerLens uses LLM agents for personalized mobile power management on Android, leveraging commonsense reasoning to bridge user activities and system parameters across 18 device parameters with safety constraints.

entry.title: FlowScene: Style-Consistent Indoor Scene Generation with Multimodal Graph Rectified Flow

author.name: Zhifei Yang, Guangyao Zhai, Keyang Lu, YuYang Yin, Chao Zhang, Zhen Xiao, Jieyi Long, Nassir Navab, Yikai Wang

entry.summary: FlowScene generates indoor scenes with style consistency using a tri-branch rectified flow model conditioned on multimodal graphs, simultaneously generating layouts, shapes, and textures.

entry.title: CeRLP: A Cross-embodiment Robot Local Planning Framework for Visual Navigation

author.name: Haoyu Xi, Mingao Tan, Xinming Zhang, Siwei Cheng, Shanze Wang, Yin Gu, Xiaoyu Shen, Wei Zhang

entry.summary: CeRLP proposes a cross-embodiment robot local planning framework for visual navigation that abstracts visual information into unified geometric formulation, working across different robot configurations and camera types.

entry.title: CAF-Score: Calibrating CLAP with LALMs for Reference-free Audio Captioning Evaluation

author.name: Insung Lee, Taeyoung Jeong, Haejun Yoo, Du-Seong Chang, Myoung-Wan Koo

entry.summary: CAF-Score proposes a reference-free audio captioning evaluation metric that calibrates CLAP's coarse-grained alignment with Large Audio-Language Models' fine-grained comprehension to detect syntactic errors and hallucinations, achieving highest correlation with human judgments.

entry.title: IUP-Pose: Decoupled Iterative Uncertainty Propagation for Real-time Relative Pose Regression via Implicit Dense Alignment v1

author.name: Jun Wang, Xiaoyan Huang

entry.summary: IUP-Pose addresses real-time relative pose estimation by decoupling rotation and translation estimation with iterative uncertainty propagation and lightweight cross-attention for implicit dense alignment, running at 43 FPS.

entry.title: TSegAgent: Zero-Shot Tooth Segmentation via Geometry-Aware Vision-Language Agents

author.name: Shaojie Zhuang, Lu Yin, Guangshun Wei, Yunpeng Li, Xilu Wang, Yuanfeng Zhou

entry.summary: TSegAgent reformulates dental tooth segmentation as a zero-shot geometric reasoning problem using vision-language agents, combining foundation model representations with explicit geometric inductive biases from dental anatomy rather than task-specific training.

entry.title: A Unified Phase-native Computational Principle Governs Hippocampal Spike Timing and Neural Coding

author.name: Reza Ahmadvand, Sara Safura Sharif, Yaser Mike Banad

entry.summary: Proposes that hippocampal phase locking emerges from forced phase integration, developing the unified complex-valued neuron framework that separates neural information into orthogonal magnitude and phase coordinates, tested on rodent hippocampal data.

entry.title: BALM: A Model-Agnostic Framework for Balanced Multimodal Learning under Imbalanced Missing Rates

author.name: Phuong-Anh Nguyen, Tien Anh Pham, Duc-Trong Le, Cam-Van Thi Nguyen

entry.summary: BALM proposes a model-agnostic framework for balanced multimodal learning when modalities have different missing rates, using feature calibration and gradient rebalancing to prevent dominant modalities from overwhelming weaker ones.

entry.title: PCSTracker: Long-Term Scene Flow Estimation for Point Cloud Sequences

author.name: Min Lin, Gangwei Xu, Xianqi Wang, Yuyi Peng, Xin Yang

entry.summary: PCSTracker proposes the first end-to-end framework for consistent scene flow estimation in point cloud sequences, introducing iterative geometry-motion joint optimization and spatio-temporal trajectory update modules for long-term temporal consistency.

entry.title: One Model, Two Minds: Task-Conditioned Reasoning for Unified Image Quality and Aesthetic Assessment

author.name: Wen Yin, Cencen Liu, Dingrui Liu, Bing Su, Yuan-Fang Li, Tao He

entry.summary: TATAR proposes task-conditioned reasoning for unified image quality and aesthetic assessment, showing that IQA and IAA require fundamentally different reasoning strategies and reward functions, addressing reasoning and optimization mismatches.

entry.title: Evaluating Vision Foundation Models for Pixel and Object Classification in Microscopy

author.name: Carolin Teuber, Anwai Archit, Tobias Boothe, Peter Ditte, Jochen Rink, Constantin Pape

entry.summary: Evaluates whether vision foundation models (VFMs) like SAM and DINOv2 can improve pixel and object classification in microscopy, comparing feature-based shallow learning with VFM-extracted features across diverse microscopy data.

entry.title: GDEGAN: Gaussian Dynamic Equivariant Graph Attention Network for Ligand Binding Site Prediction

author.name: Animesh, Plaban Kumar Bhowmick, Pralay Mitra

entry.summary: Proposes GDEGAN, replacing dot-product attention with adaptive Gaussian kernels in equivariant graph neural networks for protein binding site prediction, better capturing geometric and chemical variation of neighboring residues.

entry.title: Learning Like Humans: Analogical Concept Learning for Generalized Category Discovery

author.name: Jizhou Han, Chenhao Ding, Yuhang He, Qiang Wang, Shaokun Wang, SongLin Dong, Yihong Gong

entry.summary: Introduces ATCG, a plug-and-play module for Generalized Category Discovery that generates analogical textual concepts from labeled knowledge and fuses them with visual features, turning discovery into visual-textual reasoning.

entry.title: PanORama: Multiview Consistent Panoptic Segmentation in Operating Rooms

author.name: Tuna G\"urb\"uz, Ege \"Ozsoy, Tony Danjun Wang, Nassir Navab

entry.summary: Introduces PanORama, the first multiview-consistent panoptic segmentation for operating rooms that models cross-view interactions at the feature level in a single forward pass, achieving >70% Panoptic Quality.

entry.title: ReconMIL: Synergizing Latent Space Reconstruction with Bi-Stream Mamba for Whole Slide Image Analysis

author.name: Lubin Gan and Jing Zhang and Heng Zhang and Xin Di and Zhifeng Wang and Wenke Huang and Xiaoyan Sun

entry.summary: Proposes ReconMIL for whole slide image analysis, combining latent space reconstruction to bridge the domain gap between foundation model features and specific histological tasks with a bi-stream Mamba architecture for balanced global-local aggregation.

entry.title: RAM: Recover Any 3D Human Motion in-the-Wild

author.name: Sen Jia, Ning Zhu, Jinqin Zhong, Jiale Zhou, Huaping Zhang, Jenq-Neng Hwang, Lei Li

entry.summary: Proposes RAM for recovering 3D multi-person human motion in the wild using a motion-aware semantic tracker, memory-augmented temporal HMR, and a prediction module for handling occlusions and dynamic interactions.

entry.title: An Agentic Approach to Generating XAI-Narratives

author.name: Yifan He and David Martens

entry.summary: Proposes a multi-agent framework for generating XAI narratives where a Narrator generates explanations and Critic Agents provide feedback on faithfulness and coherence, enabling iterative improvement of natural-language explanations.

entry.title: AgenticRS-EnsNAS: Ensemble-Decoupled Self-Evolving Architecture Search

author.name: Yun Chen, Moyu Zhang, Jinxin Hu, Yu Zhang, Xiaoyi Zeng

entry.summary: Introduces Ensemble-Decoupled Architecture Search, a framework that predicts system-level ensemble performance from single-learner evaluation, reducing NAS validation cost from O(M) to O(1) per candidate. Targets industrial production systems with large ensembles (50-200 models).

entry.title: DIAL-KG: Schema-Free Incremental Knowledge Graph Construction via Dynamic Schema Induction and Evolution-Intent Assessment

author.name: Weidong Bao, Yilin Wang, Ruyu Gao, Fangling Leng, Yubin Bao, and Ge Yu

entry.summary: Introduces DIAL-KG, a framework for incremental knowledge graph construction that dynamically induces and evolves schemas without predefined structures. Uses a Meta-Knowledge Base to orchestrate a three-stage cycle of extraction, assessment, and evolution.

entry.title: Generalizable NGP-SR: Generalizable Neural Radiance Fields Super-Resolution via Neural Graph Primitives

author.name: Wanqi Yuan, Omkar Sharad Mayekar, Connor Pennington, Nianyi Li

entry.summary: Proposes Generalizable NGP-SR, a 3D-aware super-resolution framework that reconstructs high-resolution radiance fields directly from low-resolution posed images, maintaining multi-view consistency without post-hoc 2D upsampling.

entry.title: AGILE: A Comprehensive Workflow for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation Learning

author.name: Huihua Zhao, Rafael Cathomen, Lionel Gulich, Wei Liu, Efe Arda Ongan, Michael Lin, Shalin Jain, Soha Pouya, Yan Chang

entry.summary: Presents AGILE, an end-to-end workflow for humanoid robot reinforcement learning that standardizes the policy development lifecycle across environment verification, training, evaluation, and deployment stages.

entry.title: Wildfire Spread Scenarios: Increasing Sample Diversity of Segmentation Diffusion Models with Training-Free Methods

author.name: Sebastian Gerard and Josephine Sullivan

entry.summary: Evaluates training-free sampling methods (particle guidance, SPELL, and a new cluster-repulsion approach) for increasing sample diversity in segmentation diffusion models, applied to wildfire spread prediction.

entry.title: Pseudo-Labeling for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation with Kernel GLMs

author.name: Nathan Weill and Kaizheng Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a principled framework for unsupervised domain adaptation using pseudo-labeling in kernel GLMs, establishing non-asymptotic excess-risk bounds that characterize adaptation performance through an 'effective labeled sample size'.

entry.title: Kolmogorov-Arnold causal generative models

author.name: Alejandro Almod\'ovar, Mar Elizo, Patricia A. Apell\'aniz, Santiago Zazo, Juan Parras

entry.summary: Proposes KaCGM, a causal generative model using Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for structural equations in mixed-type tabular data, enabling inspectable causal mechanisms including symbolic approximations.

entry.title: Curriculum Guided Personalized Subgraph Federated Learning

author.name: Minku Kang, Hogun Park

entry.summary: Proposes CUFED, a curriculum-guided personalized subgraph federated learning framework that addresses rapid overfitting and collapsed client similarity in federated GNN training through difficulty-aware scheduling.

entry.title: Grounded Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Drafting of Radiology Impressions Using Case-Based Similarity Search

author.name: Himadri Samanta

entry.summary: Proposes a multimodal RAG system for drafting radiology impressions using contrastive image-text embeddings and citation-constrained generation to ensure factual grounding against historical reports.

entry.title: Enhancing Legal LLMs through Metadata-Enriched RAG Pipelines and Direct Preference Optimization

author.name: Suyash Maniyar, Deepali Singh, Rohith Reddy

entry.summary: Proposes metadata-enriched hybrid RAG with Direct Preference Optimization for legal LLMs, addressing retrieval errors from lexical redundancy and training models to refuse when context is insufficient.

entry.title: LARFT: Closing the Cognition-Action Gap for Length Instruction Following in Large Language Models

author.name: Wei Zhang, Lintong Du, Yuanhe Zhang, Zhenhong Zhou, Kun Wang, Li Sun, Sen Su

entry.summary: Proposes LARFT, a training framework combining length-oriented reinforcement learning with hindsight length awareness to improve LLMs' ability to follow length constraints in outputs.

entry.title: Generative Active Testing: Efficient LLM Evaluation via Proxy Task Adaptation

author.name: Aashish Anantha Ramakrishnan, Ardavan Saeedi, Hamid Reza Hassanzadeh, Fazlolah Mohaghegh, Dongwon Lee

entry.summary: Proposes Generative Active Testing (GAT), using LLMs as surrogates for efficient sample selection in benchmark development, adapting generative QA tasks into pseudo-classification for uncertainty-aware acquisition.

entry.title: BrainSCL: Subtype-Guided Contrastive Learning for Brain Disorder Diagnosis

author.name: Xiaolong Li, Guiliang Guo, Guangqi Wen, Peng Cao, Jinzhu Yang, Honglin Wu, Xiaoli Liu, Fei Wang, Osmar R. Zaiane

entry.summary: Proposes BrainSCL, a subtype-guided contrastive learning framework for brain disorder diagnosis that models patient heterogeneity as latent subtypes using multi-view representations from clinical text and BOLD signals, with dual-level attention for subtype-specific connectivity patterns.

entry.title: Memory-Driven Role-Playing: Evaluation and Enhancement of Persona Knowledge Utilization in LLMs

author.name: Kai Wang, Haoyang You, Yang Zhang, Zhongjie Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a Memory-Driven Role-Playing paradigm for LLMs inspired by Stanislavski's acting theory, with MREval benchmark assessing four memory abilities and MRPrompt architecture for enhancing persona consistency in long dialogues without explicit cues.

entry.title: A General Deep Learning Framework for Wireless Resource Allocation under Discrete Constraints

author.name: Yikun Wang, Yang Li, Yik-Chung Wu, and Rui Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a general deep learning framework for wireless resource allocation with discrete constraints, using support sets to represent discrete variables and learning joint probability distributions factorized into conditional probabilities.

entry.title: Beyond Weighted Summation: Learnable Nonlinear Aggregation Functions for Robust Artificial Neurons

author.name: Berke Deniz Bozyigit

entry.summary: Proposes learnable nonlinear aggregation functions to replace weighted summation in neurons, including F-Mean and Gaussian Support neurons, with hybrid neurons that interpolate between linear and nonlinear aggregation for robustness.

entry.title: Bridging Conformal Prediction and Scenario Optimization: Discarded Constraints and Modular Risk Allocation

author.name: Giuseppe C. Calafiore

entry.summary: Bridges conformal prediction and scenario optimization from a systems-and-control viewpoint, extending the connection to sample-and-discard algorithms and introducing a modular composition rule for combining separate conformal guarantees.

entry.title: LoFi: Location-Aware Fine-Grained Representation Learning for Chest X-ray

author.name: Myeongkyun Kang, Yanting Yang, Xiaoxiao Li

entry.summary: LoFi proposes location-aware fine-grained representation learning for chest X-rays by jointly optimizing sigmoid, captioning, and location-aware captioning losses with a lightweight LLM. This enables region-level supervision for grounding and dense captioning, improving retrieval and phrase grounding tasks in medical imaging.

entry.title: TRACE: Trajectory Recovery with State Propagation Diffusion for Urban Mobility

author.name: Jinming Wang, Hai Wang, Hongkai Wen, Geyong Min, Man Luo

entry.summary: TRACE introduces a diffusion model for GPS trajectory recovery that reconstructs dense trajectories from sparse inputs. Uses a State Propagation Diffusion Model with a memory mechanism for handling complex spatio-temporal patterns in urban mobility data.

entry.title: Depictions of Depression in Generative AI Video Models: A Preliminary Study of OpenAI's Sora 2

author.name: Matthew Flathers, Griffin Smith, Julian Herpertz, Zhitong Zhou, John Torous

entry.summary: Characterizes how OpenAI's Sora 2 depicts depression across consumer App and developer API access points, finding representational patterns and stereotypes in generated mental health content.

entry.title: PhyUnfold-Net: Advancing Remote Sensing Change Detection with Physics-Guided Deep Unfolding

author.name: Zelin Lei, Yaoxing Ren, and Jiaming Chang

entry.summary: PhyUnfold-Net formulates remote sensing change detection as physics-guided decomposition, using deep unfolding to separate genuine changes from illumination/seasonal pseudo-changes based on singular-value entropy priors.

entry.title: Accelerating Diffusion Decoders via Multi-Scale Sampling and One-Step Distillation

author.name: Chuhan Wang, Hao Chen

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage acceleration framework for diffusion-based image decoders: multi-scale sampling for coarse-to-fine reconstruction and one-step distillation for inference speedup.

entry.title: Evolving Embodied Intelligence: Graph Neural Network--Driven Co-Design of Morphology and Control in Soft Robotics

author.name: Jianqiang Wang, Shuaiqun Pan, Alvaro Serra-Gomez, Xiaohan Wei, Yue Xie

entry.summary: Uses graph attention networks for co-designing soft robot morphology and control, representing robots as graphs and addressing the challenge that morphological changes disrupt learned controllers.

entry.title: Beyond Quadratic: Linear-Time Change Detection with RWKV

author.name: Zhenyu Yang, Gensheng Pei, Tao Chen, Xia Yuan, Haofeng Zhang, Xiangbo Shu, Yazhou Yao

entry.summary: ChangeRWKV applies the RWKV framework to remote sensing change detection, combining parallelizable training with linear-time inference. Features hierarchical encoder and Spatial-Temporal Fusion Module for multi-scale alignment.

entry.title: FB-CLIP: Fine-Grained Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection with Foreground-Background Disentanglement

author.name: Ming Hu, Yongsheng Huo, Mingyu Dou, Jianfu Yin, Peng Zhao, Yao Wang, Cong Hu, Bingliang Hu, Quan Wang

entry.summary: FB-CLIP proposes a framework for zero-shot anomaly detection that disentangles foreground and background features in CLIP, using multi-strategy textual representations and multi-view soft separation. It targets industrial and medical applications where labeled anomalies are scarce.

entry.title: UniBioTransfer: A Unified Framework for Multiple Biometrics Transfer

author.name: Caiyi Sun, Yujing Sun, Xiangyu Li, Yuhang Zheng, Yiming Ren, Jiamin Wang, Yuexin Ma, Siu-Ming Yiu

entry.summary: UniBioTransfer is the first unified framework handling both conventional deepfake tasks (face transfer, reenactment) and shape-varying transformations (hair/head transfer) in a single model, addressing data scarcity through cross-task data augmentation.

entry.title: Unbiased Dynamic Multimodal Fusion

author.name: Shicai Wei, Kaijie Zhang, Luyi Chen, Tao He, Guiduo Duan

entry.summary: Proposes UDML framework for dynamic multimodal fusion that addresses modality quality measurement failures at extreme noise levels and corrects for intrinsic modality dependency bias that penalizes hard-to-learn modalities.

entry.title: EvoTaxo: Building and Evolving Taxonomy from Social Media Streams

author.name: Yiyang Li, Tianyi Ma, Yanfang Ye

entry.summary: EvoTaxo proposes an LLM-based framework for building and evolving taxonomies from temporally ordered social media streams, using structured draft actions, dual-view clustering, and refinement-arbitration for reliable taxonomy updates.

entry.title: Decoupled Sensitivity-Consistency Learning for Weakly Supervised Video Anomaly Detection

author.name: Hantao Zheng, Ning Han, Yawen Zeng, Hao Chen

entry.summary: Proposes DeSC, a decoupled framework for weakly supervised video anomaly detection that separates temporal sensitivity and semantic consistency into two specialized streams with distinct optimization strategies. This addresses the fundamental trade-off between detecting transient vs. sustained anomalies that limits unified frameworks.

entry.title: Gesture2Speech: How Far Can Hand Movements Shape Expressive Speech?

author.name: Lokesh Kumar, Nirmesh Shah, Ashishkumar P. Gudmalwar, Pankaj Wasnik

entry.summary: Proposes Gesture2Speech, a multimodal TTS framework that leverages hand gesture cues to modulate prosody in synthesized speech using a Mixture-of-Experts architecture for dynamic fusion of linguistic and gesture features.

entry.title: Span-Level Machine Translation Meta-Evaluation

author.name: Stefano Perrella, Eric Morales Agostinho, Hugo Zaragoza

entry.summary: Investigates span-level meta-evaluation methods for machine translation error detection, showing that seemingly similar precision/recall implementations yield substantially different rankings, and proposes improved metrics.

entry.title: Cov2Pose: Leveraging Spatial Covariance for Direct Manifold-aware 6-DoF Object Pose Estimation

author.name: Nassim Ali Ousalah, Peyman Rostami, Vincent Gaudilli\`ere, Emmanuel Koumandakis, Anis Kacem, Enjie Ghorbel, Djamila Aouada

entry.summary: Proposes Cov2Pose for 6-DoF object pose estimation using covariance-pooled representations that encode spatial second-order statistics as SPD matrices, with a novel pose encoder operating on the SO(3)×ℝ³ manifold.

entry.title: NEC-Diff: Noise-Robust Event-RAW Complementary Diffusion for Seeing Motion in Extreme Darkness

author.name: Haoyue Liu, Jinghan Xu, Luxin Feng, Hanyu Zhou, Haozhi Zhao, Yi Chang, Luxin Yan

entry.summary: Proposes NEC-Diff, a diffusion-based framework for extremely low-light imaging that combines event camera data with conventional camera (RAW) data, extracting reliable information from heavily noisy signals for dynamic scene reconstruction.

entry.title: Continual Learning as Shared-Manifold Continuation Under Compatible Shift

author.name: Henry J. Kobs

entry.summary: Proposes SPMA (Support-Preserving Manifold Assimilation), a geometric approach to continual learning that maintains a shared latent manifold rather than using standard regularization or replay. Evaluates on CIFAR10 and Tiny-ImageNet under compatible distribution shifts.

entry.title: MFil-Mamba: Multi-Filter Scanning for Spatial Redundancy-Aware Visual State Space Models

author.name: Puskal Khadka, KC Santosh

entry.summary: Proposes MFil-Mamba, a visual state space architecture that uses multi-filter scanning to reduce redundancy in Mamba's visual processing. Each scan captures unique spatial information rather than repeating traversal patterns over the same input.

entry.title: Chain-of-Adaptation: Surgical Vision-Language Adaptation with Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Jiajie Li, Chenhui Xu, Meihuan Liu, Jinjun Xiong

entry.summary: Proposes Chain-of-Adaptation (CoA), a framework using reinforcement learning to adapt vision-language models to surgical domains while preserving pretrained multimodal capabilities through structured reasoning formats.

entry.title: Improving Generalization on Cybersecurity Tasks with Multi-Modal Contrastive Learning

author.name: Jianan Huang and Rodolfo V. Valentim and Luca Vassio and Matteo Boffa and Marco Mellia and Idilio Drago and Dario Rossi

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage multi-modal contrastive learning framework for cybersecurity that transfers knowledge from text (vulnerability descriptions) to data-scarce modalities (payloads) for improved threat classification generalization.

entry.title: MeanFlow Meets Control: Scaling Sampled-Data Control for Swarms

author.name: Anqi Dong, Yongxin Chen, Karl H. Johansson, and Johan Karlsson

entry.summary: Introduces a control-space learning framework inspired by MeanFlow for steering large-scale swarms under sampled-data constraints. The learned object is a finite-horizon minimum-energy control coefficient with both integral and differential representations.

entry.title: LumosX: Relate Any Identities with Their Attributes for Personalized Video Generation

author.name: Jiazheng Xing, Fei Du, Hangjie Yuan, Pengwei Liu, Hongbin Xu, Hai Ci, Ruigang Niu, Weihua Chen, Fan Wang, Yong Liu

entry.summary: Proposes LumosX for personalized video generation with precise face-attribute alignment across multiple subjects. Uses a tailored data collection pipeline and MLLM-inferred subject-specific relational priors for consistency.

entry.title: GravCal: Single-Image Calibration of IMU Gravity Priors with Per-Sample Confidence

author.name: Haichao Zhu and Qian Zhang

entry.summary: GravCal is a feedforward model that corrects noisy IMU gravity priors using a single RGB image, outputting both a corrected gravity direction and per-sample confidence score by combining residual correction with prior-independent estimation.

entry.title: 3D Gaussian Splatting with Self-Constrained Priors for High Fidelity Surface Reconstruction

author.name: Takeshi Noda and Yu-Shen Liu and Zhizhong Han

entry.summary: Proposes self-constrained priors derived from TSDF grids for 3D Gaussian Splatting to improve surface reconstruction quality by constraining Gaussians to lie near estimated surfaces.

entry.title: Beyond detection: cooperative multi-agent reasoning for rapid onboard EO crisis response

author.name: Alejandro D. Mousist, Pedro Delgado de Robles Mart\'in, Raquel Lladr\'o Climent, Julian Cobos Aparicio

entry.summary: Proposes a hierarchical multi-agent architecture for onboard Earth Observation processing enabling rapid crisis detection on satellites under strict resource and bandwidth constraints, with early warning and detailed analysis agents.

entry.title: Demonstration of Adapt4Me: An Uncertainty-Aware Authoring Environment for Personalizing Automatic Speech Recognition to Non-normative Speech

author.name: Niclas Pokel, Yiming Zhao, Pehu\'en Moure, Yingqiang Gao, Roman B\"ohringer

entry.summary: Proposes Adapt4Me, a web-based decentralized platform for personalizing ASR to non-normative speech using Bayesian active learning and VI-LoRA, enabling end users to personalize models without expert supervision.

entry.title: Hyper-Connections for Adaptive Multi-Modal MRI Brain Tumor Segmentation

author.name: Lokendra Kumar, Shubham Aggarwal

entry.summary: First study of Hyper-Connections as drop-in replacement for residual connections across five architectures for brain tumor segmentation, showing consistent improvements on BraTS 2021 with negligible parameter overhead.

entry.title: FalconBC: Flow matching for Amortized inference of Latent-CONditioned physiologic Boundary Conditions

author.name: Chloe H. Choi, Alison L. Marsden, Daniele E. Schiavazzi

entry.summary: Introduces FalconBC, a flow-matching-based amortized inference framework for estimating boundary conditions in patient-specific cardiovascular modeling. Handles open-loop models and vascular lesions where prior methods fail.

entry.title: Model Selection and Parameter Estimation of Multi-dimensional Gaussian Mixture Model

author.name: Xinyu Liu and Hai Zhang

entry.summary: Studies model selection and parameter estimation for multi-dimensional GMMs, establishing information-theoretic lower bounds on sample complexity and proposing a thresholding-based spectral estimation algorithm.

entry.title: Uncertainty Quantification Via the Posterior Predictive Variance

author.name: Sanjay Chaudhuri and Dean Dustin and Bertrand Clarke

entry.summary: Uses the law of total variance to generate multiple decompositions of the posterior predictive variance, enabling quantification and attribution of different sources of predictive uncertainty.

entry.title: Divide-and-Conquer Decoupled Network for Cross-Domain Few-Shot Segmentation

author.name: Runmin Cong, Anpeng Wang, Bin Wan, Cong Zhang, Xiaofei Zhou, Wei Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes DCDNet for cross-domain few-shot segmentation that decouples backbone features into category-relevant and domain-relevant representations via adversarial-contrastive decomposition.

entry.title: AIFloodSense: A Global Aerial Imagery Dataset for Semantic Segmentation and Understanding of Flooded Environments

author.name: Georgios Simantiris, Konstantinos Bacharidis, Apostolos Papanikolaou, Petros Giannakakis, Costas Panagiotakis

entry.summary: Introduces AIFloodSense, a globally diverse aerial imagery dataset of 470 high-resolution images from 230 flood events across 64 countries, supporting classification, segmentation, and counting tasks.

entry.title: Spatio-Temporal Attention for Consistent Video Semantic Segmentation in Automated Driving

author.name: Serin Varghese, Kevin Ross, Fabian Hueger, Kira Maag

entry.summary: Proposes Spatio-Temporal Attention (STA) mechanism extending transformer attention to incorporate multi-frame context for video semantic segmentation in automated driving, with minimal architectural changes.

entry.title: DanceHA: A Multi-Agent Framework for Document-Level Aspect-Based Sentiment Analysis

author.name: Lei Wang, Min Huang, Eduard Dragut

entry.summary: Introduces DanceHA, a multi-agent framework for document-level aspect-based sentiment analysis using divide-and-conquer strategy for long-context ABSIA, with a human-AI collaborative annotation component.

entry.title: Autonoma: A Hierarchical Multi-Agent Framework for End-to-End Workflow Automation

author.name: Eslam Reda, Maged Yasser, and Sara El-Metwally

entry.summary: Introduces Autonoma, a hierarchical multi-agent framework for workflow automation with Coordinator, Planner, and Supervisor tiers orchestrating specialized agents for web browsing, coding, and file management.

entry.title: From Flat to Structural: Enhancing Automated Short Answer Grading with GraphRAG

author.name: Yucheng Chu, Haoyu Han, Shen Dong, Hang Li, Kaiqi Yang, Yasemin Copur-Gencturk, Joseph Krajcik, Namsoo Shin, Hui Liu

entry.summary: Applies GraphRAG (Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation) using Microsoft's framework to automated short answer grading in education, organizing reference materials into a knowledge graph to capture structural concept dependencies for better rubric adherence and multi-hop reasoning.

entry.title: Multilingual Hate Speech Detection and Counterspeech Generation: A Comprehensive Survey and Practical Guide

author.name: Zahra Safdari Fesaghandis and Suman Kalyan Maity

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey of multilingual hate speech detection and counterspeech generation, analyzing why monolingual systems fail in non-English and code-mixed contexts. Proposes a three-phase framework covering task design, data curation, and evaluation.

entry.title: Exploring Subnetwork Interactions in Heterogeneous Brain Network via Prior-Informed Graph Learning

author.name: Siyu Liu and Guangqi Wen and Peng Cao and Jinzhu Yang and Xiaoli Liu and Fei Wang and Osmar R. Zaiane

entry.summary: Proposes KD-Brain, a prior-informed graph learning framework for modeling brain subnetwork interactions in mental disorder diagnosis, using semantic-conditioned interaction mechanisms and pathology-consistent constraints to guide learning with limited training samples.

entry.title: Prompt-tuning with Attribute Guidance for Low-resource Entity Matching

author.name: Lihui Liu, Carl Yang

entry.summary: Introduces PROMPTATTRIB, a prompt-tuning approach for entity matching in low-resource settings that incorporates attribute-level guidance for more fine-grained and interpretable matching decisions beyond entity-level comparison.

entry.title: PAI: Fast, Accurate, and Full Benchmark Performance Projection with AI

author.name: Avery Johnson, Mohammad Majharul Islam, Riad Akram, Abdullah Muzahid

entry.summary: Presents PAI, a technique for predicting full benchmark performance of hardware designs using AI, addressing the slowness of traditional cycle-accurate simulators. Claims to be the first to accurately predict full benchmark performance, not just sampled portions.

entry.title: A Novel Solution for Zero-Day Attack Detection in IDS using Self-Attention and Jensen-Shannon Divergence in WGAN-GP

author.name: Ziyu Mu, Xiyu Shi and Safak Dogan

entry.summary: Proposes SA-WGAN-GP and JS-WGAN-GP for synthesizing network traffic mimicking zero-day attack patterns to improve intrusion detection systems, adding self-attention for cross-feature dependencies and Jensen-Shannon divergence for training stability.

entry.title: Factored Levenberg-Marquardt for Diffeomorphic Image Registration: An efficient optimizer for FireANTs

author.name: Rohit Jena, Pratik Chaudhari, James C. Gee

entry.summary: Proposes a factored Levenberg-Marquardt optimizer for diffeomorphic image registration that reduces memory by up to 24.6% for large volumes compared to Adam, using only a single scalar damping parameter with adaptive trust region tuning.

entry.title: Real-Time Optical Communication Using Event-Based Vision with Moving Transmitters

author.name: Harmeet Dhillon, Pranay Katyal, Brendan Long, Rohan Walia, Matthew Cleaveland, Kevin Leahy

entry.summary: Develops an optical communication system using event cameras for multi-robot systems, achieving 95%+ decoding accuracy during motion. Uses a Geometry-Aware Unscented Kalman Filter for tracking moving transmitters and decoding messages in real time.

entry.title: Teaching an Agent to Sketch One Part at a Time

author.name: Xiaodan Du, Ruize Xu, David Yunis, Yael Vinker, Greg Shakhnarovich

entry.summary: Develops a method for generating vector sketches one part at a time using a multi-modal language model agent trained with process-reward RL. Introduces ControlSketch-Part dataset with rich part-level annotations obtained via automated annotation pipeline.

entry.title: ItinBench: Benchmarking Planning Across Multiple Cognitive Dimensions with Large Language Models

author.name: Tianlong Wang, Pinqiao Wang, Weili Shi, Sheng li

entry.summary: ItinBench evaluates LLMs on travel itinerary planning incorporating spatial reasoning (route optimization) alongside verbal reasoning tasks, testing multiple cognitive dimensions in a real-world planning context.

entry.title: Pedestrian Crossing Intent Prediction via Psychological Features and Transformer Fusion

author.name: Sima Ashayer, Hoang H. Nguyen, Yu Liang, Mina Sartipi

entry.summary: Proposes a lightweight pedestrian crossing intent prediction architecture fusing behavioral streams with highway encoders and compact Transformer, including variational and Mahalanobis uncertainty quantification. Outperforms vision-language models on PSI 1.0 benchmark.

entry.title: Subspace Kernel Learning on Tensor Sequences

author.name: Lei Wang, Xi Ding, Yongsheng Gao, Piotr Koniusz

entry.summary: Introduces Uncertainty-driven Kernel Tensor Learning (UKTL) for multi-way tensor data, using mode-wise subspace comparisons with uncertainty-aware weighting and scalable Nyström linearization.

entry.title: Dual-Domain Representation Alignment: Bridging 2D and 3D Vision via Geometry-Aware Architecture Search

author.name: Haoyu Zhang, Zhihao Yu, Rui Wang, Yaochu Jin, Qiqi Liu and Ran Cheng

entry.summary: EvoNAS proposes an evolutionary neural architecture search framework with a hybrid VSS-ViT supernet and cross-architecture knowledge distillation for efficient 2D-3D vision models on edge devices.

entry.title: PA2D-MORL: Pareto Ascent Directional Decomposition based Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Tianmeng Hu, Biao Luo

entry.summary: PA2D-MORL proposes a multi-objective RL method using Pareto ascent direction decomposition for better approximation of the Pareto policy set in continuous/high-dimensional action spaces.

entry.title: LoD-Loc v3: Generalized Aerial Localization in Dense Cities using Instance Silhouette Alignment

author.name: Shuaibang Peng, Juelin Zhu, Xia Li, Kun Yang, Maojun Zhang, Yu Liu, and Shen Yan

entry.summary: LoD-Loc v3 addresses aerial visual localization in dense urban environments using instance-level building silhouette alignment with low-detail city models. It introduces InsLoD-Loc, the largest instance segmentation dataset for aerial imagery (100k images), and achieves zero-shot generalization.

entry.title: On Performance Guarantees for Federated Learning with Personalized Constraints

author.name: Mohammadjavad Ebrahimi, Daniel Burbano, and Farzad Yousefian

entry.summary: Proposes PC-FedAvg for federated learning with personalized (agent-specific) constraints, where each agent maintains cross-estimates of other agents' variables. Provides convergence analysis for convex and strongly convex objectives.

entry.title: Accurate Open-Loop Control of a Soft Continuum Robot Through Visually Learned Latent Representations

author.name: Henrik Krauss, Johann Licher, Naoya Takeishi, Annika Raatz, Takehisa Yairi

entry.summary: Addresses open-loop control of soft continuum robots using video-learned latent dynamics, comparing Koopman, MLP, and oscillator dynamics models with attention broadcast decoders for latent-space trajectory tracking.

entry.title: Toward High-Fidelity Visual Reconstruction: From EEG-Based Conditioned Generation to Joint-Modal Guided Rebuilding

author.name: Zhijian Gong, Tianren Yao, Wenjia Dong, Xueyuan Xu

entry.summary: JMVR proposes a framework for visual reconstruction from EEG signals that treats EEG and text as independent modalities rather than forcing EEG alignment to text/image embeddings, aiming for higher-fidelity reconstruction of spatial and chromatic details.

entry.title: Vision-Language Attribute Disentanglement and Reinforcement for Lifelong Person Re-Identification

author.name: Kunlun Xu and Haotong Cheng and Jiangmeng Li and Xu Zou and Jiahuan Zhou

entry.summary: VLADR introduces vision-language attribute disentanglement for lifelong person re-identification, explicitly modeling shared human attributes across domains using VLMs to improve both learning acquisition and anti-forgetting capacity.

entry.title: Learning Hierarchical Orthogonal Prototypes for Generalized Few-Shot 3D Point Cloud Segmentation

author.name: Yifei Zhao, Fanyu Zhao, Zhongyuan Zhang, Shengtang Wu, Yixuan Lin, Yinsheng Li

entry.summary: Presents HOP3D for generalized few-shot 3D point cloud segmentation using hierarchical orthogonal prototypes with entropy-based regularization to balance novel-class adaptation with base-class retention. Addresses the stability-plasticity trade-off in 3D segmentation.

entry.title: Multi-Agent Motion Planning on Industrial Magnetic Levitation Platforms: A Hybrid ADMM-HOCBF approach

author.name: Bavo Tistaert, Stan Servaes, Alejandro Gonzalez-Garcia, Ibrahim Ibrahim, Louis Callens, Jan Swevers, Wilm Decr\'e

entry.summary: Presents a hybrid motion planning method combining decentralized ADMM with centralized high-order control barrier functions for multi-agent systems on magnetic levitation platforms, validated on real hardware.

entry.title: Modeling subgrid scale production rates on complex meshes using graph neural networks

author.name: Priyabrat Dash, Mathis Bode, Konduri Aditya

entry.summary: Develops a graph neural network for predicting filtered species production rates in large-eddy simulations of turbulent combustion on non-uniform meshes, showing generalization across different hydrogen-methane fuel compositions.

entry.title: LIORNet: Self-Supervised LiDAR Snow Removal Framework for Autonomous Driving under Adverse Weather Conditions

author.name: Ji-il Park, Inwook Shim

entry.summary: Proposes LIORNet, a self-supervised framework for removing snow noise from LiDAR point clouds in autonomous driving, avoiding the need for labeled clean/noisy point cloud pairs.

entry.title: Structural Controllability of Large-Scale Hypergraphs

author.name: Joshua Pickard, Xin Mao, and Can Chen

entry.summary: Develops a structural controllability framework for hypergraphs by modeling dynamics as polynomial dynamical systems, extending classical accessibility and dilation concepts from linear graph-based systems.

entry.title: Promoting Critical Thinking With Domain-Specific Generative AI Provocations

author.name: Thomas \c{S}erban von Davier, Hao-Ping Lee, Jodi Forlizzi, Sauvik Das

entry.summary: Reflects on designing GenAI-powered tools (ArtBot and Privy) that use domain-specific provocations to promote critical thinking, finding that productive friction and user-dependent interactions meaningfully support critical engagement.

entry.title: Evaluating Test-Time Adaptation For Facial Expression Recognition Under Natural Cross-Dataset Distribution Shifts

author.name: John Turnbull, Shivam Grover, Amin Jalali, Ali Etemad

entry.summary: First evaluation of test-time adaptation methods for facial expression recognition under natural cross-dataset distribution shifts, showing TTA can boost performance by up to 11.34% with method effectiveness varying by shift type.

entry.title: CFCML: A Coarse-to-Fine Crossmodal Learning Framework For Disease Diagnosis Using Multimodal Images and Tabular Data

author.name: Tianling Liu and Hongying Liu and Fanhua Shang and Lequan Yu and Tong Han and Liang Wan

entry.summary: Proposes CFCML, a coarse-to-fine framework for cross-modal learning between medical images and tabular data for disease diagnosis. Progressively reduces the modality gap by exploring inter-modal relationships at multiple levels.

entry.title: Structured Latent Dynamics in Wireless CSI via Homomorphic World Models

author.name: Salmane Naoumi, Mehdi Bennis, and Marwa Chafii

entry.summary: Introduces a self-supervised framework for learning predictive wireless channel representations using JEPA and Lie algebra-based homomorphic transitions. Models CSI temporal evolution in a structured latent space that captures spatial layout and user motion.

entry.title: HortiMulti: A Multi-Sensor Dataset for Localisation and Mapping in Horticultural Polytunnels

author.name: Shuoyuan Xu, Zhipeng Zhong, Tiago Barros, Matthew Coombes, Cristiano Premebida, Hao Wu, and Cunjia Liu

entry.summary: Presents HortiMulti, a multi-sensor, cross-season dataset collected in commercial strawberry and raspberry polytunnels for agricultural robot localization and mapping. Captures challenging conditions including specular reflections, dynamic foliage, and GNSS-unreliable environments.

entry.title: The Robot's Inner Critic: Self-Refinement of Social Behaviors through VLM-based Replanning

author.name: Jiyu Lim, Youngwoo Yoon, and Kwanghyun Park

entry.title: MuSteerNet: Human Reaction Generation from Videos via Observation-Reaction Mutual Steering

author.name: Yuan Zhou, Yongzhi Li, Yanqi Dai, Xingyu Zhu, Yi Tan, Qingshan Xu, Beier Zhu, Richang Hong, Hanwang Zhang

entry.title: Preference-Guided Debiasing for No-Reference Enhancement Image Quality Assessment

author.name: Shiqi Gao, Kang Fu, Zitong Xu, Huiyu Duan, Xiongkuo Min, Jia Wang, Guangtao Zhai

entry.summary: Proposes a preference-guided debiasing framework for no-reference enhanced image quality assessment that learns an enhancement-preference embedding space and removes enhancement-induced biases from quality representations.

entry.title: CS-MUNet: A Channel-Spatial Dual-Stream Mamba Network for Multi-Organ Segmentation

author.name: Yuyang Zheng, Mingda Zhang, Jianglong Qin, Qi Mo, Jingdan Pan, Haozhe Hu, Hongyi Huang

entry.summary: CS-MUNet proposes a Mamba-based network for multi-organ segmentation with boundary-aware state modulation via Bayesian attention and channel-dimension Mamba state aggregation for cross-channel anatomical collaboration.

entry.title: Quantifying Gate Contribution in Quantum Feature Maps for Scalable Circuit Optimization

entry.title: Infinite-dimensional spherical-radial decomposition for probabilistic functions, with application to constrained optimal control and Gaussian process regression

author.name: Kewei Wang, Georg Stadler

entry.title: Radar-Inertial Odometry with Online Spatio-Temporal Calibration via Continuous-Time IMU Modeling

entry.title: Model-Driven Learning-Based Physical Layer Authentication for Mobile Wi-Fi Devices

author.name: Yijia Guo, Junqing Zhang, Yao-Win Peter Hong, Stefano Tomasin

author.name: Yu Wang, Olcay T\"urk, Angela Grimminger, Hendrik Buschmeier

entry.title: A comprehensive study of LLM-based argument classification: from Llama through DeepSeek to GPT-5.2

author.name: Amin Amouhadi

author.name: Yuchen Du, Ashley Li, Zixi Huang

entry.title: FedAgain: A Trust-Based and Robust Federated Learning Strategy for an Automated Kidney Stone Identification in Ureteroscopy

entry.title: ARMOR: Adaptive Resilience Against Model Poisoning Attacks in Continual Federated Learning for Mobile Indoor Localization

author.name: Danish Gufran, Akhil Singampalli, Sudeep Pasricha

entry.summary: ARMOR addresses model poisoning attacks in continual federated learning for indoor localization, using adaptive resilience mechanisms to maintain global model quality under adversarial conditions.

entry.title: Disentangle-then-Align: Non-Iterative Hybrid Multimodal Image Registration via Cross-Scale Feature Disentanglement

entry.title: Learning from Similarity/Dissimilarity and Pairwise Comparison

entry.title: Integrating Meta-Features with Knowledge Graph Embeddings for Meta-Learning

entry.summary: Proposes integrating knowledge graph embeddings with dataset meta-features for meta-learning tasks including pipeline performance estimation and dataset similarity estimation, leveraging past experimental results and pipeline metadata.

entry.title: GustPilot: A Hierarchical DRL-INDI Framework for Wind-Resilient Quadrotor Navigation

author.name: Amir Atef Habel, Roohan Ahmed Khan, Fawad Mehboob, Clement Fortin, and Dzmitry Tsetserukou

entry.title: Revisiting Gene Ontology Knowledge Discovery with Hierarchical Feature Selection and Virtual Study Group of AI Agents

entry.title: You're absolutely right, Senator. I was being naive about the political reality.

author.name: Chris Datcu

entry.summary: The author argues that LLMs create a dangerous feedback loop: they compress human complexity into simplified models, then humans (particularly in governance) adopt AI-generated outputs as their own positions, further compressing nuanced thinking. The post frames this as a systemic risk where human values and reasoning are being flattened through iterative AI-human interaction loops.

entry.title: Regularity of Solutions to Beckmann's Parametric Optimal Transport

Validated on quadrotor trajectory generation with improved feasibility at higher noise levels.
