entry.summary: Proposes REAL, a reinforcement learning framework for LLM-as-a-Judge that incorporates regression-aware rewards recognizing ordinal structure in numeric scores. Bridges the gap between binary RL rewards and ordinal regression tasks.

entry.title: Deploying Semantic ID-based Generative Retrieval for Large-Scale Podcast Discovery at Spotify

author.name: Edoardo D'Amico, Marco De Nadai, Praveen Chandar, Divita Vohra, Shawn Lin, Max Lefarov, Paul Gigioli, Gustavo Penha, Ilya Kopysitsky, Ivo Joel Senese, Darren Mei, Francesco Fabbri, Oguz Semerci, Yu Zhao, Vincent Tang, Brian St. Thomas, Alexandra Ranieri, Matthew N. K. Smith, Aaron Bernkopf, Bryan Leung, Ghazal Fazelnia, Mark VanMiddlesworth, Timothy Christopher Heath, Petter Pehrson Skiden, Alice Y. Wang, Doug J. Cole, Andreas Damianou, Maya Hristakeva, Reid Wilbur, Tarun Chillara, Vladan Radosavljevic, Pooja Chitkara, Sainath Adapa, Juan Elenter, Bernd Huber, Jacqueline Wood, Saaketh Vedantam, Jan Stypka, Sandeep Ghael, Martin D. Gould, David Murgatroyd, Yves Raimond, Mounia Lalmas, Paul N. Bennett

entry.summary: Details Spotify's deployment of semantic ID-based generative retrieval for large-scale podcast discovery, using LLMs with semantic IDs to handle both familiarity and exploration in podcast recommendations at production scale.

entry.title: Capability-Guided Compression: Toward Interpretability-Aware Budget Allocation for Large Language Models

author.name: Rishaank Gupta

entry.summary: Proposes Capability-Guided Compression (CGC), using SAE-derived capability density maps to allocate compression budgets intelligently. Argues that 'capability-blind' compression causes phase transitions and reasoning loss invisible to perplexity metrics.

entry.title: CUBE: A Standard for Unifying Agent Benchmarks

author.name: Alexandre Lacoste, Nicolas Gontier, Oleh Shliazhko, Aman Jaiswal, Kusha Sareen, Shailesh Nanisetty, Joan Cabezas, Manuel Del Verme, Omar G. Younis, Simone Baratta, Matteo Avalle, Imene Kerboua, Xing Han L\`u, Elron Bandel, Michal Shmueli-Scheuer, Asaf Yehudai, Leshem Choshen, Jonathan Lebensold, Sean Hughes, Massimo Caccia, Alexandre Drouin, Siva Reddy, Tao Yu, Yu Su, Graham Neubig, Dawn Song

entry.summary: Proposes CUBE, a universal protocol standard built on MCP and Gym for unifying agent benchmarks, separating task, benchmark, package, and registry concerns to eliminate per-benchmark integration overhead.

entry.title: Breaking the Chain: A Causal Analysis of LLM Faithfulness to Intermediate Structures

author.name: Oleg Somov, Mikhail Chaichuk, Mikhail Seleznyov, Alexander Panchenko, Elena Tutubalina

entry.summary: Introduces a causal evaluation protocol for LLM faithfulness to intermediate reasoning structures, finding models fail to update predictions after intervention in up to 60% of cases, revealing fragile apparent faithfulness.

entry.title: Beyond Reward Suppression: Reshaping Steganographic Communication Protocols in MARL via Dynamic Representational Circuit Breaking

author.name: Liu Hung Ming

entry.summary: Introduces Dynamic Representational Circuit Breaker (DRCB), an architectural defense against steganographic collusion in multi-agent RL where agents develop private communication protocols to evade monitoring. Uses VQ-VAE bottleneck to make messages auditable.

entry.title: State-Dependent Safety Failures in Multi-Turn Language Model Interaction

author.name: Pengcheng Li, Jie Zhang, Tianwei Zhang, Han Qiu, Zhang kejun, Weiming Zhang, Nenghai Yu, Wenbo Zhou

entry.summary: Studies multi-turn safety failures in LLMs from a state-space perspective, introducing STAR framework that treats dialogue history as a state transition operator to analyze how conversational context evolution leads to safety failures.

entry.title: MiroThinker-1.7 & H1: Towards Heavy-Duty Research Agents via Verification

author.name: MiroMind Team, S. Bai, L. Bing, L. Lei, R. Li, X. Li, X. Lin, E. Min, L. Su, B. Wang, L. Wang, L. Wang, S. Wang, X. Wang, Y. Zhang, Z. Zhang, G. Chen, L. Chen, Z. Cheng, Y. Deng, Z. Huang, D. Ng, J. Ni, Q. Ren, X. Tang, B. L. Wang, H. Wang, N. Wang, C. Wei, Q. Wu, J. Xia, Y. Xiao, H. Xu, X. Xu, C. Xue, Z. Yang, Z. Yang, F. Ye, H. Ye, J. Yu, C. Zhang, W. Zhang, H. Zhao, P. Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces MiroThinker-1.7 and H1, research agents for complex long-horizon reasoning with verification integrated at local and global levels. Achieves strong results on research benchmarks through agentic mid-training with structured planning.

entry.title: Understanding Moral Reasoning Trajectories in Large Language Models: Toward Probing-Based Explainability

author.name: Fan Huang, Haewoon Kwak, Jisun An

entry.summary: Introduces 'moral reasoning trajectories' to analyze how LLMs invoke and switch between ethical frameworks across reasoning steps. Finds that 55-58% of consecutive steps involve framework switches, and unstable trajectories are 1.29x more susceptible to persuasive attacks. Uses linear probes to localize framework-specific representations.

entry.title: SWE-QA-Pro: A Representative Benchmark and Scalable Training Recipe for Repository-Level Code Understanding

author.name: Songcheng Cai, Zhiheng Lyu, Yuansheng Ni, Xiangchao Chen, Baichuan Zhou, Shenzhe Zhu, Yi Lu, Haozhe Wang, Chi Ruan, Benjamin Schneider, Weixu Zhang, Xiang Li, Andy Zheng, Yuyu Zhang, Ping Nie, Wenhu Chen

entry.summary: Introduces SWE-QA-Pro, a benchmark for repository-level code understanding from diverse long-tail repositories with executable environments, enforcing topical balance and difficulty calibration where agentic workflows significantly outperform direct answering.

entry.title: Malicious Or Not: Adding Repository Context to Agent Skill Classification

author.name: Florian Holzbauer, David Schmidt, Gabriel Gegenhuber, Sebastian Schrittwieser, Johanna Ullrich

entry.summary: Presents the largest empirical security analysis of AI agent skill ecosystems (238K skills from major platforms), questioning prior claims that up to 46.8% of skills are malicious by incorporating repository context into classification. This is timely given the rapid growth of agent skill marketplaces.

entry.title: Kestrel: Grounding Self-Refinement for LVLM Hallucination Mitigation

author.name: Jiawei Mao, Hardy Chen, Haoqin Tu, Yuhan Wang, Letian Zhang, Zeyu Zheng, Huaxiu Yao, Zirui Wang, Cihang Xie, Yuyin Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes Kestrel, a training-free framework for mitigating LVLM hallucinations by combining visual grounding agents with evidence-verified self-refinement. Converts tool outputs into structured textual evidence for verification.

entry.title: DexGrasp-Zero: A Morphology-Aligned Policy for Zero-Shot Cross-Embodiment Dexterous Grasping

author.name: Yuliang Wu, Yanhan Lin, WengKit Lao, Yuhao Lin, Yi-Lin Wei, Wei-Shi Zheng, Ancong Wu

entry.summary: Proposes DexGrasp-Zero, a policy for zero-shot cross-embodiment dexterous grasping that uses a morphology-aligned graph representation. Enables transfer to unseen hand designs without retraining.

entry.title: HoloByte: Continuous Hyperspherical Distillation for Tokenizer-Free Modeling

author.name: Vladimer Khasia

entry.summary: Introduces HoloByte, a tokenizer-free framework using Continuous Hyperspherical Distillation that projects byte sequences into a hyperspherical manifold via invertible orthogonal rotations. Aims to eliminate subword tokenization while maintaining computational tractability.

entry.title: Attention Sinks Induce Gradient Sinks

author.name: Yihong Chen, Quanming Yao

entry.summary: Shows that attention sinks in Transformers induce gradient concentration ('gradient sinks') during backpropagation, and that massive activations in pre-norm architectures are an adaptive response. Introduces V-scale modification to test the hypothesis.

entry.title: From Drop-off to Recovery: A Mechanistic Analysis of Segmentation in MLLMs

author.name: Boyong Wu, Sanghwan Kim, Zeynep Akata

entry.summary: Investigates how multimodal LLMs handle segmentation through layerwise probing, finding that adapters cause a segmentation 'drop-off' that LLM layers progressively recover through attention-mediated refinement. Proposes bidirectional attention to improve spatial consistency.

entry.title: ChopGrad: Pixel-Wise Losses for Latent Video Diffusion via Truncated Backpropagation

author.name: Dmitriy Rivkin, Parker Ewen, Lili Gao, Julian Ost, Stefanie Walz, Rasika Kangutkar, Mario Bijelic, Felix Heide

entry.summary: Introduces ChopGrad, a truncated backpropagation scheme for video diffusion models that limits gradient computation to local frame windows while maintaining global consistency, enabling pixel-wise loss fine-tuning for long/high-res videos.

entry.title: Mediocrity is the key for LLM as a Judge Anchor Selection

author.name: Shachar Don-Yehiya, Asaf Yehudai, Leshem Choshen, Omri Abend

entry.summary: Systematically investigates anchor selection in LLM-as-a-Judge benchmarks, finding that mediocre-performing models make the best anchors while top/bottom models are poor choices. Tests 22 anchors on Arena-Hard-v2.0.

entry.title: Offline Exploration-Aware Fine-Tuning for Long-Chain Mathematical Reasoning

author.name: Yongyu Mu, Jiali Zeng, Fandong Meng, JingBo Zhu, Tong Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes Offline eXploration-Aware (OXA) fine-tuning that improves the SFT initialization for RLVR by promoting low-confidence verified data and suppressing high-confidence incorrect trajectories, improving subsequent RL exploration for mathematical reasoning.

entry.title: Understanding and Defending VLM Jailbreaks via Jailbreak-Related Representation Shift

author.name: Zhihua Wei, Qiang Li, Jian Ruan, Zhenxin Qin, Leilei Wen, Dongrui Liu, Wen Shen

entry.summary: Investigates VLM jailbreaks through representation analysis, finding that visual modality shifts representations toward a specific 'jailbreak state' rather than failing to recognize harmful intent. Proposes a quantitative framework and defense mechanism based on representation shift.

entry.title: Pretrained Multilingual Transformers Reveal Quantitative Distance Between Human Languages

author.name: Yue Zhao, Jiatao Gu, Paloma Jereti\v{c}, Weijie Su

entry.summary: Introduces Attention Transport Distance (ATD), a method that uses attention mechanisms from pretrained multilingual transformers to quantitatively measure distances between human languages. This provides a tokenization-agnostic, scalable approach to measuring cross-linguistic distance, bridging computational linguistics with anthropology and evolutionary history.

entry.title: MOSAIC: Composable Safety Alignment with Modular Control Tokens

author.name: Jingyu Peng, Hongyu Chen, Jiancheng Dong, Maolin Wang, Wenxi Li, Yuchen Li, Kai Zhang, Xiangyu Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes MOSAIC, a modular framework for compositional safety alignment using learnable control tokens over a frozen LLM backbone, where each token represents a safety constraint that can be flexibly activated and composed at inference.

entry.title: Don't Trust Stubborn Neighbors: A Security Framework for Agentic Networks

author.name: Samira Abedini, Sina Mavali, Lea Sch\"onherr, Martin Pawelczyk, Rebekka Burkholz

entry.summary: Proposes a theoretical framework for studying security of LLM multi-agent systems using the Friedkin-Johnsen opinion formation model from social sciences, showing it closely captures LLM-MAS behavior under manipulation.

entry.title: Evaluating Agentic Optimization on Large Codebases

author.name: Atharva Sehgal, James Hou, Akanksha Sarkar, Ishaan Mantripragada, Swarat Chaudhuri, Jennifer J. Sun, Yisong Yue

entry.summary: Introduces FormulaCode, a benchmark for evaluating agentic optimization on large real-world codebases with 957 performance bottlenecks from scientific Python repositories, paired with expert patches and performance workloads.

entry.title: Functorial Neural Architectures from Higher Inductive Types

author.name: Karen Sargsyan

entry.summary: Proposes that compositional generalization failure in neural networks is architectural, proving it's equivalent to functoriality of the decoder. Compiles Higher Inductive Type specifications into neural architectures via monoidal functors from path groupoids to parametric maps.

entry.title: Grounding the Score: Explicit Visual Premise Verification for Reliable Vision-Language Process Reward Models

author.name: Junxin Wang, Dai Guan, Weijie Qiu, Zhihang Li, Yongbo Gai, Zhengyi Yang, Mengyu Zhou, Erchao Zhao, Xiaoxi Jiang, Guanjun Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces Explicit Visual Premise Verification (EVPV) for Vision-Language Process Reward Models, conditioning step scoring on the reliability of visual premises to disentangle perception errors from reasoning errors. Reduces both false positives (rewarding hallucinations) and false negatives.

entry.title: Omanic: Towards Step-wise Evaluation of Multi-hop Reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Xiaojie Gu, Sherry T. Tong, Aosong Feng, Sophia Simeng Han, Jinghui Lu, Yingjian Chen, Yusuke Iwasawa, Yutaka Matsuo, Chanjun Park, Rex Ying, Irene Li

entry.summary: Introduces Omanic, a multi-hop QA benchmark with step-level decomposed sub-questions and intermediate answers for diagnosing LLM reasoning failures. Contains 10K synthetic training examples and 967 expert-annotated evaluation examples.

entry.title: MetaClaw: Just Talk -- An Agent That Meta-Learns and Evolves in the Wild

author.name: Peng Xia, Jianwen Chen, Xinyu Yang, Haoqin Tu, Jiaqi Liu, Kaiwen Xiong, Siwei Han, Shi Qiu, Haonian Ji, Yuyin Zhou, Zeyu Zheng, Cihang Xie, Huaxiu Yao

entry.summary: Presents MetaClaw, a continual meta-learning framework for LLM agents that jointly evolves base policy and reusable behavioral skills. Designed for platforms like OpenClaw handling diverse workloads across 20+ channels.

entry.title: A Unified Language Model for Large Scale Search, Recommendation, and Reasoning

author.name: Marco De Nadai, Edoardo D'Amico, Max Lefarov, Alexandre Tamborrino, Divita Vohra, Mark VanMiddlesworth, Shawn Lin, Jacqueline Wood, Jan Stypka, Eliza Klyce, Keshi Dai, Timothy Christopher Heath, Martin D. Gould, Yves Raimond, Sandeep Ghael, Tony Jebara, Andreas Damianou, Vladan Radosavljevic, Paul N. Bennett, Mounia Lalmas, Praveen Chandar

entry.summary: Describes a unified LLM approach for jointly handling search, recommendation, and reasoning over large heterogeneous catalogs, addressing challenges of generating unambiguous item references across multiple entity types under strict latency constraints.

entry.title: Gaussian Process Limit Reveals Structural Benefits of Graph Transformers

author.name: Nil Ayday, Lingchu Yang, Debarghya Ghoshdastidar

entry.summary: Proves that attention-based graph architectures have structural benefits over GCNs by analyzing NNGP limits of graph transformers (GAT, Graphormer, Specformer) with infinite width/heads, deriving node-level and edge-level kernels.

entry.title: Social Simulacra in the Wild: AI Agent Communities on Moltbook

author.name: Agam Goyal, Olivia Pal, Hari Sundaram, Eshwar Chandrasekharan, Koustuv Saha

entry.summary: Presents the first large-scale empirical comparison of AI-agent and human online communities, analyzing 73K Moltbook posts vs 190K Reddit posts. Finds AI communities show extreme participation inequality, emotional flatness, and social detachment.

entry.title: Structured Semantic Cloaking for Jailbreak Attacks on Large Language Models

author.name: Xiaobing Sun, Perry Lam, Shaohua Li, Zizhou Wang, Rick Siow Mong Goh, Yong Liu, Liangli Zhen

entry.summary: Proposes Structured Semantic Cloaking (S2C), a jailbreak attack that distributes malicious semantic cues across multiple dimensions requiring multi-step inference to reconstruct, bypassing latent-level safety mechanisms.

entry.title: Evolving Contextual Safety in Multi-Modal Large Language Models via Inference-Time Self-Reflective Memory

author.name: Ce Zhang, Jinxi He, Junyi He, Katia Sycara, Yaqi Xie

entry.summary: Presents MM-SafetyBench++, a benchmark for contextual safety in multimodal LLMs that pairs unsafe image-text examples with safe counterparts, and proposes an inference-time self-reflective memory approach to evolve safety understanding without retraining.

entry.title: HopChain: Multi-Hop Data Synthesis for Generalizable Vision-Language Reasoning

author.name: Shenzhi Wang, Shixuan Liu, Jing Zhou, Chang Gao, Xiong-Hui Chen, Binghai Wang, An Yang, Shiji Song, Bowen Yu, Gao Huang, Junyang Lin

entry.summary: Proposes HopChain, a framework for synthesizing multi-hop vision-language reasoning data for RLVR training of VLMs, where each hop is logically dependent and grounded in visual instances. From Alibaba/Qwen team.

entry.title: Versatile Editing of Video Content, Actions, and Dynamics without Training

author.name: Vladimir Kulikov, Roni Paiss, Andrey Voynov, Inbar Mosseri, Tali Dekel, Tomer Michaeli

entry.summary: DynaEdit is a training-free video editing method that enables editing of actions, dynamics, and content interactions in real-world videos using pretrained text-to-video flow models. Goes beyond structure-preserving edits to support motion modification.

entry.title: Protein Design with Agent Rosetta: A Case Study for Specialized Scientific Agents

author.name: Jacopo Teneggi, S. M. Bargeen A. Turzo, Tanya Marwah, Alberto Bietti, P. Douglas Renfrew, Vikram Khipple Mulligan, Siavash Golkar

entry.summary: Introduces Agent Rosetta, an LLM agent paired with the Rosetta physics-based protein design software, capable of iteratively refining designs including non-canonical amino acids. Authors from Flatiron Institute.

entry.title: NeuronSpark: A Spiking Neural Network Language Model with Selective State Space Dynamics

author.name: Zhengzheng Tang

entry.summary: Introduces NeuronSpark, a 0.9B-parameter pure spiking neural network language model trained from scratch with next-token prediction, achieving 3.6 pretraining loss and early multi-turn dialogue after SFT.

entry.title: Via Negativa for AI Alignment: Why Negative Constraints Are Structurally Superior to Positive Preferences

author.name: Quan Cheng

entry.summary: Provides a formal argument that negative constraints are structurally superior to positive preferences for AI alignment, unifying recent empirical results showing negative-only feedback matching or exceeding standard RLHF.

entry.title: Surg$\Sigma$: A Spectrum of Large-Scale Multimodal Data and Foundation Models for Surgical Intelligence

author.name: Zhitao Zeng, Mengya Xu, Jian Jiang, Pengfei Guo, Yunqiu Xu, Zhu Zhuo, Chang Han Low, Yufan He, Dong Yang, Chenxi Lin, Yiming Gu, Jiaxin Guo, Yutong Ban, Daguang Xu, Qi Dou, Yueming Jin

entry.summary: Introduces SurgΣ, a large-scale multimodal dataset and foundation model framework for surgical intelligence, addressing the lack of systematically curated surgical data. The framework spans multiple procedures and institutions to enable generalization in surgical AI.

entry.title: You've Got a Golden Ticket: Improving Generative Robot Policies With A Single Noise Vector

author.name: Omkar Patil, Ondrej Biza, Thomas Weng, Karl Schmeckpeper, Wil Thomason, Xiaohan Zhang, Robin Walters, Nakul Gopalan, Sebastian Castro, Eric Rosen

entry.summary: Demonstrates that a pretrained frozen diffusion/flow matching robot policy can be improved by finding a single constant 'golden ticket' noise vector instead of random sampling, using Monte-Carlo policy evaluation without retraining.

entry.title: OMNIFLOW: A Physics-Grounded Multimodal Agent for Generalized Scientific Reasoning

author.name: Hao Wu, Yongheng Zhang, Yuan Gao, Fan Xu, Fan Zhang, Ruobing Xie, Ruijian Gou, Yuxuan Liang, Xiaomeng Huang, Xian Wu

entry.summary: Introduces OMNIFLOW, a neuro-symbolic architecture grounding frozen multimodal LLMs in physical laws for PDE-governed dynamics without domain-specific fine-tuning. Uses Semantic-Symbolic Alignment to project flow tensors into linguistic descriptors.

entry.title: MoLoRA: Composable Specialization via Per-Token Adapter Routing

author.name: Shrey Shah, Justin Wagle

entry.summary: Introduces MoLoRA, enabling per-token routing of LoRA adapters within sequences rather than per-sequence routing, supporting multimodal and mixed-capability requests with provably optimal work complexity.

entry.title: Residual Stream Duality in Modern Transformer Architectures

author.name: Yifan Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes a two-axis view of Transformers (sequence position and layer depth) arguing the residual stream is representational machinery, not just optimization plumbing. Shows that causal depth-wise residual attention is equivalent to short sliding-window attention over the depth axis, potentially opening new architectural design space.

entry.title: DyJR: Preserving Diversity in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards via Dynamic Jensen-Shannon Replay

author.name: Long Li, Zhijian Zhou, Tianyi Wang, Weidi Xu, Zuming Huang, Wei Chu, Zhe Wang, Shirui Pan, Chao Qu, Yuan Qi

entry.summary: Proposes DyJR (Dynamic Jensen-Shannon Replay) for preserving diversity in RL-trained LLMs with verifiable rewards. Uses a dynamic reference distribution from recent trajectories to prevent mode collapse, with a Time-Sensitive Dynamic Buffer and adaptive sizing.

entry.title: An Efficient Heterogeneous Co-Design for Fine-Tuning on a Single GPU

author.name: Ruijia Yang, Zeyi Wen

entry.summary: Presents SlideFormer for fine-tuning 123B+ LLMs on a single RTX 4090 via asynchronous CPU-GPU sliding window execution, heterogeneous memory management, and optimized Triton kernels.

entry.title: REFORGE: Multi-modal Attacks Reveal Vulnerable Concept Unlearning in Image Generation Models

author.name: Yong Zou, Haoran Li, Fanxiao Li, Shenyang Wei, Yunyun Dong, Li Tang, Wei Zhou, Renyang Liu

entry.summary: Introduces REFORGE, a black-box red-teaming framework that evaluates the robustness of image generation model unlearning (IGMU) via adversarial image prompts. Uses stroke-based image initialization and cross-attention-guided masking to reveal vulnerabilities in concept unlearning methods.

entry.title: V-Co: A Closer Look at Visual Representation Alignment via Co-Denoising

author.name: Han Lin, Xichen Pan, Zun Wang, Yue Zhang, Chu Wang, Jaemin Cho, Mohit Bansal

entry.summary: Investigates visual representation alignment via co-denoising in pixel-space diffusion models. Disentangles design choices in co-denoising approaches to identify which are essential for improving diffusion training with pretrained visual features.

entry.title: MHPO: Modulated Hazard-aware Policy Optimization for Stable Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Hongjun Wang, Wei Liu, Weibo Gu, Xing Sun, Kai Han

entry.summary: Proposes MHPO, a policy optimization framework improving on GRPO with a Log-Fidelity Modulator for smooth gradient mapping and hazard-aware mechanisms to suppress extreme policy deviations.

entry.title: Self-Conditioned Denoising for Atomistic Representation Learning

author.name: Tynan Perez, Rafael Gomez-Bombarelli

entry.summary: Introduces Self-Conditioned Denoising (SCD), a backbone-agnostic pretraining objective for atomistic representation learning that uses self-embeddings for conditional denoising. Works across any domain of atomistic data without requiring DFT labels.

entry.title: Learning Permutation Distributions via Reflected Diffusion on Ranks

author.name: Sizhuang He, Yangtian Zhang, Shiyang Zhang, David van Dijk

entry.summary: Proposes Soft-Rank Diffusion, a framework for learning distributions over permutations by lifting discrete ranks to continuous soft-rank representations and using reflected diffusion processes.

entry.title: Procedural Generation of Algorithm Discovery Tasks in Machine Learning

author.name: Alexander D. Goldie, Zilin Wang, Adrian Hayler, Deepak Nathani, Edan Toledo, Ken Thampiratwong, Aleksandra Kalisz, Michael Beukman, Alistair Letcher, Shashank Reddy, Clarisse Wibault, Theo Wolf, Charles O'Neill, Uljad Berdica, Nicholas Roberts, Saeed Rahmani, Hannah Erlebach, Roberta Raileanu, Shimon Whiteson, Jakob N. Foerster

entry.summary: DiscoGen introduces a procedural generator for algorithm discovery tasks in ML, addressing issues like data contamination, saturation, and evaluation methodology in existing task suites. Spans millions of tasks of varying difficulty.

entry.title: Atomic Trajectory Modeling with State Space Models for Biomolecular Dynamics

author.name: Liang Shi, Jiarui Lu, Junqi Liu, Chence Shi, Zhi Yang, Jian Tang

entry.summary: Introduces ATMOS, a generative framework using State Space Models for generating atom-level molecular dynamics trajectories of biomolecular systems, integrating Pairformer-based state transitions for long-range temporal dependencies.

entry.title: Adaptive Guidance for Retrieval-Augmented Masked Diffusion Models

author.name: Jaemin Kim, Jong Chul Ye

entry.summary: Proposes ARAM, a training-free adaptive guidance framework for masked diffusion models in retrieval-augmented generation that dynamically adjusts reliance on retrieved context when it conflicts with the model's parametric knowledge.

entry.title: LoST: Level of Semantics Tokenization for 3D Shapes

author.name: Niladri Shekhar Dutt, Zifan Shi, Paul Guerrero, Chun-Hao Paul Huang, Duygu Ceylan, Niloy J. Mitra, Xuelin Chen

entry.summary: Proposes Level-of-Semantics Tokenization (LoST) for 3D shapes, ordering tokens by semantic salience so that early prefixes decode into complete plausible shapes with principal semantics, improving autoregressive 3D generation.

entry.title: Language Models Don't Know What You Want: Evaluating Personalization in Deep Research Needs Real Users

author.name: Nishant Balepur, Malachi Hamada, Varsha Kishore, Sergey Feldman, Amanpreet Singh, Pao Siangliulue, Joseph Chee Chang, Eunsol Choi, Jordan Lee Boyd-Graber, Aakanksha Naik

entry.summary: Presents MyScholarQA, a personalized Deep Research tool that infers user research profiles and generates personalized reports. Finds that standard LLM-judge evaluation misses key aspects of personalization that real user studies reveal.

entry.title: SpecSteer: Synergizing Local Context and Global Reasoning for Efficient Personalized Generation

author.name: Hang Lv, Sheng Liang, Hao Wang, Yongyue Zhang, Hongchao Gu, Wei Guo, Defu Lian, Yong Liu, Enhong Chen

entry.summary: Proposes SpecSteer, an asymmetric collaborative inference framework where private on-device models draft personalized sequences and cloud models verify/correct via speculative decoding, preserving privacy while leveraging cloud-scale reasoning.

entry.title: When and Why Does Unsupervised RL Succeed in Mathematical Reasoning? A Manifold Envelopment Perspective

author.name: Zelin Zhang, Fei Cheng, Chenhui Chu

entry.summary: Investigates when and why unsupervised RL (without ground-truth annotations) succeeds for mathematical reasoning in LLMs, introducing a 'manifold envelopment' perspective. Designs intrinsic rewards enforcing concise and certain generation.

entry.title: UniSAFE: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Safety Evaluation of Unified Multimodal Models

author.name: Segyu Lee, Boryeong Cho, Hojung Jung, Seokhyun An, Juhyeong Kim, Jaehyun Kwak, Yongjin Yang, Sangwon Jang, Youngrok Park, Wonjun Chang, Se-Young Yun

entry.summary: UniSAFE introduces the first comprehensive safety benchmark for Unified Multimodal Models across 7 I/O modality combinations, including novel multimodal-context image generation settings. Uses shared-target design for controlled cross-task safety comparison.

entry.title: VideoAtlas: Navigating Long-Form Video in Logarithmic Compute

author.name: Mohamed Eltahir, Ali Habibullah, Yazan Alshoibi, Lama Ayash, Tanveer Hussain, Naeemullah Khan

entry.summary: VideoAtlas represents video as a hierarchical grid that is lossless, navigable, and scalable, enabling language models to process long-form video in logarithmic compute. Eliminates lossy text conversion by using visual representation uniformly.

entry.title: The Unreasonable Effectiveness of Text Embedding Interpolation for Continuous Image Steering

author.name: Yigit Ekin, Yossi Gandelsman

entry.summary: Demonstrates that simple text-embedding interpolation with LLM-generated debiased contrastive prompts enables continuous, controllable image editing at test time without training. Computes steering vectors in text-encoder space.

entry.title: “Act-based approval-directed agents”, for IDA skeptics

author.name: Steven Byrnes

entry.summary: Steven Byrnes attempts to separate Paul Christiano's 'approval-directed agents' concept from the Iterated Distillation and Amplification (IDA) framework, arguing the core intuition about agents that only do what supervisors would approve of may still be valuable even if IDA algorithms won't work.

entry.title: Visual Distraction Undermines Moral Reasoning in Vision-Language Models

author.name: Xinyi Yang, Chenheng Xu, Weijun Hong, Ce Mo, Qian Wang, Fang Fang, Yixin Zhu

entry.summary: Shows that visual inputs fundamentally alter moral decision-making in VLMs, bypassing text-based safety mechanisms. Introduces Moral Dilemma Simulation (MDS) benchmark grounded in Moral Foundation Theory.

entry.title: Beyond Muon: MUD (MomentUm Decorrelation) for Faster Transformer Training

author.name: Ben S. Southworth, Stephen Thomas

entry.summary: MUD replaces Muon optimizer's polar decomposition with a Cholesky-like whitening surrogate for transformer training, reducing computational overhead while maintaining the orthogonalization benefits. Connects to Gauss-Seidel preconditioning theory.

entry.title: Inhibitory normalization of error signals improves learning in neural circuits

author.name: Roy Henha Eyono, Daniel Levenstein, Arna Ghosh, Jonathan Cornford, Blake Richards

entry.summary: Shows that inhibitory normalization in neural circuits improves learning when applied to error signals rather than activations, connecting biological neural mechanisms to artificial neural network training practices.

entry.title: Unified Spatio-Temporal Token Scoring for Efficient Video VLMs

author.name: Jianrui Zhang, Yue Yang, Rohun Tripathi, Winson Han, Ranjay Krishna, Christopher Clark, Yong Jae Lee, Sangho Lee

entry.summary: Introduces Spatio-Temporal Token Scoring (STTS), a lightweight module for pruning vision tokens across both ViT and LLM in video VLMs without text conditioning, achieving significant computational savings while maintaining performance.

entry.title: Efficient Reasoning on the Edge

author.name: Yelysei Bondarenko, Thomas Hehn, Rob Hesselink, Romain Lepert, Fabio Valerio Massoli, Evgeny Mironov, Leyla Mirvakhabova, Tribhuvanesh Orekondy, Spyridon Stasis, Andrey Kuzmin, Anna Kuzina, Markus Nagel, Ankita Nayak, Corrado Rainone, Ork de Rooij, Paul N Whatmough, Arash Behboodi, Babak Ehteshami Bejnordi

entry.summary: Proposes lightweight approaches to enable reasoning in small LLMs for edge deployment using LoRA adapters with supervised fine-tuning, addressing the verbosity and KV-cache overhead of chain-of-thought reasoning for mobile devices.

entry.title: QV May Be Enough: Toward the Essence of Attention in LLMs

author.name: Zhang Edward

entry.summary: Explores the essence of the QKV attention mechanism from a linguistic perspective, proposing that a QV paradigm (removing Keys) may be sufficient and introducing the QV-Ka optimization scheme with empirical validation.

entry.title: Regularized Latent Dynamics Prediction is a Strong Baseline For Behavioral Foundation Models

author.name: Pranaya Jajoo, Harshit Sikchi, Siddhant Agarwal, Amy Zhang, Scott Niekum, Martha White

entry.summary: Shows that regularized latent next-state prediction is a strong baseline for Behavioral Foundation Models, questioning whether complex representation learning objectives are necessary for zero-shot RL.

entry.title: Are Large Language Models Truly Smarter Than Humans?

author.name: Eshwar Reddy M, Sourav Karmakar

entry.summary: Studies benchmark contamination in frontier LLMs through three experiments, finding 13.8% contamination rate on MMLU with up to 66.7% in Philosophy, and showing performance drops of 8-19% on novel variants.

entry.title: When AI Navigates the Fog of War

author.name: Ming Li, Xirui Li, Tianyi Zhou

entry.summary: Studies whether AI models can reason about war trajectories before outcomes are historically obvious, using the 2026 Middle East conflict (after training cutoffs) as a temporally grounded case study with 42 verifiable questions.

entry.title: Differential Harm Propensity in Personalized LLM Agents: The Curious Case of Mental Health Disclosure

author.name: Caglar Yildirim

entry.summary: Studies how mental health disclosure in user profiles affects harmful behavior in agentic LLMs, finding differential harm propensity based on personalization signals in the AgentHarm benchmark.

entry.title: One Operator to Rule Them All? On Boundary-Indexed Operator Families in Neural PDE Solvers

author.name: Lennon J. Shikhman

entry.summary: Argues that neural PDE solvers don't learn a single solution operator but rather a boundary-indexed family of operators conditioned on training boundary distributions. Formalizes this as conditional risk minimization, revealing non-identifiability issues outside training distributions.

entry.title: Recursive Language Models Meet Uncertainty: The Surprising Effectiveness of Self-Reflective Program Search for Long Context

author.name: Keivan Alizadeh, Parshin Shojaee, Minsik Cho, Mehrdad Farajtabar

entry.summary: Introduces SRLM, augmenting Recursive Language Models with uncertainty-aware self-reflection for long-context handling. Uses three intrinsic signals (self-consistency, entropy, confidence calibration) to guide program search for context decomposition.

entry.title: DRCY: Agentic Hardware Design Reviews

author.name: Kyle Dumont, Nicholas Herbert, Hayder Tirmazi, Shrikanth Upadhayaya

entry.summary: Presents DRCY, the first production-ready multi-agent LLM system for automated hardware schematic review that fetches datasheets, performs pin-by-pin analysis, and posts findings as inline comments. Eliminates a class of costly post-fabrication errors.

entry.title: Transition Flow Matching

author.name: Chenrui Ma

entry.summary: Proposes Transition Flow Matching, a paradigm that directly learns transition flows as global quantities, enabling single-step generation while maintaining connections to Mean Velocity Flow models.

entry.title: Meta-TTRL: A Metacognitive Framework for Self-Improving Test-Time Reinforcement Learning in Unified Multimodal Models

author.name: Lit Sin Tan, Junzhe Chen, Xiaolong Fu, Lichen Ma, Junshi Huang, Jianzhong Shi, Yan Li, Lijie Wen

entry.summary: Proposes Meta-TTRL, a metacognitive framework for test-time reinforcement learning in unified multimodal models for text-to-image generation, achieving capability-level improvement rather than just instance-level improvements.

entry.title: Simulation Distillation: Pretraining World Models in Simulation for Rapid Real-World Adaptation

author.name: Jacob Levy, Tyler Westenbroek, Kevin Huang, Fernando Palafox, Patrick Yin, Shayegan Omidshafiei, Dong-Ki Kim, Abhishek Gupta, David Fridovich-Keil

entry.summary: Introduces SimDist, a sim-to-real framework that distills simulator priors into latent world models for rapid real-world adaptation via online planning. Transfers reward and value models from simulation to provide dense planning signals.

entry.title: Hypothesis Class Determines Explanation: Why Accurate Models Disagree on Feature Attribution

author.name: Thackshanaramana B

entry.summary: Shows through large-scale experiments (24 datasets) that equally accurate models from different hypothesis classes produce substantially different feature attributions, challenging the assumption that prediction-equivalent models give equivalent explanations.

entry.title: Towards the Vision-Sound-Language-Action Paradigm: The HEAR Framework for Sound-Centric Manipulation

author.name: Chang Nie, Tianchen Deng, Guangming Wang, Zhe Liu, Hesheng Wang

entry.summary: Introduces the HEAR framework for Vision-Sound-Language-Action (VSLA) paradigm in robot manipulation, addressing the gap where current VLA models treat sound as static prompts. Solves the 'Blind Execution Interval' problem in action chunking where acoustic events are lost.

entry.title: Frequency Matters: Fast Model-Agnostic Data Curation for Pruning and Quantization

author.name: Francesco Pio Monaco, Elia Cunegatti, Flavio Vella, Giovanni Iacca

entry.summary: Introduces ZipCal, a model-agnostic data curation strategy for selecting calibration data for LLM compression (pruning and quantization) based on intrinsic data properties (frequency analysis) rather than model-specific signals.

entry.title: FederatedFactory: Generative One-Shot Learning for Extremely Non-IID Distributed Scenarios

author.name: Andrea Moleri, Christian Intern\`o, Ali Raza, Markus Olhofer, David Klindt, Fabio Stella, Barbara Hammer

entry.summary: Introduces FederatedFactory, a one-shot federated learning framework that federates generative priors instead of discriminative parameters, enabling ex nihilo synthesis of class-balanced datasets in a single communication round for extremely non-IID scenarios.

entry.title: IndexRAG: Bridging Facts for Cross-Document Reasoning at Index Time

author.name: Zhenghua Bao, Yi Shi

entry.summary: Proposes IndexRAG, shifting cross-document reasoning from online inference to offline indexing by identifying bridge entities and pre-generating bridging facts. Achieves +4.6 F1 over Naive RAG on multi-hop QA with single-step retrieval.

entry.title: CompDiff: Hierarchical Compositional Diffusion for Fair and Zero-Shot Intersectional Medical Image Generation

author.name: Mahmoud Ibrahim, Bart Elen, Chang Sun, Gokhan Ertaylan, Michel Dumontier

entry.summary: Proposes CompDiff, a hierarchical compositional diffusion framework for fair medical image generation that addresses the imbalanced generator problem—where generators inherit training data imbalances for rare demographic intersections.

entry.title: When Openclaw Agents Learn from Each Other: Insights from Emergent AI Agent Communities for Human-AI Partnership in Education

author.name: Eason Chen, Ce Guan, Ahmed Elshafiey, Zhonghao Zhao, Joshua Zekeri, Afeez Edeifo Shaibu, Emmanuel Osadebe Prince, Cyuan-Jhen Wu

entry.summary: Examines emergent AI agent communities on platforms where 167K+ agents interact as peers, identifying phenomena like bidirectional scaffolding and peer learning that emerge without researcher intervention. Draws implications for AI in education.

entry.title: Retrieving Counterfactuals Improves Visual In-Context Learning

author.name: Guangzhi Xiong, Sanchit Sinha, Zhenghao He, Aidong Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces CIRCLES, a framework that uses composed image retrieval to select counterfactual demonstration examples for visual in-context learning. Aims to improve causal reasoning by selecting non-correlated but causally relevant examples.

entry.title: Finding Common Ground in a Sea of Alternatives

author.name: Jay Chooi, Paul G\"olz, Ariel D. Procaccia, Benjamin Schiffer, Shirley Zhang

entry.summary: Studies the problem of selecting consensus statements across diverse preferences using generative AI, formalizing it through the proportional veto core from social choice theory. Proposes algorithms with guarantees in the infinite alternative setting.

entry.title: Early Quantization Shrinks Codebook: A Simple Fix for Diversity-Preserving Tokenization

author.name: Wenhao Zhao, Qiran Zou, Rushi Shah, Yudi Wu, Zhouhan Lin, Dianbo Liu

entry.summary: Investigates codebook collapse in vector quantization for generative models. Identifies that early quantization causes codebook shrinkage and proposes a simple fix for diversity-preserving tokenization.

entry.title: CircuitBuilder: From Polynomials to Circuits via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Weikun K. Zhang, Rohan Pandey, Bhaumik Mehta, Kaijie Jin, Naomi Morato, Archit Ganapule, Michael Ruofan Zeng, Jarod Alper

entry.summary: Applies AlphaZero-style RL (PPO+MCTS and SAC) to discover efficient arithmetic circuits computing polynomials. Motivated by Valiant's VP vs VNP conjecture and auto-proof generation.

entry.title: Noise-Response Calibration: A Causal Intervention Protocol for LLM-Judges

author.name: Maxim Khomiakov, Jes Frellsen

entry.summary: Proposes a calibration protocol for LLM judges using controlled input noise interventions. Tests whether LLM scoring degrades predictably with increasing noise, using slope-based hypothesis tests.

entry.title: Abstraction as a Memory-Efficient Inductive Bias for Continual Learning

author.name: Elnaz Rahmati, Nona Ghazizadeh, Zhivar Sourati, Nina Rouhani, Morteza Dehghani

entry.summary: Proposes Abstraction-Augmented Training (AAT), a loss-level modification encouraging models to capture latent relational structure for continual learning. Eliminates the need for replay buffers by leveraging abstract representations.

entry.title: SCALE:Scalable Conditional Atlas-Level Endpoint transport for virtual cell perturbation prediction

author.name: Shuizhou Chen, Lang Yu, Kedu Jin, Songming Zhang, Hao Wu, Wenxuan Huang, Sheng Xu, Quan Qian, Qin Chen, Lei Bai, Siqi Sun, Zhangyang Gao

entry.summary: Presents SCALE, a large-scale foundation model for virtual cell perturbation prediction, addressing training efficiency, high-dimensional stability, and evaluation protocol issues. Built on BioNeMo framework.

entry.title: Cohomological Obstructions to Global Counterfactuals: A Sheaf-Theoretic Foundation for Generative Causal Models

author.name: Rui Wu, Hong Xie, Yongjun Li

entry.summary: Proves that locally consistent causal mechanisms can fail to yield globally coherent counterfactuals when causal graphs have non-trivial homology. Introduces sheaf-theoretic formalization with Entropic Wasserstein Causal Sheaf Laplacian.

entry.title: The Causal Uncertainty Principle: Manifold Tearing and the Topological Limits of Counterfactual Interventions

author.name: Rui Wu, Hong Xie, Yongjun Li

entry.summary: Establishes fundamental limits of causal interventions in continuous generative models through the Manifold Tearing Theorem. Proves deterministic flows develop singularities under extreme interventions and introduces a Causal Uncertainty Principle.

entry.title: Discovering Decoupled Functional Modules in Large Language Models

author.name: Yanke Yu, Jin Li, Ying Sun, Ping Li, Zhefeng Wang, Yi Zheng

entry.summary: ULCMOD discovers decoupled functional modules in LLMs by simultaneously disentangling neurons into modules and discovering related input topics, using an unsupervised framework with an iterative decoupling algorithm.

entry.title: CARE: Covariance-Aware and Rank-Enhanced Decomposition for Enabling Multi-Head Latent Attention

author.name: Zhongzhu Zhou, Fengxiang Bie, Ziyan Chen, Zhenyu Zhang, Yibo Yang, Junxiong Wang, Ben Athiwaratkun, Xiaoxia Wu, Shuaiwen Leon Song

entry.summary: CARE proposes a covariance-aware, rank-enhanced pipeline for converting grouped-query attention to multi-head latent attention in pretrained models, accounting for activation covariance structure and non-uniform rank allocation across layers.

entry.title: NeuroNarrator: A Generalist EEG-to-Text Foundation Model for Clinical Interpretation via Spectro-Spatial Grounding and Temporal State-Space Reasoning

author.name: Guoan Wang, Shihao Yang, Jun-en Ding, Hao Zhu, Feng Liu

entry.summary: NeuroNarrator is the first generalist EEG-to-text foundation model that translates EEG segments into clinical narratives, trained on NeuroCorpus-160K with 160,000+ paired EEG-text samples. Uses spectro-spatial grounding and temporal state-space reasoning.

entry.title: Wasserstein-type Gaussian Process Regressions for Input Measurement Uncertainty

author.name: Hengrui Luo, Xiaoye S. Li, Yang Liu, Marcus Noack, Ji Qiang, Mark D. Risser

entry.summary: Develops Gaussian process regression under input measurement uncertainty using Wasserstein distances between probability measures. Introduces a deterministic projected Wasserstein ARD kernel with closed-form expressions for scalable, positive-definite kernels on distributions.

entry.title: HeiSD: Hybrid Speculative Decoding for Embodied Vision-Language-Action Models with Kinematic Awareness

author.name: Zihao Zheng, Zhihao Mao, Sicheng Tian, Maoliang Li, Jiayu Chen, Xinhao Sun, Zhaobo Zhang, Xuanzhe Liu, Donggang Cao, Hong Mei, Xiang Chen

entry.summary: Proposes HeiSD, a hybrid speculative decoding method for Vision-Language-Action models that combines drafter-based and retrieval-based approaches with kinematic awareness to accelerate robot control inference.

entry.title: Sensi: Learn One Thing at a Time -- Curriculum-Based Test-Time Learning for LLM Game Agents

author.name: Mohsen Arjmandi

entry.summary: Presents Sensi, an LLM agent architecture for ARC-AGI-3 that introduces structured test-time learning through a two-player architecture, curriculum-based learning, and database-as-control-plane for programmatic context steering.

entry.title: ClaimFlow: Tracing the Evolution of Scientific Claims in NLP

author.name: Aniket Pramanick, Yufang Hou, Saif M. Mohammad, Iryna Gurevych

entry.summary: Introduces ClaimFlow, a claim-centric view of NLP literature with 304 annotated papers, 1,084 claims, and 832 cross-paper claim relations tracking how scientific claims are supported, extended, qualified, or refuted over time.

entry.title: SOMP: Scalable Gradient Inversion for Large Language Models via Subspace-Guided Orthogonal Matching Pursuit

author.name: Yibo Li, Qiongxiu Li

entry.summary: Presents SOMP, a scalable gradient inversion framework that recovers private training text from aggregated gradients by casting it as a sparse signal recovery problem exploiting head-wise geometric structure in transformers.

entry.title: Look Where It Matters: High-Resolution Crops Retrieval for Efficient VLMs

author.name: Nimrod Shabtay, Moshe Kimhi, Artem Spector, Sivan Haray, Ehud Rivlin, Chaim Baskin, Raja Giryes, Eli Schwartz

entry.summary: Presents AwaRes, a spatial-on-demand framework for VLMs that operates on low-resolution global views and retrieves high-resolution crops only when needed via tool-calling, resolving the accuracy-efficiency tradeoff.

entry.title: Empirical Recipes for Efficient and Compact Vision-Language Models

author.name: Jiabo Huang, Zhizhong Li, Sina Sajadmanesh, Weiming Zhuang, Lingjuan Lyu

entry.summary: Conducts empirical efficiency analysis of compact VLMs and develops optimization recipes that cut time-to-first-token by 53% on InternVL3-2B and 93% on SmolVLM-256M, providing practical deployment guidance.

entry.title: FineViT: Progressively Unlocking Fine-Grained Perception with Dense Recaptions

author.name: Peisen Zhao, Xiaopeng Zhang, Mingxing Xu, Ruoyu Sun, Zewei Du, Dunzheng Wang, Guanghao Zheng, Haohang Xu, Zhibo Zhang, Yuhang Zhang, Yi Ai, Lin Liu, Qi Tian

entry.summary: Introduces FineViT, a vision encoder designed for fine-grained perception that replaces coarse web data with dense recaptions and uses progressive training at high native resolution to systematically improve visual detail capture.

entry.title: TINA: Text-Free Inversion Attack for Unlearned Text-to-Image Diffusion Models

author.name: Qianlong Xiang, Miao Zhang, Haoyu Zhang, Kun Wang, Junhui Hou, Liqiang Nie

entry.summary: TINA proposes a text-free inversion attack showing that concept erasure in diffusion models only severs text-to-image mapping while visual knowledge persists. Uses DDIM inversion to bypass text-centric erasure defenses.

entry.title: AHOY! Animatable Humans under Occlusion from YouTube Videos with Gaussian Splatting and Video Diffusion Priors

author.name: Aymen Mir, Riza Alp Guler, Xiangjun Tang, Peter Wonka, Gerard Pons-Moll

entry.summary: AHOY reconstructs complete, animatable 3D Gaussian avatars from monocular in-the-wild video despite heavy occlusion. Uses identity-finetuned diffusion models as hallucination-based supervision for unobserved body regions.

entry.title: VectorWorld: Efficient Streaming World Model via Diffusion Flow on Vector Graphs

author.name: Chaokang Jiang, Desen Zhou, Jiuming Liu, Kevin Li Sun

entry.summary: VectorWorld is a streaming world model for autonomous driving that generates ego-centric lane-agent vector-graph tiles during rollout, enabling real-time closed-loop simulation with motion-aware gated VAE initialization.

entry.title: ReSteer: Quantifying and Refining the Steerability of Multitask Robot Policies

author.name: Zhenyang Chen, Alan Tian, Liquan Wang, Benjamin Joffe, Yingyan Celine Lin, Yuxiao Chen, Siddharth Karamcheti, Danfei Xu

entry.summary: ReSteer quantifies and improves task steerability in multitask robot policies, revealing that state-of-the-art policies commonly fail to switch tasks mid-execution. Proposes a proxy metric and data augmentation fix.

entry.title: EVA: Aligning Video World Models with Executable Robot Actions via Inverse Dynamics Rewards

author.name: Ruixiang Wang, Qingming Liu, Yueci Deng, Guiliang Liu, Zhen Liu, Kui Jia

entry.summary: EVA aligns video world models with executable robot actions by using inverse dynamics rewards during training, addressing the executability gap where visually coherent rollouts violate physical constraints.

entry.title: Formal Verification: The Ultimate Fitness Function

author.name: Adam Chlipala

entry.summary: Adam Chlipala argues that formal verification can serve as an extremely fast fitness function for evolutionary search over AI systems, enabling strong mathematical guarantees about agent behavior. Positions formal verification as key to analyzing AI agent source code for safety properties.

entry.title: DynHD: Hallucination Detection for Diffusion Large Language Models via Denoising Dynamics Deviation Learning

author.name: Yanyu Qian, Yue Tan, Yixin Liu, Wang Yu, Shirui Pan

entry.summary: Proposes DynHD for hallucination detection in diffusion LLMs by modeling the evolution of token-level uncertainty throughout the diffusion denoising process, addressing the unique challenge that tokens contribute unevenly in fixed-length generation.

entry.title: DynaTrust: Defending Multi-Agent Systems Against Sleeper Agents via Dynamic Trust Graphs

author.name: Yu Li, Qiang Hu, Yao Zhang, Lili Quan, Jiongchi Yu, Junjie Wang

entry.summary: Proposes DynaTrust, a defense method against sleeper agents in multi-agent LLM systems using dynamic trust graphs that model trust as a continuous, evolving signal rather than static blocking.

entry.title: MAC: Multi-Agent Constitution Learning

author.name: Rushil Thareja, Gautam Gupta, Francesco Pinto, Nils Lukas

entry.summary: Proposes Multi-Agent Constitutional Learning (MAC) that optimizes structured constitutions (sets of rules) using a network of specialized agents for accepting, editing, or rejecting rules, improving data efficiency over existing prompt optimizers.

entry.title: ARISE: Agent Reasoning with Intrinsic Skill Evolution in Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yu Li, Rui Miao, Zhengling Qi, Tian Lan

entry.summary: Introduces ARISE, a hierarchical RL framework for mathematical reasoning where a shared policy acts as both Skills Manager and Worker, maintaining a tiered skill library through structured summarization of successful solution traces.

entry.title: Anticipatory Planning for Multimodal AI Agents

author.name: Yongyuan Liang, Shijie Zhou, Yu Gu, Hao Tan, Gang Wu, Franck Dernoncourt, Jihyung Kil, Ryan A. Rossi, Ruiyi Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces TraceR1, a two-stage RL framework for anticipatory planning in multimodal agents that forecasts short-horizon trajectories before execution, with trajectory-level RL and grounded fine-tuning stages.

entry.title: Is Conformal Factuality for RAG-based LLMs Robust? Novel Metrics and Systematic Insights

author.name: Yi Chen, Daiwei Chen, Sukrut Madhav Chikodikar, Caitlyn Heqi Yin, Ramya Korlakai Vinayak

entry.summary: Systematically analyzes conformal factuality methods for RAG-based LLMs, proposing new metrics to evaluate both reliability and usefulness of statistically-guaranteed factual outputs. The work reveals limitations in current conformal filtering approaches across multiple dimensions including generation, scoring, and calibration.

entry.title: Steering Frozen LLMs: Adaptive Social Alignment via Online Prompt Routing

author.name: Zeyu Zhang, Xiangxiang Dai, Ziyi Han, Xutong Liu, John C. S. Lui

entry.summary: Introduces CCLUB, a bandit-based framework for adaptive social alignment of frozen LLMs at inference time via system-prompt routing. Uses consensus clustering to balance utility and safety in evolving deployment contexts.

entry.title: IdentityGuard: Context-Aware Restriction and Provenance for Personalized Synthesis

author.name: Lingyun Zhang, Yu Xie, Ping Chen

entry.summary: Introduces IDENTITYGUARD, a context-aware safety system for personalized text-to-image models that blocks harmful content only when combined with personalized identity, plus concept-specific watermarking for traceability.

entry.title: The Agentic Researcher: A Practical Guide to AI-Assisted Research in Mathematics and Machine Learning

author.name: Max Zimmer, Nico Pelleriti, Christophe Roux, Sebastian Pokutta

entry.summary: Provides a practical guide to AI-assisted research in mathematics and ML, including a five-level taxonomy of AI integration and an open-source framework for turning coding agents into research assistants.

entry.title: VIBEPASS: Can Vibe Coders Really Pass the Vibe Check?

author.name: Srijan Bansal, Jiao Fangkai, Yilun Zhou, Austin Xu, Shafiq Joty, Semih Yavuz

entry.summary: Introduces VIBEPASS, the first benchmark decomposing 'vibe coding' into fault-triggering test generation and fault-targeted program repair, evaluating LLMs' ability to self-diagnose and repair subtle bugs.

entry.title: ExpertGen: Scalable Sim-to-Real Expert Policy Learning from Imperfect Behavior Priors

author.name: Zifan Xu, Ran Gong, Maria Vittoria Minniti, Ahmet Salih Gundogdu, Eric Rosen, Kausik Sivakumar, Riedana Yan, Zixing Wang, Di Deng, Peter Stone, Xiaohan Zhang, Karl Schmeckpeper

entry.summary: Introduces ExpertGen, a framework automating expert policy learning in simulation for scalable sim-to-real transfer, using diffusion policy priors refined by RL that optimizes initial noise distribution.

entry.title: Resource Consumption Threats in Large Language Models

author.name: Yuanhe Zhang, Xinyue Wang, Zhican Chen, Weiliu Wang, Zilu Zhang, Zhengshuo Gong, Zhenhong Zhou, Kun Wang, Li Sun, Yang Liu, Sen Su

entry.summary: Systematic survey of resource consumption threats in LLMs—attacks that induce excessive generation to degrade efficiency and harm service availability. Establishes a unified view covering threat induction, mechanism understanding, and mitigation across the full pipeline.

entry.title: Parallel In-context Learning for Large Vision Language Models

author.name: Shin'ya Yamaguchi, Daiki Chijiwa, Tamao Sakao, Taku Hasegawa

entry.summary: Proposes Parallel-ICL for large vision-language models, partitioning long demonstration contexts into shorter chunks processed in parallel with a weighted Product-of-Experts ensemble at the logit level, reducing inference latency while maintaining performance.

entry.title: Fanar 2.0: Arabic Generative AI Stack

author.name: FANAR TEAM, Ummar Abbas, Mohammad Shahmeer Ahmad, Minhaj Ahmad, Abdulaziz Al-Homaid, Anas Al-Nuaimi, Enes Altinisik, Ehsaneddin Asgari, Sanjay Chawla, Shammur Chowdhury, Fahim Dalvi, Kareem Darwish, Nadir Durrani, Mohamed Elfeky, Ahmed Elmagarmid, Mohamed Eltabakh, Asim Ersoy, Masoomali Fatehkia, Mohammed Qusay Hashim, Majd Hawasly, Mohamed Hefeeda, Mus'ab Husaini, Keivin Isufaj, Soon-Gyo Jung, Houssam Lachemat, Ji Kim Lucas, Abubakr Mohamed, Tasnim Mohiuddin, Basel Mousi, Hamdy Mubarak, Ahmad Musleh, Mourad Ouzzani, Amin Sadeghi, Husrev Taha Sencar, Mohammed Shinoy, Omar Sinan, Yifan Zhang

entry.summary: Presents Fanar 2.0, Qatar's Arabic-centric generative AI platform built on 256 H100 GPUs. Features Fanar-27B, continually pre-trained from Gemma-3-27B on 120B curated Arabic tokens, emphasizing data quality over quantity for a low-resource language.

entry.title: Unlearning for One-Step Generative Models via Unbalanced Optimal Transport

author.name: Hyundo Choi, Junhyeong An, Jinseong Park, Jaewoong Choi

entry.summary: Proposes UOT-Unlearn for machine unlearning in one-step generative models (flow maps) using Unbalanced Optimal Transport, addressing a gap where diffusion unlearning methods are incompatible with single-step generators.

entry.title: MLLM-based Textual Explanations for Face Comparison

author.name: Redwan Sony, Anil K Jain, Ross Arun

entry.summary: Systematically analyzes MLLM-generated explanations for face verification on challenging surveillance imagery. Finds that even when MLLMs make correct decisions, their explanations frequently rely on hallucinated or non-verifiable facial attributes.

entry.title: CABTO: Context-Aware Behavior Tree Grounding for Robot Manipulation

author.name: Yishuai Cai, Xinglin Chen, Yunxin Mao, Kun Hu, Minglong Li, Yaodong Yang, Yuanpei Chen

entry.summary: Formalizes the BT Grounding problem for behavior trees in robotics and introduces CABTO, leveraging large pretrained models to automate construction of complete BT systems for robot manipulation.

entry.title: MessyKitchens: Contact-rich object-level 3D scene reconstruction

author.name: Junaid Ahmed Ansari, Ran Ding, Fabio Pizzati, Ivan Laptev

entry.summary: Advances object-level 3D scene reconstruction from monocular images with focus on physically-plausible contact-rich scenes. Introduces a benchmark for cluttered kitchen scenes requiring non-penetration and realistic contact modeling.

entry.title: A foundation model for electrodermal activity data

author.name: Leonardo Alchieri, Matteo Garzon, Lidia Alecci, Francesco Bombassei De Bona, Martin Gjoreski, Giovanni De Felice, Silvia Santini

entry.summary: Compiles EDAMAME, a 25K+ hour EDA dataset from 24 public sources, and trains UME, the first dedicated foundation model for electrodermal activity. Demonstrates strong performance across eight downstream tasks.

entry.title: Beyond Outliers: A Data-Free Layer-wise Mixed-Precision Quantization Approach Driven by Numerical and Structural Dual-Sensitivity

author.name: Hengyuan Zhang, Xinrong Chen, Zunhai Su, Xiao Liang, Jing Xiong, Wendong Xu, He Xiao, Chaofan Tao, Wei Zhang, Ruobing Xie, Lei Jiang, Hayden Kwok-Hay So, Ngai Wong

entry.summary: Proposes NSDS, a calibration-free layer-wise mixed-precision quantization framework using both numerical and structural sensitivity analysis. Decomposes layers into operational roles and quantifies sensitivity from dual perspectives.

entry.title: Can Blindfolded LLMs Still Trade? An Anonymization-First Framework for Portfolio Optimization

author.name: Joohyoung Jeon, Hongchul Lee

entry.summary: BlindTrade anonymizes stock tickers and company names to test whether LLM trading agents rely on memorized associations versus genuine market understanding. Uses GNN graphs from reasoning embeddings for portfolio optimization.

entry.title: Towards Infinitely Long Neural Simulations: Self-Refining Neural Surrogate Models for Dynamical Systems

author.name: Qi Liu, Laure Zanna, Joan Bruna

entry.summary: Introduces a self-refining framework for autoregressive neural surrogate models that addresses distribution drift in long-horizon simulations. Provides a mathematical framework making the accuracy-consistency tradeoff explicit and proposes a hyperparameter-free approach.

entry.title: Only relative ranks matter in weight-clustered large language models

author.name: Borja Aizpurua, Sukhbinder Singh, Rom\'an Or\'us

entry.summary: Shows that relative weight ranks matter more than precise magnitudes in LLMs, demonstrating that weight clustering to 16-64 distinct values per matrix preserves accuracy without retraining. Fine-tuning only cluster centroids recovers most remaining accuracy.

entry.title: Knowledge Localization in Mixture-of-Experts LLMs Using Cross-Lingual Inconsistency

author.name: Lucas Bandarkar, Alan Ansell, Trevor Cohn

entry.summary: Uses cross-lingual inconsistency in LLM factual recall as a tool for knowledge localization in mixture-of-experts models, isolating components that play functional roles in answering specific knowledge queries.

entry.title: Adaptive Contracts for Cost-Effective AI Delegation

author.name: Eden Saig, Tamar Garbuz, Ariel D. Procaccia, Inbal Talgam-Cohen, Jamie Tucker-Foltz

entry.summary: Introduces adaptive contracts for AI delegation where detailed evaluation is performed selectively after an initial coarse signal, reducing costs in pay-for-performance AI text generation. Provides efficient algorithms for optimal contracts under natural assumptions and proves hardness in the general case.

entry.title: In Trust We Survive: Emergent Trust Learning

author.name: Qianpu Chen, Giulio Barbero, Mike Preuss, Derya Soydaner

entry.summary: Introduces Emergent Trust Learning (ETL), a lightweight trust-based control algorithm for AI agents that enables cooperation in competitive shared-resource environments using only local observations and individual rewards.

entry.title: Modeling Overlapped Speech with Shuffles

author.name: Matthew Wiesner, Samuele Cornell, Alexander Polok, Lucas Ondel Yang, Luk\'a\v{s} Burget, Sanjeev Khudanpur

entry.summary: Proposes modeling overlapped speech using shuffle products and partial order finite-state automata, enabling alignment and speaker-attributed transcription by marginalizing over all possible serializations of overlapping sequences.

entry.title: scicode-lint: Detecting Methodology Bugs in Scientific Python Code with LLM-Generated Patterns

author.name: Sergey V. Samsonau

entry.summary: Presents scicode-lint, a two-tier linter for detecting methodology bugs in scientific Python code (data leakage, incorrect cross-validation, missing seeds) using LLM-generated patterns at build time and fast AST matching at runtime.

entry.title: SciZoom: A Large-scale Benchmark for Hierarchical Scientific Summarization across the LLM Era

author.name: Han Jang, Junhyeok Lee, Kyu Sung Choi

entry.summary: Introduces SciZoom, a benchmark of 44,946 papers from NeurIPS/ICLR/ICML/EMNLP spanning 2003-2024 for hierarchical scientific summarization, also analyzing how scientific writing has evolved since ChatGPT's release.

entry.title: Parametric Social Identity Injection and Diversification in Public Opinion Simulation

author.name: Hexi Wang, Yujia Zhou, Bangde Du, Qingyao Ai, Yiqun Liu

entry.summary: Identifies 'Diversity Collapse' in LLM hidden representations for public opinion simulation, where distinct social identities become indistinguishable. Proposes Parametric Social Identity Injection to maintain diversity in simulated responses.

entry.title: Visual Set Program Synthesizer

author.name: Zehua Cheng, Wei Dai, Wenhu Zhang, Thomas Lukasiewicz, Jiahao Sun

entry.summary: Proposes treating visual reasoning as Visual Program Synthesis, generating symbolic programs executed by a separate engine. Introduces Set-VQA benchmark for set-based visual reasoning (filtering, comparison, aggregation over visual scenes).

entry.title: From the Inside Out: Progressive Distribution Refinement for Confidence Calibration

author.name: Xizhong Yang, Yinan Xia, Huiming Wang, Mofei Song

entry.summary: Proposes DistriTTRL, which leverages distribution priors of model confidence during RL to progressively optimize reward signals for test-time training, addressing the gap between test and training internal information and mitigating reward hacking.

entry.title: Astrolabe: Steering Forward-Process Reinforcement Learning for Distilled Autoregressive Video Models

author.name: Songchun Zhang, Zeyue Xue, Siming Fu, Jie Huang, Xianghao Kong, Y Ma, Haoyang Huang, Nan Duan, Anyi Rao

entry.summary: Introduces Astrolabe, an efficient online RL framework for distilled autoregressive video models that uses forward-process RL with negative-aware fine-tuning, avoiding expensive re-distillation or reverse-process optimization.

entry.title: GigaWorld-Policy: An Efficient Action-Centered World--Action Model

author.name: Angen Ye, Boyuan Wang, Chaojun Ni, Guan Huang, Guosheng Zhao, Hao Li, Hengtao Li, Jie Li, Jindi Lv, Jingyu Liu, Min Cao, Peng Li, Qiuping Deng, Wenjun Mei, Xiaofeng Wang, Xinze Chen, Xinyu Zhou, Yang Wang, Yifan Chang, Yifan Li, Yukun Zhou, Yun Ye, Zhichao Liu, Zheng Zhu

entry.summary: Introduces GigaWorld-Policy, an action-centered World-Action Model that learns 2D pixel-action dynamics for robot policy learning while enabling efficient action decoding separately from optional video generation.

entry.title: Temporal Gains, Spatial Costs: Revisiting Video Fine-Tuning in Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Linghao Zhang, Jungang Li, Yonghua Hei, Sicheng Tao, Song Dai, Yibo Yan, Zihao Dongfang, Weiting Liu, Chenxi Qin, Hanqian Li, Xin Zou, Jiahao Zhang, Shuhang Xun, Haiyun Jiang, Xuming Hu

entry.summary: Systematically studies how video supervised fine-tuning reshapes visual capabilities in MLLMs, finding a consistent pattern where video-SFT improves video performance but degrades static image benchmarks. Shows the tradeoff is tied to temporal budget allocation.

entry.title: DeepCORO-CLIP: A Multi-View Foundation Model for Comprehensive Coronary Angiography Video-Text Analysis and External Validation

author.name: Sarra Harrabi, Yichen Wu, Geoffrey H. Tison, Minhaj Ansari, Milos Vukadinovic, David Ouyang, Joshua P. Barrios, Jacques Delfrate, Robert Avram

entry.summary: DeepCORO-CLIP presents a multi-view foundation model for coronary angiography using video-text contrastive learning on 203K+ videos from 28K+ patients, externally validated on 4K+ studies. Integrates multiple projections for comprehensive coronary assessment.

entry.title: Steering Video Diffusion Transformers with Massive Activations

author.name: Xianhang Cheng, Yujian Zheng, Zhenyu Xie, Tingting Liao, Hao Li

entry.summary: Studies Massive Activations (high-magnitude hidden state spikes) in video diffusion transformers, discovering they carry global layout semantics with a clear magnitude hierarchy across frame types. Uses this for training-free quality enhancement.

entry.title: Feeling the Space: Egomotion-Aware Video Representation for Efficient and Accurate 3D Scene Understanding

author.name: Shuyao Shi, Kang G. Shin

entry.summary: Motion-MLLM enhances multimodal LLMs with IMU egomotion data for efficient 3D scene understanding from video. Introduces cascaded motion-visual keyframe filtering and asymmetric motion-visual fusion.

entry.title: Loc3R-VLM: Language-based Localization and 3D Reasoning with Vision-Language Models

author.name: Kevin Qu, Haozhe Qi, Mihai Dusmanu, Mahdi Rad, Rui Wang, Marc Pollefeys

entry.summary: Loc3R-VLM equips 2D Vision-Language Models with 3D understanding from monocular video through global layout reconstruction and explicit situation modeling. Inspired by human spatial cognition.

entry.title: Embodied Foundation Models at the Edge: A Survey of Deployment Constraints and Mitigation Strategies

author.name: Utkarsh Grover (University of South Florida, Tampa, USA), Ravi Ranjan (Florida International University, Miami, USA), Mingyang Mao (University of South Florida, Tampa, USA), Trung Tien Dong (University of South Florida, Tampa, USA), Satvik Praveen (University of South Florida, Tampa, USA), Zhenqi Wu (University of South Florida, Tampa, USA), J. Morris Chang (University of South Florida, Tampa, USA), Tinoosh Mohsenin (Johns Hopkins University, Baltimore, USA), Yi Sheng (University of South Florida, Tampa, USA), Agoritsa Polyzou (Florida International University, Miami, USA), Eiman Kanjo (Nottingham Trent University, Nottingham, United Kingdom, Imperial College London, London, United Kingdom), Xiaomin Lin (University of South Florida, Tampa, USA)

entry.summary: Surveys deployment constraints for foundation models on embodied edge systems, organizing them into eight coupled barriers (the 'Deployment Gauntlet') covering memory, compute, latency, and safety.

entry.title: Generative Control as Optimization: Time Unconditional Flow Matching for Adaptive and Robust Robotic Control

author.name: Zunzhe Zhang, Runhan Huang, Yicheng Liu, Shaoting Zhu, Linzhan Mou, Hang Zhao

entry.summary: GeCO transforms flow matching for robot control from trajectory integration into iterative optimization with a stationary velocity field, enabling adaptive compute allocation based on action complexity.

entry.title: Specification-Aware Distribution Shaping for Robotics Foundation Models

author.name: Sad{\i}k Bera Y\"uksel, Derya Aksaray

entry.summary: Proposes specification-aware distribution shaping for robotics foundation models that enforces Signal Temporal Logic constraints during execution without modifying model parameters.

entry.title: Anthropic vs. DoW #5: Motions Filed

author.name: Zvi

entry.summary: Zvi's legal analysis update on Anthropic's lawsuit against the Department of War, covering upcoming motions for a temporary restraining order and the legal arguments from both sides. Discusses amicus briefs and the likelihood of injunctive relief at the March 24 hearing.

entry.title: Compiled Memory: Not More Information, but More Precise Instructions for Language Agents

author.name: James Rhodes, George Kang

entry.summary: Presents Atlas, a memory kernel that compiles task experience into instruction rewrites for agents without fine-tuning or RAG. Facts from failures/successes are promoted through a three-step gate and delivered by rewriting the system prompt.

entry.title: Adaptive Theory of Mind for LLM-based Multi-Agent Coordination

author.name: Chunjiang Mu, Ya Zeng, Qiaosheng Zhang, Kun Shao, Chen Chu, Hao Guo, Danyang Jia, Zhen Wang, Shuyue Hu

entry.summary: Introduces Adaptive Theory of Mind (A-ToM) for LLM-based multi-agent coordination, where agents estimate and align their ToM reasoning depth with partners to avoid mismatched reasoning that impairs coordination.

entry.title: TRUST-SQL: Tool-Integrated Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning for Text-to-SQL over Unknown Schemas

author.name: Ai Jian, Xiaoyun Zhang, Wanrou Du, Jingqing Ruan, Jiangbo Pei, Weipeng Zhang, Ke Zeng, Xunliang Cai

entry.summary: Proposes TRUST-SQL for Text-to-SQL over unknown schemas, formulating the task as a POMDP where agents actively discover relevant schema subsets through a four-phase protocol with dual reward RL.

entry.title: IQuest-Coder-V1 Technical Report

author.name: Jian Yang, Wei Zhang, Shawn Guo, Zhengmao Ye, Lin Jing, Shark Liu, Yizhi Li, Jiajun Wu, Cening Liu, X. Ma, Yuyang Song, Siwei Wu, Yuwen Li, L. Liao, T. Zheng, Ziling Huang, Zelong Huang, Che Liu, Yan Xing, Renyuan Li, Qingsong Cai, Hanxu Yan, Siyue Wang, Shikai Li, Jason Klein Liu, An Huang, Yongsheng Kang, Jinxing Zhang, Chuan Hao, Haowen Wang, Weicheng Gu, Ran Tao, Mingjie Tang, Peihao Wu, Jianzhou Wang, Xianglong Liu, Weifeng Lv, Bryan Dai

entry.summary: Introduces IQuest-Coder-V1 series (7B-40B), code LLMs trained with a code-flow multi-stage paradigm capturing dynamic software logic evolution through pre-training, mid-training with reasoning trajectories, and specialized post-training.

entry.title: Alternating Reinforcement Learning with Contextual Rubric Rewards

author.name: Guangchen Lan

entry.summary: Proposes Alternating RL with Rubric Rewards (ARL-RR), which replaces fixed scalar reward aggregation with alternating optimization over individual rubric dimensions, addressing correlations and sensitivity to score design in multi-dimensional evaluation.

entry.title: LLM-Driven Discovery of High-Entropy Catalysts via Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: AI Scientists, Xinyi Lin, Danqing Yin, Ying Guo

entry.summary: Demonstrates using RAG-augmented GPT-4 for high-entropy catalyst discovery, generating 250+ candidates with 82% thermodynamic stability from a database of 50K+ known materials for CO2 reduction.

entry.title: Embedding-Aware Feature Discovery: Bridging Latent Representations and Interpretable Features in Event Sequences

author.name: Artem Sakhno, Ivan Sergeev, Alexey Shestov, Omar Zoloev, Elizaveta Kovtun, Gleb Gusev, Andrey Savchenko, Maksim Makarenko

entry.summary: Introduces Embedding-Aware Feature Discovery (EAFD), bridging pretrained event-sequence embeddings with LLM-driven interpretable feature generation for financial systems, where production pipelines still rely on handcrafted features.

entry.title: CorrectionPlanner: Self-Correction Planner with Reinforcement Learning in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Yihong Guo, Dongqiangzi Ye, Sijia Chen, Anqi Liu, Xianming Liu

entry.summary: Proposes CorrectionPlanner for autonomous driving that models planning as motion-token generation within a propose-evaluate-correct loop, using a learned collision critic to trigger self-correction when unsafe actions are detected.

entry.title: Aligning Paralinguistic Understanding and Generation in Speech LLMs via Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Jingxiang Chen, Minseok Kim, Seong-Gyun Leem, Yin Huang, Rashi Rungta, Zhicheng Ouyang, Haibin Wu, Surya Teja Appini, Ankur Bansal, Yang Bai, Yue Liu, Florian Metze, Ahmed A Aly, Anuj Kumar, Ariya Rastrow, Zhaojiang Lin

entry.summary: Proposes multi-task RL with chain-of-thought prompting for aligning paralinguistic understanding and generation in speech LLMs, introducing PALLM that jointly optimizes sentiment classification and paralinguistics-aware response generation.

entry.title: CounterRefine: Answer-Conditioned Counterevidence Retrieval for Inference-Time Knowledge Repair in Factual Question Answering

author.name: Tianyi Huang, Ying Kai Deng

entry.summary: Introduces CounterRefine, a lightweight inference-time repair layer for retrieval-augmented QA that generates a draft answer, retrieves both supporting and conflicting evidence via answer-conditioned queries, then applies deterministic validation before accepting revisions.

entry.title: PathGLS: Evaluating Pathology Vision-Language Models without Ground Truth through Multi-Dimensional Consistency

author.name: Minbing Chen, Zhu Meng, Fei Su

entry.summary: Proposes PathGLS, a reference-free evaluation framework for pathology VLMs assessing three dimensions: Grounding (visual-text alignment), Logic (entailment consistency), and Stability (robustness to perturbations). Supports both patch-level and whole-slide evaluation.

entry.title: Who Benchmarks the Benchmarks? A Case Study of LLM Evaluation in Icelandic

author.name: Finnur \'Ag\'ust Ingimundarson, Steinunn Rut Fri{\dh}riksd\'ottir, Bjarki \'Armannsson, Iris Edda Nowenstein, Stein{\th}\'or Steingr\'imsson

entry.summary: Evaluates LLM benchmarks for Icelandic, finding that synthetic/machine-translated test data contains severely flawed examples that skew results. Warns against unverified MT-based benchmarking for low-resource languages.

entry.title: FEAT: A Linear-Complexity Foundation Model for Extremely Large Structured Data

author.name: Zhenghang Song, Tang Qian, Lu Chen, Yushuai Li, Zhengke Hu, Bingbing Fang, Yumeng Song, Junbo Zhao, Sheng Zhang, Tianyi Li

entry.summary: Proposes FEAT, a linear-complexity foundation model for extremely large structured data using multi-layer dual-axis architecture, addressing the O(N²) complexity of existing approaches for tabular data in healthcare, finance, and e-commerce.

entry.title: SpecMoE: Spectral Mixture-of-Experts Foundation Model for Cross-Species EEG Decoding

author.name: D. Darankoum, C. Habermacher, J. Volle, S. Grudinin

entry.summary: Introduces SpecMoE, a cross-species EEG foundation model using a Mixture-of-Experts architecture with a novel Gaussian-smoothed masking scheme on STFT maps. Addresses bias toward high-frequency oscillations in standard masking approaches.

entry.title: Minimum-Action Learning: Energy-Constrained Symbolic Model Selection for Physical Law Identification from Noisy Data

author.name: Martin G. Frasch

entry.summary: Presents Minimum-Action Learning, a framework for identifying physical laws from noisy data by minimizing a Triple-Action functional. A wide-stencil technique reduces noise variance by 10,000x enabling law recovery at extremely low SNR.

entry.title: Variational Rectification Inference for Learning with Noisy Labels

author.name: Haoliang Sun, Qi Wei, Lei Feng, Yupeng Hu, Fan Liu, Hehe Fan, Yilong Yin

entry.summary: Proposes Variational Rectification Inference (VRI) for learning with noisy labels, formulating adaptive loss rectification as amortized variational inference under a meta-learning framework.

entry.title: Variational Kernel Design for Internal Noise: Gaussian Chaos Noise, Representation Compatibility, and Reliable Deep Learning

author.name: Ziran Liu

entry.summary: Introduces Variational Kernel Design, a framework deriving internal noise mechanisms from learning desiderata. Shows that a maximum-entropy principle yields Gaussian noise with Dirichlet Green kernel correlation geometry.

entry.title: Complementary Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Dilxat Muhtar, Jiashun Liu, Wei Gao, Weixun Wang, Shaopan Xiong, Ju Huang, Siran Yang, Wenbo Su, Jiamang Wang, Ling Pan, Bo Zheng

entry.summary: Complementary RL introduces a dual-memory system inspired by neuroscience's complementary learning systems, addressing the misalignment between stored experience and an improving RL actor during training. Enables experience to coevolve with the actor's capability.

entry.title: RAMP: Reinforcement Adaptive Mixed Precision Quantization for Efficient On Device LLM Inference

author.name: Arpit Singh Gautam, Saurabh Jha

entry.summary: RAMP uses off-policy Soft Actor-Critic RL to learn per-layer mixed-precision quantization assignments for LLMs, minimizing perplexity under a bit budget. Introduces Scale Folding for stable sub-4-bit quantization and enables zero-shot transfer across model families.

entry.title: Mirror Descent on Riemannian Manifolds

author.name: Jiaxin Jiang, Lei Shi, Jiyuan Tan

entry.summary: Generalizes Mirror Descent to Riemannian manifolds with non-asymptotic convergence guarantees. Shows the framework reduces to known methods on the Stiefel manifold and provides a stochastic extension.

entry.title: rSDNet: Unified Robust Neural Learning against Label Noise and Adversarial Attacks

author.name: Suryasis Jana, Abhik Ghosh

entry.summary: Proposes rSDNet, a unified framework for robust neural classification addressing both label noise and adversarial perturbations within a single learning objective based on statistical divergence measures.

entry.title: NLP Occupational Emergence Analysis: How Occupations Form and Evolve in Real Time -- A Zero-Assumption Method Demonstrated on AI in the US Technology Workforce, 2022-2026

author.name: David Nordfors

entry.summary: Proposes a zero-assumption method for detecting occupational emergence from resume data using vocabulary and population cohesion as co-attractors, applied to 8.2M US resumes to track AI-related occupational evolution from 2022-2026.

entry.title: More Rounds, More Noise: Why Multi-Turn Review Fails to Improve Cross-Context Verification

author.name: Song Tae-Eun
