entry.title: LLM-Driven Discovery of High-Entropy Catalysts via Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: AI Scientists, Xinyi Lin, Danqing Yin, Ying Guo

entry.summary: Demonstrates using RAG-augmented GPT-4 for catalyst discovery, generating 250+ candidates with 82% thermodynamic stability rate for CO2 reduction, accessing a database of 50,000+ known materials.

entry.title: CorrectionPlanner: Self-Correction Planner with Reinforcement Learning in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Yihong Guo, Dongqiangzi Ye, Sijia Chen, Anqi Liu, Xianming Liu

entry.summary: Proposes CorrectionPlanner for autonomous driving, an autoregressive planner with self-correction that uses a learned collision critic to evaluate proposed motion tokens and generates corrections conditioned on the history of unsafe proposals.

entry.title: 100x Cost & Latency Reduction: Performance Analysis of AI Query Approximation using Lightweight Proxy Models

author.name: Yeounoh Chung, Rushabh Desai, Jian He, Yu Xiao, Thibaud Hottelier, Yves-Laurent Kom Samo, Pushkar Kadilkar, Xianshun Chen, Sam Idicula, Fatma \"Ozcan, Alon Halevy, Yannis Papakonstantinou

entry.summary: Evaluates AI query approximation using lightweight proxy models to achieve 100x cost and latency reduction for LLM-powered SQL queries over structured and unstructured data, grounding results in a recent query approximation approach.

entry.title: Aligning Paralinguistic Understanding and Generation in Speech LLMs via Multi-Task Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Jingxiang Chen, Minseok Kim, Seong-Gyun Leem, Yin Huang, Rashi Rungta, Zhicheng Ouyang, Haibin Wu, Surya Teja Appini, Ankur Bansal, Yang Bai, Yue Liu, Florian Metze, Ahmed A Aly, Anuj Kumar, Ariya Rastrow, Zhaojiang Lin

entry.summary: Proposes multi-task RL with chain-of-thought prompting for speech LLMs to align paralinguistic understanding and generation, introducing PALLM that jointly optimizes sentiment classification and paralinguistics-aware response generation.

entry.title: CounterRefine: Answer-Conditioned Counterevidence Retrieval for Inference-Time Knowledge Repair in Factual Question Answering

author.name: Tianyi Huang, Ying Kai Deng

entry.summary: Presents CounterRefine, a lightweight inference-time repair layer for retrieval-augmented QA that produces a draft answer, gathers conflicting evidence, and applies a restricted refinement step with deterministic validation.

entry.title: ASDA: Automated Skill Distillation and Adaptation for Financial Reasoning

author.name: Tik Yu Yim, Wenting Tan, Sum Yee Chan, Tak-Wah Lam, Siu Ming Yiu

entry.summary: Introduces ASDA, a training-free framework that automatically generates structured skill artifacts through iterative error-corrective learning for financial reasoning, where a teacher model analyzes student failures and creates reusable skill patterns.

entry.title: VisBrowse-Bench: Benchmarking Visual-Native Search for Multimodal Browsing Agents

author.name: Zhengbo Zhang, Jinbo Su, Zhaowen Zhou, Changtao Miao, Yuhan Hong, Qimeng Wu, Yumeng Liu, Feier Wu, Yihe Tian, Yuhao Liang, Zitong Shan, Wanke Xia, Yi-Fan Zhang, Bo Zhang, Zhe Li, Shiming Xiang, Ying Yan

entry.summary: Introduces VisBrowse-Bench, a benchmark for visual-native search evaluating multimodal browsing agents' visual reasoning capabilities through text-image cross-validation, containing 169 VQA instances across multiple domains.

entry.title: Trained Persistent Memory for Frozen Encoder--Decoder LLMs: Six Architectural Methods

author.name: Hong Jeong

entry.summary: Proof-of-concept study showing persistent memory in frozen encoder-decoder LLMs is feasible through six architectural methods using trained adapters, enabling memory to accumulate at inference time without gradient descent.

entry.title: EngGPT2: Sovereign, Efficient and Open Intelligence

author.name: G. Ciarfaglia, A. Rosanova, S. Cipolla, J. Bartoli, A. Di Domenico, C. Fioroni, A. Fontana, M. R. Scoleri, M. I. Mone, D. Franchi, M. C. Del Gaudio, F. Picariello, M. Gabusi, S. Bonura, V. Morreale, I. Bailo

entry.summary: Introduces EngGPT2-16B-A3B, an Italian MoE LLM trained from scratch on 2.5T tokens, achieving performance comparable to 8B-16B dense models while requiring 1/5 inference power and 1/10 training data.

entry.title: SparkVSR: Interactive Video Super-Resolution via Sparse Keyframe Propagation

author.name: Jiongze Yu, Xiangbo Gao, Pooja Verlani, Akshay Gadde, Yilin Wang, Balu Adsumilli, Zhengzhong Tu

entry.summary: Proposes SparkVSR, an interactive video super-resolution framework where users can correct artifacts by super-resolving sparse keyframes, which are then propagated to the full video sequence.

entry.title: Determinism in the Undetermined: Deterministic Output in Charge-Conserving Continuous-Time Neuromorphic Systems with Temporal Stochasticity

author.name: Jing Yan, Kang You, Zhezhi He, Yaoyu Zhang

entry.summary: Develops a continuous-time framework for SNNs coupling charge conservation with neuron-level constraints, proving that terminal states depend only on aggregate input charge, yielding deterministic outputs despite temporal stochasticity.

entry.title: Learning Lineage-guided Geodesics with Finsler Geometry

author.name: Aaron Zweig, Mingxuan Zhang, David A. Knowles, Elham Azizi

entry.summary: Introduces a Finsler metric combining continuous geometry with discrete directed prior knowledge (e.g., lineage trees) for trajectory inference in developmental biology and other dynamical systems.

entry.title: Deep Adaptive Model-Based Design of Experiments

author.name: Arno Strouwen, Sebastian Miclu\c{t}a-C\^ampeanu

entry.summary: Combines Deep Adaptive Design (amortized sequential experimental design) with differentiable mechanistic models for model-based design of experiments in nonlinear dynamical systems, enabling real-time adaptive experimentation.

entry.title: PashtoCorp: A 1.25-Billion-Word Corpus, Evaluation Suite, and Reproducible Pipeline for Low-Resource Language Development

author.name: Hanif Rahman

entry.summary: Presents PashtoCorp, a 1.25-billion-word corpus for Pashto (40x larger than OSCAR Pashto), assembled from 39 sources with a reproducible pipeline. Shows 25% perplexity reduction and 10% NER F1 improvement from continued pre-training.

entry.title: POLAR:A Per-User Association Test in Embedding Space

author.name: Pedro Bento, Arthur Buzelin, Arthur Chagas, Yan Aquino, Victoria Estanislau, Samira Malaquias, Pedro Robles Dutenhefner, Gisele L. Pappa, Virgilio Almeida, Wagner MeiraJr

entry.summary: Proposes POLAR, a per-user lexical association test in embedding space that uses private deterministic tokens to probe individual-level biases, distinguishing LLM bots from humans and quantifying extremist alignment.

entry.title: On the Emotion Understanding of Synthesized Speech

author.name: Yuan Ge, Haishu Zhao, Aokai Hao, Junxiang Zhang, Bei Li, Xiaoqian Liu, Chenglong Wang, Jianjin Wang, Bingsen Zhou, Bingyu Liu, Jingbo Zhu, Zhengtao Yu, Tong Xiao

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates speech emotion recognition on synthesized speech and finds current SER models cannot generalize to synthesized speech due to representation mismatch induced by speech token prediction during synthesis.

entry.title: AdaMem: Adaptive User-Centric Memory for Long-Horizon Dialogue Agents

author.name: Shannan Yan, Jingchen Ni, Leqi Zheng, Jiajun Zhang, Peixi Wu, Dacheng Yin, Jing Lyu, Chun Yuan, Fengyun Rao

entry.summary: Proposes AdaMem, an adaptive memory framework for long-horizon dialogue agents that organizes history into working, episodic, persona, and graph memories with adaptive granularity for different question types.

entry.title: BrainBench: Exposing the Commonsense Reasoning Gap in Large Language Models

author.name: Yuzhe Tang

entry.summary: Introduces BrainBench, a 100-question benchmark targeting commonsense reasoning failures in LLMs across 20 categories. The best model (Claude Opus 4.6 with extended thinking) achieves only 80.3% accuracy on questions humans answer trivially.

entry.title: EFF-Grasp: Energy-Field Flow Matching for Physics-Aware Dexterous Grasp Generation

author.name: Yukun Zhao, Zichen Zhong, Yongshun Gong, Yilong Yin, Haoliang Sun

entry.summary: EFF-Grasp reformulates dexterous grasp generation as a deterministic ODE process using flow matching instead of stochastic diffusion, achieving more efficient and physically plausible grasp synthesis with energy-field guidance.

entry.title: DriveFix: Spatio-Temporally Coherent Driving Scene Restoration

author.name: Heyu Si, Brandon James Denis, Muyang Sun, Dragos Datcu, Yaoru Li, Xin Jin, Ruiju Fu, Yuliia Tatarinova, Federico Landi, Jie Song, Mingli Song, Qi Guo

entry.summary: DriveFix proposes a multi-view restoration framework for driving scenes using an interleaved diffusion transformer with specialized blocks for temporal and cross-camera spatial consistency, conditioning on historical context.

entry.title: Iris: Bringing Real-World Priors into Diffusion Model for Monocular Depth Estimation

author.name: Xinhao Cai, Gensheng Pei, Zeren Sun, Yazhou Yao, Fumin Shen, Wenguan Wang

entry.summary: Iris proposes a deterministic diffusion-based monocular depth estimation framework with a two-stage Priors-to-Geometry schedule that uses spectral-gated distillation for real-world prior transfer and geometric refinement.

entry.title: ProgressiveAvatars: Progressive Animatable 3D Gaussian Avatars

author.name: Kaiwen Song, Jinkai Cui, Juyong Zhang

entry.summary: ProgressiveAvatars builds a progressive hierarchy of 3D Gaussians on a template mesh with adaptive subdivision, supporting incremental loading and rendering at multiple detail levels for real-time XR applications.

entry.title: Rethinking Pose Refinement in 3D Gaussian Splatting under Pose Prior and Geometric Uncertainty

author.name: Mangyu Kong, Jaewon Lee, Seongwon Lee, Euntai Kim

entry.summary: This paper analyzes pose refinement limitations in 3D Gaussian Splatting, identifying pose prior uncertainty and geometric uncertainty as two major failure modes. It proposes solutions to handle both sources of uncertainty for more robust visual localization.

entry.title: HeBA: Heterogeneous Bottleneck Adapters for Robust Vision-Language Models

author.name: Md Jahidul Islam

entry.summary: HeBA proposes heterogeneous bottleneck adapters for CLIP that use modality-specific structural inductive biases—2D convolutions for visual tokens and 1D convolutions for text tokens—rather than uniform adapters.

entry.title: Search2Motion: Training-Free Object-Level Motion Control via Attention-Consensus Search

author.name: Sainan Liu, Tz-Ying Wu, Hector A Valdez, Subarna Tripathi

entry.summary: Search2Motion presents a training-free framework for object-level motion editing in image-to-video generation that uses target-frame-based control and attention consensus for seed selection, without requiring trajectories or masks.

entry.title: Linearized Bregman Iterations for Sparse Spiking Neural Networks

author.name: Daniel Windhager, Bernhard A. Moser, Michael Lunglmayr

entry.summary: Introduces Linearized Bregman Iterations as an optimizer for training sparse spiking neural networks, achieving significant parameter reduction (up to 90%) while maintaining competitive accuracy on neuromorphic benchmarks.

entry.title: Enabling Dynamic Tracking in Vision-Language-Action Models via Time-Discrete and Time-Continuous Velocity Feedforward

author.name: Johannes Hechtl, Philipp Schmitt, Georg von Wichert, Wolfram Burgard

entry.summary: Demonstrates the importance of velocity feedforward terms in VLA policies for industrial robot deployment, proposing time-discrete and time-continuous methods for extracting velocity targets from VLAs.

entry.title: OGScene3D: Incremental Open-Vocabulary 3D Gaussian Scene Graph Mapping for Scene Understanding

author.name: Siting Zhu, Ziyun Lu, Guangming Wang, Chenguang Huang, Yongbo Chen, I-Ming Chen, Wolfram Burgard, Hesheng Wang

entry.summary: OGScene3D enables incremental open-vocabulary 3D scene understanding with Gaussian semantic representation and scene graph construction, supporting robotic exploration of unknown environments.

entry.title: Toward Deep Representation Learning for Event-Enhanced Visual Autonomous Perception: the eAP Dataset

author.name: Jinghang Li, Shichao Li, Qing Lian, Peiliang Li, Xiaozhi Chen, Yi Zhou

entry.summary: Presents eAP, the largest event camera dataset for autonomous perception with tasks including 3D vehicle detection and time-to-contact estimation, demonstrating event cameras' value for challenging illumination.

entry.title: LLMs as Giant Lookup-Tables of Shallow Circuits

author.name: niplav

entry.summary: Argues that current LLMs behave like 'giant lookup tables of shallow circuits'—exhibiting capable behavior without deep optimizer-like agent structure. Connects to mechanistic interpretability findings that models use shallow, composable circuits rather than coherent goal-directed reasoning.

entry.title: TRUST-SQL: Tool-Integrated Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning for Text-to-SQL over Unknown Schemas

author.name: Ai Jian, Xiaoyun Zhang, Wanrou Du, Jingqing Ruan, Jiangbo Pei, Weipeng Zhang, Ke Zeng, Xunliang Cai

entry.summary: Proposes TRUST-SQL for text-to-SQL with unknown schemas, formulated as a POMDP where agents actively discover relevant schema subsets rather than receiving the full schema upfront. Features a four-phase protocol with dual-mode RL training.

entry.title: Temporal Fact Conflicts in LLMs: Reproducibility Insights from Unifying DYNAMICQA and MULAN

author.name: Ritajit Dey, Iadh Ounis, Graham McDonald, Yashar Moshfeghi

entry.summary: A reproducibility study that reconciles contradictory findings from DYNAMICQA and MULAN on whether external context can resolve temporal fact conflicts in LLMs. Cross-evaluation reveals the source of discrepancy lies in dataset and evaluation differences.

entry.title: Understanding Cell Fate Decisions with Temporal Attention

author.name: Florian B\"urger, Martim Dias Gomes, Adri\'an E. Granada, No\'emie Moreau, Katarzyna Bozek

entry.summary: Presents a Transformer-based deep learning approach for predicting cell fate from raw live-cell recordings of cancer cells under chemotherapy, with a comprehensive explainability framework for temporal and morphological cue interpretation.

entry.title: GDPO-SR: Group Direct Preference Optimization for One-Step Generative Image Super-Resolution

author.name: Qiaosi Yi, Shuai Li, Rongyuan Wu, Lingchen Sun, Zhengqiang Zhang, Lei Zhang

entry.summary: GDPO-SR introduces Group Direct Preference Optimization for one-step generative image super-resolution, combining insights from DPO and GRPO while adding patch-level likelihood computation for local detail preservation.

entry.title: FlowComposer: Composable Flows for Compositional Zero-Shot Learning

author.name: Zhenqi He, Lin Li, Long Chen

entry.summary: FlowComposer uses normalizing flows to create composable representations for compositional zero-shot learning, addressing limitations of implicit composition and feature entanglement in existing PEFT-based approaches.

entry.title: AIDABench: AI Data Analytics Benchmark

author.name: Yibo Yang, Fei Lei, Yixuan Sun, Yantao Zeng, Chengguang Lv, Jiancao Hong, Jiaojiao Tian, Tianyu Qiu, Xin Wang, Yanbing Chen, Yanjie Li, Zheng Pan, Xiaochen Zhou, Guanzhou Chen, Haoran Lv, Yuning Xu, Yue Ou, Haodong Liu, Shiqi He, Anya Jia, Yulei Xin, Huan Wu, Liang Liu, Jiaye Ge, Jianxin Dong, Dahua Lin, Wenxiu Sun

entry.summary: Introduces AIDABench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating AI systems on complex data analytics tasks end-to-end, with 600+ diverse document analysis tasks across question answering, data visualization, and file generation. Addresses the gap between isolated capability benchmarks and real-world multi-step workflows.

entry.title: An Agentic Evaluation Framework for AI-Generated Scientific Code in PETSc

author.name: Hong Zhang, Barry Smith, Satish Balay, Le Chen, Murat Keceli, Lois Curfman McInnes, Junchao Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces petscagent-bench, an agentic evaluation framework for AI-generated scientific code in PETSc (a major HPC library). Uses an agents-evaluating-agents paradigm with a tool-augmented evaluator agent that compiles, executes, and measures generated code across 14 evaluation dimensions.

entry.title: SQL-ASTRA: Alleviating Sparse Feedback in Agentic SQL via Column-Set Matching and Trajectory Aggregation

author.name: Long Li, Zhijian Zhou, Jiangxuan Long, Peiyang Liu, Weidi Xu, Zhe Wang, Shirui Pan, Chao Qu

entry.summary: Proposes SQL-ASTRA for agentic text-to-SQL with a two-tiered reward mechanism addressing the credit assignment problem in multi-turn RL. Introduces Aggregated Trajectory Reward and column-set matching for dense step-level signals.

entry.title: BenchPreS: A Benchmark for Context-Aware Personalized Preference Selectivity of Persistent-Memory LLMs

author.name: Sangyeon Yoon, Sunkyoung Kim, Hyesoo Hong, Wonje Jeung, Yongil Kim, Wooseok Seo, Heuiyeen Yeen, Albert No

entry.summary: Introduces BenchPreS to evaluate whether LLMs with persistent memory appropriately apply or suppress stored user preferences across different communication contexts. Finds frontier LLMs struggle with context-sensitive preference application.

entry.title: DASH: Dynamic Audio-Driven Semantic Chunking for Efficient Omnimodal Token Compression

author.name: Bingzhou Li, Tao Huang

entry.summary: Proposes DASH, a training-free token compression framework for omnimodal LLMs that uses audio embeddings as semantic anchors to detect natural boundary points for dynamic, variable-length chunking of multimodal token sequences.

entry.title: Loosely-Structured Software: Engineering Context, Structure, and Evolution Entropy in Runtime-Rewired Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Weihao Zhang, Yitong Zhou, Huanyu Qu, Hongyi Li

entry.summary: Introduces Loosely-Structured Software (LSS), a new software engineering paradigm for LLM-based multi-agent systems that addresses context pressure, coordination errors, and system drift as agent count scales, drawing on object-oriented programming principles.

entry.title: BadLLM-TG: A Backdoor Defender powered by LLM Trigger Generator

author.name: Ruyi Zhang, Heng Gao, Songlei Jian, Yusong Tan, Haifang Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes BadLLM-TG, using LLMs as trigger generators for backdoor defense in NLP, optimized through prompt-driven RL with the victim model's feedback loss as reward. Generated triggers are used for adversarial training to mitigate backdoors.

entry.title: This Is Taking Too Long -- Investigating Time as a Proxy for Energy Consumption of LLMs

author.name: Lars Krupp, Daniel Gei{\ss}ler, Francisco M. Calatrava-Nicolas, Vishal Banwari, Paul Lukowicz, Jakob Karolus

entry.summary: Investigates whether inference time can serve as a proxy for energy consumption of API-based LLMs, showing that time measurements can help infer GPU models and ground energy cost estimations when direct measurement is impossible.

entry.title: Embedding-Aware Feature Discovery: Bridging Latent Representations and Interpretable Features in Event Sequences

author.name: Artem Sakhno, Ivan Sergeev, Alexey Shestov, Omar Zoloev, Elizaveta Kovtun, Gleb Gusev, Andrey Savchenko, Maksim Makarenko

entry.summary: Introduces Embedding-Aware Feature Discovery (EAFD), bridging pretrained event-sequence embeddings with interpretable handcrafted features using an LLM-driven feature generation agent for financial systems.

entry.title: Informationally Compressive Anonymization: Non-Degrading Sensitive Input Protection for Privacy-Preserving Supervised Machine Learning

author.name: Jeremy J Samuelson

entry.summary: Introduces Informationally Compressive Anonymization (ICA) and VEIL architecture for privacy-preserving ML that achieves privacy through architectural design rather than noise injection or cryptography, using supervised multi-objective encoding in a trusted environment.

entry.title: Generative AI for Quantum Circuits and Quantum Code: A Technical Review and Taxonomy

author.name: Juhani Merilehto

entry.summary: Reviews 13 generative systems and 5 datasets for quantum circuit/code generation, organizing them by artifact type and training regime, finding that no reviewed system reports end-to-end hardware executability evaluation.

entry.title: Visual Prompt Discovery via Semantic Exploration

author.name: Jaechang Kim, Yotaro Shimose, Zhao Wang, Kuang-Da Wang, Jungseul Ok, Shingo Takamatsu

entry.summary: Proposes an automated semantic exploration framework for discovering task-wise visual prompts for LVLMs, replacing manual human trial-and-error with systematic exploration to mitigate perception failures.

entry.title: SF-Mamba: Rethinking State Space Model for Vision

author.name: Masakazu Yoshimura, Teruaki Hayashi, Yuki Hoshino, Wei-Yao Wang, Takeshi Ohashi

entry.summary: Proposes SF-Mamba, rethinking the scan operation for vision Mamba models to address inefficiencies in multi-scan strategies and slow computational speed under short token lengths common in visual tasks.

entry.title: EmoLLM: Appraisal-Grounded Cognitive-Emotional Co-Reasoning in Large Language Models

author.name: Yifei Zhang, Mingyang Li, Henry Gao, Liang Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes EmoLLM, an appraisal-theory-grounded framework for IQ/EQ co-reasoning in LLM dialogue, using explicit Appraisal Reasoning Graphs to structure reasoning over user needs, appraisal dimensions, and emotional states.

entry.title: Federated Learning with Multi-Partner OneFlorida+ Consortium Data for Predicting Major Postoperative Complications

author.name: Yuanfang Ren, Varun Sai Vemuri, Zhenhong Hu, Benjamin Shickel, Ziyuan Guan, Tyler J. Loftus, Parisa Rashidi, Tezcan Ozrazgat-Baslanti, Azra Bihorac

entry.summary: Develops federated learning models for predicting major postoperative complications using 358K patients across 5 healthcare institutions, demonstrating robust generalizability while preserving data privacy.

entry.title: How to Achieve Prototypical Birth and Death for OOD Detection?

author.name: Ningkang Peng, Qianfeng Yu, Xiaoqian Peng, Linjing Qian, Yafei Liu, Canran Xiao, Xinyu Lu, Tingyu Lu, Zhichao Zheng, Yanhui Gu

entry.summary: Proposes PID (Prototype Birth and Death), a method that adaptively adjusts prototype count for OOD detection based on data complexity, inspired by biological cell birth and death processes.

entry.title: Longitudinal Risk Prediction in Mammography with Privileged History Distillation

author.name: Banafsheh Karimian, Alexis Guichemerre, Soufiane Belharbi, Natacha Gillet, Luke McCaffrey, Mohammadhadi Shateri, Eric Granger

entry.summary: Proposes a longitudinal mammography risk prediction model using privileged history distillation to handle missing prior exams at test time, leveraging longitudinal data during training.

entry.title: DISCOVER: A Solver for Distributional Counterfactual Explanations

author.name: Yikai Gu, Lele Cao, Bo Zhao, Lei Lei, Lei You

entry.summary: Introduces DISCOVER, a model-agnostic solver for distributional counterfactual explanations that works with non-differentiable models while preserving optimal transport objectives and statistical certification.

entry.title: Optimal uncertainty bounds for multivariate kernel regression under bounded noise: A Gaussian process-based dual function

author.name: Amon Lahr, Anna Scampicchio, Johannes K\"ohler, Melanie N. Zeilinger

entry.summary: Presents tight, distribution-free uncertainty bounds for multi-output kernel regression under bounded noise, using an unconstrained duality-based formulation compatible with downstream safe control tasks.

entry.title: A Practical Algorithm for Feature-Rich, Non-Stationary Bandit Problems

author.name: Wei Min Loh, Sajib Kumer Sinha, Ankur Agarwal, Pascal Poupart

entry.summary: Introduces C3 Thompson sampling for contextual bandits with dense arm features, non-linear rewards, and correlated but non-stationary reward distributions. Combines improved Nadaraya-Watson estimation with Thompson sampling for online learning without retraining.

entry.title: Beyond Distance: Quantifying Point Cloud Dynamics with Persistent Homology and Dynamic Optimal Transport

author.name: Yixin Wang, Ting Gao, Jinqiao Duan

entry.summary: Extends Topological Optimal Transport distance for analyzing topological tipping in time-evolutionary point clouds, with hierarchical dynamic evaluation and hypergraph reconstruction to detect transient structural reorganizations.

entry.title: Shuffling the Stochastic Mirror Descent via Dual Lipschitz Continuity and Kernel Conditioning

author.name: Junwen Qiu, Leilei Mei, Junyu Zhang

entry.summary: Extends convergence analysis of shuffled stochastic mirror descent beyond Lipschitz smoothness using dual Lipschitz continuity and kernel conditioning, enabling techniques like random reshuffling under relative smoothness.

entry.title: Controlling Fish Schools via Reinforcement Learning of Virtual Fish Movement

author.name: Yusuke Nishii, Hiroaki Kawashima

entry.summary: Uses reinforcement learning to train virtual fish displayed on screens to guide real fish schools toward target directions, overcoming limitations of physical robotic agents. Real-world experiments confirm successful guidance.

entry.title: CTG-DB: An Ontology-Based Transformation of ClinicalTrials.gov to Enable Cross-Trial Drug Safety Analyses

author.name: Jeffery L. Painter, Fran\c{c}ois Haguinet, Andrew Bate

entry.summary: Presents CTG-DB, an open-source pipeline that transforms ClinicalTrials.gov XML data into a relational database with standardized adverse event terminology using MedDRA, enabling cross-trial drug safety analyses.

entry.title: BANGLASOCIALBENCH: A Benchmark for Evaluating Sociopragmatic and Cultural Alignment of LLMs in Bangladeshi Social Interaction

author.name: Tanvir Ahmed Sijan, S. M Golam Rifat, Pankaj Chowdhury Partha, Md. Tanjeed Islam, Md. Musfique Anwar

entry.summary: Introduces BANGLASOCIALBENCH, the first benchmark for evaluating sociopragmatic competence of LLMs in Bangla, testing context-dependent language use across address terms, kinship reasoning, and social customs.

entry.title: Diverging Transformer Predictions for Human Sentence Processing: A Comprehensive Analysis of Agreement Attraction Effects

author.name: Titus von der Malsburg, Sebastian Pad\'o

entry.summary: Evaluates eleven autoregressive transformers on agreement attraction configurations in English, finding models align with human reading times for prepositional phrases but fail significantly on object-extracted relative clauses.

entry.title: Domain Mixture Design via Log-Likelihood Differences for Aligning Language Models with a Target Model

author.name: Ryo Kishino, Riku Shiomi, Hiroaki Yamagiwa, Momose Oyama, Hidetoshi Shimodaira

entry.summary: Proposes a method to align a base language model toward a target model by optimizing domain mixture weights in training data, using log-likelihood space geometry rather than direct distillation. Experiments with NanoGPT show consistent KL divergence reduction compared to uniform weighting.

entry.title: CLRNet: Targetless Extrinsic Calibration for Camera, Lidar and 4D Radar Using Deep Learning

author.name: Marcell Kegl, Andras Palffy, Csaba Benedek, Dariu M. Gavrila

entry.summary: Proposes CLRNet, an end-to-end deep learning network for joint calibration of camera, lidar, and 4D radar sensors without calibration targets. Achieves superior accuracy on the View-of-Delft and Dual-Radar datasets.

entry.title: ModTrack: Sensor-Agnostic Multi-View Tracking via Identity-Informed PHD Filtering with Covariance Propagation

author.name: Aditya Iyer, Jack Roberts, Nora Ayanian

entry.summary: ModTrack proposes a modular multi-view multi-object tracking system using PHD filtering with covariance propagation that matches end-to-end performance while generalizing across sensor layouts and modalities without retraining.

entry.title: Out-of-Distribution Object Detection in Street Scenes via Synthetic Outlier Exposure and Transfer Learning

author.name: Sadia Ilyas, Annika M\"utze, Klaus Friedrichs, Thomas Kurbiel, Matthias Rottmann

entry.summary: SynOE-OD enables a single object detector to identify OOD objects alongside in-distribution ones using synthetic outlier exposure and transfer learning, addressing the problem of OOD objects being silently treated as background.

entry.title: Segmentation-before-Staining Improves Structural Fidelity in Virtual IHC-to-Multiplex IF Translation

author.name: Junhyeok Lee, Han Jang, Heeseong Eum, Joon Jang, Kyu Sung Choi

entry.summary: Proposes a segmentation-before-staining approach for virtual IHC-to-multiplex IF translation that constrains nuclear morphology during synthesis, preventing clinically consequential distortions in cell quantification metrics like Ki67 index.

entry.title: Reliable Reasoning in SVG-LLMs via Multi-Task Multi-Reward Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Haomin Wang, Qi Wei, Qianli Ma, Shengyuan Ding, Jinhui Yin, Kai Chen, Hongjie Zhang

entry.summary: CTRL-S introduces chain-of-thought reasoning for SVG generation via reinforcement learning, with a multi-task multi-reward framework. Constructs SVG-Sophia, a 145K sample dataset across SVG tasks.

entry.title: Leveling3D: Leveling Up 3D Reconstruction with Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting and Geometry-Aware Generation

author.name: Yiming Huang, Baixiang Huang, Beilei Cui, Chi Kit Ng, Long Bai, Hongliang Ren

entry.summary: Leveling3D integrates feed-forward 3D reconstruction with geometry-consistent diffusion generation using a lightweight leveling adapter that aligns diffusion model knowledge with geometric priors for holistic reconstruction and generation.

entry.title: PureCLIP-Depth: Prompt-Free and Decoder-Free Monocular Depth Estimation within CLIP Embedding Space

author.name: Ryutaro Miya, Kazuyoshi Fushinobu, Tatsuya Kawaguchi

entry.summary: PureCLIP-Depth performs monocular depth estimation entirely within CLIP embedding space without prompts or decoders, learning a direct RGB-to-depth mapping in the conceptual space. Achieves SOTA among CLIP-based depth models.

entry.title: SpikeCLR: Contrastive Self-Supervised Learning for Few-Shot Event-Based Vision using Spiking Neural Networks

author.name: Maxime Vaillant, Axel Carlier, Lai Xing Ng, Christophe Hurter, Benoit R. Cottereau

entry.summary: SpikeCLR introduces contrastive self-supervised learning for spiking neural networks to learn visual representations from unlabeled event camera data, enabling few-shot learning on neuromorphic hardware.

entry.title: HGP-Mamba: Integrating Histology and Generated Protein Features for Mamba-based Multimodal Survival Risk Prediction

author.name: Jing Dai, Chen Wu, Ming Wu, Qibin Zhang, Zexi Wu, Jingdong Zhang, Hongming Xu

entry.summary: HGP-Mamba integrates histopathology images with generated protein features using a Mamba-based architecture for survival prediction, deriving protein embeddings directly from WSIs to avoid expensive protein profiling.

entry.title: ACPV-Net: All-Class Polygonal Vectorization for Seamless Vector Map Generation from Aerial Imagery

author.name: Weiqin Jiao, Hao Cheng, George Vosselman, Claudio Persello

entry.summary: ACPV-Net formalizes all-class polygonal vectorization from aerial imagery as a single unified task, producing topologically consistent vector maps without gaps or overlaps, and releases the first public benchmark for this task.

entry.title: Mixture of Style Experts for Diverse Image Stylization

author.name: Shihao Zhu, Ziheng Ouyang, Yijia Kang, Qilong Wang, Mi Zhou, Bo Li, Ming-Ming Cheng, Qibin Hou

entry.summary: StyleExpert introduces a mixture-of-experts framework for diverse image stylization that handles multiple semantic levels of style transfer, using a unified style encoder trained on content-style-stylized triplets.

entry.title: GLANCE: Gaze-Led Attention Network for Compressed Edge-inference

author.name: Neeraj Solanki, Hong Ding, Sepehr Tabrizchi, Ali Shafiee Sarvestani, Shaahin Angizi, David Z. Pan, Arman Roohi

entry.summary: GLANCE proposes a gaze-led attention pipeline for AR/VR that combines weightless neural networks for ultra-efficient gaze estimation (393 MACs per frame) with attention-guided selective object detection, reducing compute by 40-50%.

entry.title: SignNav: Leveraging Signage for Semantic Visual Navigation in Large-Scale Indoor Environments

author.name: Jian Sun, Yuming Huang, He Li, Shuqi Xiao, Shenyan Guo, Maani Ghaffari, Qingbiao Li, Chengzhong Xu, Hui Kong

entry.summary: SignNav introduces an embodied navigation task requiring agents to interpret semantic hints from signage in large-scale indoor environments, with a new dataset and specialized agent architecture.

entry.title: Ultrafast Sampling-based Kinodynamic Planning via Differential Flatness

author.name: Thai Duong, Clayton W. Ramsey, Zachary Kingston, Wil Thomason, Lydia E. Kavraki

entry.summary: Presents ultrafast kinodynamic motion planning using differential flatness to avoid solving boundary value problems, enabling microsecond-scale planning for high-DOF robots.

entry.title: ADAPT: Adaptive Dual-projection Architecture for Perceptive Traversal

author.name: Shuo Shao, Tianchen Huang, Wei Gao, Shiwu Zhang

entry.summary: ADAPT proposes a dual-projection architecture for humanoid locomotion using horizontal elevation maps and vertical distance maps, with learnable sensing range as a policy action.

entry.title: Reconciling distributed compliance with high-performance control in continuum soft robotics

author.name: Vito Daniele Perfetta, Daniel Feliu Talegon, Ebrahim Shahabi, Cosimo Della Santina

entry.summary: Challenges the prevailing assumption that distributed softness and dynamic precision are incompatible in continuum soft robots. Demonstrates high-performance closed-loop control on a truly soft manipulator, rather than the stiff piecewise architectures typically used.

entry.title: Face2Scene: Using Facial Degradation as an Oracle for Diffusion-Based Scene Restoration

author.name: Amirhossein Kazerouni, Maitreya Suin, Tristan Aumentado-Armstrong, Sina Honari, Amanpreet Walia, Iqbal Mohomed, Konstantinos G. Derpanis, Babak Taati, Alex Levinshtein

entry.summary: Face2Scene proposes a two-stage restoration framework that uses face degradation as a perceptual oracle to estimate scene-wide degradation and guide full-image restoration, extending beyond face-only restoration to the entire scene.

entry.title: Neural Pushforward Samplers for the Fokker-Planck Equation on Embedded Riemannian Manifolds

author.name: Andrew Qing He, Wei Cai

entry.summary: Extends the Weak Adversarial Neural Pushforward method to solve Fokker-Planck equations on compact Riemannian manifolds, using neural pushforward maps constrained to the manifold through retraction.

entry.title: Selective Memory for Artificial Intelligence: Write-Time Gating with Hierarchical Archiving

author.name: Oliver Zahn, Simran Chana

entry.summary: Introduces write-time gating for AI memory that filters incoming knowledge using composite salience scores (source reputation, novelty, reliability) while maintaining version chains. Achieves 100% accuracy vs 13% for ungated stores, with critical robustness under distractor scaling.

entry.title: FactorEngine: A Program-level Knowledge-Infused Factor Mining Framework for Quantitative Investment

author.name: Qinhong Lin, Ruitao Feng, Yinglun Feng, Zhenxin Huang, Yukun Chen, Zhongliang Yang, Linna Zhou, Binjie Fei, Jiaqi Liu, Yu Li

entry.summary: Introduces FactorEngine, a program-level alpha factor discovery framework for quantitative investment that casts factors as Turing-complete code and uses LLM-guided directional search combined with Bayesian optimization. Separates logic revision from parameter optimization.

entry.title: Runtime Governance for AI Agents: Policies on Paths

author.name: Maurits Kaptein, Vassilis-Javed Khan, Andriy Podstavnychy

entry.summary: Formalizes runtime governance for AI agents as compliance policies over execution paths, showing that prompt-level instructions and static access control are special cases. Treats the execution path as the central object for governance.

entry.title: MedCL-Bench: Benchmarking stability-efficiency trade-offs and scaling in biomedical continual learning

author.name: Min Zeng, Shuang Zhou, Zaifu Zhan, Rui Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces MedCL-Bench, a continual learning benchmark for biomedical NLP with 10 datasets across 5 task families, evaluating 11 CL strategies across 8 task orders with compute-aware reporting.

entry.title: Attribution-Guided Model Rectification of Unreliable Neural Network Behaviors

author.name: Peiyu Yang, Naveed Akhtar, Jiantong Jiang, Ajmal Mian

entry.summary: Proposes an attribution-guided framework using rank-one model editing to locate and correct unreliable neural network behaviors on corrupted inputs, reducing reliance on large clean datasets for model rectification.

entry.title: Tackling Over-smoothing on Hypergraphs: A Ricci Flow-guided Neural Diffusion Approach

author.name: Mengyao Zhou, Zhiheng Zhou, Xiao Han, Xingqin Qi, Guanghui Wang, Guiying Yan

entry.summary: Proposes Ricci Flow-guided Hypergraph Neural Diffusion (RFHND) to address over-smoothing in hypergraph neural networks, theoretically establishing that discrete Ricci flow can regulate node feature evolution on hypergraphs.

entry.title: When Stability Fails: Hidden Failure Modes Of LLMS in Data-Constrained Scientific Decision-Making

author.name: Nazia Riasat

entry.summary: Introduces a framework separating four dimensions of LLM decision-making (stability, correctness, prompt sensitivity, output validity) for scientific tasks, showing that stability does not guarantee correctness in data-constrained scientific workflows.

entry.title: Counteractive RL: Rethinking Core Principles for Efficient and Scalable Deep Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Ezgi Korkmaz

entry.summary: Introduces Counteractive RL, a theoretically-founded paradigm for efficient exploration in high-dimensional MDPs based on experiences from counteractive actions, providing theoretical basis for accelerated learning in complex environments.

entry.title: RadAnnotate: Large Language Models for Efficient and Reliable Radiology Report Annotation

author.name: Saisha Pradeep Shetty, Roger Eric Goldman, Vladimir Filkov

entry.summary: Presents RadAnnotate, an LLM-based framework for radiology report annotation that uses RAG-guided synthetic reports and confidence-based selective automation to reduce expert labeling effort, showing synthetic-only models remain within 1-2 F1 points of gold-trained models.

entry.title: LICA: Layered Image Composition Annotations for Graphic Design Research

author.name: Elad Hirsch, Shubham Yadav, Mohit Garg, Purvanshi Mehta

entry.summary: Introduces LICA, a large-scale dataset of 1.55M multi-layer graphic design compositions with rich per-element metadata spanning 20 design categories, also introducing graphic design video as a new challenge for VLMs.

entry.title: 360{\deg} Image Perception with MLLMs: A Comprehensive Benchmark and a Training-Free Method

author.name: Huyen T. T. Tran, Van-Quang Nguyen, Farros Alferro, Kang-Jun Liu, Takayuki Okatani

entry.summary: Introduces 360Bench, a VQA benchmark for 360° image perception by MLLMs with 7K-resolution images and seven sub-tasks, along with a training-free method to improve MLLM performance on panoramic images.

entry.title: AW-MoE: All-Weather Mixture of Experts for Robust Multi-Modal 3D Object Detection

author.name: Hongwei Lin, Xun Huang, Chenglu Wen, Cheng Wang

entry.summary: Introduces AW-MoE for robust multi-modal 3D object detection under adverse weather, using image-guided weather-aware routing to select weather-specific experts, addressing performance conflicts from mixed weather training.

entry.title: DynamicGate MLP Conditional Computation via Learned Structural Dropout and Input Dependent Gating for Functional Plasticity

author.name: Yong Il Choi

entry.summary: Proposes DynamicGate-MLP, a framework unifying dropout regularization with conditional computation through learned input-dependent gates that decide whether to use each unit, enabling sample-dependent execution.

entry.title: Evaluating Black-Box Vulnerabilities with Wasserstein-Constrained Data Perturbations

author.name: Adriana Laurindo Monteiro, Jean-Michel Loubes

entry.summary: Applies optimal transport theory to analyze ML model vulnerability by finding the closest Wasserstein-constrained distribution perturbation that changes model behavior.

entry.title: Physics-integrated neural differentiable modeling for immersed boundary systems

author.name: Chenglin Li, Hang Xu, Jianting Chen, Yanfei Zhang

entry.summary: Extends neural PDE solvers with physics-integrated differentiable framework for immersed-boundary flow prediction, structurally integrating physical principles for long-horizon stability.

entry.title: Deep Tabular Representation Corrector

author.name: Hangting Ye, Peng Wang, Wei Fan, Xiaozhuang Song, He Zhao, Dandan Gun, Yi Chang

entry.summary: Proposes a deep tabular representation corrector that improves learned representations post-hoc without requiring training from scratch or pre-training, applicable to various deep tabular learning methods.

entry.title: Simplex-to-Euclidean Bijection for Conjugate and Calibrated Multiclass Gaussian Process

author.name: Bernardo Williams, Harsha Vardhan Tetali, Arto Klami, Marcelo Hartmann

entry.summary: Proposes a conjugate Gaussian process model for multi-class classification using Aitchison geometry to map simplex probabilities to Euclidean space, enabling conjugate inference with fewer latent dimensions.

entry.title: S2Act: Simple Spiking Actor

author.name: Ugur Akcal, Seung Hyun Kim, Mikihisa Yuasa, Hamid Osooli, Jiarui Sun, Ribhav Sahu, Mattia Gazzola, Huy T. Tran, Girish Chowdhary

entry.summary: Proposes S2Act, a lightweight framework for deploying RL policies using spiking neural networks on mobile robots, addressing SNN sensitivity to hyperparameters in complex environments through a three-step architect-train-convert pipeline.

entry.title: Safe Distributionally Robust Feature Selection under Covariate Shift

author.name: Hiroyuki Hanada, Satoshi Akahane, Noriaki Hashimoto, Shion Takeno, Ichiro Takeuchi

entry.summary: Studies distributionally robust feature selection under covariate shift for multi-sensor systems, providing safe screening rules to prune irrelevant features without solving the full optimization problem.

entry.title: Polyglot-Lion: Efficient Multilingual ASR for Singapore via Balanced Fine-Tuning of Qwen3-ASR

author.name: Quy-Anh Dang, Chris Ngo

entry.summary: Presents Polyglot-Lion, compact multilingual ASR models for Singapore's four languages by fine-tuning Qwen3-ASR with balanced sampling, achieving competitive performance to a 6x larger model at minimal training cost.

entry.title: RECOVER: Robust Entity Correction via agentic Orchestration of hypothesis Variants for Evidence-based Recovery

author.name: Abhishek Kumar, Aashraya Sachdeva

entry.summary: Introduces RECOVER, an agentic ASR correction framework that uses multiple hypotheses, entity retrieval, and LLM correction to fix rare and domain-specific entity errors in speech recognition.

entry.title: Tarab: A Multi-Dialect Corpus of Arabic Lyrics and Poetry

author.name: Mo El-Haj

entry.summary: Introduces the Tarab Corpus, a 2.56-million-verse, 13.5M-token corpus of Arabic song lyrics and poetry spanning Classical Arabic, MSA, and six regional varieties across 28 nation states and 14+ centuries.

entry.title: Domain Adaptation Without the Compute Burden for Efficient Whole Slide Image Analysis

author.name: Umar Marikkar, Muhammad Awais, Sara Atito

entry.summary: Addresses domain adaptation for whole slide image analysis by proposing a compute-efficient approach that avoids expensive domain-specific pre-training of feature extractors while adapting to histopathology.

entry.title: Speak, Segment, Track, Navigate: An Interactive System for Video-Guided Skull-Base Surgery

author.name: Jecia Z. Y. Mao, Francis X. Creighton, Russell H. Taylor, Manish Sahu

entry.summary: A speech-guided system for video-guided skull base surgery that integrates natural language interaction with real-time visual perception on intraoperative video, enabling surgeons to request computational assistance without disengaging from operative tasks.

entry.title: Learning Human-Object Interaction for 3D Human Pose Estimation from LiDAR Point Clouds

author.name: Daniel Sungho Jung, Dohee Cho, Kyoung Mu Lee

entry.summary: Proposes learning human-object interaction features for 3D human pose estimation from LiDAR, addressing spatial ambiguity between human and object points and class imbalance in interaction scenarios.

entry.title: Unified Removal of Raindrops and Reflections: A New Benchmark and A Novel Pipeline

author.name: Xingyu Liu, Zewei He, Yu Chen, Chunyu Zhu, Zixuan Chen, Xing Luo, Zhe-Ming Lu

entry.summary: Defines the unified removal of raindrops and reflections (UR³) task, constructs a real-shot dataset RDRF, and proposes DiffUR³, a diffusion-based framework for this composite image degradation problem.

entry.title: Evo-Retriever: LLM-Guided Curriculum Evolution with Viewpoint-Pathway Collaboration for Multimodal Document Retrieval

author.name: Weiqing Li, Jinyue Guo, Yaqi Wang, Haiyang Xiao, Yuewei Zhang, Guohua Liu, Hao Henry Wang

entry.summary: Evo-Retriever introduces an LLM-guided curriculum evolution framework with viewpoint-pathway collaboration for multimodal document retrieval. It addresses cross-modal embedding inconsistencies in heterogeneous documents through multi-view alignment and bidirectional contrastive learning.

entry.title: WildDepth: A Multimodal Dataset for 3D Wildlife Perception and Depth Estimation

author.name: Muhammad Aamir, Naoya Muramatsu, Sangyun Shin, Matthew Wijers, Jiaxing Jhong, Xinyu Hou, Amir Patel, Andrew Markham

entry.summary: WildDepth presents a multimodal dataset with synchronized RGB and LiDAR for depth estimation, behavior detection, and 3D reconstruction of animals ranging from domestic to wild environments.

entry.title: SE(3)-LIO: Smooth IMU Propagation With Jointly Distributed Poses on SE(3) Manifold for Accurate and Robust LiDAR-Inertial Odometry

author.name: Gunhee Shin, Seungjae Lee, Jei Kong, Youngwoo Seo, Hyun Myung

entry.summary: SE(3)-LIO proposes smooth IMU propagation on the SE(3) manifold with jointly distributed poses for improved LiDAR-inertial odometry, better incorporating rotational variation into translation propagation.

entry.title: PanguMotion: Continuous Driving Motion Forecasting with Pangu Transformers

author.name: Quanhao Ren, Yicheng Li, Nan Song

entry.summary: PanguMotion integrates Transformer blocks from the Pangu-1B language model into motion forecasting for continuous driving scenarios, leveraging temporal continuity and historical context.

entry.title: Agile Interception of a Flying Target using Competitive Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Timoth\'ee Gavin (ENAC-LAB, LAAS-RIS), Simon Lacroix (LAAS-RIS), Murat Bronz (ENAC)

entry.summary: Presents competitive RL for drone interception using PPO-trained policies for both interceptor and target drones, with a high-fidelity JAX-based simulation environment for parallelized training.

entry.title: Onboard MuJoCo-based Model Predictive Control for Shipboard Crane with Double-Pendulum Sway Suppression

author.name: Oscar Pang, Lisa Coiffard, Paul Templier, Luke Beddow, Kamil Dreczkowski, Antoine Cully

entry.summary: Presents onboard MuJoCo-based model predictive control for shipboard crane operations with double-pendulum sway suppression, deployed on compute-constrained hardware.

entry.title: ManiTwin: Scaling Data-Generation-Ready Digital Object Dataset to 100K

author.name: Kaixuan Wang, Tianxing Chen, Jiawei Liu, Honghao Su, Shaolong Zhu, Minxuan Wang, Zixuan Li, Yue Chen, Huan-ang Gao, Yusen Qin, Jiawei Wang, Qixuan Zhang, Lan Xu, Jingyi Yu, Yao Mu, Ping Luo

entry.summary: Introduces ManiTwin, an automated pipeline for generating simulation-ready 3D digital object twins from single images, constructing a 100K asset dataset with physical properties and manipulation annotations for robotic training.

entry.title: Did You Check the Right Pocket? Cost-Sensitive Store Routing for Memory-Augmented Agents

author.name: Madhava Gaikwad

entry.summary: Formulates memory retrieval for memory-augmented agents as a store-routing problem, showing that selective retrieval from specialized stores outperforms uniform retrieval in both accuracy and token efficiency. An oracle router achieves higher QA accuracy with substantially fewer context tokens.

entry.title: I Know What I Don't Know: Latent Posterior Factor Models for Multi-Evidence Probabilistic Reasoning

author.name: Aliyu Agboola Alege

entry.summary: Introduces Latent Posterior Factors (LPF), a framework that transforms VAE latent posteriors into soft likelihood factors for Sum-Product Network inference, enabling probabilistic reasoning over unstructured evidence with calibrated uncertainty. Applied to multi-evidence aggregation tasks.

entry.title: VIGIL: Towards Edge-Extended Agentic AI for Enterprise IT Support

author.name: Sarthak Ahuja, Neda Kordjazi, Evren Yortucboylu, Vishaal Kapoor, Mariam Dundua, Yiming Li, Derek Ho, Vaibhavi Padala, Jennifer Whitted, Rebecca Steinert

entry.summary: Presents VIGIL, an edge-extended agentic AI system for enterprise IT support that deploys desktop-resident agents for diagnosis, retrieval, and remediation. 10-week pilot on 100 endpoints shows 39% fewer interaction rounds and 4x faster diagnosis.

entry.title: RetailBench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Autonomous Decision-Making and Strategy Stability of LLM Agents in Realistic Retail Environments

author.name: Linghua Zhang, Jun Wang, Jingtong Wu, Zhisong Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces RetailBench for evaluating LLM agents' long-horizon autonomous decision-making in realistic retail scenarios with stochastic demand. Proposes Evolving Strategy & Execution framework separating strategic reasoning from action execution.

entry.title: V-DyKnow: A Dynamic Benchmark for Time-Sensitive Knowledge in Vision Language Models

author.name: Seyed Mahed Mousavi, Christian Moiola, Massimo Rizzoli, Simone Alghisi, Giuseppe Riccardi

entry.summary: Presents V-DyKnow, a benchmark for evaluating time-sensitive factual knowledge in Vision-Language Models. Tests how well VLMs handle facts that change over time and evaluates knowledge editing and multimodal RAG methods.

entry.title: Exploring the Use of VLMs for Navigation Assistance for People with Blindness and Low Vision

author.name: Yu Li, Yuchen Zheng, Giles Hamilton-Fletcher, Marco Mezzavilla, Yao Wang, Sundeep Rangan, Maurizio Porfiri, Zhou Yu, John-Ross Rizzo

entry.summary: Evaluates vision-language models (GPT-4V, GPT-4o, Gemini-1.5-Pro, Claude-3.5-Sonnet, and open-source alternatives) for assisting blind and low-vision people in navigation tasks, testing spatial reasoning, obstacle counting, and scene understanding.

entry.title: Discovering the Hidden Role of Gini Index In Prompt-based Classification

author.name: Ruixi Lin

entry.summary: Reveals a hidden connection between Gini Index and class accuracy disparities in prompt-based classification, showing it can serve as both a diagnostic measure and optimization metric for debiasing long-tailed minority class performance.

entry.title: Data-Local Autonomous LLM-Guided Neural Architecture Search for Multiclass Multimodal Time-Series Classification

author.name: Emil Hardarson, Luka Biedebach, \'Omar Bessi \'Omarsson, Teitur Hr\'olfsson, Anna Sigridur Islind, Mar\'ia \'Oskarsd\'ottir

entry.summary: Presents a data-local LLM-guided neural architecture search framework for multimodal time-series classification that respects privacy constraints, enabling automated exploration of preprocessing and architecture choices without exposing sensitive data.

entry.title: Standardizing Medical Images at Scale for AI

author.name: Callen MacPhee, Yiming Zhou, Koichiro Kishima, Bahram Jalali

entry.summary: Presents a physics-based image preprocessing framework using PhyCV algorithms to standardize medical images across institutions, modeling images as optical fields undergoing diffractive propagation to suppress domain-specific artifacts.

entry.title: SEAHateCheck: Functional Tests for Detecting Hate Speech in Low-Resource Languages of Southeast Asia

author.name: Ri Chi Ng, Aditi Kumaresan, Yujia Hu, Roy Ka-Wei Lee

entry.summary: Introduces SEAHateCheck, a hate speech detection benchmark for four Southeast Asian languages (Indonesian, Tagalog, Thai, Vietnamese), building on HateCheck's functional testing framework with culturally relevant test cases validated by local experts.

entry.title: Sample-Efficient Adaptation of Drug-Response Models to Patient Tumors under Strong Biological Domain Shift

author.name: Camille Jimenez Cortes, Philippe Lalanda, German Vega

entry.summary: Proposes a staged transfer-learning framework for drug response prediction that separates representation learning from task supervision, using autoencoder-based learning on pharmacogenomic data to enable sample-efficient adaptation to patient tumors.

entry.title: Attention-guided Evidence Grounding for Spoken Question Answering

author.name: Ke Yang, Bolin Chen, Yuejie Li, Yueying Hua, Jianhao Nie, Yueping He, Bowen Li, Chengjun Mao

entry.summary: Introduces Attention-guided Evidence Grounding for spoken question answering, using internal cross-modal attention of Speech LLMs to locate and ground key evidence, with a Learning to Focus on Evidence fine-tuning paradigm.

entry.title: Robust Physics-Guided Diffusion for Full-Waveform Inversion

author.name: Jishen Peng, Enze Jiang, Zheng Ma, Xiongbin Yan

entry.summary: Proposes a physics-guided diffusion framework for full-waveform inversion combining score-based generative priors with Wasserstein-2 data-consistency potential and preconditioned guided reverse-diffusion for improved robustness.

entry.title: Can Linguistically Related Languages Guide LLM Translation in Low-Resource Settings?

author.name: Aishwarya Ramasethu, Niyathi Allu, Rohin Garg, Harshwardhan Fartale, Dun Li Chan

entry.summary: Investigates whether linguistically related pivot languages can improve LLM translation for extremely low-resource languages using few-shot in-context learning, without parameter updates.

entry.title: Flood Risk Follows Valleys, Not Grids: Graph Neural Networks for Flash Flood Susceptibility Mapping in Himachal Pradesh with Conformal Uncertainty Quantification

author.name: Paras Sharma, Swastika Sharma

entry.summary: Applies Graph Neural Networks (GraphSAGE) on watershed connectivity graphs for flash flood susceptibility mapping in Himachal Pradesh, outperforming pixel-based baselines with spatial cross-validation.

entry.title: Online Semi-infinite Linear Programming: Efficient Algorithms via Function Approximation

author.name: Yiming Zong, Jiashuo Jiang

entry.summary: Develops algorithms for Online Semi-infinite Linear Programming using function approximation to reduce infinite constraints to a constant number, with regret bounds independent of constraint count.

entry.title: Novelty-Driven Target-Space Discovery in Automated Electron and Scanning Probe Microscopy

author.name: Utkarsh Pratiush, Kamyar Barakati, Boris N. Slautin, Catherine C. Bodinger, Christopher D. Lowe, Brandi M. Cossairt, Sergei V. Kalinin

entry.summary: Develops a deep-kernel-learning BEACON framework for novelty-driven target-space discovery in automated microscopy, guiding experiments to seek diverse response regimes.

entry.title: Dynamic Meta-Layer Aggregation for Byzantine-Robust Federated Learning

author.name: Reek Das, Biplab Kanti Sen

entry.summary: Proposes FedAOT, a meta-learning inspired adaptive aggregation framework for Byzantine-robust federated learning that dynamically weights client updates to counter multi-label flipping and untargeted poisoning attacks.

entry.title: PulmoVec: A Two-Stage Stacking Meta-Learning Architecture Built on the HeAR Foundation Model for Multi-Task Classification of Pediatric Respiratory Sounds

author.name: Izzet Turkalp Akbasli, Oguzhan Serin

entry.summary: Develops PulmoVec, a multi-task framework for pediatric respiratory sound classification built on Google's HeAR foundation model, using stacking meta-learning across screening, sound-pattern recognition, and disease-group prediction tasks.

entry.title: Self-supervised Disentanglement of Disease Effects from Aging in 3D Medical Shapes

author.name: Jakaria Rabbi, Nilanjan Ray, Dana Cobzas

entry.summary: Proposes a two-stage framework for disentangling disease effects from aging in 3D medical shapes using self-supervised learning of implicit shape representations with clustering-derived pseudo labels.

entry.title: SIA: A Synthesize-Inject-Align Framework for Knowledge-Grounded and Secure E-commerce Search LLMs with Industrial Deployment

author.name: Zhouwei Zhai, Mengxiang Chen, Anmeng Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes SIA framework for building knowledge-grounded and secure e-commerce search LLMs by synthesizing knowledge from graphs and behavioral logs, then injecting via parameter-efficient methods with safety alignment.

entry.title: Towards Fair and Robust Volumetric CT Classification via KL-Regularised Group Distributionally Robust Optimisation

author.name: Samuel Johnny, Blessed Guda, Frank Ebeledike, Goodness Obasi, Moise Busogi

entry.summary: Addresses both distribution shift and demographic fairness in volumetric CT classification using KL-regularised Group DRO with MobileViT-XXS encoder and SliceTransformer aggregator for COVID-19 and lung pathology tasks.

entry.title: Volumetrically Consistent Implicit Atlas Learning via Neural Diffeomorphic Flow for Placenta MRI

author.name: Athena Taymourtash, S. Mazdak Abulnaga, Esra Abaci Turk, P. Ellen Grant, Polina Golland

entry.summary: Introduces a volumetrically consistent implicit model coupling signed distance functions with neural diffeomorphic flow for placenta MRI atlas learning, enforcing interior deformations rather than just surface correspondences.

entry.title: Exclusivity-Guided Mask Learning for Semi-Supervised Crowd Instance Segmentation and Counting

author.name: Jiyang Huang, Hongru Cheng, Wei Lin, Jia Wan, Antoni B. Chan

entry.summary: Proposes XMask for semi-supervised crowd instance segmentation using exclusivity-guided mask learning with an Exclusion-Constrained Dual-Prompt SAM to generate mask supervision from point annotations.

entry.title: Persistent Story World Simulation with Continuous Character Customization

author.name: Jinlu Zhang, Qiyun Wang, Baoxiang Du, Jiayi Ji, Jing He, Rongsheng Zhang, Tangjie Lv, Xiaoshuai Sun, Rongrong Ji

entry.summary: EverTale presents a story world simulator with continuous character customization using an All-in-One-World Character Integrator via unified LoRA and an MLLM-as-Judge Character Quality Gate for fidelity verification.

entry.title: DermaFlux: Synthetic Skin Lesion Generation with Rectified Flows for Enhanced Image Classification

author.name: Stathis Galanakis, Alexandros Koliousis, Stefanos Zafeiriou

entry.summary: DermaFlux uses rectified flow-based generation fine-tuned with LoRA on Flux.1 to synthesize clinically grounded skin lesion images from text descriptions, improving classification of underrepresented lesion types.

entry.title: Fast-HaMeR: Boosting Hand Mesh Reconstruction using Knowledge Distillation

author.name: Hunain Ahmed Jillani, Ahmed Tawfik Aboukhadra, Ahmed Elhayek, Jameel Malik, Nadia Robertini, Didier Stricker

entry.summary: Fast-HaMeR uses knowledge distillation with lightweight neural networks to accelerate 3D hand reconstruction, making the HaMeR model faster and lighter while maintaining comparable accuracy for real-time VR/AR applications.

entry.title: SuCor: Susceptibility Distortion Correction via Parameter-Free and Self-Regularized Optimal Transport

author.name: Sreekar Chigurupati, Eleftherios Garyfallidis

entry.summary: SuCor corrects susceptibility-induced geometric distortions in EPI brain imaging using optimal transport, modeling the distortion field as Wasserstein-2 barycentric displacements with automatic regularization.

entry.title: SAMSEM -- A Generic and Scalable Approach for IC Metal Line Segmentation

author.name: Christian Gehrmann, Jonas Ricker, Simon Damm, Deruo Cheng, Julian Speith, Yiqiong Shi, Asja Fischer, Christof Paar

entry.summary: SAMSEM adapts Meta's SAM2 for segmenting metal lines on SEM images of integrated circuits, addressing the challenge of cross-IC generalization for hardware security verification.

entry.title: Robust Dynamic Object Detection in Cluttered Indoor Scenes via Learned Spatiotemporal Cues

author.name: Juan Rached, Yixuan Jia, Kota Kondo, Jonathan P. How

entry.summary: Presents a LiDAR-only framework for dynamic object detection in cluttered indoor environments that fuses temporal occupancy-grid motion segmentation with a learned bird's-eye-view dynamic prior.

entry.title: PA-LVIO: Real-Time LiDAR-Visual-Inertial Odometry and Mapping with Pose-Only Bundle Adjustment

author.name: Hailiang Tang, Tisheng Zhang, Liqiang Wang, Xin Ding, Man Yuan, Xiaoji Niu

entry.summary: PA-LVIO presents a pose-only bundle adjustment approach for real-time LiDAR-visual-inertial odometry with IMU-centric online spatial-temporal calibration for pixel-wise LiDAR-camera alignment.

entry.title: GenZ-LIO: Generalizable LiDAR-Inertial Odometry Beyond Indoor--Outdoor Boundaries

author.name: Daehan Lee, Hyungtae Lim, Seongjun Kim, Soonbin Rho, Changhyeon Lee, Sanghyun Park, Junwoo Hong, Eunseon Choi, Hyunyoung Jo, Soohee Han

entry.summary: GenZ-LIO proposes a generalizable LiDAR-inertial odometry framework that handles transitions between indoor and outdoor environments using PID-inspired adaptive mechanisms.

entry.title: Form Follows Function: Recursive Stem Model

author.name: Navid Hakimi

entry.summary: Introduces Recursive Stem Model (RSM) that improves recursive reasoning by detaching hidden-state history during training and applying loss only at the final step, creating a depth-agnostic transition operator. Builds on TRM-style backbone while reducing training overhead from deep supervision.

entry.title: Persona-Conditioned Risk Behavior in Large Language Models: A Simulated Gambling Study with GPT-4.1

author.name: Sankalp Dubedy

entry.summary: Studies how GPT-4.1 exhibits risk-taking behavior when assigned different socioeconomic personas in a simulated gambling environment. Finds the model reproduces key behavioral patterns like the sunk-cost effect and loss aversion across persona conditions.

entry.title: POaaS: Minimal-Edit Prompt Optimization as a Service to Lift Accuracy and Cut Hallucinations on On-Device sLLMs

author.name: Jungwoo Shim, Dae Won Kim, Sun Wook Kim, Soo Young Kim, Myungcheol Lee, Jae-geun Cha, Hyunhwa Choi

entry.summary: Proposes POaaS, a minimal-edit prompt optimization layer for on-device small language models that routes queries to lightweight specialists (Cleaner, Paraphraser, Fact-Adder) under strict drift and length constraints. Addresses prompt quality issues for resource-constrained sLLMs.

entry.title: Prompt Programming for Cultural Bias and Alignment of Large Language Models

author.name: Maksim Eren, Eric Michalak, Brian Cook, Johnny Seales Jr

entry.summary: Explores prompt programming techniques for reducing cultural bias in LLMs, extending previous work on culture-specific prompting to open-source models and automated prompt generation. Aims to improve alignment with target population value profiles.

entry.title: A federated learning framework with knowledge graph and temporal transformer for early sepsis prediction in multi-center ICUs

author.name: Yue Chang, Guangsen Lin, Jyun Jie Chuang, Shunqi Liu, Xinkui Li, Yaozheng Li

entry.summary: Proposes a federated learning framework integrating knowledge graphs and temporal transformers with meta-learning for early sepsis prediction across multiple ICUs, preserving patient privacy while enabling collaborative model training.

entry.title: Morphemes Without Borders: Evaluating Root-Pattern Morphology in Arabic Tokenizers and LLMs

author.name: Yara Alakeel, Chatrine Qwaider, Hanan Aldarmaki, Sawsan Alqahtani

entry.summary: Investigates how LLMs and tokenizers handle Arabic root-pattern (non-concatenative) morphology, evaluating whether they capture genuine morphological structure or rely on surface memorization, using a new test set across seven Arabic-centric and multilingual LLMs.

entry.title: Parallelised Differentiable Straightest Geodesics for 3D Meshes

author.name: Hippolyte Verninas, Caner Korkmaz, Stefanos Zafeiriou, Tolga Birdal, Simone Foti

entry.summary: Provides a parallel GPU implementation and differentiable computation of straightest geodesics on 3D meshes, enabling backpropagation through geometric operations for learning on Riemannian surfaces.

entry.title: Interact3D: Compositional 3D Generation of Interactive Objects

author.name: Hui Shan, Keyang Luo, Ming Li, Sizhe Zheng, Yanwei Fu, Zhen Chen, Xiangru Huang

entry.summary: Presents Interact3D, a framework for generating physically plausible 3D compositional objects from single images, handling occlusions and preserving object-object spatial relationships through a two-stage composition pipeline.

entry.title: Open-Source Reproduction and Explainability Analysis of Corrective Retrieval Augmented Generation

author.name: Surya Vardhan Yalavarthi

entry.summary: Presents an open-source reproduction of Corrective RAG (CRAG) replacing proprietary components with open alternatives, and contributes the first explainability analysis of CRAG's retrieval evaluator using SHAP.

entry.title: A Scoping Review of AI-Driven Digital Interventions in Mental Health Care: Mapping Applications Across Screening, Support, Monitoring, Prevention, and Clinical Education

author.name: Yang Ni, Fanli Jia

entry.summary: Scoping review mapping AI-driven mental health interventions across screening, treatment support, monitoring, prevention, and clinical education, synthesizing 36 empirical studies on LLMs, ML models, and conversational agents.

entry.title: $D^3$-RSMDE: 40$\times$ Faster and High-Fidelity Remote Sensing Monocular Depth Estimation

author.name: Ruizhi Wang, Weihan Li, Zunlei Feng, Haofei Zhang, Mingli Song, Jiayu Wang, Jie Song, Li Sun

entry.summary: Proposes D³-RSMDE, an efficient framework for remote sensing monocular depth estimation combining ViT-based rapid depth map generation with diffusion model refinement, achieving 40x speedup.

entry.title: Bridging the High-Frequency Data Gap: A Millisecond-Resolution Network Dataset for Advancing Time Series Foundation Models

author.name: Subina Khanal, Seshu Tirupathi, Merim Dzaferagic, Marco Ruffini, Torben Bach Pedersen

entry.summary: Introduces a millisecond-resolution 5G wireless network dataset for time series foundation models, addressing the gap in high-frequency training data and introducing the wireless network domain.

entry.title: Manifold-Matching Autoencoders

author.name: Laurent Cheret, Vincent L\'etourneau, Isar Nejadgholi, Chris Drummond, Hussein Al Osman, Maia Fraser

entry.summary: Proposes Manifold-Matching Autoencoders (MMAE), aligning pairwise latent distances to input data distances via MSE, finding this outperforms similar methods on nearest-neighbor and persistent homology preservation metrics.

entry.title: Real-Time Decoding of Movement Onset and Offset for Brain-Controlled Rehabilitation Exoskeleton

author.name: Kanishka Mitra, Satyam Kumar, Frigyes Samuel Racz, Deland Liu, Ashish D. Deshpande, Jos\'e del R. Mill\'an

entry.summary: Demonstrates online dual-state motor imagery control of an upper-limb exoskeleton via EEG, enabling both initiation and termination of robot-assisted movements for neuroplasticity-targeted rehabilitation.

entry.title: Game-Theory-Assisted Reinforcement Learning for Border Defense: Early Termination based on Analytical Solutions

author.name: Goutam Das, Michael Dorothy, Kyle Volle, Daigo Shishika

entry.summary: Combines game-theoretic insights with reinforcement learning for a border defense game, using Apollonius Circle equilibrium solutions to enable early termination and improve RL training efficiency.

entry.title: Adaptive regularization parameter selection for high-dimensional inverse problems: A Bayesian approach with Tucker low-rank constraints

author.name: Qing-Mei Yang, Da-Qing Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces a variational Bayesian method integrating Tucker decomposition for high-dimensional inverse problems, with per-mode precision parameters enabling adaptive anisotropic regularization.

entry.title: GeMA: Learning Latent Manifold Frontiers for Benchmarking Complex Systems

author.name: Jia Ming Li, Anupriya, Daniel J. Graham

entry.summary: Proposes GeMA (Geometric Manifold Analysis), a VAE-based framework for benchmarking complex systems that learns latent manifold frontiers, replacing classical DEA/SFA with a more flexible geometric approach.

entry.title: RaDAR: Relation-aware Diffusion-Asymmetric Graph Contrastive Learning for Recommendation

author.name: Yixuan Huang, Jiawei Chen, Shengfan Zhang, Zongsheng Cao

entry.summary: Proposes RaDAR, a graph contrastive learning framework for recommendations that combines a graph generative model for global structure capture with a relation-aware denoising model for noisy edge refinement.

entry.title: Communication-Aware Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning for Decentralized Cooperative UAV Deployment

author.name: Enguang Fan, Yifan Chen, Zihan Shan, Matthew Caesar, Jae Kim

entry.summary: Presents a graph-based multi-agent RL framework for decentralized cooperative UAV deployment with centralized training/decentralized execution, using agent-entity attention and neighbor self-attention over distance-limited communication graphs.

entry.title: Encoding Predictability and Legibility for Style-Conditioned Diffusion Policy

author.name: Adrien Jacquet Cr\'etides, Mouad Abrini, Hamed Rahimi, Mohamed Chetouani

entry.summary: Proposes Style-Conditioned Diffusion Policy for human-robot collaboration that balances between legible (expressive) and efficient robot motion based on environmental ambiguity.

entry.title: Bridging the Simulation-to-Reality Gap in Electron Microscope Calibration via VAE-EM Estimation

author.name: Jilles S. van Hulst (Maurice), W. P. M. H. (Maurice), Heemels, Duarte J. Antunes

entry.summary: Uses variational autoencoders trained on simulated data to learn low-dimensional representations for scanning transmission electron microscope calibration, bridging the simulation-to-reality gap through EM estimation.

entry.title: Conflict-Aware Multimodal Fusion for Ambivalence and Hesitancy Recognition

author.name: Salah Eddine Bekhouche, Hichem Telli, Azeddine Benlamoudi, Salah Eddine Herrouz, Abdelmalik Taleb-Ahmed, Abdenour Hadid

entry.summary: ConflictAwareAH detects ambivalence and hesitancy by computing pairwise cross-modal conflict features between video, audio, and text modalities, using disagreements between channels as diagnostic signals.

entry.title: Structured prototype regularization for synthetic-to-real driving scene parsing

author.name: Jiahe Fan, Xiao Ma, Sergey Vityazev, George Giakos, Shaolong Shu, Rui Fan

entry.summary: Proposes structured prototype regularization for synthetic-to-real domain adaptation in driving scene parsing, modeling semantic relations among classes that global feature alignment methods miss.

entry.title: Boosting Quantitive and Spatial Awareness for Zero-Shot Object Counting

author.name: Da Zhang, Bingyu Li, Feiyu Wang, Zhiyuan Zhao, Junyu Gao

entry.summary: QICA addresses zero-shot object counting with a synergistic prompting strategy that adapts vision and language encoders through numerical-aware prompts and spatial cast aggregation for improved quantity and spatial awareness.

entry.title: Point-to-Mask: From Arbitrary Point Annotations to Mask-Level Infrared Small Target Detection

author.name: Weihua Gao, Wenlong Niu, Jie Tang, Man Yang, Jiafeng Zhang, Xiaodong Peng

entry.summary: Point-to-Mask bridges point annotations and mask-level detection for infrared small targets through physics-driven adaptive mask generation and a radius-aware regression network using spatiotemporal cues.

entry.title: PKINet-v2: Towards Powerful and Efficient Poly-Kernel Remote Sensing Object Detection

author.name: Xinhao Cai, Liulei Li, Gensheng Pei, Zeren Sun, Yazhou Yao, Wenguan Wang

entry.summary: PKINet-v2 extends PKINet for remote sensing object detection by combining anisotropic strip kernels and isotropic large kernels to handle both geometric diversity (slender objects) and scale diversity in aerial images.

entry.title: Near-light Photometric Stereo with Symmetric Lights

author.name: Lilika Makabe, Heng Guo, Hiroaki Santo, Fumio Okura, Yasuyuki Matsushita

entry.summary: Proposes a linear closed-form solution for near-light photometric stereo using symmetric light source arrangements, eliminating the need for non-convex optimization and initialization while reducing calibration requirements.

entry.title: BUSSARD: Normalizing Flows for Bijective Universal Scene-Specific Anomalous Relationship Detection

author.name: Melissa Schween, Mathis Kruse, Bodo Rosenhahn

entry.summary: BUSSARD uses normalizing flows for detecting anomalous relationships in scene graphs, embedding object-relation-object triplets with language models and performing likelihood-based anomaly detection.

entry.title: An assessment of data-centric methods for label noise identification in remote sensing data sets

author.name: Felix Kr\"ober, Genc Hoxha, Ribana Roscher

entry.summary: Systematically evaluates three data-centric methods for identifying label noise in remote sensing datasets under different noise types and levels (10-70%), addressing an understudied problem in remote sensing.

entry.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning-Assisted Automated Operator Portfolio for Constrained Multi-objective Optimization

author.name: Shuai Shao, Ye Tian, Shangshang Yang, Xingyi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes deep RL-assisted automated operator portfolio selection for constrained multi-objective optimization, learning to recommend multiple operators rather than a single best operator per generation.

entry.title: Early-Terminable Energy-Safe Iterative Coupling for Parallel Simulation of Port-Hamiltonian Systems

author.name: Qi Wei, Jianfeng Tao, Hongyu Nie, Wangtao Tan

entry.summary: Proposes an energy-safe iterative coupling method for parallel simulation of port-Hamiltonian systems using Douglas-Rachford splitting in wave coordinates, preventing spurious energy injection.

entry.title: Coverage First Next Best View for Inspection of Cluttered Pipe Networks Using Mobile Manipulators

author.name: Joshua Raymond Bettles, Jiaxu Wu, Bruno Vilhena Adorno, Joaquin Carrasco, Atsushi Yamashita

entry.summary: Proposes a coverage-first next-best-view planning approach for robotic inspection of cluttered pipe networks using mobile manipulators, reformulating coverage planning as information gain.

entry.title: Beyond Cybathlon: On-demand Quadrupedal Assistance for People with Limited Mobility

author.name: Carmen Scheidemann, Andrei Cramariuc, Changan Chen, Jia-Ruei Chiu, Marco Hutter

entry.summary: Presents a quadrupedal robot system for assisting people with limited mobility, using shared autonomy that combines semi-autonomous task execution with human teleoperation. Unlike wheelchair-mounted arms, the robot operates independently and assists on demand.

entry.title: Research note on window shifting training

author.name: Kei Nishimura-Gasparian

entry.summary: Research note exploring how adding prompt prefixes during SFT affects model behavior: prefixes pushing toward a behavior during training paradoxically make the model exhibit it less, and vice versa. The 'window shifting' effect yields mixed results for improving fine-tuning outcomes.

entry.title: CraniMem: Cranial Inspired Gated and Bounded Memory for Agentic Systems

author.name: Pearl Mody, Mihir Panchal, Rishit Kar, Kiran Bhowmick, Ruhina Karani

entry.summary: Presents CraniMem, a neurocognitively-inspired gated memory system for LLM agents with goal-conditioned gating, bounded episodic buffer, and a structured long-term knowledge graph. Features scheduled consolidation that replays high-utility traces while pruning low-utility ones.

entry.title: HMAR: Hierarchical Modality-Aware Expert and Dynamic Routing Medical Image Retrieval Architecture

author.name: Aojie Yuan

entry.summary: HMAR proposes a hierarchical MoE-based medical image retrieval framework with dual experts for global and local feature matching, addressing limitations of uniform feature encoding in clinical retrieval.

entry.title: BrickSim: A Physics-Based Simulator for Manipulating Interlocking Brick Assemblies

author.name: Haowei Wen, Ruixuan Liu, Weiyi Piao, Siyu Li, Changliu Liu

entry.summary: Presents BrickSim, the first real-time physics-based simulator for interlocking brick (e.g., LEGO) assemblies that captures snap-fit mechanics. Uses a force-based model solved via convex QP, enabling simulation of assembly, disassembly, and structural collapse.

entry.title: Neural-Symbolic Logic Query Answering in Non-Euclidean Space

author.name: Lihui Liu

entry.summary: Proposes HYQNET, a neural-symbolic model that uses hyperbolic space for first-order logic query answering on knowledge graphs. It decomposes queries into relation projections and logical operations over fuzzy sets with a hyperbolic GNN for knowledge graph completion. Addresses the gap in capturing hierarchical structure of logical queries.

entry.title: Theoretical Foundations of Latent Posterior Factors: Formal Guarantees for Multi-Evidence Reasoning

author.name: Aliyu Agboola Alege

entry.summary: Companion theoretical paper to the LPF framework, providing formal guarantees including consistency, calibration bounds, and convergence results for multi-evidence reasoning via Latent Posterior Factors.

entry.title: Argumentative Human-AI Decision-Making: Toward AI Agents That Reason With Us, Not For Us

author.name: Stylianos Loukas Vasileiou, Antonio Rago, Francesca Toni, William Yeoh

entry.summary: Proposes that computational argumentation and LLMs should converge to enable Argumentative Human-AI Decision-Making, where agents engage in dialectical processes with contestable and revisable decisions rather than just justifying outputs.

entry.title: NeSy-Route: A Neuro-Symbolic Benchmark for Constrained Route Planning in Remote Sensing

author.name: Ming Yang, Zhi Zhou, Shi-Yu Tian, Kun-Yang Yu, Lan-Zhe Guo, Yu-Feng Li

entry.summary: Introduces NeSy-Route, a neuro-symbolic benchmark for constrained route planning in remote sensing. Features an automated data-generation framework for creating planning tasks at scale with accurate evaluation protocols.

entry.title: Domain-Independent Dynamic Programming with Constraint Propagation

author.name: Imko Marijnissen, J. Christopher Beck, Emir Demirovi\'c, Ryo Kuroiwa
