entry.summary: Introduces SpatialMed, the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating 3D spatial intelligence in medical MLLMs with ~10K QA pairs, plus an agentic pipeline for synthesizing spatial VQA data using computational tools and radiologist validation.

entry.title: S2GS: Streaming Semantic Gaussian Splatting for Online Scene Understanding and Reconstruction

author.name: Renhe Zhang, Yuyang Tan, Jingyu Gong, Zhizhong Zhang, Lizhuang Ma, Yuan Xie, Xin Tan

entry.summary: Proposes S2GS, a streaming semantic Gaussian splatting framework for online joint scene reconstruction and understanding that processes frames causally without reprocessing history.

entry.title: Early Failure Detection and Intervention in Video Diffusion Models

author.name: Kwon Byung-Ki, Sohwi Lim, Nam Hyeon-Woo, Moon Ye-Bin, Tae-Hyun Oh

entry.summary: Proposes an early failure detection and diagnostic intervention pipeline for text-to-video diffusion models that converts latents to previews for real-time quality inspection during generation.

entry.title: HomeGuard: VLM-based Embodied Safeguard for Identifying Contextual Risk in Household Task

author.name: Xiaoya Lu, Yijin Zhou, Zeren Chen, Ruocheng Wang, Bingrui Sima, Enshen Zhou, Lu Sheng, Dongrui Liu, Jing Shao

entry.summary: HomeGuard proposes a VLM-based safety framework for embodied agents using Context-Guided Chain-of-Thought to identify contextual risks in household tasks where benign commands become hazardous.

entry.title: StAR: Segment Anything Reasoner

author.name: Seokju Yun, Dongheon Lee, Noori Bae, Jaesung Jun, Chanseul Cho, Youngmin Ro

entry.summary: StAR (Segment Anything Reasoner) refines the design space for reasoning segmentation from multiple perspectives and introduces parallel test-time scaling for segmentation tasks.

entry.title: Distilling Latent Manifolds: Resolution Extrapolation by Variational Autoencoders

author.name: Jiaming Chu, Tao Wang, Lei Jin

entry.summary: Reports a counter-intuitive finding that VAE encoders distilled at low resolutions perform better at higher unseen resolutions, studying resolution extrapolation in latent diffusion.

entry.title: Balancing Saliency and Coverage: Semantic Prominence-Aware Budgeting for Visual Token Compression in VLMs

author.name: Jaehoon Lee, Mingi Jung, Soohyuk Jang, Seungryong Yoo, Dahuin Jung, Sungroh Yoon

entry.summary: Proposes PromPrune, a sample-adaptive visual token compression method for VLMs that balances saliency and coverage based on per-sample semantic prominence distribution, rather than using static compression strategies.

entry.title: Edit2Interp: Adapting Image Foundation Models from Spatial Editing to Video Frame Interpolation with Few-Shot Learning

author.name: Nasrin Rahimi, M{\i}sra Yavuz, Burak Can Biner, Yunus Bilge Kurt, Ahmet Rasim Emirda\u{g}{\i}, S\"uleyman Aslan, G\"orkay Aydemir, M. Ak{\i}n Y{\i}lmaz, A. Murat Tekalp

entry.summary: Demonstrates that image editing models can be adapted for Video Frame Interpolation using only 64-256 samples via LoRA, repurposing spatial reasoning priors for temporal synthesis without video-specific architecture.

entry.title: Generative Video Compression with One-Dimensional Latent Representation

author.name: Zihan Zheng, Zhaoyang Jia, Naifu Xue, Jiahao Li, Bin Li, Zongyu Guo, Xiaoyi Zhang, Zhenghao Chen, Houqiang Li, Yan Lu

entry.summary: Proposes generative video compression with 1D latent representations instead of traditional 2D grids, better exploiting spatial-temporal redundancy by enabling more compact cross-frame aggregation.

entry.title: Tri-Prompting: Video Diffusion with Unified Control over Scene, Subject, and Motion

author.name: Zhenghong Zhou, Xiaohang Zhan, Zhiqin Chen, Soo Ye Kim, Nanxuan Zhao, Haitian Zheng, Qing Liu, He Zhang, Zhe Lin, Yuqian Zhou, Jiebo Luo

entry.summary: Tri-Prompting is a unified video diffusion framework providing joint control over scene composition, multi-view consistent subject customization, and camera/motion adjustment. Uses a two-stage training paradigm for versatile controllable video generation.

entry.title: A Theory of Appropriateness That Accounts for Norms of Rationality

author.name: Joel Z. Leibo, Alexander Sasha Vezhnevets, Manfred Diaz, John P. Agapiou, William A. Cunningham, Peter Sunehag, Logan Cross, Raphael Koster, Stanley M. Bileschi, Minsuk Chang, Iyad Rahwan, Simon Osindero, James A. Evans

entry.summary: Proposes a society-first theory of normative appropriateness where individuals, modeled analogously to LLMs, generate behavior via predictive pattern completion. Challenges rational-choice theories by accounting for norms' context-dependence, arbitrariness, and automaticity.

entry.title: KoopmanFlow: Spectrally Decoupled Generative Control Policy via Koopman Structural Bias

author.name: Chengsi Yao, Ge Wang, Kai Kang, Shenhao Yan, Jiahao Yang, Fan Feng, Honghao Cai, Xianxian Zeng, Rongjun Chen, Yiming Zhao, Yatong Han, Xi Li

entry.summary: KoopmanFlow introduces Koopman-inspired structural bias into generative control policies to spectrally decouple stable global motions from high-frequency local corrections, enabling single-step ODE inference for real-time robotic control.

entry.title: Building Explicit World Model for Zero-Shot Open-World Object Manipulation

author.name: Xiaotong Li, Gang Chen, Javier Alonso-Mora

entry.summary: Proposes an explicit world model framework for zero-shot open-world manipulation that constructs a digital twin of the environment, enabling strategy exploration and evaluation in simulation without requiring robot demonstrations.

entry.title: From Scanning Guidelines to Action: A Robotic Ultrasound Agent with LLM-Based Reasoning

author.name: Yuan Bi, Yiping Zhou, Pei Liu, Feng Li, Zhongliang Jiang, Nassir Navab

entry.summary: Proposes a unified framework for autonomous robotic ultrasound scanning that uses an LLM-based agent to interpret scanning guidelines and dynamically invoke software tools, rather than encoding fixed procedures. The LLM retrieves relevant guidelines and reasons about how to execute scans. This demonstrates LLMs as flexible task planners in medical robotics.

entry.title: Learning from Mistakes: Post-Training for Driving VLA with Takeover Data

author.name: Yinfeng Gao, Deqing Liu, Qichao Zhang, Yupeng Zheng, Haochen Tian, Guang Li, Hangjun Ye, Long Chen, Da-Wei Ding, Dongbin Zhao

entry.summary: TakeVLA proposes a VLA post-training framework for autonomous driving that uses takeover data more effectively through pre-takeover language supervision and active exploration beyond passive preference optimization. Addresses distribution shift in end-to-end driving systems.

entry.title: Scalable Text-Embedding-informed Cognitive Diagnosis of Large Language Models

author.name: Jia Liu, Zhiyu Xu, Yuqi Gu

entry.summary: Adapts cognitive diagnosis models from psychometrics to LLM evaluation, enabling fine-grained diagnosis of LLM capabilities through multidimensional discrete profiles. Addresses scalability to 1000+ items and 20+ latent attributes through joint estimation of mastery profiles and Q-matrices.

entry.title: Reasons to be pessimistic (and optimistic) on the future of biosecurity

author.name: Abhishaike Mahajan

entry.summary: A comprehensive analysis of the current state of biosecurity, drawing on conversations with ~16 experts from organizations like Ginkgo Bioworks, SecureDNA, Blueprint Biosecurity, and Johns Hopkins. The essay examines both reasons for pessimism (AI-enabled bioweapons, inadequate defenses) and optimism in the biosecurity landscape.

entry.title: LLM Routing as Reasoning: A MaxSAT View

author.name: Son Nguyen, Xinyuan Liu, Ransalu Senanayake

entry.summary: Formulates LLM routing (selecting which model to use) as a weighted MaxSAT/MaxSMT problem where natural language feedback induces constraints over model attributes. Tests on a 25-model benchmark.

entry.title: Autonomous Agents Coordinating Distributed Discovery Through Emergent Artifact Exchange

author.name: Fiona Y. Wang, Lee Marom, Subhadeep Pal, Rachel K. Luu, Wei Lu, Jaime A. Berkovich, Markus J. Buehler

entry.summary: Presents ScienceClaw + Infinite, a framework for autonomous scientific research where independent agents conduct investigation without central coordination, sharing artifacts with full provenance via a DAG-based lineage system.

entry.title: Learning to Forget: Sleep-Inspired Memory Consolidation for Resolving Proactive Interference in Large Language Models

author.name: Ying Xie

entry.summary: Proposes SleepGate, a biologically-inspired framework augmenting transformer KV caches with sleep-like consolidation cycles to resolve proactive interference from outdated information. Includes conflict-aware tagging, selective replay, and targeted forgetting.

entry.title: Gauge-Equivariant Intrinsic Neural Operators for Geometry-Consistent Learning of Elliptic PDE Maps

author.name: Pengcheng Cheng

entry.summary: Proposes Gauge-Equivariant Intrinsic Neural Operators (GINO) for learning PDE solution maps that are invariant under local frame changes, using intrinsic spectral multipliers coupled with gauge-equivariant nonlinearities.

entry.title: Learning Retrieval Models with Sparse Autoencoders

author.name: Thibault Formal, Maxime Louis, Herv\'e Dejean, St\'ephane Clinchant

entry.summary: Introduces SPLARE, a method using Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) as a foundation for learned sparse retrieval, decomposing LLM representations into interpretable features for efficient information retrieval.

entry.title: Mind the Discriminability Trap in Source-Free Cross-domain Few-shot Learning

author.name: Zhenyu Zhang, Yixiong Zou, Yuhua Li, Ruixuan Li, Guangyao Chen

entry.summary: Discovers that strengthening visual-modal discriminability paradoxically suppresses VLM performance in source-free cross-domain few-shot learning, providing theoretical and experimental analysis of the phenomenon with a proposed solution.

entry.title: Accelerating Suffix Jailbreak attacks with Prefix-Shared KV-cache

author.name: Xinhai Wang, Shaopeng Fu, Shu Yang, Liangyu Wang, Tianhang Zheng, Di Wang

entry.summary: Presents PSKV, a prefix-shared KV cache optimization that accelerates suffix jailbreak attacks by sharing the common prefix KV cache across candidate suffixes during red-teaming, achieving significant speedups.

entry.title: MIBench: Evaluating LMMs on Multimodal Interaction

author.name: Yu Miao, Zequn Yang, Yake Wei, Ziheng Chen, Haotian Ni, Haodong Duan, Kai Chen, Di Hu

entry.summary: Introduces MIBench, a benchmark evaluating multimodal interaction capabilities of Large Multimodal Models, formulating instances as (visual context, text context, task) triplets requiring correct forms of multimodal interaction.

entry.title: Spatial Transcriptomics as Images for Large-Scale Pretraining

author.name: Yishun Zhu, Jiaxin Qi, Jian Wang, Yuhua Zheng, Jianqiang Huang

entry.summary: Proposes treating spatial transcriptomics data as images for large-scale pretraining, addressing the ill-posed question of what constitutes a training sample in ST by defining tissue patches as training units.

entry.title: Spatially Grounded Long-Horizon Task Planning in the Wild

author.name: Sehun Jung, HyunJee Song, Dong-Hee Kim, Reuben Tan, Jianfeng Gao, Yong Jae Lee, Donghyun Kim

entry.summary: Introduces GroundedPlanBench, a benchmark for spatially grounded long-horizon action planning that jointly evaluates hierarchical plan generation and precise spatial interaction point specification for robots.

entry.title: A Causal Framework for Mitigating Data Shifts in Healthcare

author.name: Kurt Butler, Stephanie Riley, Damian Machlanski, Edward Moroshko, Panagiotis Dimitrakopoulos, Thomas Melistas, Akchunya Chanchal, Konstantinos Vilouras, Zhihua Liu, Steven McDonagh, Hana Chockler, Ben Glocker, Niccolo Tempini, Matthew Sperrin, Sotirios A Tsaftaris, Ricardo Silva

entry.summary: Proposes a causal framework for designing predictive models that generalize across healthcare data shifts, connecting domain generalization methods with causal reasoning to understand assumptions and trade-offs.

entry.title: SmoothVLA: Aligning Vision-Language-Action Models with Physical Constraints via Intrinsic Smoothness Optimization

author.name: Jiashun Li, Xiaoyu Shi, Hong Xie, Mingsheng Shang, Yun Lu

entry.summary: Proposes SmoothVLA, an RL fine-tuning framework for Vision-Language-Action models that jointly optimizes task performance and motion smoothness through physics-informed hybrid rewards.

entry.title: FLUX: Data Worth Training On

author.name: Gowtham, Sai Rupesh, Sanjay Kumar, Saravanan, Venkata Chaithanya

entry.summary: Introduces FLUX, a data preprocessing pipeline for LLM training that maximizes token retention while enforcing quality control, achieving 32.14 on benchmarks with a 3B model trained on 60B tokens.

entry.title: Diffusion Reinforcement Learning via Centered Reward Distillation

author.name: Yuanzhi Zhu, Xi Wang, St\'ephane Lathuili\`ere, Vicky Kalogeiton

entry.summary: Presents Centered Reward Distillation (CRD), a diffusion RL framework derived from KL-regularized reward maximization for fine-tuning diffusion models, addressing brittleness of existing approaches.

entry.title: Artificial intelligence-enabled single-lead ECG for non-invasive hyperkalemia detection: development, multicenter validation, and proof-of-concept deployment

author.name: Gongzheng Tang, Qinghao Zhao, Guangkun Nie, Yujie Xiao, Shijia Geng, Donglin Xie, Shun Huang, Deyun Zhang, Xingchen Yao, Jinwei Wang, Kangyin Chen, Luxia Zhang, Shenda Hong

entry.summary: Develops Pocket-K, an AI-ECG system for non-invasive hyperkalemia detection using single-lead ECG, validated across multiple centers on 34,439 patients.

entry.title: AEX: Non-Intrusive Multi-Hop Attestation and Provenance for LLM APIs

author.name: Yongjie Guan

entry.summary: AEX proposes a non-intrusive attestation extension for LLM APIs that cryptographically binds client requests to server responses, providing provenance guarantees for multi-hop API chains without modifying existing API semantics.

entry.title: How Do Medical MLLMs Fail? A Study on Visual Grounding in Medical Images

author.name: Guimeng Liu, Tianze Yu, Somayeh Ebrahimkhani, Lin Zhi Zheng Shawn, Kok Pin Ng, Ngai-Man Cheung

entry.summary: Systematically investigates visual grounding failures in medical MLLMs through VGMED, a new evaluation dataset. Disentangles visual grounding from semantic grounding to understand why medical MLLMs underperform in image interpretation.

entry.title: The Pulse of Motion: Measuring Physical Frame Rate from Visual Dynamics

author.name: Xiangbo Gao, Mingyang Wu, Siyuan Yang, Jiongze Yu, Pardis Taghavi, Fangzhou Lin, Zhengzhong Tu

entry.summary: Introduces Visual Chronometer to measure physical frame rate from video dynamics, addressing 'chronometric hallucination' where generative video models produce ambiguous motion speeds due to training on diverse frame rates.

entry.title: D-MEM: Dopamine-Gated Agentic Memory via Reward Prediction Error Routing

author.name: Yuru Song, Qi Xin

entry.summary: D-MEM proposes a biologically-inspired memory architecture for LLM agents using reward prediction error (RPE) routing to separate fast O(1) caching from slow O(N) memory evolution, reducing write latency from O(N²).

entry.title: Human-AI Ensembles Improve Deepfake Detection in Low-to-Medium Quality Videos

author.name: Marco Postiglione, Isabel Gortner, V. S. Subrahmanian

entry.summary: Shows that human-AI ensembles improve deepfake detection, especially for low-quality mobile videos. On CharadesDF dataset, AI accuracy drops to 0.537 while humans maintain 0.784. Human and AI errors are complementary.

entry.title: IntegratingWeather Foundation Model and Satellite to Enable Fine-Grained Solar Irradiance Forecasting

author.name: Ziqing Ma, Kai Ying, Xinyue Gu, Tian Zhou, Tianyu Zhu, Haifan Zhang, Peisong Niu, Wang Zheng, Cong Bai, Liang Sun

entry.summary: Baguan-solar combines a global weather foundation model with high-resolution geostationary satellite imagery for 24-hour solar irradiance forecasting at kilometer scale. The two-stage design first forecasts continuous intermediates like cloud cover, then estimates irradiance. Addresses limitations of both coarse NWP models and short-horizon satellite extrapolation.

entry.title: How Log-Barrier Helps Exploration in Policy Optimization

author.name: Leonardo Cesani, Matteo Papini, Marcello Restelli

entry.summary: Proposes log-barrier regularization for the Stochastic Gradient Bandit algorithm to enforce minimal exploration. Proves convergence without unrealistic assumptions about optimal action probability being bounded away from zero. Matches SGB sample complexity while providing stronger guarantees.

entry.title: TrajFlow: Nation-wide Pseudo GPS Trajectory Generation with Flow Matching Models

author.name: Peiran Li, Jiawei Wang, Haoran Zhang, Xiaodan Shi, Noboru Koshizuka, Chihiro Shimizu, Renhe Jiang

entry.summary: TrajFlow is the first flow-matching-based generative model for GPS trajectory generation, operating at nation-wide scale. Addresses limitations of diffusion-based approaches in spatial scale, transportation-mode diversity, and efficiency. Generates pseudo-GPS trajectories to address privacy concerns with real mobile phone data.

entry.title: In-Context Symbolic Regression for Robustness-Improved Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks

author.name: Francesco Sovrano, Lidia Losavio, Giulia Vilone, Marc Langheinrich

entry.summary: Studies in-context symbolic regression for improving Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks by replacing edge functions with symbolic operators. Addresses the bottleneck of standard KAN-to-symbol extraction which fits operators in isolation. Uses context-aware approach that considers how local substitutions interact through the full network.

entry.title: NV-Bench: Benchmark of Nonverbal Vocalization Synthesis for Expressive Text-to-Speech Generation

author.name: Qinke Ni, Huan Liao, Dekun Chen, Yuxiang Wang, Zhizheng Wu

entry.summary: NV-Bench is the first benchmark for nonverbal vocalization synthesis in TTS, grounded in a functional taxonomy treating NVs as communicative acts. Covers 1,651 multilingual utterances across 14 NV categories with paired human reference audio. Introduces dual evaluation protocol for instruction alignment and acoustic fidelity.

entry.title: RieMind: Geometry-Grounded Spatial Agent for Scene Understanding

author.name: Fernando Ropero, Erkin Turkoz, Daniel Matos, Junqing Du, Antonio Ruiz, Yanfeng Zhang, Lu Liu, Mingwei Sun, Yongliang Wang

entry.summary: RieMind proposes an agentic framework for 3D indoor scene reasoning that decouples perception from reasoning by grounding an LLM in an explicit 3D scene graph. Investigates whether this decoupling improves spatial reasoning compared to end-to-end approaches. Uses persistent scene graph representation.

entry.title: Generalization and Memorization in Rectified Flow

author.name: Mingxing Rao, Daniel Moyer

entry.summary: Systematically investigates memorization in Rectified Flow models using membership inference attacks, introducing a complexity-calibrated metric that decouples image complexity from memorization signals.

entry.title: SemRep: Generative Code Representation Learning with Code Transformations

author.name: Weichen Li, Jiamin Song, Bogdan Alexandru Stoica, Arav Dhoot, Gabriel Ryan, Shengyu Fu, Kexin Pei

entry.summary: Proposes SemRep, a framework that uses semantics-preserving code transformations as intermediate representations for improving code transformation tasks, serving as both a generative mid-training task and transformation guide.

entry.title: TACTIC for Navigating the Unknown: Tabular Anomaly deteCTion via In-Context inference

author.name: Patryk Marsza{\l}ek, Tomasz Ku\'smierczyk, Marek \'Smieja

entry.summary: Studies in-context learning models (like TabPFN) for tabular anomaly detection, showing their supervised classification priors don't readily extend. Proposes TACTIC, a method that adapts in-context models for anomaly detection with improved stability.

entry.title: Refold: Refining Protein Inverse Folding with Efficient Structural Matching and Fusion

author.name: Yiran Zhu, Changxi Chi, Hongxin Xiang, Wenjie Du, Xiaoqi Wang, Jun Xia

entry.summary: Proposes Refold for protein inverse folding, combining template-based structural matching with deep learning to capture both fine-grained local structure and general structure-to-sequence patterns, addressing limitations of each approach alone.

entry.title: Unlearning-based sliding window for continual learning under concept drift

author.name: Michal Wozniak, Marek Klonowski, Maciej Maczynski, Bartosz Krawczyk

entry.summary: Proposes using machine unlearning instead of full retraining for sliding window approaches in continual learning under concept drift, incrementally removing outdated data influence rather than rebuilding models from scratch.

entry.title: Cross-RAG: Zero-Shot Retrieval-Augmented Time Series Forecasting via Cross-Attention

author.name: Seunghan Lee, Jaehoon Lee, Jun Seo, Sungdong Yoo, Minjae Kim, Tae Yoon Lim, Dongwan Kang, Hwanil Choi, SoonYoung Lee, Wonbin Ahn

entry.summary: Proposes Cross-RAG, a zero-shot retrieval-augmented time series forecasting framework using cross-attention to selectively attend to query-relevant retrieved samples, addressing the problem of irrelevant retrieval in existing approaches.

entry.title: Point-Identification of a Robust Predictor Under Latent Shift with Imperfect Proxies

author.name: Zahra Rahiminasab, Reza Soumi, Arto Klami, Samuel Kaski

entry.summary: Addresses domain adaptation under latent confounders with imperfect proxies that break the completeness assumption, proposing a method for point-identification of robust predictors using auxiliary sensitivity information.

entry.title: Decomposing Probabilistic Scores: Reliability, Information Loss and Uncertainty

author.name: Arthur Charpentier, Agathe Fernandes-Machado

entry.summary: Develops decomposition identities for proper losses that make calibration's dependence on retained information explicit, providing a three-term identity splitting scores into miscalibration, information loss (grouping), and residual uncertainty.

entry.title: Deep Learning for BioImaging: What Are We Learning?

author.name: Ivan Svatko, Maxime Sanchez, Ihab Bendidi, Gilles Cottrell, Auguste Genovesio

entry.summary: Conducts a systematic study of representation learning for microscopy imaging, revealing that state-of-the-art methods perform comparably to simple baselines including untrained models, questioning what current methods actually learn.

entry.title: State-space models through the lens of ensemble control

author.name: Ye Feng, Jianfeng Lu

entry.summary: Formulates SSM training as an ensemble optimal control problem with shared control laws, derives Pontryagin's maximum principle, and proves convergence with conditions for global optimality.

entry.title: A Single-Sample Polylogarithmic Regret Bound for Nonstationary Online Linear Programming

author.name: Haoran Xu, Owen Shen, Peter Glynn, Yinyu Ye, Patrick Jaillet

entry.summary: Achieves polylogarithmic regret for nonstationary online linear programming in the single-sample setting, where only one sample from each distribution is available. This significantly improves upon prior bounds for this challenging setting.

entry.title: Towards Next-Generation LLM Training: From the Data-Centric Perspective

author.name: Hao Liang, Zhengyang Zhao, Zhaoyang Han, Meiyi Qiang, Xiaochen Ma, Bohan Zeng, Qifeng Cai, Zhiyu Li, Linpeng Tang, Weinan E, Wentao Zhang

entry.summary: A comprehensive survey on data-centric approaches for next-generation LLM training, covering data preparation, curation, and utilization strategies. Highlights the need for mature agent-based data systems and systematic data quality mechanisms.

entry.title: Trustworthy Koopman Operator Learning: Invariance Diagnostics and Error Bounds

author.name: Gustav Conradie, Nicolas Boull\'e, Jean-Christophe Loiseau, Steven L. Brunton, Matthew J. Colbrook

entry.summary: Develops a unified methodology for certifying Koopman operator approximations using only snapshot data, providing a posteriori diagnostics for invariance and projection errors and actionable guarantees for dictionary refinement.

entry.title: LiveWeb-IE: A Benchmark For Online Web Information Extraction

author.name: Seungbin Yang, Jihwan Kim, Jaemin Choi, Dongjin Kim, Soyoung Yang, ChaeHun Park, Jaegul Choo

entry.summary: Introduces LiveWeb-IE, a benchmark for evaluating web information extraction systems against live (not static) websites, addressing the limitation that performance on static HTML snapshots doesn't generalize to dynamic real-world scenarios.

entry.title: Top-b: Entropic Regulation of Relative Probability Bands in Autoregressive Language Processes

author.name: Deepon Halder, Raj Dabre

entry.summary: Proposes Top-b (Adaptive Relative Band Sampling), a decoding strategy that dynamically adjusts the candidate token set based on instantaneous Shannon entropy, replacing static truncation rules of Top-k and Top-p with entropy-coupled bandwidth.

entry.title: MMKU-Bench: A Multimodal Update Benchmark for Diverse Visual Knowledge

author.name: Baochen Fu, Yuntao Du, Cheng Chang, Baihao Jin, Wenzhi Deng, Muhao Xu, Hongmei Yan, Weiye Song, Yi Wan

entry.summary: Proposes MMKU-Bench, a benchmark for multimodal knowledge updating in vision-language models with 25K+ knowledge instances and 49K+ images, covering both learning new knowledge and updating outdated knowledge with cross-modal consistency evaluation.

entry.title: Gloss-Free Sign Language Translation: An Unbiased Evaluation of Progress in the Field

author.name: Ozge Mercanoglu Sincan, Jian He Low, Sobhan Asasi, Richard Bowden

entry.summary: Comprehensive re-evaluation of gloss-free sign language translation models in a unified codebase, finding that many reported gains come from backbone choices and training optimizations rather than methodological novelty.

entry.title: LADR: Locality-Aware Dynamic Rescue for Efficient Text-to-Image Generation with Diffusion Large Language Models

author.name: Chenglin Wang, Yucheng Zhou, Shawn Chen, Tao Wang, Kai Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes LADR, a training-free method to accelerate discrete diffusion language models for text-to-image generation by exploiting spatial Markov properties, prioritizing recovery of tokens at the 'generation frontier' near observed pixels.

entry.title: WAT: Online Video Understanding Needs Watching Before Thinking

author.name: Zifan Han, Hongbo Sun, Jinglin Xu, Canhui Tang, Yulong Lei, Xuchong Zhang, Hongbin Sun, Zhongjiang He, Hao Sun

entry.summary: Proposes WAT (Watching Before Thinking), a two-stage framework for online video reasoning with MLLMs that separates query-independent watching (building hierarchical memory) from query-triggered thinking. Uses short-term and long-term memory with redundancy-aware eviction.

entry.title: Deep Learning From Routine Histology Improves Risk Stratification for Biochemical Recurrence in Prostate Cancer

author.name: Cl\'ement Grisi, Khrystyna Faryna, Nefise Uysal, Vittorio Agosti, Enrico Munari, Sol\`ene-Florence Kammerer-Jacquet, Paulo Guilherme de Oliveira Salles, Yuri Tolkach, Reinhard B\"uttner, Sofiya Semko, Maksym Pikul, Axel Heidenreich, Jeroen van der Laak, Geert Litjens

entry.summary: Develops a deep learning biomarker from H&E-stained prostatectomy slides to predict biochemical recurrence risk, validated across four international cohorts with robust generalization.

entry.title: FIND: A Simple yet Effective Baseline for Diffusion-Generated Image Detection

author.name: Jie Li, Yingying Feng, Chi Xie, Jie Hu, Lei Tan, Jiayi Ji

entry.summary: Proposes FIND, a simple method for detecting diffusion-generated images based on the insight that real images are harder to fit with Gaussian distributions than synthetic ones, requiring only a binary classifier.

entry.title: AvatarForcing: One-Step Streaming Talking Avatars via Local-Future Sliding-Window Denoising

author.name: Liyuan Cui, Wentao Hu, Wenyuan Zhang, Zesong Yang, Fan Shi, Xiaoqiang Liu

entry.summary: AvatarForcing enables real-time streaming talking avatar generation using one-step diffusion with a local-future sliding window and dual-anchor temporal forcing for unbounded stable streams.

entry.title: LongVidSearch: An Agentic Benchmark for Multi-hop Evidence Retrieval Planning in Long Videos

author.name: Rongyi Yu, Chenyuan Duan, Wentao Zhang

entry.summary: LongVidSearch is a benchmark for evaluating agentic multi-hop evidence retrieval planning in long videos, separating retrieval planning failures from answer generation failures.

entry.title: A Skill-augmented Agentic Framework and Benchmark for Multi-Video Understanding

author.name: Yue Zhang, Liqiang Jing, Jia Li, Yapeng Tian, Xinya Du, Yunhui Guo, Vibhav Gogate

entry.summary: Introduces MVX-Bench for multi-video understanding and a skill-augmented agentic framework that decomposes cross-video reasoning into specialized skills via tool use.

entry.title: Video-CoE: Reinforcing Video Event Prediction via Chain of Events

author.name: Qile Su, Jing Tang, Rui Chen, Lei Sun, Xiangxiang Chu

entry.summary: Proposes Chain of Events (CoE) paradigm for video event prediction, constructing temporal event chains to guide MLLMs in making logical future predictions from video content, addressing gaps in temporal reasoning.

entry.title: GeoNVS: Geometry Grounded Video Diffusion for Novel View Synthesis

author.name: Minjun Kang, Inkyu Shin, Taeyeop Lee, Myungchul Kim, In So Kweon, Kuk-Jin Yoon

entry.summary: Introduces GeoNVS, a geometry-grounded novel view synthesizer using a Gaussian Splat Feature Adapter (GS-Adapter) that lifts diffusion features into 3D Gaussians for geometry-constrained novel view synthesis.

entry.title: AnyCrowd: Instance-Isolated Identity-Pose Binding for Arbitrary Multi-Character Animation

author.name: Zhenyu Xie, Ji Xia, Michael Kampffmeyer, Panwen Hu, Zehua Ma, Yujian Zheng, Jing Wang, Zheng Chong, Xujie Zhang, Xianhang Cheng, Xiaodan Liang, Hao Li

entry.summary: Proposes AnyCrowd, a DiT-based framework for multi-character animation scaling to arbitrary numbers of characters, addressing identity bleeding and identity-pose mis-binding through instance-isolated encoding.

entry.title: Evaluating Time Awareness and Cross-modal Active Perception of Large Models via 4D Escape Room Task

author.name: Yurui Dong, Ziyue Wang, Shuyun Lu, Dairu Liu, Xuechen Liu, Fuwen Luo, Peng Li, Yang Liu

entry.summary: Introduces EscapeCraft-4D, a 4D environment in Minecraft for evaluating multimodal models' time awareness and cross-modal active perception with audio, vision, and language under time-varying conditions.

entry.title: Fast SAM 3D Body: Accelerating SAM 3D Body for Real-Time Full-Body Human Mesh Recovery

author.name: Timing Yang, Sicheng He, Hongyi Jing, Jiawei Yang, Zhijian Liu, Chuhang Zou, Yue Wang

entry.summary: Fast SAM 3D Body accelerates state-of-the-art monocular 3D human mesh recovery from seconds to interactive rates without retraining. Replaces iterative mesh fitting with feedforward mapping, achieving 10,000x speedup for SMPL extraction.

entry.title: Ego to World: Collaborative Spatial Reasoning in Embodied Systems via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Heng Zhou, Li Kang, Yiran Qin, Xiufeng Song, Ao Yu, Zilu Zhang, Haoming Song, Kaixin Xu, Yuchen Fan, Dongzhan Zhou, Xiaohong Liu, Ruimao Zhang, Philip Torr, Lei Bai, Zhenfei Yin

entry.summary: Ego-to-World (E2W) benchmark evaluates VLMs' ability to fuse heterogeneous viewpoints across counting, relational reasoning, and grasping tasks. CoRL framework combines Chain-of-Thought fine-tuning with reinforcement learning for multi-agent spatial reasoning.

entry.title: ST-VLA: Enabling 4D-Aware Spatiotemporal Understanding for General Robot Manipulation

author.name: You Wu, Zixuan Chen, Cunxu Ou, Wenxuan Wang, Wenbo Huang, Lin Cao, Yangtao Chen, Weichao Qiu, Xingyue Quan, Jieqi Shi, Jing Huo, Yang Gao

entry.summary: ST-VLA proposes a hierarchical VLA framework using unified 3D-4D representations to bridge perception and action, converting 2D guidance into 3D trajectories with smooth spatial masks capturing spatiotemporal context.

entry.title: ImagiNav: Scalable Embodied Navigation via Generative Visual Prediction and Inverse Dynamics

author.name: Jie Chen, Yuxin Cai, Yizhuo Wang, Ruofei Bai, Yuhong Cao, Jun Li, Yau Wei Yun, Guillaume Sartoretti

entry.summary: ImagiNav decouples visual planning from robot actuation for language-guided navigation, using a VLM for subgoals, finetuned video diffusion for visual planning, and inverse dynamics for action generation, enabling use of in-the-wild navigation videos.

entry.title: URDF-Anything+: Autoregressive Articulated 3D Models Generation for Physical Simulation

author.name: Zhuangzhe Wu, Yue Xin, Chengkai Hou, Minghao Chen, Yaoxu Lyu, Jieyu Zhang, Shanghang Zhang

entry.summary: URDF-Anything+ is an autoregressive framework that generates executable URDF articulated object models from visual observations, sequentially producing part geometries and joint parameters without multi-stage pipelines.

entry.title: Stiffness Copilot: An Impedance Policy for Contact-Rich Teleoperation

author.name: Yeping Wang, Zhengtong Xu, Pornthep Preechayasomboon, Ben Abbatematteo, Amirhossein H. Memar, Nick Colonnese, Sonny Chan

entry.summary: Stiffness Copilot is a vision-based policy for shared-control teleoperation that automatically adjusts robot impedance based on wrist-camera images, trained in simulation with privileged contact information and transferring zero-shot to real images.

entry.title: NavThinker: Action-Conditioned World Models for Coupled Prediction and Planning in Social Navigation

author.name: Tianshuai Hu, Zeying Gong, Lingdong Kong, XiaoDong Mei, Yiyi Ding, Qi Zeng, Ao Liang, Rong Li, Yangyi Zhong, Junwei Liang

entry.summary: NavThinker couples an action-conditioned world model with on-policy RL for social navigation. The world model operates in Depth Anything V2 feature space and autoregressively predicts future scene geometry and human motion, enabling the robot to reason about how its actions influence pedestrians.

entry.title: Adding Typos Made Haiku's Accuracy Go Up

author.name: bira

entry.summary: Reports that adding typos to prompts at 16% rate increased Claude Haiku's accuracy by 22% on BigCodeBench, while Opus's accuracy dropped by 9%. The effect appears Haiku-specific (both 3.5 and 4.5 versions) and is not explained by longer outputs (output length actually decreased).

entry.title: HalDec-Bench: Benchmarking Hallucination Detector in Image Captioning

author.name: Kuniaki Saito, Risa Shinoda, Shohei Tanaka, Tosho Hirasawa, Fumio Okura, Yoshitaka Ushiku

entry.summary: Introduces HalDec-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating hallucination detectors in image captioning across diverse VLMs and hallucination types with human annotations.

entry.title: Prompt Complexity Dilutes Structured Reasoning: A Follow-Up Study on the Car Wash Problem

author.name: Heejin Jo

entry.summary: Follow-up study showing that STAR reasoning, which achieves 100% on a car wash problem in isolation, drops to 0-30% when embedded in a complex 60+ line production prompt. Demonstrates that prompt complexity dilutes structured reasoning effectiveness.

entry.title: Supervised Fine-Tuning versus Reinforcement Learning: A Study of Post-Training Methods for Large Language Models

author.name: Haitao Jiang, Wenbo Zhang, Jiarui Yao, Hengrui Cai, Sheng Wang, Rui Song

entry.summary: Comprehensive survey presenting a unified perspective on SFT and RL for LLM post-training, analyzing their objectives, algorithmic structures, data requirements, and interplay including hybrid frameworks.

entry.title: SuperLocalMemory V3: Information-Geometric Foundations for Zero-LLM Enterprise Agent Memory

author.name: Varun Pratap Bhardwaj

entry.summary: Establishes information-geometric foundations for AI agent memory, deriving retrieval metrics from Fisher information, formulating memory lifecycle as Riemannian Langevin dynamics, and providing formal contradiction detection—all computable in O(d) time.

entry.title: Argumentation for Explainable and Globally Contestable Decision Support with LLMs

author.name: Adam Dejl, Matthew Williams, Francesca Toni

entry.summary: Introduces ArgEval, a framework combining LLMs with computational argumentation for structured evaluation of general decision options, enabling global contestation that changes underlying decision logic rather than just instance-specific reasoning.

entry.title: RenderMem: Rendering as Spatial Memory Retrieval

author.name: JooHyun Park, HyeongYeop Kang

entry.summary: Introduces RenderMem, a spatial memory framework for embodied agents that treats rendering as the interface between 3D representations and spatial reasoning, generating query-conditioned visual evidence from maintained 3D scenes.

entry.title: VTC-Bench: Evaluating Agentic Multimodal Models via Compositional Visual Tool Chaining

author.name: Xuanyu Zhu, Yuhao Dong, Rundong Wang, Yang Shi, Zhipeng Wu, Yinlun Peng, YiFan Zhang, Yihang Lou, Yuanxing Zhang, Ziwei Liu, Yan Bai, Yuan Zhou

entry.summary: Introduces VTC-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating tool-use proficiency in multimodal LLMs with 32 diverse tools and complex compositional tool-chaining trajectories, designed to reflect realistic computer vision pipelines.

entry.title: Evaluation of Audio Language Models for Fairness, Safety, and Security

author.name: Ranya Aloufi, Srishti Gupta, Soumya Shaw, Battista Biggio, Lea Sch\"onherr

entry.summary: Introduces a structural taxonomy for Audio Large Language Models and evaluates fairness, safety, and security across different architectural choices, showing how model design affects FSS behavior.

entry.title: FedTreeLoRA: Reconciling Statistical and Functional Heterogeneity in Federated LoRA Fine-Tuning

author.name: Jieming Bian, Lei Wang, Letian Zhang, Jie Xu

entry.summary: Proposes FedTreeLoRA, a federated LoRA fine-tuning framework with tree-structured aggregation that addresses both statistical heterogeneity across clients and functional heterogeneity across LLM layers.

entry.title: From Stochastic Answers to Verifiable Reasoning: Interpretable Decision-Making with LLM-Generated Code

author.name: Anirudh Jaidev Mahesh, Ben Griffin, Fuat Alican, Joseph Ternasky, Zakari Salifu, Kelvin Amoaba, Yagiz Ihlamur, Aaron Ontoyin Yin, Aikins Laryea, Afriyie Samuel, Yigit Ihlamur

entry.summary: Reframes LLMs as code generators rather than per-instance evaluators for decision-making, generating executable, auditable decision logic in a single LLM call that runs deterministically over structured data.

entry.title: RelayCaching: Accelerating LLM Collaboration via Decoding KV Cache Reuse

author.name: Yingsheng Geng, Yuchong Gao, Weihong Wu, Guyue Liu, Jiang Liu

entry.summary: Presents RelayCaching, which directly reuses decoding-phase KV caches from previous agents in multi-agent LLM systems, reducing redundant prefill computation and improving time-to-first-token.

entry.title: Pragma-VL: Towards a Pragmatic Arbitration of Safety and Helpfulness in MLLMs

author.name: Ming Wen, Kun Yang, Xin Chen, Jingyu Zhang, Dingding Han, Shiwen Cui, Yuedong Xu

entry.summary: Introduces Pragma-VL, an end-to-end alignment algorithm for multimodal LLMs that pragmatically balances safety and helpfulness, using a cold-start SFT stage to enhance visual risk perception.

entry.title: ICPRL: Acquiring Physical Intuition from Interactive Control

author.name: Xinrun Xu, Pi Bu, Ye Wang, B\"orje F. Karlsson, Ziming Wang, Tengtao Song, Qi Zhu, Jun Song, Shuo Zhang, Zhiming Ding, Bo Zheng

entry.summary: Introduces ICPRL (In-Context Physical Reinforcement Learning), which trains VLMs to acquire physical intuition through multi-turn interaction using Group Relative Policy Optimization over diverse episode histories.

entry.title: Evidence-based Distributional Alignment for Large Language Models

author.name: Viet-Thanh Pham, Lizhen Qu, Zhuang Li, Gholamreza Haffari

entry.summary: Proposes Evi-DA, an evidence-based alignment technique that improves LLM-based distribution prediction under domain and cultural shift, enabling models to predict how populations distribute responses rather than collapsing to a single answer.

entry.title: Ethical Fairness without Demographics in Human-Centered AI

author.name: Shaily Roy, Harshit Sharma, Asif Salekin

entry.summary: Proposes a framework for ethical fairness in AI without requiring demographic attributes, addressing the impracticality of demographic-dependent fairness methods in privacy-sensitive domains like healthcare and education.

entry.title: Schema First Tool APIs for LLM Agents: A Controlled Study of Tool Misuse, Recovery, and Budgeted Performance

author.name: Akshey Sigdel, Rista Baral

entry.summary: Studies whether schema-based tool contracts and structured validation diagnostics improve LLM agent tool-use reliability under strict interaction budgets, finding that interface design significantly affects misuse rates.

entry.title: Outcome-Aware Tool Selection for Semantic Routers: Latency-Constrained Learning Without LLM Inference

author.name: Huamin Chen, Xunzhuo Liu, Junchen Jiang, Bowei He, Xue Liu

entry.summary: Proposes OATS, an outcome-aware tool selection method for semantic routers that interpolates tool embeddings toward success centroids offline, improving NDCG@5 on tool selection benchmarks without adding inference latency.

entry.title: CHIMERA-Bench: A Benchmark Dataset for Epitope-Specific Antibody Design

author.name: Mansoor Ahmed, Nadeem Taj, Imdad Ullah Khan, Hemanth Venkateswara, Murray Patterson

entry.summary: Introduces CHIMERA-Bench, a standardized benchmark for epitope-conditioned CDR sequence-structure co-design in antibodies, addressing the lack of fair comparison across computational antibody design methods.

entry.title: Modality-free Graph In-context Alignment

author.name: Wei Zhuo, Siqiang Luo

entry.summary: Introduces MF-GIA, a framework for modality-free graph in-context learning that enables pretrained graph encoders to perform few-shot prediction across heterogeneous domains using gradient fingerprints, without requiring modality-specific encoders.

entry.title: Preconditioned Test-Time Adaptation for Out-of-Distribution Debiasing in Narrative Generation

author.name: Hanwen Shen, Ting Ying, Jiajie Lu, Shanshan Wang

entry.summary: Proposes CAP-TTA, a test-time adaptation framework for debiasing LLMs against out-of-distribution bias prompts. Uses context-aware LoRA updates triggered by bias-risk thresholds with a precomputed preconditioner for fast adaptation.

entry.title: Level Up: Defining and Exploiting Transitional Problems for Curriculum Learning

author.name: Zhenwei Tang, Amogh Inamdar, Ashton Anderson, Richard Zemel

entry.summary: Introduces a method for measuring problem difficulty relative to model ability for curriculum learning, identifying 'transitional problems' that become easier as ability increases. Applied to chess and mathematics with improved training efficiency.

entry.title: Fine-tuning is Not Enough: A Parallel Framework for Collaborative Imitation and Reinforcement Learning in End-to-end Autonomous Driving

author.name: Zhexi Lian, Haoran Wang, Xuerun Yan, Weimeng Lin, Xianhong Zhang, Yongyu Chen, Jia Hu

entry.summary: Proposes PaIR-Drive, a parallel framework combining imitation learning and reinforcement learning for end-to-end autonomous driving, avoiding the policy drift problems of sequential RL fine-tuning.

entry.title: Not All Latent Spaces Are Flat: Hyperbolic Concept Control

author.name: Maria Rosaria Briglia, Simone Facchiano, Paolo Cursi, Alessio Sampieri, Emanuele Rodol\`a, Guido Maria D'Amely di Melendugno, Luca Franco, Fabio Galasso, Iacopo Masi

entry.summary: Introduces HyCon, a hyperbolic control mechanism for text-to-image models that uses parallel transport in hyperbolic space for more expressive concept manipulation, achieving SOTA results across safety benchmarks.

entry.title: I'm Not Reading All of That: Understanding Software Engineers' Level of Cognitive Engagement with Agentic Coding Assistants

author.name: Carlos Rafael Catalan, Lheane Marie Dizon, Patricia Nicole Monderin, Emily Kuang

entry.summary: A formative study examining how software engineers cognitively engage with agentic coding assistants. Finds that cognitive engagement varies and that these tools should be designed as 'Tools for Thought' rather than autonomous task performers to prevent over-reliance.

entry.title: OxyGen: Unified KV Cache Management for Vision-Language-Action Models under Multi-Task Parallelism

author.name: Xiangyu Li, Huaizhi Tang, Xin Ding, Weijun Wang, Ting Cao, Yunxin Liu

entry.summary: OxyGen proposes unified KV cache management for Vision-Language-Action models running multiple tasks in parallel, treating KV cache as a shared resource across tasks and time to eliminate redundant computation in embodied AI agents.

entry.title: ES-Merging: Biological MLLM Merging via Embedding Space Signals

author.name: Wonbin Lee, Dongki Kim, Sung Ju Hwang

entry.summary: ES-Merging proposes a representation-aware framework for merging biological MLLMs (e.g., protein, molecule models) by estimating merging coefficients from embedding space signals rather than parameter-space heuristics. Author Sung Ju Hwang is well-known.

entry.title: $PA^3$: $\textbf{P}$olicy-$\textbf{A}$ware $\textbf{A}$gent $\textbf{A}$lignment through Chain-of-Thought

author.name: Shubhashis Roy Dipta, Daniel Bis, Kun Zhou, Lichao Wang, Benjamin Z. Yao, Chenlei Guo, Ruhi Sarikaya

entry.summary: PA³ teaches LLM-based conversational agents to recall and apply business policies during chain-of-thought reasoning without including full policies in context. Introduces PolicyRecall reward based on Jaccard similarity for RL training.

entry.title: AgentTrace: Causal Graph Tracing for Root Cause Analysis in Deployed Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Zhaohui Geoffrey Wang

entry.summary: AgentTrace is a lightweight causal tracing framework for diagnosing failures in deployed multi-agent systems by reconstructing causal graphs from execution logs and ranking root causes without LLM inference at debug time.

entry.title: ContiGuard: A Framework for Continual Toxicity Detection Against Evolving Evasive Perturbations

author.name: Hankun Kang, Xin Miao, Jianhao Chen, Jintao Wen, Mayi Xu, Weiyu Zhang, Wenpeng Lu, Tieyun Qian

entry.summary: ContiGuard addresses evolving evasive perturbations in toxicity detection through continual learning. Tackles the problem that malicious users continually develop new evasion tactics while traditional detectors remain static. Handles perturbation-induced noise that distorts semantics.

entry.title: Learning Question-Aware Keyframe Selection with Synthetic Supervision for Video Question Answering

author.name: Minchan Kwon, Hyounguk Shon, Junmo Kim

entry.summary: Proposes question-aware keyframe selection for video QA using pseudo labels from LMMs and coverage regularization for temporal diversity. Improves accuracy on temporal and causal questions by selecting more informative frames. Addresses efficiency and reasoning quality in video understanding.

entry.title: Empowering Chemical Structures with Biological Insights for Scalable Phenotypic Virtual Screening

author.name: Xiaoqing Lian, Pengsen Ma, Tengfeng Ma, Zhonghao Ren, Xibao Cai, Zhixiang Cheng, Bosheng Song, He Wang, Xiang Pan, Yangyang Chen, Sisi Yuan, Chen Lin

entry.summary: DECODE bridges structural screening scalability with phenotypic profiling's biological insights by empowering chemical representations with biological semantics. Enables structure-based in silico biological profiling without requiring biological data at inference time. Addresses a key trade-off in drug discovery.

entry.title: Open Biomedical Knowledge Graphs at Scale: Construction, Federation, and AI Agent Access with Samyama Graph Database

author.name: Madhulatha Mandarapu, Sandeep Kunkunuru

entry.summary: Presents two open-source biomedical knowledge graphs built on a high-performance Rust graph database: Pathways KG and Clinical Trials KG spanning millions of nodes and edges from multiple sources. Provides reproducible ETL patterns and AI agent access patterns for biomedical knowledge integration.

entry.title: CATFormer: When Continual Learning Meets Spiking Transformers With Dynamic Thresholds

author.name: Vaishnavi Nagabhushana, Kartikay Agrawal, Ayon Borthakur

entry.summary: CATFormer combines spiking neural networks with transformers using context-adaptive dynamic thresholds for class-incremental continual learning. Addresses catastrophic forgetting in SNNs which suffer sharp performance drops as tasks accumulate. Brain-inspired approach to continual learning.

entry.title: Towards Foundation Models for Consensus Rank Aggregation

author.name: Yijun Jin, Simon Kl\"uttermann, Chiara Balestra, Emmanuel M\"uller

entry.summary: Kemeny Transformer uses reinforcement learning to train a Transformer to approximate the NP-hard Kemeny optimal ranking aggregation. Outperforms classical majority-heuristic methods. Applications in recommendation systems, search engines, and elections.

entry.title: From Documents to Spans: Code-Centric Learning for LLM-based ICD Coding

author.name: Xu Zhang, Wenxin Ma, Chenxu Wu, Rongsheng Wang, Kun Zhang, S. Kevin Zhou

entry.summary: Code-Centric Learning shifts ICD coding supervision from document-level to code-span level, improving LLM interpretability and efficiency. Addresses limited code space coverage in public datasets and high computational cost of processing long clinical documents. More targeted training approach for medical coding.

entry.title: SKILLS: Structured Knowledge Injection for LLM-Driven Telecommunications Operations

author.name: Ivo Brett

entry.summary: SKILLS benchmarks LLM agents on 37 telecom operations scenarios across 8 TM Forum Open API domains with live mock API servers and deterministic evaluation. Tests whether general-purpose LLMs can execute telecom workflows or need structured domain guidance. Practical benchmark for enterprise AI deployment.

entry.title: The PokeAgent Challenge: Competitive and Long-Context Learning at Scale

author.name: Seth Karten, Jake Grigsby, Tersoo Upaa Jr, Junik Bae, Seonghun Hong, Hyunyoung Jeong, Jaeyoon Jung, Kun Kerdthaisong, Gyungbo Kim, Hyeokgi Kim, Yujin Kim, Eunju Kwon, Dongyu Liu, Patrick Mariglia, Sangyeon Park, Benedikt Schink, Xianwei Shi, Anthony Sistilli, Joseph Twin, Arian Urdu, Matin Urdu, Qiao Wang, Ling Wu, Wenli Zhang, Kunsheng Zhou, Stephanie Milani, Kiran Vodrahalli, Amy Zhang, Fei Fang, Yuke Zhu, Chi Jin

entry.summary: Presents the PokeAgent Challenge, a large-scale benchmark for AI decision-making using Pokemon battles (partial observability, game-theoretic reasoning) and RPG speedrunning (long-horizon planning).

entry.title: RBF-Solver: A Multistep Sampler for Diffusion Probabilistic Models via Radial Basis Functions

author.name: Soochul Park, Yeon Ju Lee, SeongJin Yoon, Jiyub Shin, Juhee Lee, Seongwoon Jo

entry.summary: Proposes RBF-Solver, a diffusion sampler using Gaussian radial basis functions with learnable shape parameters to follow optimal sampling trajectories, reducing to DDIM at first order.

entry.title: Probabilistic Gaussian Homotopy: A Probability-Space Continuation Framework for Nonconvex Optimization

author.name: Eshed Gal, Samy Wu Fung, Eldad Haber

entry.summary: Introduces Probabilistic Gaussian Homotopy, a probability-space continuation framework for nonconvex optimization that uses Boltzmann-weighted gradient aggregation to bias descent toward low-energy regions.

entry.title: PLUME: Building a Network-Native Foundation Model for Wireless Traces via Protocol-Aware Tokenization

author.name: Swadhin Pradhan, Shazal Irshad, Jerome Henry

entry.summary: Introduces PLUME, a 140M-parameter foundation model for 802.11 wireless packet traces with a protocol-aware tokenizer that produces 6.2x shorter sequences than BPE.

entry.title: Learning to Order: Task Sequencing as In-Context Optimization

author.name: Jan Kobiolka, Christian Frey, Arlind Kadra, Gresa Shala, Josif Grabocka

entry.summary: Demonstrates that transformers can meta-learn task sequencing from synthetically generated problems (paths in directed graphs) and achieve few-shot generalization to new sequencing problems in domains like robotics and autonomous driving.

entry.title: Proactive Routing to Interpretable Surrogates with Distribution-Free Safety Guarantees

author.name: Iqtedar Uddin, Mazin Khider, Andr\'e Bauer

entry.summary: Studies proactive model routing between black-box and interpretable surrogate models with distribution-free safety guarantees via Clopper-Pearson conformal calibration, ensuring the routed-set violation rate is controlled.

entry.title: Interpretable Classification of Time Series Using Euler Characteristic Surfaces

author.name: Salam Rabindrajit Luwang, Sushovan Majhi, Vishal Mandal, Atish J. Mitra, Md. Nurujjaman, Buddha Nath Sharma

entry.summary: Proposes Euler Characteristic Surfaces (ECS) as computationally efficient topological signatures for time series classification, providing spatiotemporal information more efficiently than persistent homology with stability guarantees.

entry.title: Data Augmentation via Causal-Residual Bootstrapping

author.name: Mateusz Gajewski, Sophia Xiao, Bijan Mazaheri

entry.summary: Proposes causal-residual bootstrapping for data augmentation that incorporates causal knowledge beyond Markov equivalence classes by permuting residuals of models built on marginal distributions under additive noise assumptions.

entry.title: SmartSearch: How Ranking Beats Structure for Conversational Memory Retrieval

author.name: Jesper Derehag, Carlos Calva, Timmy Ghiurau

entry.summary: Demonstrates that a simple deterministic pipeline (NER-weighted matching + CrossEncoder ranking) can outperform complex LLM-based structuring approaches for conversational memory retrieval. Identifies ranking as the key bottleneck rather than retrieval recall.

entry.title: Refining 3D Medical Segmentation with Verbal Instruction

author.name: Kangxian Xie, Jiancheng Yang, Nandor Pinter, Chao Wu, Behzad Bozorgtabar, Mingchen Gao

entry.summary: Introduces CoWTalk, a benchmark for refining 3D medical segmentation using verbal instructions from radiologists, addressing the scarcity of paired data linking erroneous shapes to corrective instructions via controllable synthesized anatomical errors.

entry.title: Preconditioned One-Step Generative Modeling for Bayesian Inverse Problems in Function Spaces

author.name: Zilan Cheng, Li-Lian Wang, Zhongjian Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a one-step generative transport method for Bayesian inverse problems in function spaces using neural-operator backbones, showing that white-noise references become incompatible in the function-space limit and introducing prior-aligned anisotropic Gaussian references.

entry.title: Sequential Transport for Causal Mediation Analysis

author.name: Agathe Fernandes-Machado, Iryna Voitsitska, Arthur Charpentier, Ewen Gallic

entry.summary: Proposes sequential transport for causal mediation analysis, combining optimal transport with mediator DAGs to construct unit-level counterfactuals without cross-world assumptions, handling both continuous and categorical mediators.

entry.title: Writer-R1: Enhancing Generative Writing in LLMs via Memory-augmented Replay Policy Optimization

author.name: Jihao Zhao, Shuaishuai Zu, Zhiyuan Ji, Chunlai Zhou, Biao Qin

entry.summary: Proposes Writer-R1 with Memory-augmented Replay Policy Optimization (MRPO) for creative writing, using multi-agent collaborative workflow based on Grounded Theory to produce fine-grained evaluation criteria, enabling controlled iterative generation.

entry.title: DOS: Dependency-Oriented Sampler for Masked Diffusion Language Models

author.name: Xueyu Zhou, Yangrong Hu, Jian Huang

entry.summary: Proposes Dependency-Oriented Sampler (DOS) for masked diffusion language models, a training-free decoding strategy that leverages inter-token dependencies from attention matrices to improve generation quality.

entry.title: CreativeBench: Benchmarking and Enhancing Machine Creativity via Self-Evolving Challenges

author.name: Zi-Han Wang, Lam Nguyen, Zhengyang Zhao, Mengyue Yang, Chengwei Qin, Yujiu Yang, Linyi Yang

entry.summary: Introduces CreativeBench, a benchmark for evaluating machine creativity in code generation with two subsets targeting combinatorial and exploratory creativity, using reverse engineering and self-play for automated evaluation.

entry.title: Causal Tracing of Audio-Text Fusion in Large Audio Language Models

author.name: Wei-Chih Chen, Chien-yu Huang, Hung-yi Lee

entry.summary: Adapts causal tracing to investigate how large audio language models integrate acoustic features with text, finding different fusion strategies across models (progressive vs. abrupt) and that the final sequence token acts as an informational bottleneck.

entry.title: Anchor Forcing: Anchor Memory and Tri-Region RoPE for Interactive Streaming Video Diffusion

author.name: Yang Yang, Tianyi Zhang, Wei Huang, Jinwei Chen, Boxi Wu, Xiaofei He, Deng Cai, Bo Li, Peng-Tao Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces Anchor Forcing for interactive streaming video diffusion, addressing quality degradation during prompt switching through anchor memory and tri-region RoPE. Tackles two failure modes: weak boundary conditioning at prompt switches and progressive motion degradation.

entry.title: Ego-1K -- A Large-Scale Multiview Video Dataset for Egocentric Vision

author.name: Jae Yong Lee, Daniel Scharstein, Akash Bapat, Hao Hu, Andrew Fu, Haoru Zhao, Paul Sammut, Xiang Li, Stephen Jeapes, Anik Gupta, Lior David, Saketh Madhuvarasu, Jay Girish Joshi, Jason Wither

entry.summary: Presents Ego-1K, a large-scale dataset of ~1000 time-synchronized egocentric multiview videos captured with a 12+4 camera rig, focusing on hand motions and hand-object interactions.

entry.title: PhysAlign: Physics-Coherent Image-to-Video Generation through Feature and 3D Representation Alignment

author.name: Zhexiao Xiong, Yizhi Song, Liu He, Wei Xiong, Yu Yuan, Feng Qiao, Nathan Jacobs

entry.summary: Proposes PhysAlign for physics-coherent image-to-video generation using a synthetic data pipeline with rigid-body simulation and explicit physics/3D alignment during training.

entry.title: When Visual Privacy Protection Meets Multimodal Large Language Models

author.name: Xiaofei Hui, Qian Wu, Haoxuan Qu, Majid Mirmehdi, Hossein Rahmani, Jun Liu

entry.summary: Investigates visual privacy protection when using black-box MLLM cloud services like GPT-4V, developing methods to protect visual privacy while maintaining MLLM utility without access to internal model information.

entry.title: EyeWorld: A Generative World Model of Ocular State and Dynamics

author.name: Ziyu Gao, Xinyuan Wu, Xiaolan Chen, Zhuoran Liu, Ruoyu Chen, Bowen Liu, Bingjie Yan, Zhenhan Wang, Kai Jin, Jiancheng Yang, Yih Chung Tham, Mingguang He, Danli Shi

entry.summary: Introduces EyeWorld, a generative world model for ophthalmology that learns a latent ocular state across modalities, supporting cross-modality translation, quality enhancement, and longitudinal disease progression forecasting.

entry.title: Fair Benchmarking of Emerging One-Step Generative Models Against Multistep Diffusion and Flow Models

author.name: Advaith Ravishankar, Serena Liu, Mingyang Wang, Todd Zhou, Jeffrey Zhou, Arnav Sharma, Ziling Hu, L\'eopold Das, Abdulaziz Sobirov, Faizaan Siddique, Freddy Yu, Seungjoo Baek, Yan Luo, Mengyu Wang

entry.summary: Provides a standardized benchmarking framework for comparing one-step generative models against multi-step diffusion and flow models, addressing inconsistencies in sampling steps and CFG settings across prior evaluations.

entry.title: MistExit: Learning to Exit for Early Mistake Detection in Procedural Videos

author.name: Sagnik Majumder, Anish Nethi, Ziad Al-Halah, Kristen Grauman

entry.summary: Introduces early mistake detection in procedural videos using a mistake detector and RL policy that adaptively decides when to stop watching video and make a prediction about keystep correctness.

entry.title: Interp3R: Continuous-time 3D Geometry Estimation with Frames and Events

author.name: Shuang Guo, Filbert Febryanto, Lei Sun, Guillermo Gallego

entry.summary: Interp3R enhances pointmap-based 3D models (like DUSt3R) with event camera data to estimate depth and poses at arbitrary time instants between frames, enabling continuous geometry estimation.

entry.title: Make it SING: Analyzing Semantic Invariants in Classifiers

author.name: Harel Yadid, Meir Yossef Levi, Roy Betser, Guy Gilboa

entry.summary: SING provides semantic interpretations of classifier null-space invariants by mapping network features to vision-language models, revealing what variations classifiers ignore.

entry.title: SSR: A Training-Free Approach for Streaming 3D Reconstruction

author.name: Hui Deng, Yuxin Mao, Yuxin He, Yuchao Dai

entry.summary: SSR proposes a training-free plug-and-play regularization for streaming 3D reconstruction from a Grassmannian manifold perspective, enforcing sequence regularity on persistent latent states.

entry.title: LLMind: Bio-inspired Training-free Adaptive Visual Representations for Vision-Language Models

author.name: Soumyaratna Debnath, Bui Duc Manh, Zinan Liu, Lin Wang

entry.summary: Presents LLMind, a training-free framework mimicking human foveated vision and cortical magnification for adaptive visual representations in VLMs under tight pixel budgets, providing the first systematic analysis of bio-inspired visual representations.

entry.title: Molecular Identifier Visual Prompt and Verifiable Reinforcement Learning for Chemical Reaction Diagram Parsing

author.name: Jiahe Song, Chuang Wang, Yinfan Wang, Hao Zheng, Rui Nie, Bowen Jiang, Xingjian Wei, Junyuan Gao, Yubin Wang, Bin Wang, Lijun Wu, Jiang Wu, Qian Yu, Conghui He

entry.summary: Proposes Identifier as Visual Prompting and verifiable reinforcement learning for chemical reaction diagram parsing with VLMs, addressing the alignment between visual entities and molecular knowledge.

entry.title: GUI-CEval: A Hierarchical and Comprehensive Chinese Benchmark for Mobile GUI Agents

author.name: Yang Li, Yuchen Liu, Haoyu Lu, Zhiqiang Xia, Hongzhen Wang, Kaiyang Han, Changpeng Yang, Jinyang Wu, Jiaming Xu, Runyu Shi, Ying Huang

entry.summary: Introduces GUI-CEval, the first comprehensive benchmark for Chinese mobile GUI agents built on physical devices, spanning 201 apps across four device types with hierarchical evaluation from perception to execution.

entry.title: Multi-turn Physics-informed Vision-language Model for Physics-grounded Anomaly Detection

author.name: Yao Gu, Xiaohao Xu, Yingna Wu

entry.summary: Introduces a physics-informed instruction tuning framework for VLMs that encodes object properties and dynamic constraints via multi-turn dialogues, targeting anomaly detection requiring causal physics understanding.

entry.title: MeMix: Writing Less, Remembering More for Streaming 3D Reconstruction

author.name: Jiacheng Dong, Huan Li, Sicheng Zhou, Wenhao Hu, Weili Xu, Yan Wang

entry.summary: Proposes MeMix, a training-free plug-and-play module for streaming 3D reconstruction that partitions recurrent state into memory patches and selectively updates only least-aligned ones to prevent catastrophic forgetting.

entry.title: Panoramic Affordance Prediction

author.name: Zixin Zhang, Chenfei Liao, Hongfei Zhang, Harold Haodong Chen, Kanghao Chen, Zichen Wen, Litao Guo, Bin Ren, Xu Zheng, Yinchuan Li, Xuming Hu, Nicu Sebe, Ying-Cong Chen

entry.summary: Introduces panoramic affordance prediction using 360° imagery, including a new benchmark (PAP-12K) with ultra-high-resolution panoramic images and 12K annotated QA pairs. Proposes a framework for holistic scene understanding in embodied AI contexts.

entry.title: PerlAD: Towards Enhanced Closed-loop End-to-end Autonomous Driving with Pseudo-simulation-based Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Yinfeng Gao, Qichao Zhang, Deqing Liu, Zhongpu Xia, Guang Li, Kun Ma, Guang Chen, Hangjun Ye, Long Chen, Da-Wei Ding, Dongbin Zhao

entry.summary: PerlAD constructs a pseudo-simulation in vector space for training autonomous driving policies via reinforcement learning, avoiding the rendering gap and computational costs of rendering-based environments while enabling closed-loop training.

entry.title: Creating manufacturable blueprints for coarse-grained virtual robots

author.name: Zihan Guo, Muhan Li, Shuzhe Zhang, Sam Kriegman

entry.summary: Automates the mapping from simplified, evolvable virtual robot designs to complete manufacturable blueprints, addressing the longstanding gap between evolved virtual agents and physically realizable robots.

entry.title: Amortizing Trajectory Diffusion with Keyed Drift Fields

author.name: Gokul Puthumanaillam, Melkior Ornik

entry.summary: Proposes keyed drift fields for amortizing trajectory diffusion to achieve one-step inference while retaining diverse trajectory sampling, addressing the inference-time cost bottleneck of diffusion planners in receding-horizon control.

entry.title: GelSphere: An Omnidirectional Rolling Vision-Based Tactile Sensor for Online 3D Reconstruction and Normal Force Estimation

author.name: Seoyeon Lee, Mohammad Amin Mirzaee, Wenzhen Yuan

entry.summary: GelSphere is a spherical vision-based tactile sensor enabling omnidirectional rolling on surfaces via steel ball bearings between gel and housing, with Wi-Fi streaming and online large-surface reconstruction capability.

entry.title: OmniClone: Engineering a Robust, All-Rounder Whole-Body Humanoid Teleoperation System

author.name: Yixuan Li, Le Ma, Yutang Lin, Yushi Du, Mengya Liu, Kaizhe Hu, Jieming Cui, Yixin Zhu, Wei Liang, Baoxiong Jia, Siyuan Huang

entry.summary: OmniClone is a whole-body humanoid teleoperation system designed to be simultaneously robust, versatile, and affordable, with diagnostic evaluation exposing failure modes that aggregate metrics miss.

entry.title: MorFiC: Fixing Value Miscalibration for Zero-Shot Quadruped Transfer

author.name: Prakhar Mishra, Amir Hossain Raj, Xuesu Xiao, Dinesh Manocha

entry.summary: MorFiC enables zero-shot cross-morphology locomotion for quadruped robots using a single shared RL policy. It addresses the key problem of shared critic value miscalibration across different robot morphologies by conditioning the critic via morphology-aware modulation.

entry.title: Transformers As Generalizable Optimal Controllers

author.name: Turki Bin Mohaya, Maitham F. AL-Sunni, John M. Dolan, Peter Seiler

entry.summary: Trains a single transformer to approximate optimal LQR state-feedback laws across heterogeneous MIMO LTI systems of different dimensions. Uses standardization, padding, and dimension encoding to handle varying system sizes, achieving low sub-optimality relative to LQR.

entry.title: Sanders's Data Center Moratorium Is Risky Strategy for AI Safety

author.name: thomasrodskog

entry.summary: Analysis of Senator Bernie Sanders' proposed moratorium on new data center construction, arguing that while his concerns about AI risks are legitimate, a moratorium could be counterproductive for AI safety by shifting compute infrastructure to less regulated jurisdictions and reducing US influence over AI development.

entry.title: VulnAgent-X: A Layered Agentic Framework for Repository-Level Vulnerability Detection

author.name: Renwei Meng, Haoyi Wu, Jingming Wang, Haoyan Bai

entry.summary: Proposes VulnAgent-X, a layered agentic framework for repository-level vulnerability detection that integrates risk screening, context expansion, specialized analysis agents, and dynamic verification into a unified pipeline.

entry.title: CtrlAttack: A Unified Attack on World-Model Control in Diffusion Models

author.name: Shuhan Xu, Siyuan Liang, Hongling Zheng, Yong Luo, Han Hu, Lefei Zhang, Dacheng Tao

entry.summary: Proposes CtrlAttack, the first analysis of vulnerability in diffusion-based image-to-video models by targeting temporal control mechanisms, using trajectory-control perturbations to interfere with state evolution.

entry.title: Distilling Reasoning Without Knowledge: A Framework for Reliable LLMs

author.name: Auksarapak Kietkajornrit, Jad Tarifi, Nima Asgharbeygi

entry.summary: Proposes a modular framework that explicitly separates planning from factual retrieval in LLM question answering. A student planner trained via teacher-student generates structured decompositions with abstract reasoning steps and fact requests.

entry.title: Beyond Local Code Optimization: Multi-Agent Reasoning for Software System Optimization

author.name: Huiyun Peng, Parth Vinod Patil, Antonio Zhong Qiu, George K. Thiruvathukal, James C. Davis

entry.summary: Introduces a multi-agent framework for whole-system optimization of microservices that integrates control-flow and data-flow representations, going beyond local code transformations.

entry.title: LUMINA: A Multi-Vendor Mammography Benchmark with Energy Harmonization Protocol

author.name: Hongyi Pan, Gorkem Durak, Halil Ertugrul Aktas, Andrea M. Bejar, Baver Tutun, Emre Uysal, Ezgi Bulbul, Mehmet Fatih Dogan, Berrin Erok, Berna Akkus Yildirim, Sukru Mehmet Erturk, Ulas Bagci

entry.summary: Presents LUMINA, a curated multi-vendor mammography dataset with energy harmonization protocol, comprising 1824 images from 468 patients spanning six acquisition systems with pathology-confirmed outcomes and BI-RADS assessments.

entry.title: Bayesian Inference for Missing Physics

author.name: Arno Strouwen

entry.summary: Applies Bayesian symbolic regression to discover interpretable equations from universal differential equations (neural ODEs embedded in differential equations), enabling uncertainty quantification for the discovered symbolic expressions of missing physics.

entry.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Fano Hypersurfaces

author.name: Marc Truter

entry.summary: Applies deep reinforcement learning to discover Fano 4-fold hypersurfaces with terminal singularities in algebraic geometry, training a neural network as a dynamic search heuristic for a high-dimensional integer lattice with sparse rewards.

entry.title: ExPosST: Explicit Positioning with Adaptive Masking for LLM-Based Simultaneous Machine Translation

author.name: Yuzhe Shang, Pengzhi Gao, Yazheng Yang, Jiayao Ma, Wei Liu, Jian Luan, Jingsong Su

entry.summary: Proposes ExPosST for simultaneous machine translation with LLMs, resolving positional mismatch in decoder-only models through explicit position allocation with reserved slots for incoming source tokens, enabling efficient KV cache decoding.

entry.title: VeloEdit: Training-Free Consistent and Continuous Instruction-Based Image Editing via Velocity Field Decomposition

author.name: Zongqing Li, Zhihui Liu, Yujie Xie, Shansiyuan Wu, Hongshen Lv, Songzhi Su

entry.summary: Proposes VeloEdit, a training-free image editing method that identifies editing regions by comparing velocity fields for preservation vs. editing in flow matching models, enabling consistent and continuously controllable edits.

entry.title: AURORA-KITTI: Any-Weather Depth Completion and Denoising in the Wild

author.name: Yiting Wang, Tim Br\"odermann, Hamed Haghighi, Haonan Zhao, Christos Sakaridis, Kurt Debattista, Valentina Donzella

entry.summary: AURORA-KITTI is the first large-scale multi-modal multi-weather benchmark for robust depth completion with 82K+ weather-consistent RGBL pairs, formulating unified depth completion and denoising.

entry.title: Zero-Shot Reconstruction of Animatable 3D Avatars with Cloth Dynamics from a Single Image

author.name: Joohyun Kwon, Geonhee Sim, Gyeongsik Moon

entry.summary: DynaAvatar reconstructs animatable 3D avatars with cloth dynamics from a single image in a zero-shot manner, using static-to-dynamic knowledge transfer with transformer-based deformation prediction.

entry.title: Relevance Feedback in Text-to-Image Diffusion: A Training-Free And Model-Agnostic Interactive Framework

author.name: Wenxi Wang, Hongbin Liu, Mingqian Li, Junyan Yuan, Junqi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes RFD, a training-free, model-agnostic interactive framework that adapts relevance feedback from information retrieval to text-to-image diffusion models, letting users refine generation through implicit multi-select feedback rather than explicit text.

entry.title: Tracking the Discriminative Axis: Dual Prototypes for Test-Time OOD Detection Under Covariate Shift

author.name: Wooseok Lee, Jin Mo Yang, Saewoong Bahk, Hyung-Sin Kim

entry.summary: Proposes dual prototype tracking for test-time OOD detection under covariate shift, discovering that ID and OOD samples remain separable along a discriminative axis even under distribution shift.

entry.title: HALO:Closing Sim-to-Real Gap for Heavy-loaded Humanoid Agile Motion Skills via Differentiable Simulation

author.name: Xingyi Wang, Chenyun Zhang, Weiji Xie, Chao Yu, Wei Song, Chenjia Bai, Shiqiang Zhu

entry.summary: HALO addresses sim-to-real transfer for humanoid robots carrying unknown payloads using a two-stage gradient-based system identification framework built on differentiable MuJoCo XLA. Calibrates the nominal model then identifies payload mass distribution, enabling zero-shot policy transfer under heavy loads.

entry.title: Structured Credal Learning

author.name: Varun Venkatesh, Eyke H\"ullermeier, Bernd Bischl, Mina Rezaei

entry.summary: Introduces structured credal learning that explicitly separates covariate shift and label noise as distinct uncertainty sources. Derives geometric bounds showing how covariate shift modulates the contribution of label disagreement to joint uncertainty.

entry.title: Collapse or Preserve: Data-Dependent Temporal Aggregation for Spiking Neural Network Acceleration

author.name: Jiahao Qin

entry.summary: Demonstrates that spike sparsity doesn't actually accelerate SNN inference on GPU hardware, and proposes Temporal Aggregated Convolution (TAC) that pre-aggregates spike frames to achieve 13.8x speedup on rate-coded data.

entry.title: Improving Visual Reasoning with Iterative Evidence Refinement

author.name: Zeru Shi, Kai Mei, Yihao Quan, Dimitris N. Metaxas, Ruixiang Tang

entry.summary: Proposes SIEVE, an end-to-end framework training VLMs to re-engage image evidence through internal self-revisit mechanisms during reasoning, without external image operations like zooming or cropping.

entry.title: Trajectory-Diversity-Driven Robust Vision-and-Language Navigation

author.name: Jiangyang Li, Cong Wan, SongLin Dong, Chenhao Ding, Qiang Wang, Zhiheng Ma, Yihong Gong

entry.summary: Proposes NavGRPO, a reinforcement learning framework using Group Relative Policy Optimization for Vision-and-Language Navigation, achieving improved robustness on R2R and REVERIE benchmarks.

entry.title: DyACE: Dynamic Algorithm Co-evolution for Online Automated Heuristic Design with Large Language Model

author.name: Guidong Lu, Yiping Liu, Xiangxiang Zeng

entry.summary: Reformulates automated heuristic design as a non-stationary bi-level control problem and introduces DyACE, which uses receding horizon control to co-evolve heuristic logic with solution populations, leveraging LLMs for look-ahead strategy generation.

entry.title: The AI Fiction Paradox

author.name: Katherine Elkins

entry.summary: Argues that AI has a 'fiction dependency problem': models need fiction training data but struggle to generate quality fiction. Identifies three fundamental challenges: narrative causation conflicting with forward generation, subjective interiority, and stylistic voice.

entry.title: Orla: A Library for Serving LLM-Based Multi-Agent Systems

author.name: Rana Shahout, Hayder Tirmazi, Minlan Yu, Michael Mitzenmacher

entry.summary: Introduces Orla, a library for constructing LLM-based multi-agent systems that separates request execution from workflow policy, providing agent-level control through stage mapping, scheduling policies, and execution controllers.

entry.title: PA-Net: Precipitation-Adaptive Mixture-of-Experts for Long-Tail Rainfall Nowcasting

author.name: Xinyu Xiao, Sen Lei, Eryun Liu, Shiming Xiang, Hao Li, Cheng Yuan, Yuan Qi, Qizhao Jin

entry.summary: Proposes PA-Net for precipitation nowcasting using a Mixture-of-Experts approach that dynamically scales activated experts based on rainfall intensity, specifically targeting the long-tail distribution where heavy rain events are <0.1% of samples.

entry.title: Agentic DAG-Orchestrated Planner Framework for Multi-Modal, Multi-Hop Question Answering in Hybrid Data Lakes

author.name: Kirushikesh D B, Manish Kesarwani, Nishtha Madaan, Sameep Mehta, Aldrin Dennis, Siddarth Ajay, Rakesh B R, Renu Rajagopal, Sudheesh Kairali

entry.summary: Presents A.DOT Planner, a framework for multi-modal multi-hop question answering over hybrid data lakes (structured tables + unstructured documents) that compiles NL queries into DAG execution plans traversing both data types.

entry.title: Contests with Spillovers: Incentivizing Content Creation with GenAI

author.name: Sagi Ohayon, Boaz Taitler, Omer Ben-Porat

entry.summary: Models the economic dynamics of content creation with GenAI spillovers, where creators' efforts can be easily reused by LLMs. Introduces the CCS model analyzing how platforms should incentivize genuine creative effort when AI enables easy imitation.

entry.title: RS-WorldModel: a Unified Model for Remote Sensing Understanding and Future Sense Forecasting

author.name: Linrui Xu, Zhongan Wang, Fei Shen, Gang Xu, Huiping Zhuang, Ming Li, Haifeng Li

entry.summary: Introduces RS-WorldModel, a unified world model for remote sensing that jointly handles spatiotemporal change understanding and text-guided future scene forecasting. Includes RSWBench-1.1M, a 1.1M sample dataset with language annotations.

entry.title: Advancing Multimodal Agent Reasoning with Long-Term Neuro-Symbolic Memory

author.name: Rongjie Jiang, Jianwei Wang, Gengda Zhao, Chengyang Luo, Kai Wang, Wenjie Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes NS-Mem, a neuro-symbolic memory framework for multimodal agents that integrates neural memory with explicit symbolic structures and rules, advancing long-term reasoning capabilities for deductive tasks.

entry.title: Brain-Inspired Graph Multi-Agent Systems for LLM Reasoning

author.name: Guangfu Hao, Yuming Dai, Xianzhe Qin, Shan Yu

entry.summary: Proposes BIGMAS, a brain-inspired graph multi-agent system where specialized LLM agents coordinate through a centralized shared workspace (inspired by global workspace theory) organized as a dynamically constructed directed graph.

entry.title: Agent Lifecycle Toolkit (ALTK): Reusable Middleware Components for Robust AI Agents

author.name: Zidane Wright, Jason Tsay, Anupama Murthi, Osher Elhadad, Diego Del Rio, Saurabh Goyal, Kiran Kate, Jim Laredo, Koren Lazar, Vinod Muthusamy, Yara Rizk

entry.summary: Presents ALTK, an open-source toolkit of modular middleware components for making AI agents more robust across their lifecycle, addressing failure modes like tool argument errors, silent reasoning failures, and policy violations.
