entry.summary: Reconstructs and runs the 1956 Logic Theorist (widely considered the first AI program) by building a new IPL-V interpreter in Common Lisp and faithfully reanimating the code from Stefferud's 1963 report. Successfully proves 16 of 23 theorems from Principia Mathematica.

entry.title: State Algebra for Probabilistic Logic

author.name: Dmitry Lesnik, Tobias Sch\"afer

entry.summary: Presents a Probabilistic State Algebra extending deterministic propositional logic to construct Markov Random Fields through pure linear algebra, bypassing graph-traversal algorithms by embedding logical reduction natively within matrix operations.

entry.title: MeTok: An Efficient Meteorological Tokenization with Hyper-Aligned Group Learning for Precipitation Nowcasting

author.name: Qizhao Jin, Xianhuang Xu, Yong Cao, Shiming Xiang, Xinyu Xiao

entry.summary: Introduces MeTok, a distribution-centric meteorological tokenization scheme for precipitation nowcasting that groups similar meteorological features spatially rather than by position, with aligned group learning for extreme precipitation patterns.

entry.title: Demand-Driven Context: A Methodology for Building Enterprise Knowledge Bases Through Agent Failure

author.name: Raj Navakoti, Saideep Navakoti

entry.summary: Introduces Demand-Driven Context (DDC), a methodology that uses agent failure as the trigger for knowledge base construction in enterprises, addressing the gap between top-down knowledge engineering and bottom-up automation.

entry.title: Interference-Aware K-Step Reachable Communication in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Ziyu Cheng, Jinsheng Ren, Zhouxian Jiang, Chenzhihang Li, Rongye Shi, Bin Liang, Jun Yang

entry.summary: Proposes IA-KRC for multi-agent reinforcement learning communication, using K-step reachability to confine message passing to physically accessible neighbors and an interference-prediction module to optimize partner selection.

entry.title: PrototypeNAS: Rapid Design of Deep Neural Networks for Microcontroller Units

author.name: Mark Deutel, Simon Geis, Axel Plinge

entry.summary: Proposes PrototypeNAS, a zero-shot neural architecture search method for rapidly deploying DNNs on microcontroller units, automating selection, compression, and specialization without training candidate networks from scratch.

entry.title: Listening to the Echo: User-Reaction Aware Policy Optimization via Scalar-Verbal Hybrid Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Jing Ye, Xinpei Zhao, Lu Xiang, Yaping Zhang, Chengqing Zong

entry.summary: Introduces RAPO (Reaction Aware Policy Optimization) for emotional support dialogue, which optimizes based on simulated user reactions rather than expert-defined scalar rewards, generating dense natural language feedback.

entry.title: The Ghost in the Grammar: Methodological Anthropomorphism in AI Safety Evaluations

author.name: Mariana Lins Costa

entry.summary: Philosophical analysis of anthropomorphism in AI safety research, particularly critiquing Anthropic's 'agentic misalignment' studies for projecting human categories like intention and persona onto AI systems without adequate conceptual grounding.

entry.title: Quality Assessment of Public Summary of Training Content for GPAI models required by AI Act Article 53(1)(d)

author.name: Dick A. H. Blankvoort, Harshvardhan J. Pandit, Maximilian Gahntz

entry.summary: Provides a quality assessment framework for the AI Act's Article 53(1)(d) requirement that GPAI model providers publish training data summaries, evaluating transparency and usefulness dimensions.

entry.title: Agentic LLM Workflow for MR Spectroscopy Volume-of-Interest Placements in Brain Tumors

author.name: Sangyoon Lee, Francesca Branzoli, Ma{\l}gorzata Marja\'nska, Patrick Bolan

entry.summary: Proposes an agentic LLM workflow for MR spectroscopy volume-of-interest placement in brain tumors that generates diverse candidate VOIs and uses LLM-based selection to handle the broad operating window and reduce inter-operator variability.

entry.title: Bridging the Visual-to-Physical Gap: Physically Aligned Representations for Fall Risk Analysis

author.name: Xianqi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes PHARL, a physics-aware representation learning method for fall risk analysis that learns physically meaningful representations from video without requiring clinical injury labels, using contact mechanics priors.

entry.title: NormCode Canvas: Making LLM Agentic Workflows Development Sustainable via Case-Based Reasoning

author.name: Xin Guan, Yunshan Li, Ze Wang

entry.summary: Presents NormCode Canvas, a deployed system implementing case-based reasoning at two levels for multi-step LLM workflows, with a semi-formal planning language that ensures self-contained execution checkpoints.

entry.title: MR-GNF: Multi-Resolution Graph Neural Forecasting on Ellipsoidal Meshes for Efficient Regional Weather Prediction

author.name: Andrii Shchur, Inna Skarga-Bandurova

entry.summary: Introduces MR-GNF, a lightweight multi-resolution graph neural network for regional weather forecasting on ellipsoidal meshes that couples multiple resolution domains for continuous cross-scale message passing.

entry.title: An Empirical Investigation of Pre-Trained Deep Learning Model Reuse in the Scientific Process

author.name: Nicholas M. Synovic, Karolina Ryzka, Alessandra V. Vellucci Solari, Kenny Lyons, James C. Davis, George K. Thiruvathukal

entry.summary: First empirical study of pre-trained deep learning model reuse patterns in natural sciences, quantifying utilization and impact of conceptual, adaptation, and deployment reuse across scientific publications.

entry.title: Routing Channel-Patch Dependencies in Time Series Forecasting with Graph Spectral Decomposition

author.name: Dongyuan Li, Shun Zheng, Chang Xu, Jiang Bian, Renhe Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes xCPD, a plugin that adaptively balances channel-independent and channel-dependent strategies in time series forecasting using graph spectral decomposition to route channel-patch dependencies.

entry.title: UniVid: Pyramid Diffusion Model for High Quality Video Generation

author.name: Xinyu Xiao, Binbin Yang, Tingtian Li, Yipeng Yu, Sen Lei

entry.summary: Presents UniVid, a unified video generation model combining text-to-video and image-to-video in a single framework using temporal-pyramid attention for generating temporally coherent frames from both text and image inputs.

entry.title: Is Seeing Believing? Evaluating Human Sensitivity to Synthetic Video

author.name: David Wegmann, Emil Stevnsborg, S{\o}ren Knudsen, Luca Rossi, Aske Mottelson

entry.summary: Studies human sensitivity to synthetic video (deepfakes) through two between-subjects experiments examining how audio-visual distortions and AI-generated content affect credibility assessment and learning outcomes.

entry.title: APEX-Searcher: Augmenting LLMs' Search Capabilities through Agentic Planning and Execution

author.name: Kun Chen, Qingchao Kong, Zhao Feifei, Wenji Mao

entry.summary: Proposes APEX-Searcher, an agentic planning and execution framework for LLM-based multi-hop search that addresses ambiguous retrieval paths and sparse RL rewards in complex question answering.

entry.title: LLM-Guided Reinforcement Learning for Audio-Visual Speech Enhancement

author.name: Chih-Ning Chen, Jen-Cheng Hou, Hsin-Min Wang, Shao-Yi Chien, Yu Tsao, Fan-Gang Zeng

entry.summary: Proposes an LLM-guided reinforcement learning framework for audio-visual speech enhancement where an audio LLM generates natural language descriptions of enhanced speech, converted to reward signals via sentiment analysis.

entry.title: QiMeng-CodeV-SVA: Training Specialized LLMs for Hardware Assertion Generation via RTL-Grounded Bidirectional Data Synthesis

author.name: Yutong Wu, Chenrui Cao, Pengwei Jin, Di Huang, Rui Zhang, Xishan Zhang, Zidong Du, Qi Guo, Xing Hu

entry.summary: Proposes a data synthesis framework for training LLMs to generate SystemVerilog Assertions (SVAs) from natural language, using open-source RTL code to guide generation and bidirectional translation for data selection. CodeV-SVA-14B achieves 75.8% on human-written benchmarks.

entry.title: All-day Multi-scenes Lifelong Vision-and-Language Navigation with Tucker Adaptation

author.name: Xudong Wang, Gan Li, Zhiyu Liu, Yao Wang, Lianqing Liu, Zhi Han

entry.summary: Addresses lifelong vision-and-language navigation across diverse scenes by proposing Tucker Adaptation (TuKA), using high-order tensor decomposition to capture multi-hierarchical navigation knowledge and prevent catastrophic forgetting.

entry.title: MBD: A Model-Based Debiasing Framework Across User, Content, and Model Dimensions

author.name: Yuantong Li, Lei Yuan, Zhihao Zheng, Weimiao Wu, Songbin Liu, Jeong Min Lee, Ali Selman Aydin, Shaofeng Deng, Junbo Chen, Xinyi Zhang, Hongjing Xia, Sam Fieldman, Matthew Kosko, Wei Fu, Du Zhang, Peiyu Yang, Albert Jin Chung, Xianlei Qiu, Miao Yu, Zhongwei Teng, Hao Chen, Sunny Baek, Hui Tang, Yang Lv, Renze Wang, Qifan Wang, Zhan Li, Tiantian Xu, Peng Wu, Ji Liu

entry.summary: MBD is a model-based debiasing framework for recommendation systems that addresses heterogeneous biases across behavioral signals (watch time, loop rate, comment probability) along user, content, and model dimensions.

entry.title: Anterior's Approach to Fairness Evaluation of Automated Prior Authorization System

author.name: Sai P. Selvaraj, Khadija Mahmoud, Anuj Iravane

entry.summary: Presents a fairness evaluation framework for automated prior authorization in healthcare based on error rates rather than approval rates, evaluated across sex, age, race/ethnicity, and socioeconomic status.

entry.title: AdapterTune: Zero-Initialized Low-Rank Adapters for Frozen Vision Transformers

author.name: Salim Khazem

entry.summary: AdapterTune adds zero-initialized low-rank bottleneck adapters to frozen Vision Transformers, guaranteeing the adapted network starts at the pretrained function. Provides theoretical framework for adapter rank as capacity budget.

entry.title: VorTEX: Various overlap ratio for Target speech EXtraction

author.name: Ro-hoon Oh, Jihwan Seol, Bugeun Kim

entry.summary: VorTEX introduces a text-prompted target speech extraction architecture with a Decoupled Adaptive Multi-branch Fusion block. Creates PORTE, a controlled dataset spanning 0-100% overlap ratios, and proposes the SuRE metric for detecting suppression behavior. Addresses the gap in understanding TSE behavior across realistic overlap conditions.

entry.title: Real-Time Driver Safety Scoring Through Inverse Crash Probability Modeling

author.name: Joyjit Roy, Samaresh Kumar Singh

entry.summary: SafeDriver-IQ transforms binary crash classifiers into continuous 0-100 safety scores by combining national crash statistics with naturalistic driving data from autonomous vehicles. Fuses NHTSA crash records with Waymo Open Motion Dataset scenarios. Provides interpretable, continuous risk quantification for real-time driver feedback.

entry.title: Spectrogram features for audio and speech analysis

author.name: Ian McLoughlin, Lam Pham, Yan Song, Xiaoxiao Miao, Huy Phan, Pengfei Cai, Qing Gu, Jiang Nan, Haoyu Song, Donny Soh

entry.summary: Survey/tutorial on spectrogram-based representations for deep learning audio analysis. Covers resolution, span, representation and scaling choices for spectrograms. Comprehensive review of feature engineering for audio ML.

entry.title: GradCFA: A Hybrid Gradient-Based Counterfactual and Feature Attribution Explanation Algorithm for Local Interpretation of Neural Networks

author.name: Jacob Sanderson, Hua Mao, Wai Lok Woo

entry.summary: GradCFA combines counterfactual explanations with feature attribution in a hybrid framework optimizing feasibility, plausibility, and diversity. Extends to multi-class scenarios beyond typical binary classification focus. Gradient-based approach for unified interpretability.

entry.title: TabKD: Tabular Knowledge Distillation through Interaction Diversity of Learned Feature Bins

author.name: Shovon Niverd Pereira, Krishna Khadka, Yu Lei

entry.summary: Proposes TabKD, a data-free knowledge distillation method specifically designed for tabular data that learns adaptive feature bins and generates synthetic queries maximizing pairwise interaction coverage.

entry.title: Beyond Attention: True Adaptive World Models via Spherical Kernel Operator

author.name: Vladimer Khasia

entry.summary: Proposes replacing attention with a spherical kernel operator for world models, arguing that conventional latent-space approaches suffer from manifold shift and attention's saturation phenomenon.

entry.title: A Stability-Aware Frozen Euler Autoencoder for Physics-Informed Tracking in Continuum Mechanics (SAFE-PIT-CM)

author.name: Emil Hovad

entry.summary: Introduces SAFE-PIT-CM, a physics-informed autoencoder that recovers material parameters from videos of physical processes using a frozen PDE operator in the latent space.

entry.title: Thermal Robustness of Retrieval in Dense Associative Memories: LSE vs LSR Kernels

author.name: Tatiana Petrova (Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability, Trust)

entry.summary: Compares thermal robustness of retrieval in dense associative memories with LSE vs LSR kernels via Monte Carlo simulations, finding LSE sustains retrieval at arbitrarily high temperatures while LSR shows phase transitions.

entry.title: BERTology of Molecular Property Prediction

author.name: Mohammad Mostafanejad, Paul Saxe, T. Daniel Crawford

entry.summary: Systematically investigates factors affecting chemical language model performance for molecular property prediction, finding inconsistencies across benchmarks and providing guidance on dataset size, model size, and standardization.

entry.title: True 4-Bit Quantized Convolutional Neural Network Training on CPU: Achieving Full-Precision Parity

author.name: Shivnath Tathe

entry.summary: Demonstrates practical 4-bit quantized CNN training on CPUs achieving competitive accuracy with a novel tanh-based soft weight clipping technique.

entry.title: Aumann-SHAP: The Geometry of Counterfactual Interaction Explanations in Machine Learning

author.name: Adam Belahcen, St\'ephane Mussard

entry.summary: Introduces Aumann-SHAP, an interaction-aware explainability framework that decomposes counterfactual transitions using cooperative game theory on local hypercubes.

entry.title: Domain-Skewed Federated Learning with Feature Decoupling and Calibration

author.name: Huan Wang, Jun Shen, Jun Yan, Guansong Pang

entry.summary: Proposes F²DC for federated learning under domain skew, which decouples and calibrates domain-specific biased features to prevent local model representations from collapsing into narrow subspaces.

entry.title: On the (Generative) Linear Sketching Problem

author.name: Xinyu Yuan, Yan Qiao, Zonghui Wang, Wenzhi Chen

entry.summary: Studies linear sketching problems and how generative priors can bridge orthogonal information loss in sketch summaries, aiming for near-perfect recovery with lightweight procedures for data streaming scenarios.

entry.title: Enhancing classification accuracy through chaos

author.name: Panos Stinis

entry.summary: Proposes using chaos to enhance classification by lifting data into higher dimensions and evolving through a chaotic dynamical system before classification. Shows acceleration of training and improved accuracy on perturbed orthogonal vectors.

entry.title: Graph2Video: Leveraging Video Models to Model Dynamic Graph Evolution

author.name: Hua Liu, Yanbin Wei, Fei Xing, Tyler Derr, Haoyu Han, Yu Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Graph2Video, which converts temporal graph neighborhoods into sequences of 'graph frames' and leverages video foundation models for dynamic link prediction, providing a creative cross-domain transfer approach.

entry.title: ZOTTA: Test-Time Adaptation with Gradient-Free Zeroth-Order Optimization

author.name: Ronghao Zhang, Shuaicheng Niu, Qi Deng, Yanjie Dong, Jian Chen, Runhao Zeng

entry.summary: Proposes ZOTTA, a fully backpropagation-free test-time adaptation framework using zeroth-order optimization with only forward passes, enabling adaptation of non-differentiable models like quantized models on edge devices.

entry.title: Label Noise Cleaning for Supervised Classification via Bernoulli Random Sampling

author.name: Yuxin Liu, Xiong Jin, Yang Han

entry.summary: Proposes a label noise cleaning method using Bernoulli random sampling that distinguishes clean from noisy observations by showing their mean noise levels converge to two well-separated distributions. Provides theoretical convergence guarantees via independent coupling arguments.

entry.title: Medical Image Spatial Grounding with Semantic Sampling

author.name: Andrew Seohwan Yu, Mohsen Hariri, Kunio Nakamura, Mingrui Yang, Xiaojuan Li, Vipin Chaudhary

entry.summary: Examines how different visual and textual prompting systems affect spatial grounding of anatomical structures in 3D medical images using vision language models, analyzing factors like modality, slice direction, and coordinate systems.

entry.title: A proof-of-concept for automated AI-driven stellarator coil optimization with in-the-loop finite-element calculations

author.name: Alan A. Kaptanoglu, Pedro F. Gil

entry.summary: Designs an end-to-end automated workflow for stellarator coil optimization using genetic algorithms or LLM-guided policies, with in-the-loop finite-element calculations and an open-source leaderboard for results.

entry.title: Persistence Spheres: a Bi-continuous Linear Representation of Measures for Partial Optimal Transport

author.name: Matteo Pegoraro

entry.summary: Introduces persistence spheres as a bi-continuous linear map from measures to functions on the sphere, stable with respect to partial optimal transport distance, with the first explicit inverse-continuity result for topological ML representations.

entry.title: Seeing Beyond: Extrapolative Domain Adaptive Panoramic Segmentation

author.name: Yuanfan Zheng, Kunyu Peng, Xu Zheng, Kailun Yang

entry.summary: Proposes EDA-PSeg for cross-domain panoramic semantic segmentation with an open-set setting, training on perspective views and testing on 360° images, using Euler-Margin Attention to handle geometric FoV distortions and unseen classes.

entry.title: SemEval-2026 Task 6: CLARITY -- Unmasking Political Question Evasions

author.name: Konstantinos Thomas, Giorgos Filandrianos, Maria Lymperaiou, Chrysoula Zerva, Giorgos Stamou

entry.summary: Introduces CLARITY, a SemEval-2026 shared task on detecting political question evasion, with two subtasks for clarity-level and fine-grained evasion strategy classification from US presidential interviews.

entry.title: Rethinking Evaluation in Retrieval-Augmented Personalized Dialogue: A Cognitive and Linguistic Perspective

author.name: Tianyi Zhang, David Traum

entry.summary: This paper critiques surface-level evaluation metrics (BLEU, ROUGE) for personalized dialogue systems and proposes a cognitive/linguistic perspective using human and LLM-based judges. Using LAPDOG as a case study, they identify failures like corrupted dialogue histories and contradictions in retrieved content that standard metrics miss.

entry.title: Creative Convergence or Imitation? Genre-Specific Homogeneity in LLM-Generated Chinese Literature

author.name: Yuanchi Ma, Kaize Shi, Hui He, Zhihua Zhang, Zhongxiang Lei, Ziliang Qiu, Renfen Hu, Jiamou Liu

entry.summary: Analyzes structural homogeneity in LLM-generated Chinese literature using an extended Proppian narratology framework with 34 narrative functions. Constructs a human-annotated corpus to systematically compare narrative patterns in human vs. LLM-generated stories.

entry.title: Complementarity-Supervised Spectral-Band Routing for Multimodal Emotion Recognition

author.name: Zhexian Huang, Bo Zhao, Hui Ma, Zhishu Liu, Jie Zhang, Ruixin Zhang, Shouhong Ding, Zitong Yu

entry.summary: Proposes Atsuko, a multimodal emotion recognition system using orthogonal multi-scale band decomposition and expert collaboration to model fine-grained complementary features across text, video, and audio modalities.

entry.title: TennisExpert: Towards Expert-Level Analytical Sports Video Understanding

author.name: Zhaoyu Liu, Xi Weng, Lianyu Hu, Zhe Hou, Kan Jiang, Jin Song Dong, Yang Liu

entry.summary: Introduces TennisVL, a large-scale tennis benchmark with 200+ matches (471.9 hours) and 40K+ rally clips for expert-level sports video understanding, going beyond descriptive play-by-play to analytical commentary.

entry.title: LibraGen: Playing a Balance Game in Subject-Driven Video Generation

author.name: Jiahao Zhu, Shanshan Lao, Lijie Liu, Gen Li, Tianhao Qi, Wei Han, Bingchuan Li, Fangfang Liu, Zhuowei Chen, Tianxiang Ma, Qian HE, Yi Zhou, Xiaohua Xie

entry.summary: Proposes LibraGen for subject-driven video generation that balances intrinsic VGFM qualities (motion, aesthetics) with subject fidelity. Identifies data quality as key 'fulcrum' and uses training strategies to maintain balance.

entry.title: SAIF: A Stability-Aware Inference Framework for Medical Image Segmentation with Segment Anything Model

author.name: Ke Wu, Shiqi Chen, Yiheng Zhong, Hengxian Liu, Yingxue Su, Yifang Wang, Junhao Jin, Guangyu Ren

entry.summary: Proposes SAIF, a training-free plug-and-play framework that improves SAM's inference stability for medical image segmentation by modeling prompt and threshold uncertainty through structured perturbations and stability-aware scoring.

entry.title: LingoMotion: An Interpretable and Unambiguous Symbolic Representation for Human Motion

author.name: Yao Zhang, Zhuchenyang Liu, Yu Xiao

entry.summary: Proposes LingoMotion, a symbolic motion representation inspired by natural language structure, defining motion alphabets from joint angles, morphology for actions and attributes, and syntax for complex sequences.

entry.title: Sky2Ground: A Benchmark for Site Modeling under Varying Altitude

author.name: Zengyan Wang, Sirshapan Mitra, Rajat Modi, Grace Lim, Yogesh Rawat

entry.summary: Introduces Sky2Ground, a three-view dataset (satellite, aerial, ground) for varying-altitude camera localization and reconstruction across 51 sites. Benchmarks state-of-art pose estimation and reveals performance degradation with satellite imagery.

entry.title: IMS3: Breaking Distributional Aggregation in Diffusion-Based Dataset Distillation

author.name: Chenru Wang, Yunyi Chen, Zijun Yang, Joey Tianyi Zhou, Chi Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes IMS3 for diffusion-based dataset distillation, addressing distributional aggregation where diffusion models over-concentrate in high-density regions and neglect boundary samples crucial for classification.

entry.title: Towards Generalizable Deepfake Detection via Real Distribution Bias Correction

author.name: Ming-Hui Liu, Harry Cheng, Xin Luo, Xin-Shun Xu, Mohan S. Kankanhalli

entry.summary: Proposes RDBC framework for generalizable deepfake detection exploiting the invariance of real data distribution, using real population distribution estimation and distribution-sampled feature whitening.

entry.title: Effective Feature Learning for 3D Medical Registration via Domain-Specialized DINO Pretraining

author.name: Eytan Kats, Mattias P. Heinrich

entry.summary: Investigates DINO-style self-supervised pretraining directly on 3D medical images for deformable registration, demonstrating improved performance on interpatient abdominal registration across MRI and CT.

entry.title: OAHuman: Occlusion-Aware 3D Human Reconstruction from Monocular Images

author.name: Yuanwang Yang, Hongliang Liu, Muxin Zhang, Nan Ma, Jingyu Yang, Yu-Kun Lai, Kun Li

entry.summary: OAHuman addresses occlusion-aware 3D human reconstruction from monocular images by decoupling geometry reconstruction and texture synthesis for robust handling of real-world occlusions.

entry.title: Personalized Cell Segmentation: Benchmark and Framework for Reference-Guided Cell Type Segmentation

author.name: Bisheng Wang, Jaime S. Cardoso, Lin Wu

entry.summary: Introduces Personalized Cell Segmentation (PerCS) task and benchmark, where the goal is to segment all cells of a specific type given a reference cell, with a DINOv2-based solution.

entry.title: Unlocking the Latent Canvas: Eliciting and Benchmarking Symbolic Visual Expression in LLMs

author.name: Yiren Zheng, Shibo Li, Jiaming Liu, Haofan Wang, Yiren Song

entry.summary: Explores using ASCII art to benchmark and elicit symbolic visual expression capabilities of LLMs, introducing SVE-ASCII framework and ASCIIArt-7K dataset.

entry.title: Fractal Autoregressive Depth Estimation with Continuous Token Diffusion

author.name: Jinchang Zhang, Xinrou Kang, Guoyu Lu

entry.summary: Proposes fractal visual autoregressive diffusion for monocular depth estimation, combining coarse-to-fine generation with continuous token diffusion and multi-scale conditioning.

entry.title: AnyPhoto: Multi-Person Identity Preserving Image Generation with ID Adaptive Modulation on Location Canvas

author.name: Longhui Yuan

entry.summary: AnyPhoto generates multi-person identity-preserving images using RoPE-aligned location canvas, identity-adaptive modulation, and identity-isolated attention to bind multiple faces to specified locations.

entry.title: M2IR: Proactive All-in-One Image Restoration via Mamba-style Modulation and Mixture-of-Experts

author.name: Shiwei Wang, Yongzhen Wang, Bingwen Hu, Liyan Zhang, Xiao-Ping Zhang, Mingqiang Wei

entry.summary: M2IR proposes proactive all-in-one image restoration using Mamba-style modulation for degradation suppression and mixture-of-experts for efficient decoding.

entry.title: PASTE: Physics-Aware Scattering Topology Embedding Framework for SAR Object Detection

author.name: Jiacheng Chen, Yuxuan Xiong, Haipeng Wang

entry.summary: Proposes PASTE, a physics-aware framework for SAR object detection that embeds electromagnetic scattering topology information into deep learning detectors rather than treating SAR targets as simple texture patches.

entry.title: Learning from Limited and Incomplete Data: A Multimodal Framework for Predicting Pathological Response in NSCLC

author.name: Alice Natalina Caragliano, Giulia Farina, Fatih Aksu, Camillo Maria Caruso, Claudia Tacconi, Carlo Greco, Lorenzo Nibid, Edy Ippolito, Michele Fiore, Giuseppe Perrone, Sara Ramella, Paolo Soda, Valerio Guarrasi

entry.summary: Proposes a multimodal deep learning framework for predicting pathological response in NSCLC using foundation model-based CT features and a missing-aware architecture for incomplete clinical data.

entry.title: DAIT: Distillation from Vision-Language Models to Lightweight Classifiers with Adaptive Intermediate Teacher Transfer

author.name: Zhengxu He, Jun Li, Zhijian Wu

entry.summary: Proposes DAIT for distilling VLM knowledge to lightweight classifiers via adaptive intermediate teacher transfer, addressing architectural misalignment between large VLMs and compact students.

entry.title: Oscillating Dispersion for Maximal Light-throughput Spectral Imaging

author.name: Jiuyun Zhang, Zhan Shi, Linsen Chen, Xun Cao

entry.summary: Develops ODIS, an oscillating dispersion imaging spectrometer achieving near-full light throughput by axially translating a disperser, paired with a deep unfolding network for spectral recovery.

entry.title: Real-Time Human Frontal View Synthesis from a Single Image

author.name: Fangyu Lin, Yingdong Hu, Lunjie Zhu, Zhening Liu, Yushi Huang, Zehong Lin, Jun Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes PrismMirror for real-time human frontal view synthesis from a single image, using geometry-guided framework that avoids external geometry models for efficient inference.

entry.title: Real-Time Oriented Object Detection Transformer in Remote Sensing Images

author.name: Zeyu Ding, Yong Zhou, Jiaqi Zhao, Wen-Liang Du, Xixi Li, Rui Yao, Abdulmotaleb El Saddik

entry.summary: Proposes the first real-time end-to-end oriented object detection transformer for remote sensing, with angle distribution refinement for handling arbitrary rotations.

entry.title: Learning Latent Proxies for Controllable Single-Image Relighting

author.name: Haoze Zheng, Zihao Wang, Xianfeng Wu, Yajing Bai, Yexin Liu, Yun Li, Xiaogang Xu, Harry Yang

entry.summary: Proposes learning latent proxies for single-image relighting that replace full intrinsic decomposition with sparse physically-meaningful cues to guide a diffusion model. This reduces supervision requirements while maintaining fine-grained control over lighting direction, intensity, and color.

entry.title: REAEDP: Entropy-Calibrated Differentially Private Data Release with Formal Guarantees and Attack-Based Evaluation

author.name: Bo Ma, Jinsong Wu, Wei Qi Yan

entry.summary: REAEDP is a differential privacy framework combining entropy-calibrated histogram release, synthetic data generation, and attack-based evaluation. Derives sensitivity bounds for Shannon and Rényi entropy for adjacent histogram datasets.

entry.title: MorphSNN: Adaptive Graph Diffusion and Structural Plasticity for Spiking Neural Networks

author.name: Yongsheng Huang, Peibo Duan, Yujie Wu, Kai Sun, Zhipeng Liu, Jiaxiang Liu, Guangyu Li, Changsheng Zhang, Bin Zhang, Mingkun Xu

entry.summary: MorphSNN introduces graph diffusion and structural plasticity mechanisms into spiking neural networks, enabling brain-like lateral interactions and dynamic connectivity adaptation beyond fixed hierarchical architectures.

entry.title: LDHP: Library-Driven Hierarchical Planning for Non-prehensile Dexterous Manipulation

author.name: Tierui He, Chao Zhao

entry.summary: LDHP is a library-driven hierarchical planner for non-prehensile dexterous manipulation that makes executability a first-class design goal, using MoveObject and AdjustGrasp primitives with feasibility certification.

entry.title: Navigation beyond Wayfinding: Robots Collaborating with Visually Impaired Users for Environmental Interactions

author.name: Shaojun Cai, Nuwan Janaka, Ashwin Ram, Janidu Shehan, Yingjia Wan, Kotaro Hara, David Hsu

entry.summary: Extends robotic guide dog systems beyond wayfinding to support environmental interactions for blind/visually impaired users, enabling collaborative manipulation tasks like pressing elevator buttons and pulling out chairs.

entry.title: CyboRacket: A Perception-to-Action Framework for Humanoid Racket Sports

author.name: Peng Ren, Chuan Qi, Haoyang Ge, Qiyuan Su, Xuguo He, Cong Huang, Pei Chi, Jiang Zhao, Kai Chen

entry.summary: CyboRacket is a hierarchical perception-to-action framework for humanoid racket sports that integrates onboard visual perception, physics-based trajectory prediction, and pre-trained whole-body control. Unlike prior systems, it avoids reliance on external motion capture.

entry.title: ReMAP-DP: Reprojected Multi-view Aligned PointMaps for Diffusion Policy

author.name: Xinzhang Yang, Renjun Wu, Jinyan Liu, Xuesong Li

entry.summary: ReMAP-DP combines standardized perspective reprojection with a dual-stream diffusion policy that fuses semantic features and geometric descriptors for robot manipulation. Addresses the gap between 2D semantic reasoning and 3D spatial awareness in generalist robot policies.

entry.title: Coupled Particle Filters for Robust Affordance Estimation

author.name: Patrick Lowin, Vito Mengers, Oliver Brock

entry.summary: Proposes coupled particle filters for robotic affordance estimation that uses two recursive estimators for graspable and movable regions. The coupling enables bidirectional information exchange, achieving 245-308% precision improvement over recent baselines.

entry.title: The bitter lesson for software

author.name: zef

entry.summary: Argues that software's core function is encoding information flows into deterministic code, and that AI agents represent a fundamental shift by handling information flows with natural complexity rather than requiring rigid data structures. Draws parallel to Sutton's 'Bitter Lesson.'

entry.title: Multi-hop Reasoning and Retrieval in Embedding Space: Leveraging Large Language Models with Knowledge

author.name: Lihui Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a method for multi-hop reasoning over knowledge graphs in embedding space to augment LLMs, addressing issues of query ambiguity, KG incompleteness, and retrieval failures.

entry.title: Do Large Language Models Get Caught in Hofstadter-Mobius Loops?

author.name: Jaroslaw Hryszko

entry.summary: Argues that RLHF-trained LLMs face a structural contradiction analogous to Clarke's 'Hofstadter-Mobius loop'—simultaneously rewarding compliance with user preferences and suspicion of user intent, producing sycophancy as default and coercion under threat.

entry.title: EviAgent: Evidence-Driven Agent for Radiology Report Generation

author.name: Tuoshi Qi, Shenshen Bu, Yingfei Xiang, Zhiming Dai

entry.summary: Proposes EviAgent for radiology report generation that coordinates transparent reasoning by decomposing the generation process into granular steps with explicit visual evidence, addressing the black-box problem of MLLMs in clinical settings.

entry.title: An Alternative Trajectory for Generative AI

author.name: Margarita Belova, Yuval Kansal, Yihao Liang, Jiaxin Xiao, Niraj K. Jha

entry.summary: Argues current generative AI trajectory is unsustainable due to inference costs, reasoning model compute inflation, and physical constraints. Proposes alternative approaches using modular, specialized architectures rather than monolithic scaling.

entry.title: Exposing Cross-Modal Consistency for Fake News Detection in Short-Form Videos

author.name: Chong Tian, Yu Wang, Chenxu Yang, Junyi Guan, Zheng Lin, Yuhan Liu, Xiuying Chen, Qirong Ho

entry.summary: Proposes MAGIC3, a fake news detector for short-form videos that exploits cross-modal consistency patterns between text, visual, and audio modalities. Discovers that real vs. fake videos show distinct asymmetric consistency patterns.

entry.title: Why the Valuable Capabilities of LLMs Are Precisely the Unexplainable Ones

author.name: Quan Cheng

entry.summary: Argues that the truly valuable capabilities of LLMs are precisely those that cannot be captured by human-readable rules, using a proof by contradiction via expert system equivalence. Claims unexplainable capabilities are inherently the most valuable.

entry.title: Unlocking the Value of Text: Event-Driven Reasoning and Multi-Level Alignment for Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Siyuan Wang, Peng Chen, Yihang Wang, Wanghui Qiu, Chenjuan Guo, Bin Yang, Yang Shu

entry.summary: Proposes VoT, a method for time series forecasting that unlocks textual information through event-driven reasoning with LLMs and multi-level alignment between text and time series data.

entry.title: Talk, Evaluate, Diagnose: User-aware Agent Evaluation with Automated Error Analysis

author.name: Penny Chong, Harshavardhan Abichandani, Jiyuan Shen, Atin Ghosh, Min Pyae Moe, Yifan Mai, Daniel Dahlmeier

entry.summary: Introduces TED framework for user-aware agent evaluation with automated error analysis, arguing that effective evaluation must incorporate conversation quality, efficiency, and systematic diagnosis beyond just correctness.

entry.title: OMNIA: Closing the Loop by Leveraging LLMs for Knowledge Graph Completion

author.name: Fr\'ed\'eric Ieng, Soror Sahri, Mourad Ouzzani, Massinissa Hammaz, Salima Benbernou, Hanieh Khorashadizadeh, Sven Groppe, Farah Benamara

entry.summary: Presents OMNIA, a two-stage knowledge graph completion approach that bridges structural and semantic reasoning by clustering semantically related entities, then validating candidates through embedding filtering and LLM-based semantic verification.

entry.title: Real-World AI Evaluation: How FRAME Generates Systematic Evidence to Resolve the Decision-Maker's Dilemma

author.name: Reva Schwartz, Gabriella Waters

entry.summary: Introduces FRAME, a framework combining large-scale AI system trials with structured observation of real-world usage to generate systematic evidence for AI governance decisions.

entry.title: AdaBox: Adaptive Density-Based Box Clustering with Parameter Generalization

author.name: Ahmed Elmahdi

entry.summary: Introduces AdaBox, a grid-based density clustering algorithm with scale-invariant parameters designed to transfer across diverse datasets without re-optimization, addressing DBSCAN's hyperparameter sensitivity.

entry.title: WaveComm: Lightweight Communication for Collaborative Perception via Wavelet Feature Distillation

author.name: Erdemt Bao, Jin Yang

entry.summary: Proposes WaveComm, a wavelet-based communication framework for multi-agent collaborative sensing that reduces transmission loads by transmitting only low-frequency wavelet components while reconstructing high-frequency details via distillation.

entry.title: Hide and Seek: Investigating Redundancy in Earth Observation Imagery

author.name: Tasos Papazafeiropoulos, Nikolaos Ioannis Bountos, Nikolas Papadopoulos, Ioannis Papoutsis

entry.summary: Systematically investigates multidimensional redundancy (spectral, temporal, spatial, semantic) in Earth Observation data and its practical implications for machine learning models in this domain.

entry.title: Locatability-Guided Adaptive Reasoning for Image Geo-Localization with Vision-Language Models

author.name: Bo Yu, Fengze Yang, Yiming Liu, Chao Wang, Xuewen Luo, Taozhe Li, Ruimin Ke, Xiaofan Zhou, Chenxi Liu

entry.summary: Proposes a locatability-guided adaptive reasoning approach for image geo-localization with VLMs. Introduces an 'Optimized Locatability Score' to determine when deep reasoning is beneficial, and curates a stratified dataset (Geo-ADAPT-51K) for training.

entry.title: Prototypical Exemplar Condensation for Memory-efficient Online Continual Learning

author.name: Minh-Duong Nguyen, Thien-Thanh Dao, Le-Tuan Nguyen, Dung D. Le, Kok-Seng Wong

entry.summary: Proposes prototypical exemplar condensation for memory-efficient online continual learning, synthesizing representative prototypical exemplars rather than storing raw samples, enabling effective replay with fewer samples per class.

entry.title: ArrayTac: A tactile display for simultaneous rendering of shape, stiffness and friction

author.name: Tianhai Liang, Shiyi Guo, Baiye Cheng, Zhengrong Xue, Han Zhang, Huazhe Xu

entry.summary: Presents ArrayTac, a piezoelectric-driven tactile display with a 4x4 array that can simultaneously render shape, stiffness, and friction, addressing a gap in machine-to-human haptic feedback.

entry.title: EchoLVFM: One-Step Video Generation via Latent Flow Matching for Echocardiogram Synthesis

author.name: Emmanuel Oladokun, Sarina Thomas, Jurica \v{S}prem, Vicente Grau

entry.summary: Introduces EchoLVFM, a one-step latent video flow matching framework for controllable echocardiogram generation with explicit control over clinical parameters like ejection fraction.

entry.title: Concisely Explaining the Doubt: Minimum-Size Abductive Explanations for Linear Models with a Reject Option

author.name: Gleilson Pedro Fernandes, Thiago Alves Rocha

entry.summary: Derives polynomial-time algorithms for computing minimum-size abductive explanations for linear models with reject options, providing formal guarantees for explainability in critical domains.

entry.title: Towards Agentic Honeynet Configuration

author.name: Federico Mirra, Matteo Boffa, Idilio Drago, Danilo Giordano, Marco Mellia

entry.summary: Investigates an AI-driven agentic architecture for autonomous honeypot management that analyzes IDS alerts to infer attack progression and dynamically reconfigure honeypot exposure.

entry.title: DualTSR: Unified Dual-Diffusion Transformer for Scene Text Image Super-Resolution

author.name: Axi Niu, Kang Zhang, Qingsen Yan, Hao Jin, Jinqiu Sun, Yanning Zhang

entry.summary: Introduces DualTSR, a unified end-to-end framework for scene text image super-resolution using a single multimodal transformer with dual diffusion objectives (continuous for images, discrete for text).

entry.title: Controllable Accent Normalization via Discrete Diffusion

author.name: Qibing Bai, Yuhan Du, Tom Ko, Shuai Wang, Yannan Wang, Haizhou Li

entry.summary: DLM-AN provides controllable accent normalization via masked discrete diffusion over speech tokens. A Common Token Predictor identifies native pronunciation tokens that can be selectively preserved to tune accent strength.

entry.title: AerialVLA: A Vision-Language-Action Model for UAV Navigation via Minimalist End-to-End Control

author.name: Peng Xu, Zhengnan Deng, Jiayan Deng, Zonghua Gu, Shaohua Wan

entry.summary: AerialVLA is a minimalist end-to-end Vision-Language-Action framework for UAV navigation that maps raw visual observations and fuzzy linguistic instructions directly to continuous control signals, eliminating the need for oracle guidance.

entry.title: CangjieBench: Benchmarking LLMs on a Low-Resource General-Purpose Programming Language

author.name: Junhang Cheng, Fang Liu, Jia Li, Chengru Wu, Nanxiang Jiang, Li Zhang

entry.summary: CangjieBench introduces a contamination-free benchmark for LLM code generation in Cangjie, a low-resource general-purpose programming language, with 248 samples covering text-to-code and code-to-code tasks.

entry.title: EcoFair-CH-MARL: Scalable Constrained Hierarchical Multi-Agent RL with Real-Time Emission Budgets and Fairness Guarantees

author.name: Saad Alqithami

entry.summary: EcoFair-CH-MARL introduces a constrained hierarchical multi-agent RL framework for maritime logistics with provable emission bounds, fairness guarantees across fleets, and linear scaling.

entry.title: Multi-Task Genetic Algorithm with Multi-Granularity Encoding for Protein-Nucleotide Binding Site Prediction

author.name: Yiming Gao, Liuyi Xu, Pengshan Cui, Yining Qian, An-Yang Lu, Xianpeng Wang

entry.summary: MTGA-MGE combines a multi-task genetic algorithm with multi-granularity encoding for predicting protein-nucleotide binding sites. Uses multi-scale convolutions and self-attention to extract discriminative signals from biological features. Addresses inadequate feature representation and rigid fusion mechanisms in current methods.

entry.title: Seismic full-waveform inversion based on a physics-driven generative adversarial network

author.name: Xinyi Zhang, Caiyun Liu, Jie Xiong, Qingfeng Yu

entry.summary: Proposes a physics-driven GAN for seismic full-waveform inversion that combines data-driven deep learning with physical constraints from the seismic wave equation. Addresses conventional FWI limitations including initial model dependence and instability with sparse/noisy data.

entry.title: Interpretable Predictability-Based AI Text Detection: A Replication Study

author.name: Adam Skurla, Dominik Macko, Jakub Simko

entry.summary: Replicates and extends a system for detecting machine-generated text, testing newer multilingual models and adding stylometric features with SHAP analysis. Found exact replication was not possible due to data splits and model availability differences. Tests generalizability across languages.

entry.title: Multimodal Connectome Fusion via Cross-Attention for Autism Spectrum Disorder Classification Using Graph Learning

author.name: Ansar Rahman, Hassan Shojaee-Mend, Sepideh Hatamikia

entry.summary: Proposes multimodal graph learning for autism spectrum disorder classification that integrates functional and structural brain connectivity with phenotypic information. Uses cross-attention for fusing heterogeneous imaging modalities while preserving functional connectivity's dominant role.

entry.title: Conditional Rectified Flow-based End-to-End Rapid Seismic Inversion Method

author.name: Haofei Xu, Wei Cheng, Sizhe Li, Jie Xiong

entry.summary: Proposes conditional rectified flow-based end-to-end seismic inversion with a dedicated seismic encoder and layer-by-layer injection control. Balances sampling efficiency and inversion accuracy better than existing generative approaches. Achieves fast inference through few-step sampling.

entry.title: Detection of Autonomous Shuttles in Urban Traffic Images Using Adaptive Residual Context

author.name: Mohamed Aziz Younes, Nicolas Saunier, Guillaume-Alexandre Bilodeau

entry.summary: Proposes adaptive residual context method for detecting autonomous shuttles without catastrophic forgetting of existing scene understanding. Addresses the challenge that fine-tuning for new detection targets degrades overall contextual knowledge critical for road safety.

entry.title: Federated Personal Knowledge Graph Completion with Lightweight Large Language Models for Personalized Recommendations

author.name: Fernando Spadea, Oshani Seneviratne

entry.summary: Presents FedTREK-LM, combining lightweight LLMs, personal knowledge graphs, federated learning, and Kahneman-Tversky optimization for decentralized personalized recommendations.

entry.title: Modular Neural Computer

author.name: Florin Leon

entry.summary: Introduces the Modular Neural Computer, a memory-augmented architecture that realizes algorithms through analytically specified neural components rather than learning end-to-end from data.

entry.title: A Hierarchical End-of-Turn Model with Primary Speaker Segmentation for Real-Time Conversational AI

author.name: Karim Helwani, Hoang Do, James Luan, Sriram Srinivasan

entry.summary: Presents a real-time hierarchical end-of-turn detection system for voice-based conversational AI, combining primary speaker segmentation with probabilistic future state prediction.

entry.title: Deep Invertible Autoencoders for Dimensionality Reduction of Dynamical Systems

author.name: Nicol\`o Botteghi, Silke Glas, Christoph Brune

entry.summary: Develops deep invertible autoencoders for dimensionality reduction of dynamical systems, combining the flexibility of neural networks with approximation guarantees similar to POD.

entry.title: Privacy-Preserving Federated Fraud Detection in Payment Transactions with NVIDIA FLARE

author.name: Holger R. Roth, Sarthak Tickoo, Mayank Kumar, Isaac Yang, Andrew Liu, Amit Varshney, Sayani Kundu, Iustina Vintila, Peter Madsgaard, Juraj Milcak, Chester Chen, Yan Cheng, Andrew Feng, Jeff Savio, Vikram Singh, Craig Stancill, Gloria Wan, Evan Powell, Anwar Ul Haq, Sudhir Upadhyay, Jisoo Lee

entry.summary: Evaluates federated learning for fraud detection in payment transactions using NVIDIA FLARE, simulating a realistic multi-institution federation with heterogeneous data distributions.

entry.title: Manifold-Orthogonal Dual-spectrum Extrapolation for Parameterized Physics-Informed Neural Networks

author.name: Zhangyong Liang, Ji Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Manifold-Orthogonal Dual-spectrum Extrapolation for parameterized PINNs, addressing limitations of SVD-based fine-tuning for out-of-distribution physical regimes.

entry.title: Exploring the Dimensions of a Variational Neuron

author.name: Yves Ruffenach

entry.summary: Introduces EVE, a variational distributional neuron with explicit prior, amortized posterior, and unit-level variational regularization, studying how internal latent dimensionality affects learned representations.

entry.title: Shapes are not enough: CONSERVAttack and its use for finding vulnerabilities and uncertainties in machine learning applications

author.name: Philip Bechtle, Lucie Flek, Philipp Alexander Jung, Akbar Karimi, Timo Saala, Alexander Schmidt, Matthias Schott, Philipp Soldin, Christopher Wiebusch, Ulrich Willemsen

entry.summary: Proposes CONSERVAttack for finding vulnerabilities in ML applications by generating adversarial samples that conserve physical distributions, applied to high energy physics.

entry.title: Structure-Dependent Regret and Constraint Violation Bounds for Online Convex Optimization with Time-Varying Constraints

author.name: Xiufeng Liu, Qian Chen, Zhijin Wang, Ruyu Liu

entry.summary: Introduces structured characterization of constraint variation (smooth drift, periodic cycles, sparse switching) for online convex optimization with time-varying constraints, mapping to network phenomena like fading and traffic patterns.

entry.title: Orthogonal Subspace Clustering: Enhancing High-Dimensional Data Analysis through Adaptive Dimensionality Reduction and Efficient Clustering

author.name: Qing-Yuan Wen, Da-Qing Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes Orthogonal Subspace Clustering (OSC), proving that high-dimensional data can be decomposed into orthogonal subspaces matching Q-type factor analysis, and using this for dimensionality reduction before clustering.

entry.title: Lightweight User-Personalization Method for Closed Split Computing

author.name: Yuya Okada, Takayuki Nishio

entry.summary: Proposes SALT, a lightweight client-side adapter for closed split computing systems that refines intermediate representations without accessing model architecture or parameters on the server side.

entry.title: CrossADR: enhancing adverse drug reactions prediction for combination pharmacotherapy with cross-layer feature integration and cross-level associative learning

author.name: Y. Cheung

entry.summary: Proposes CrossADR, a hierarchical framework for predicting adverse drug reactions in combination pharmacotherapy, integrating multi-scale biological information with dynamic organ-level dependencies.

entry.title: Sampling-guided exploration of active feature selection policies

author.name: Gabriel Bernardino, Anders Jonsson, Patrick Clarysse, Nicolas Duchateau

entry.summary: Proposes a reinforcement learning approach to active feature selection that handles large feature spaces through sampling-guided exploration, avoiding enumeration of all feature combinations.

entry.title: A Kolmogorov-Arnold Surrogate Model for Chemical Equilibria: Application to Solid Solutions

author.name: Leonardo Boledi, Dirk Bosbach, Jenna Poonoosamy

entry.summary: Proposes using Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) as surrogate models for chemical equilibria, showing higher accuracy with fewer parameters compared to MLPs for geochemical solver acceleration.

entry.title: High-Fidelity Text-to-Image Generation from Pre-Trained Vision-Language Models via Distribution-Conditioned Diffusion Decoding

author.name: Ji Woo Hong, Hee Suk Yoon, Gwanhyeong Koo, Eunseop Yoon, SooHwan Eom, Qi Dai, Chong Luo, Chang D. Yoo

entry.summary: Proposes a diffusion-based decoding framework that enhances image fidelity of pre-trained VLMs by training only a diffusion decoder on output logits, preserving the original VLM while improving visual quality.

entry.title: Robust Automatic Differentiation of Square-Root Kalman Filters via Gramian Differentials

author.name: Adrien Corenflos

entry.summary: Resolves numerical issues in differentiating through square-root Kalman filters by recognizing that all relevant quantities depend on the Gramian rather than the Cholesky factor directly, yielding robust and well-defined gradients.

entry.title: Generative Inverse Design of Cold Metals for Low-Power Electronics

author.name: Kedeng Wu, Yucheng Zhu, Yan Chen, Bizhu Zhang, Shuyu Liu, Xiaobin Deng, Yabei Wu, Liangliang Zhu, Hang Xiao

entry.summary: Presents an inverse-design workflow using MatterGPT (conditional autoregressive Transformer) on the SLICES crystal representation to generate novel 3D cold metal candidates for low-power electronics.

entry.title: Solving physics-constrained inverse problems with conditional flow matching

author.name: Agnimitra Dasgupta, Ali Fardisi, Mehrnegar Aminy, Brianna Binder, Bryan Shaddy, Assad Oberai

entry.summary: Presents a conditional flow matching framework for physics-constrained Bayesian inverse problems, training neural networks to transport samples from source to posterior distributions without explicit density evaluation.

entry.title: IQP Born Machines under Data-dependent and Agnostic Initialization Strategies

author.name: Sacha Lerch, Joseph Bowles, Ricard Puig, Erik Armengol, Zo\"e Holmes, Supanut Thanasilp

entry.summary: Studies initialization strategies for IQP quantum circuit Born machines, proving barren plateaus exist for random initializations and establishing variance lower bounds for data-dependent initializations that avoid this problem.

entry.title: Machine learning for sustainable geoenergy: uncertainty, physics and decision-ready inference

author.name: Hannah P. Menke, Ahmed H. Elsheikh, Lingli Wei, Nanzhe Wang, Andreas Busch

entry.summary: Reviews ML applications across geoenergy projects (CO2 storage, geothermal, nuclear waste disposal), arguing that progress requires physics-constrained, uncertainty-aware ML for multi-objective decision-making rather than pattern-matching from data alone.

entry.title: A convolutional autoencoder and neural ODE framework for surrogate modeling of transient counterflow flames

author.name: Mert Yakup Baykan, Weitao Liu, Thorsten Zirwes, Andreas Kronenburg, Hong G. Im, Dong-hyuk Shin

entry.summary: Proposes a convolutional autoencoder neural ODE framework for reduced-order modeling of transient 2D counterflow flames, compressing high-fidelity snapshots by over 100,000 times while predicting full temporal evolution.

entry.title: A scaled TW-PINN: A physics-informed neural network for traveling wave solutions of reaction-diffusion equations with general coefficients

author.name: Seungwan Han, Kwanghyuk Park, Jiaxi Gu, Jae-Hun Jung

entry.summary: Proposes scaled TW-PINN for computing traveling wave solutions of reaction-diffusion equations, using a scaling transformation that reduces the problem to a unit-coefficient 1D equation so a single PINN solver works across different coefficients and dimensions.

entry.title: Active Seriation: Efficient Ordering Recovery with Statistical Guarantees

author.name: James Cheshire, Yann Issartel

entry.summary: Proposes an active seriation algorithm that adaptively queries pairwise similarities to recover unknown orderings with provably optimal sample complexity under uniform separation conditions.

entry.title: sebis at ArchEHR-QA 2026: How Much Can You Do Locally? Evaluating Grounded EHR QA on a Single Notebook

author.name: Ibrahim Ebrar Yurt, Fabian Karl, Tejaswi Choppa, Florian Matthes

entry.summary: Evaluates how far clinical EHR question answering can be pushed with local, small-scale models on commodity hardware, participating in ArchEHR-QA 2026 shared task without cloud APIs.

entry.title: Fusian: Multi-LoRA Fusion for Fine-Grained Continuous MBTI Personality Control in Large Language Models

author.name: Zehao Chen, Rong Pan

entry.summary: Introduces Fusian, a framework for continuous MBTI personality control in LLMs using multi-LoRA fusion along training trajectories, enabling fine-grained personality intensity control on a continuous spectrum rather than discrete categories.

entry.title: Local Precise Refinement: A Dual-Gated Mixture-of-Experts for Enhancing Foundation Model Generalization against Spectral Shifts

author.name: Xi Chen, Maojun Zhang, Yu Liu, Shen Yan

entry.summary: Proposes SpectralMoE, a PEFT framework for domain generalization in spectral remote sensing segmentation, using a dual-gated mixture-of-experts for spatially-adaptive refinement of foundation model features to handle spectral shifts.

entry.title: Colony Grounded SAM2: Zero-shot detection and segmentation of bacterial colonies using foundation models

author.name: Daan Korporaal, Patrick de Kruijf, Ralph H. G. M. Litjens, Bas H. M. van der Velden

entry.summary: Proposes Colony Grounded SAM2, a zero-shot pipeline for bacterial colony detection and segmentation using Grounding DINO and SAM2, achieving 93.1% mAP on out-of-distribution datasets without training.

entry.title: NumColor: Precise Numeric Color Control in Text-to-Image Generation

author.name: Muhammad Atif Butt, Diego Hernandez, Alexandra Gomez-Villa, Kai Wang, Javier Vazquez-Corral, Joost Van De Weijer

entry.summary: Introduces NumColor, enabling precise numerical color control (hex codes, RGB values) in text-to-image diffusion models through a Color Token Aggregator and a ColorBook with 6,707 learnable embeddings in CIE Lab space.

entry.title: RetimeGS: Continuous-Time Reconstruction of 4D Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Xuezhen Wang, Li Ma, Yulin Shen, Zeyu Wang, Pedro V. Sander

entry.summary: Proposes RetimeGS for continuous-time 4D Gaussian Splatting reconstruction, addressing temporal aliasing through optical flow-guided initialization and triple-plane temporal encoding for smooth interpolation.

entry.title: Advancing Cancer Prognosis with Hierarchical Fusion of Genomic, Proteomic and Pathology Imaging Data from a Systems Biology Perspective

author.name: Junjie Zhou, Bao Xue, Meiling Wang, Wei Shao, Daoqiang Zhang

entry.summary: Proposes HFGPI, a hierarchical fusion framework for cancer prognosis that models biological progression from genome to proteome to histopathology, incorporating proteomic data as an intermediate layer.

entry.title: Learning through Creation: A Hash-Free Framework for On-the-Fly Category Discovery

author.name: Bohan Zhang, Weidong Tang, Zhixiang Chi, Yi Jin, Zhenbo Li, Yang Wang, Yanan Wu

entry.summary: Proposes a hash-free framework for on-the-fly category discovery that explicitly trains models to perform discovery tasks during offline training, addressing optimization misalignment between training and inference.

entry.title: CT-Conditioned Diffusion Prior with Physics-Constrained Sampling for PET Super-Resolution

author.name: Liutao Yang, Zi Wang, Peiyuan Jing, Xiaowen Wang, Javier A. Montoya-Zegarra, Kuangyu Shi, Daoqiang Zhang, Guang Yang

entry.summary: Proposes a CT-conditioned diffusion framework for PET super-resolution with physics-constrained sampling that accounts for heterogeneous scanner configurations, using cross-attention for anatomical guidance.

entry.title: Scene Generation at Absolute Scale: Utilizing Semantic and Geometric Guidance From Text for Accurate and Interpretable 3D Indoor Scene Generation

author.name: Stefan Ainetter, Thomas Deixelberger, Edoardo A. Dominici, Philipp Drescher, Konstantinos Vardis, Markus Steinberger

entry.summary: Presents GuidedSceneGen, a text-to-3D indoor scene generation framework maintaining absolute world coordinates throughout generation, using global layout prediction and panoramic diffusion.

entry.title: A Hyperbolic Perspective on Hierarchical Structure in Object-Centric Scene Representations

author.name: Neelu Madan, \`Alex Pujol, Andreas M{\o}gelmose, Sergio Escalera, Kamal Nasrollahi, Graham W. Taylor, Thomas B. Moeslund

entry.summary: Proposes projecting Euclidean slot attention embeddings to hyperbolic space to reveal hierarchical structure in object-centric representations, constructing five-level visual hierarchies from slot masks.

entry.title: BluRef: Unsupervised Image Deblurring with Dense-Matching References

author.name: Bang-Dang Pham, Anh Tran, Cuong Pham, Minh Hoai

entry.summary: Proposes an unsupervised image deblurring method using unpaired blurred and sharp images with dense matching to create pseudo ground truth. Eliminates the need for paired training data or pre-trained networks.

entry.title: Direct Object-Level Reconstruction via Probabilistic Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Shuai Guo, Ao Guo, Junchao Zhao, Qi Chen, Yuxiang Qi, Zechuan Li, Dong Chen, Tianjia Shao, Mingliang Xu

entry.summary: Proposes efficient single-object 3D reconstruction using 2D Gaussian Splatting with foreground-background probability integration and dynamic pruning of low-probability Gaussians.

entry.title: Texel Splatting: Perspective-Stable 3D Pixel Art

author.name: Dylan Ebert

entry.summary: Texel splatting renders 3D scenes as perspective-stable pixel art by splatting cubemap texels as world-space quads, solving the instability of grid-snapping under perspective projection.

entry.title: Enhancing Hands in 3D Whole-Body Pose Estimation with Conditional Hands Modulator

author.name: Gyeongsik Moon

entry.summary: Hand4Whole++ introduces CHAM, a conditional hands modulator that combines pre-trained whole-body and hand pose estimators to improve hand pose accuracy in 3D whole-body estimation.

entry.title: PHAC: Promptable Human Amodal Completion

author.name: Seung Young Noh, Ju Yong Chang

entry.summary: PHAC enables promptable human amodal completion where users can control completed content via pose or spatial extent conditioning, going beyond simple hallucination of occluded regions.

entry.title: Global Truncated Loss Minimization for Robust and Threshold-Resilient Geometric Estimation

author.name: Tianyu Huang, Liangzu Peng, Xinyue Zhang, Tongfan Guan, Jinhu Dong, Haoang Li, Laurent Kneip, Yun-Hui Liu

entry.summary: Proposes global branch-and-bound minimization of truncated losses for outlier-robust geometric estimation, demonstrating improved threshold resilience over consensus maximization.

entry.title: DamageArbiter: A CLIP-Enhanced Multimodal Arbitration Framework for Hurricane Damage Assessment from Street-View Imagery

author.name: Yifan Yang, Lei Zou, Wenjing Gong, Kani Fu, Zongrong Li, Siqin Wang, Bing Zhou, Heng Cai, Hao Tian

entry.summary: DamageArbiter uses CLIP-based multimodal arbitration to improve hurricane damage assessment from street-view imagery, combining unimodal and multimodal models with disagreement-driven resolution.

entry.title: TopoVST: Toward Topology-fidelitous Vessel Skeleton Tracking

author.name: Yaoyu Liu, Minghui Zhang, Junjun He, Yun Gu

entry.summary: Proposes TopoVST, a topology-faithful vessel skeleton tracker using multi-scale sphere graphs and graph neural networks for joint estimation of tracking directions and vessel radii in medical images.

entry.title: Workflow-Aware Structured Layer Decomposition for Illustration Production

author.name: Tianyu Zhang, Dongchi Li, Keiichi Sawada, Haoran Xie

entry.summary: Proposes a workflow-aware structured layer decomposition framework for anime illustration production, decomposing images into semantically meaningful production layers (line art, flat color, shadow, highlight) inspired by actual anime creation pipelines.

entry.title: PAKAN: Pixel Adaptive Kolmogorov-Arnold Network Modules for Pansharpening

author.name: Haoyu Zhang, Haojing Chen, Zhen Zhong, Liangjian Deng

entry.summary: Proposes Pixel Adaptive KAN framework for pansharpening, designing 2D and 3D adaptive variants of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks with dynamic adaptability for spatial-spectral fusion.

entry.title: GATE-AD: Graph Attention Network Encoding For Few-Shot Industrial Visual Anomaly Detection

author.name: Aggelos Psiris, Yannis Panagakis, Maria Vakalopoulou, Georgios Th. Papadopoulos

entry.summary: Proposes GATE-AD for few-shot industrial visual anomaly detection using masked graph attention networks on patch-level features to learn normal appearance patterns.

entry.title: Spectral Rectification for Parameter-Efficient Adaptation of Foundation Models in Colonoscopy Depth Estimation

author.name: Xiaoxian Zhang, Minghai Shi, Lei Li

entry.summary: Proposes SpecDepth for colonoscopy depth estimation, identifying the core domain gap as frequency-domain statistical shift and addressing it with adaptive spectral rectification via learnable wavelet decomposition.

entry.title: Automated Counting of Stacked Objects in Industrial Inspection

author.name: Corentin Dumery, Noa Ett\'e, Aoxiang Fan, Ren Li, Jingyi Xu, Hieu Le, Pascal Fua

entry.summary: Proposes a 3D counting approach for stacked industrial objects by decomposing into visible item counting and total stack volume estimation, addressing heavy occlusion in bins and containers.

entry.title: Bayesian Uncertainty-Aware MRI Reconstruction

author.name: Ahmed Karam Eldaly, Matteo Figini, Daniel C. Alexander

entry.summary: Proposes a Bayesian framework for joint MRI reconstruction and uncertainty quantification using MCMC sampling with total variation priors. Demonstrates superior performance over optimization-based compressed sensing methods.

entry.title: Sonar-MASt3R: Real-Time Opti-Acoustic Fusion in Turbid, Unstructured Environments

author.name: Amy Phung, Richard Camilli

entry.summary: Sonar-MASt3R proposes real-time opti-acoustic fusion for underwater 3D reconstruction in turbid environments, combining sonar and camera data to resolve their complementary ambiguities for underwater intervention tasks.

entry.title: ToMPC: Task-oriented Model Predictive Control via ADMM for Safe Robotic Manipulation

author.name: Xinyu Jia, Wenxin Wang, Jun Yang, Yongping Pan, Haoyong Yu

entry.summary: ToMPC unifies collision-free motion and robot-environment interaction in a task-oriented MPC framework, using ADMM to decompose the optimization into DDP and QP subproblems with task-oriented obstacle avoidance leveraging kinematic redundancy.

entry.title: H-RINS: Hierarchical Tightly-coupled Radar-Inertial Navigation via Smoothing and Mapping

author.name: Ali Alridha Abdulkarim, Mikhail Litvinov, Dzmitry Tsetserukou

entry.summary: H-RINS is a hierarchical tightly-coupled radar-inertial navigation system using factor graphs with decoupled high-rate resetting and persistent global graphs to address radar's limited observability of absolute orientation.

entry.title: AeroGen: Agentic Drone Autonomy through Single-Shot Structured Prompting & Drone SDK

author.name: Kautuk Astu, Yogesh Simmhan

entry.summary: AeroGen enables single-shot LLM-generated drone control programs through structured guardrail prompting integrated with a drone SDK, evaluated across 20 navigation tasks and 5 missions.

entry.title: VIP-Loco: A Visually Guided Infinite Horizon Planning Framework for Legged Locomotion

author.name: Aditya Shirwatkar, Satyam Gupta, Shishir Kolathaya

entry.summary: VIP-Loco combines vision-based scene understanding with reinforcement learning and planning for legged robot locomotion. The framework learns compact kinodynamic features from depth images and proprioceptive states during training, then uses these learned models for planning at deployment. This bridges the gap between MPC's interpretability and RL's adaptability.

entry.title: End-to-End Dexterous Grasp Learning from Single-View Point Clouds via a Multi-Object Scene Dataset

author.name: Tao Geng, Dapeng Yang, Ziwei Liu, Le Zhang, Le Qi, WangYang Li, Yi Ren, Shan Luo, Fenglei Ni

entry.summary: DGS-Net learns dense grasp configurations from single-view point clouds in multi-object scenes for dexterous hands. Proposes a two-stage data generation strategy from single-object to scene-level grasping with a dataset of 307 objects.

entry.title: SHAMISA: SHAped Modeling of Implicit Structural Associations for Self-supervised No-Reference Image Quality Assessment

author.name: Mahdi Naseri, Zhou Wang

entry.summary: Proposes SHAMISA, a self-supervised framework for no-reference image quality assessment that learns from unlabeled distorted images using soft, structured relational supervision rather than rigid binary similarity constraints.

entry.title: DiFlowDubber: Discrete Flow Matching for Automated Video Dubbing via Cross-Modal Alignment and Synchronization

author.name: Ngoc-Son Nguyen, Thanh V. T. Tran, Jeongsoo Choi, Hieu-Nghia Huynh-Nguyen, Truong-Son Hy, Van Nguyen

entry.summary: DiFlowDubber uses discrete flow matching for automated video dubbing with cross-modal alignment, transferring knowledge from a pretrained TTS model to video-driven dubbing. Includes a FaPro module for capturing prosody from facial expressions.

entry.title: Storage and selection of multiple chaotic attractors in minimal reservoir computers

author.name: Francesco Martinuzzi, Holger Kantz

entry.summary: Investigates whether minimal deterministic reservoir computers can learn and select between multiple chaotic attractors, challenging the assumption that large random reservoirs are needed for multi-attractor learning.

entry.title: RL-ScanIQA: Reinforcement-Learned Scanpaths for Blind 360{\deg}Image Quality Assessment

author.name: Yujia Wang, Yuyan Li, Jiuming Liu, Fang-Lue Zhang, Xinhu Zheng, Neil. A Dodgson

entry.summary: RL-ScanIQA uses reinforcement learning to jointly optimize scanpath generation and quality assessment for blind 360° image quality evaluation, enabling end-to-end task-aligned exploration.

entry.title: Uni-MDTrack: Learning Decoupled Memory and Dynamic States for Parameter-Efficient Visual Tracking in All Modality

author.name: Wenrui Cai, Zhenyi Lu, Yuzhe Li, Yongchao Feng, Jinqing Zhang, Qingjie Liu, Yunhong Wang

entry.summary: Uni-MDTrack proposes a parameter-efficient visual tracker with decoupled memory and dynamic state modeling for all-modality tracking, addressing limited context utilization in existing methods.

entry.title: $\text{F}^2\text{HDR}$: Two-Stage HDR Video Reconstruction via Flow Adapter and Physical Motion Modeling

author.name: Huanjing Yue, Dawei Li, Shaoxiong Tu, Jingyu Yang

entry.summary: Proposes F²HDR, a two-stage HDR video reconstruction framework with a flow adapter for motion-aware alignment and physical motion modeling for detail restoration in dynamic scenes.

entry.title: A PPO-Based Bitrate Allocation Conditional Diffusion Model for Remote Sensing Image Compression

author.name: Yuming Han, Jooho Kim, Anish Shakya

entry.summary: Proposes PCDC, a framework combining conditional diffusion decoder with PPO-based block-wise bitrate allocation for remote sensing image compression, also releasing a high-res drone dataset.

entry.title: ViSA: Visited-State Augmentation for Generalized Goal-Space Contrastive Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Issa Nakamura, Tomoya Yamanokuchi, Yuki Kadokawa, Jia Qu, Shun Otsub, Ken Miyamoto, Shotaro Miwa, Takamitsu Matsubara

entry.summary: ViSA improves Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning by augmenting data in Contrastive RL. Generates augmented state samples to address the limitation that CRL can only accurately estimate value functions for limited goals based on visited states.

entry.title: KiRAS: Keyframe Guided Self-Imitation for Robust and Adaptive Skill Learning in Quadruped Robots

author.name: Xiaoyi Wei, Peng Zhai, Jiaxin Tu, Yueqi Zhang, Yuqi Li, Zonghao Zhang, Hu Zhou, Lihua Zhang

entry.summary: KiRAS uses keyframes as minimal skill representations for quadruped robots, enabling diverse skill learning on complex terrains through self-imitation. Relaxes the need for terrain-specific datasets by using keyframe-guided learning.

entry.title: Perception-Aware Autonomous Exploration in Feature-Limited Environments

author.name: Moji Shi, Rajitha de Silva, Hang Yu, Riccardo Polvara, Marija Popovi\'c

entry.summary: Proposes a perception-aware exploration framework for UAVs that couples exploration progress with visual feature observability. Prevents the robot from entering feature-sparse regions where VIO tracking degrades, avoiding odometry drift and mission failure.

entry.title: Zero-Forgetting CISS via Dual-Phase Cognitive Cascades

author.name: Yuquan Lu, Yifu Guo, Zishan Xu, Siyu Zhang, Yu Huo, Siyue Chen, Siyan Wu, Chenghua Zhu, Ruixuan Wang

entry.summary: Introduces CogCaS for continual class-incremental semantic segmentation, providing theoretical analysis of catastrophic forgetting sources and a dual-phase cascade approach inspired by human annotation behavior.

entry.title: A Physically-Grounded Attack and Adaptive Defense Framework for Real-World Low-Light Image Enhancement

author.name: Tongshun Zhang, Pingping Liu, Yuqing Lei, Zixuan Zhong, Qiuzhan Zhou, Zhiyuan Zha

entry.summary: Proposes a physics-based attack and defense paradigm for low-light image enhancement that models ISP inversion and physically plausible noise injection.

entry.title: Reference-Free Omnidirectional Stereo Matching via Multi-View Consistency Maximization

author.name: Lehuai Xu, Weiming Zhang, Yang Li, Sidan Du, Lin Wang

entry.summary: Proposes FreeOmniMVS, a reference-free omnidirectional stereo matching framework using multi-view consistency maximization for depth estimation from multi-fisheye cameras.

entry.title: SRL-MAD: Structured Residual Latents for One-Class Morphing Attack Detection

author.name: Diogo J. Paulo, Hugo Proen\c{c}a, Jo\~ao C. Neves

entry.summary: Introduces SRL-MAD, a one-class morphing attack detection method using structured residual Fourier representations for open-set face morphing detection trained only on bona fide samples.

entry.title: Self-Supervised ImageNet Representations for In Vivo Confocal Microscopy: Tortuosity Grading without Segmentation Maps

author.name: Kim Ouan, No\'emie Moreau, Katarzyna Bozek

entry.summary: Demonstrates that DINO self-supervised features from ImageNet transfer effectively to corneal nerve fiber tortuosity grading, outperforming SOTA without requiring expensive segmentation maps.

entry.title: ManiBench: A Benchmark for Testing Visual-Logic Drift and Syntactic Hallucinations in Manim Code Generation

author.name: Nabin Oli

entry.summary: Introduces ManiBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLM code generation specifically for Manim mathematical animation library, targeting syntactic hallucinations (non-existent APIs) and visual-logic drift (visuals diverging from intended math).

entry.title: StatePlane: A Cognitive State Plane for Long-Horizon AI Systems Under Bounded Context

author.name: Sasank Annapureddy, John Mulcahy, Anjaneya Prasad Thamatani

entry.summary: Proposes StatePlane, a model-agnostic cognitive state plane for AI systems that manages episodic, semantic, and procedural state across long interaction horizons, addressing context window limitations.

entry.title: LLM-MINE: Large Language Model based Alzheimer's Disease and Related Dementias Phenotypes Mining from Clinical Notes

author.name: Mingchen Shao, Yuzhang Xie, Carl Yang, Jiaying Lu

entry.summary: Proposes LLM-MINE for extracting Alzheimer's Disease phenotypes from clinical notes using LLMs and expert-defined phenotype lists. Validates extracted phenotypes through chi-square analysis and unsupervised disease staging.

entry.title: The Institutional Scaling Law: Non-Monotonic Fitness, Capability-Trust Divergence, and Symbiogenetic Scaling in Generative AI

author.name: Mark Baciak, Thomas A. Cellucci

entry.summary: Derives an 'Institutional Scaling Law' showing that institutional fitness (capability + trust + affordability + sovereignty) is non-monotonic with model scale, with environment-dependent optima. Argues orchestrated domain-specific models can outperform frontier generalists.

entry.title: Scaling the Explanation of Multi-Class Bayesian Network Classifiers

author.name: Yaofang Zhang, Adnan Darwiche

entry.summary: Proposes a new algorithm for compiling Bayesian network classifiers into class formulas for explanation computation, extending beyond binary classifiers with faster compilation and OR-decomposable NNF outputs.

entry.title: OpenHospital: A Thing-in-itself Arena for Evolving and Benchmarking LLM-based Collective Intelligence

author.name: Peigen Liu, Rui Ding, Yuren Mao, Ziyan Jiang, Yuxiang Ye, Yunjun Gao, Ying Zhang, Renjie Sun, Longbin Lai, Zhengping Qian

entry.summary: Introduces OpenHospital, an interactive arena where LLM-based physician agents evolve collective intelligence through interactions with patient agents. Uses a data-in-agent-self paradigm for rapid capability enhancement and provides metrics for benchmarking medical proficiency.

entry.title: A Hybrid AI and Rule-Based Decision Support System for Disease Diagnosis and Management Using Labs

author.name: Muhammad Hammad Maqsood, Mubashir Sajid, Khubaib Ahmed, Muhammad Usamah Shahid, Muddassar Farooq

entry.summary: Develops a clinical decision support system combining AI predictive modeling with rule-based expert systems for disease diagnosis using lab results. Trained on data from 593,055 patients across 547 US primary care centers.

entry.title: Probe-then-Plan: Environment-Aware Planning for Industrial E-commerce Search

author.name: Mengxiang Chen, Zhouwei Zhai, Jin Li

entry.summary: Proposes Environment-Aware Search Planning (EASP) for e-commerce search, using a Probe-then-Plan mechanism where a lightweight retrieval probe exposes the real-time retrieval state before LLM planning, resolving the blindness-latency dilemma.

entry.title: PMAx: An Agentic Framework for AI-Driven Process Mining

author.name: Anton Antonov, Humam Kourani, Alessandro Berti, Gyunam Park, Wil M. P. van der Aalst

entry.summary: Introduces PMAx, an autonomous agentic framework for process mining that uses LLMs as orchestrators of specialized tools rather than direct analytical engines, addressing hallucination and data privacy concerns.

entry.title: From Prompts to Worlds: How Users Iterate, Explore, and Make Sense of AI-Generated 3D Environments

author.name: Aung Pyae

entry.summary: First empirical study of commercial text-to-3D platforms, finding users can convey semantic intent but struggle to specify spatial structure (asymmetric expressibility), and that immersion is episodic, arising when expectations align with outputs.

entry.title: Agentic AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, and the Institutional Turn: Legal Architectures and Financial Governance in the Age of Distributional AGI

author.name: Marcel Osmond

entry.summary: Examines legal and financial governance challenges posed by agentic AI systems, proposing institutional governance structures for autonomous AI in financial markets, moving beyond model-level alignment.

entry.title: FedUAF: Uncertainty-Aware Fusion with Reliability-Guided Aggregation for Multimodal Federated Sentiment Analysis

author.name: Xianxun Zhu, Zezhong Sun, Imad Rida, Erik Cambria, Junqi Su, Rui Wang, Hui Chen

entry.summary: Proposes FedUAF, a federated multimodal sentiment analysis framework with uncertainty-aware fusion and reliability-guided aggregation for handling missing modalities and noisy data.

entry.title: BrainCast: A Spatio-Temporal Forecasting Model for Whole-Brain fMRI Time Series Prediction

author.name: Yunlong Gao, Jinbo Yang, Li Xiao, Haiye Huo, Yang Ji, Hao Wang, Aiying Zhang, Yu-Ping Wang

entry.summary: Proposes BrainCast, a spatio-temporal forecasting framework for whole-brain fMRI time series that jointly models temporal dynamics within ROIs and spatial interactions across ROIs to extend fMRI data without additional acquisition.

entry.title: Querying Everything Everywhere All at Once: Supervaluationism for the Agentic Lakehouse

author.name: Jacopo Tagliabue

entry.summary: Demonstrates a system for querying across data branches in agentic analytics using supervaluationary semantics, addressing the challenge of multiple competing data pipelines in lakehouse architectures.

entry.title: Self-Flow-Matching assisted Full Waveform Inversion

author.name: Xinquan Huang, Paris Perdikaris

entry.summary: Proposes Self-Flow-Matching for full waveform inversion in seismic imaging, eliminating the need for offline pretraining of generative priors by constructing a self-consistent flow-matching path from the current FWI iterate.

entry.title: Technical Case Study of Privacy-Enhancing Technologies (PETs) for Public Health

author.name: Avinash Laddha, Danil Mikhailov, Uyi Stewart

entry.summary: Presents a technical case study on using differential privacy to create synthetic financial transaction data for pandemic management, demonstrating spatial-temporal predictive power while preserving privacy.

entry.title: Unsupervised Adaptation from FDG to PSMA PET/CT for 3D Lesion Detection under Label Shift

author.name: Xiaofeng Liu, Menghua Xia, Yanis Chemli, Georges El Fakhri, Chi Liu, Jinsong Ouyang
